Name: "Redwood"
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Used to be a martial arts teacher in Daermon. Military-grade. That was a LONG time ago, though. He's in it for the love of the art.
* Turns out, he was one of the only few that was. Nuts to this, he's leaving.
* Moved to Moteus to get some distance from the military. Closer to the forest, to nature. Tried to resume refining and teaching his craft.
* STILL too many people in it for the combat. Nuts to that, he's leaving AGAIN. Time to practice tai chi in the woods like a goddamn hermit, I guess!
* Moving west didn't work, let's try east. Rocade is still in touch with nature, and he DID like it colder.
* Mellowed out in the decades since. Took on the occasional pupil, Toph style. Mostly just living on the land, occasionally returning to Ardevor, sometimes up to Aberdon.
* Life's starting to get stale, though... Hm? Some young'uns went through the Runewall? And back? Hm.
* ... who the blazes is setting all these blazes? Don't make me get up outta my lil forest hut. You've done it now.
Birth Realm: The forests west of Ardevor, Rocade, Eurys

Name: "Trillion"
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Has served Kuzunoha since before the Maddening
- Was once a Witch of a great Circle
- His people have long since died, and he has markings of a demon
- Now seeks to restore Kuzunoha to her former glory
- Believes exercising pacifism is the way to do this.

Name: "adamai"
Backstory Bullet Points:
"Adamai was left and raised in small circus that roamed the nearby settlements,and elderly couple took him in the circus crew were always next to him being his beacon of hope,as he grew older he grew stronger then most average man,then started participating in the stunts and tricks trough out his youth,but the owner saw another potential in adamai,the owner tooked him fight in rings,and it paid well,sometimes adamai would come back hurt but would laugh it off as practice injury,yet one night adamai lost.

When he had woken up the owner had fled with all the fights and circus money leaving everyone desperate,yet adamai endured his wounds and straighten his resolve,he would fight again and again all the way to the top,and get it all back,not for him but for his family.
He would cross the runewall in search of more stranght,since he young tales of mighty creatures and endless tressure lied before the runewall 
In hope recovering all that was taken from his family and more, he advances.

Name: 45TON
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in a Cabre orphanage alongside his twin sister. Both displayed rare psychic affinity at a young age.

- As teenagers, they were recruited by Tubal & Cain to work as “Temps” — contract operatives for testing experimental technology and performing Soul Network infiltrations.

- The sister’s esper talents outpaced his own. The two became a reliable team for deep-dive missions and prototype testing however.

- During a classified trial involving a modified RWO device, a malfunction caused his sister’s consciousness to be trapped within the Soul Network. Her body survived, but her mind never resurfaced.

- Tubal & Cain used his sister to keep him on a leash. black ops missions that often would go wrong, leading to increasingly more augmentations.

- During one of their latest attempt to dive, a storm would engulf his apartment. Transfering him to the Worldhelm.

Name: A'shibah
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born the seventh son of a Hiear merchant family.
- Family was killed; but used his body to shield his twin brother, Levan
- Levan failed a ritual to revive the family, A'shibah took the consequence by making a deal with Akhir
- A'shibah promised his soul to oblivion, but Musta'khan managed to save him by binding the brothers together
- Now lives inside of Levan, sharing the same soul vessel
Sheet Link: [*"No one hurts my brother... except for me!"*](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/136lDqDNwMlPUoXgLkyJLYlqSFSXfNx9x0LwqPGY77g8/edit?gid=0#gid=0)

Name: ALEX ADDAMS
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Alex’s Father, Ressler Addams, worked for DHK in an unknown capacity; It was through this connection that DHK kidnapped Alex for their experiments. Whether or not Ressler was blacklisted, kidnapped as well, or just killed after or during the event is unknown.
• The experiments on Alex were to splice his and other creatures’ DNA with the attributes from a monster with mimicking properties. It was known as ‘The Janus Project’, a secret program they created with the intention of creating a brand new product for their customers to become dependent on: A complete body reformation… provided the product was applied daily, that is.
• After escaping from captivity- with some assistance from fellow experiment ‘Joey’- He and his new companion wandered the desert for a few months before The Saitos came across him and took him back to Haven. Wanting to pay them back, he decided to join The Saitos and help to protect Haven, eventually becoming a respected member and well known amongst the locals.

Name: AVA
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Ava is an Elden automaton, created for the purpose of entertaining an Elden Child. She and the Elden child regularly played pretend. Where she began to absorb the ideals of a heroic soldier.

-The Rapture came, and she was entombed in the chaos and destruction. Refusing to disobey her rules to wind herself up, she fell into a deep slumber.

-She was awoken by the New Empire, now truly believing her instilled values to be fact, she worked as a soldier under the new empire. Attempting to become a hero unknowingly chasing the goal she had before she lost her memories.

-During her service, she began to surpass the rules her creators had given her, becoming more independent. Even learning to wind her own mechanism.

-She was dishonorably discharged for disobeying her superiors orders to save more lives.

-Unable to comprehend her being discharged for doing the right thing, she joins the adventurer's guild, assuming proving herself would allow her to return to the New Empire in glory.

Name: Abaddon Throné
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Abaddon has no idea where he was born, but he was found in the streets of Veyrhold as a child, nearly seven.
- A woman from a local orphanage found him, and brought him in. While Abaddon has no memory of this time, according to the SIA, he killed a child he was bunking with at the age of ten. That's when the SIA took him in.
- Abaddon, since he was found, claimed he was a prince. He said had dreams of a throne of shadow. So, after the incident, the SIA started watching. He was first sent to a mental institution, but he escaped.
- His caretaker, Juvia Edina, found him first. Claimed to be 'one of his subjects' and came to 'bring him to his throne'. So, he followed. He was thirteen when he arrived at the SIA facility. 
- A lodging was provided for him. An open indoor space designed like royal chambers, just for him. He was placated, for now. Living under the SIA's watch for eleven years after.
- On one of his allowed walks through the city with answered a ringing payphone, and vanished

Name: Abigail Byrne
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Grew up in Snowmaw parents died raised by her grandmother

-Grandmother taught her magic and told her stories of the fae 

-As a teenager she grew to love nature and outdoors help out foraging for Helga’s shop

-Her magic grew as she got older she crafted a broom that made her and her alone capable of flight

-Bound her raven as a familiar with the aid of her grandmother

-Was a wilderness guide as an adult, in her latest trek she got caught up in a snowstorm that had a realmstorm hidden within and transported to the Worldhelm

Name: Absalom Kasand
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Stratford to migrant Leirsin parents
- Voracious learner, the type interested in learning a bit about everything
- Gloomy as a kid, was sensitive to the bad vibes his foresight gave, along with not having many friends because he tended to be around where misfortune struck
- Emotional state improved as he studied with the Disciples of Wisdom, feeling more secure about who he was and what his abilities did
- Nowadays acts rather perky, a little overcompensating but wants to stay optimistic in the face of adversity
- Picked up Spiritualist studies so that he could maybe help make things better when things went south
- Became eager to please the Beacon, and when the Beacon got desperate to send his disciples out for More Wisdom he signed up almost immediately
- One of those efforts threw him into researching the Runewall, he got lost and somehow wound up on a weird boat?

Name: Adelaide Cartwright
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Eldest daughter of a single mother who wants her children to have a better life than she had

- Is found to have a talent for Virelia, opening up possibilities for their family to escape their ill-fortune.

- In order to pay for Ada's entry into Galius Military Academy, her mother mortgages their estate. The family's hopes are pinned on Ada either earning prestige or marrying into nobility.

- Ada finds an unexpected opportunity for work from the Rehinsfel family, keeping tabs on their wayward daughter while she attends the boarding school.

- When that same daughter goes missing, Adelaide chases her and ends up swept into the Runewall

Name: Adelphel Durand
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Adelphel was initially a formless spirits that simply existed in nature until captured by a Necromancer to be used in a magical experiment for a subservient creation in the wake of recent disasters. They were augmented, altered and bound into a humanoid body, however all the changes caused instability in the magic and retained free will to act independently. Deemed a failure as a result.
- They have traveled throughout Kor'Tarion helping those they come across of all kinds when able without discrimination.
- They offer aid for many issues, from things like helping with a farm or defending people from life or death situations, doing so without want of reward in return.
- They appears to be a knight of some kind in attire but holds no real symbol nor claims any titles.
- They don't appear to have memories of their past, in a sense of they remember having parents and living in a nice village but nothing solid. The lack of past and memories causes them to cherish new meetings.

Name: Aelina Van Deivoet
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born to the once Royal House of Deivoet, Aelina is a third generation Lost. Her family having once been something of great import in their home realm, they have faded since becoming part of Ripplith.

-Her family is know for storm magic, the ability to summon and control the weather, which earns them a spot among the more noble houses of Ripplith, but under the High Queen.

-Aelina enrolls in the prestigious Gnosis Academy in Heartdom due to pressure from her Famiy and expectations placed on her as the next Matriarch of the house.

-She becomes part of the House of Treasures using her skills in magic to rise to near the top of her class before committing it the Rite of Arms, taking the form of a ring blade.

-Later, when about to commit to her Reagent  Caspian Riviera in the ceremony of Binding, she is rejected by him in front of the entire school. Afterwards she spirals, but is trying so very hard to build herself back up to be the Regalia she knows she can be.

Name: Aer Drasil
Backstory Bullet Points:
- **Heroic End**: Fell in battle defending her people against a relentless enemy.  

- **Arrival in Idyll**: Awoke in *Asga*, an afterlife of endless duels, trials of might, and warrior camaraderie—a paradise for her spirit.  

- **Corruption of Asga**: Peace was shattered as honor turned to madness, battles became depraved slaughter, and death tainted the hallowed fields.  

- **Becoming a Valkyrie**: Refusing despair, she took up her spear again, her indomitable will transforming her into a Valkyrie.  An Angel of Nimue.

- **Salmon’s Reach**: Found refuge in this sanctuary and became one of its protectors.  

- **Purpose Beyond**: With Vanagandr slain, Aer now must discover what her path is beyond her original aim.

Name: Aerah
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was born with a magical mutation that causes her voice to be volatile if uncontrolled, as such she was told not to speak.
- Due to an outburst she ended up accidently killing one of her bullies as a child and harming other.
- This lead to law suits putting her family into debt, which her mother tried to gamble to get out of.
- 777LC saw potential with Aerah's talents and offered her a job to help pay off her family's debt. This lead to her joining their Roller Derby circut that people bet on.
Quirk: Heirloom: Vocal Stabilizer - Flaw - When trying to speak or using abilities that require creatures to hear you this device may malfunction.

Name: Agata Nergath
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born in Hidela to Annalise Augustein and Milo Nergath. Annalise was a volunteer in the early Demon hosting process. It severely effected her health, as she died shortly after giving birth to Agata

- Agata managed to somehow inherit her Esper Abilities from her mother, purifying it into a demon of positive energy. 

- In her adolescence she had to live out in Hidela’s junkyard as her powers where uncontrollable and dangerous to those around her.

- When she was able to manage them, she returned to her father with an intense love of mechanics.

- after joining with the worldhelm she merged with her Demon, Agerion, to become a joined entity.

- she is the current custodian of the Font of Joy, a shard of positive soul network than she intends to use to heal the network at large.

Name: Aglovale of Cneldera
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born of an affair between Lady Sofie of the noble Dros family and an unknown Liersin
* Tail and upper ears removed at birth by order of the Dros patriarch to hide that she is half-Liersin, raised as a human
* In her youth she was plagued by nightmares, lesser versions of the Liersin's foresight that she did not understand, and at 12 was sent to the Order of the New Dawn
* She grew up, learned how to live with her 'episodes', awakened latent psionic talents, and became a knight of the order, receiving a fraction of the Longevity Stone's power from the Beacon
* There, alongside her brothers in arms, Vale has fought the losing war against the Calamity wherever they were needed
* When the New Dawn was called open to take part in an Expedition into the Runewall, Aglovale volunteered so that she might distinguish herself both to her Order and to her distant family

Name: Agrippa Molide
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Raised by a single mother working as a nurse, doing the best she can in North Rock
* Grew up watching Saturday morning cartoons, after-school specials, and wrestling matches on TV, all giving her a fanciful idea of ethics and values
* Inspired to eat her veggies, workout, and be a good person from those TV personalities
* This contrasts with her easy-going nature and affinity for junk food
* In an effort to follow her ideals, as well as help her mom pay bills, she joined the Terra Wide Federation
* Under the identity of the babyface wrestler **PUNCHRIOT**, she fights evil in the ring, while advocating healthy living to the children watching
* Has been experimented on, without her knowledge, by TWF doctors, to add to her strength in the ring
* Sent to the Worldhelm while lazing about at home, between two matches.

Name: Ai Xianyu (爱 纤雨)
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in a temple on the edge of the Skysea to a small family who wanted a strong, healthy daughter. As a bishi'e, Xianyu was heralded by the small community as one who would eventually become a cultivator, with ancient texts that survived the War Against Heaven scattered in the temple that detailed their feats and abilities throughout Wujing Guo. However, she had a defect in her eyes, filled with fog and darkness. Was this part of heaven's enmity...?

- She spent most of her life training and meditating, reading the texts and resonating with the land. She listens to the ancient echoes of techniques passed down from cultivators past. She becomes adept in Abyss Cultivation, pulling the qi from the land to overcome the impossible, to see, to sense clearly in the darkness of her sight.

- The pressure to perform to expectations became too strong. She heard whispers of an ancient vessel that arrived in Heaven's War. She went to locate this vessel, falling into a storm over the horizon...
Quirk: Hunted Emmisary (Boon of Auspicious Wisdom) (Curse of Heavenly Enmity)

Name: Aijing Minli
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Had a decent childhood, despite beeing a Bishè
- Eventually corrupt cultivators took notice
- His parents got sacrificed to further the corrupt cultivators power
- got taken in by Hengs master
- discovered he has an affinity for cultivation, but also healing. (with medicinal tools)
- found an aincent manuscript of the legendary alchemist Keng Sien-Seng
- stopped cultivating for a bit in order to fulltime heal people, eventually returned to it.
- got called onto the worldhelm while running away from corrupt cultivators
Birth Realm: Tian Yin | Wujing gao | Xuanwu City
Quirk:
Hunted Emissary
Boon of Auspicious Wisdom
(Divination)

Name: Aile Forrester
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Dancer / Spiritist / Chancer (LV6) 

* Born in Lastport 

* Parents died at young age 

* Raised by grandmother

* Grandmother was a philanthropist who aided in relief efforts due to the sea monster attacks on the town 

* Admires but feels inferior to her grandmothers legacy

* Danced at a young age and brought in patrons 

* Became a performer for The Butterfly House Theater

* Grandmother passed away from old age, leaving her the last of her family

* Became close with an adventurer named Heath and his siblings (One being Nutty's pc, Armou)

* Made a promise to explore the world with the three

* Heath went missing 

* Aile and Armou left the younger sister with a family friend of Aile's

* Met an old friend of Heath's named Hira (Linked to Lobsters PC, Hira )  and the three have now teamed up to find him

Name: Akahime Fuyumi
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Akahime, a serpentine yokai, has wandered the frozen land of Aldistir for nearly a decade guiding lost souls to their next destination.

- At the Grasping Tree, she found the Night Lantern: a glowing, chained staff that seems to comfort those who have succumbed to fear and marks her as a beacon for both the lost and the dangerous.

- As her presence began drawing attention, she trained to defend herself and protect the innocents she ferried from predators and vengeful entities.

- She encountered corrupted beings, especially draugr, and took it upon herself to cleanse them and guide them back into the soul cycle.

- Lost within a realmstorm, she found her way to the Worldhelm, where she embraced a greater calling—extending her duties beyond Aldistir to other realms.

- Now, she travels between worlds, learning their secrets and continuing her quiet mission: to protect, guide, and redeem the lost and the damned.
Quirk:
Heirloom:
The Night Lantern guides the lost—those whose spirits wander through the bleak blizzards where even Akahime’s sirenic voice cannot reach. Yet, the lantern’s light pierces through. Suspended from its chain at the end of her staff, it offers a sense of control, comfort, and quiet confidence to those nearby. In her hands, it becomes more than a beacon—it is a weapon, radiant and resolute, used to banish darkness in all its forms. Unfortunately, not everything the lantern attracts is friendly...

Custom Item: 
Base Form: Arcane, melee, [HR+7], [WIL + WIL], Transforming, Magic Defense Boost, Defense Boost, Damage type: Light
Transformation: Flail, melee, [HR+12], [DEX + WIL], Transforming, Accurate, Powerful, Damage type: Light
Rare Item Quality: Harmonious, Damage Change - Light

Name: Akai Katsumi
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Katsumi was born in Ogawa.
- From a young age, she had dreams of being a warrior and a cultivator when she would grow up.
- At the age of 14, she left her family home and made her way to the town monastery.
- She was disappointed by the lack of combat techniques taught, but decided to stay nonetheless to learn what she could about cultivation from the head monk.
- With time, she came to view the monastery's people as a second family, but her impatience also began brewing.
- at the age of 22 she left the monastery, intending on continuing her training alone, utilizing the basics she was taught and advancing them as best she could.
- Without anyone to direct her training, she could only focus on strengthening her body and refining the basics of breathing and meditation.
- One day, she fell asleep in her training spot and woke up to an encroaching realmstorm; with no time to get to safety, she was swept up to the Worldhelm.

Name: Akali Nubia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Daughter of Councilman Rabi Nubai

- Was taught all her life skills in order to inherit his position. Including use of the family heirloom.

- She always yearned to do something more, but relented due to the roles importance. 

- Outside of her fathers ear and sight, she typically hanged out with the locals. 

- Eventually was caught and then sent to become a student of the Order of the Sealing Sands. A place where many councilman came before and to keep a stricter eye on her.

- Eventually news of the expedition of the Rune Wall reaches the city. 

- In order to not seem small and weak before the other cities in Grestazs, they send some students of the college to the wall to join in their own expedition. Akail was involved in it and ventured with others into the storm.

- Made it to the Worldhelm where she has a chance to enjoy things without her father watching her.
Other Names:
Lady Nubai
Potential heir to Councilman Nubai's seat
Quirk:
Heirloom - Nubian Box of Crystals
This box, passed down by the many members of house Nubia. It is one of mystery. As no-one besides youngest member of the house can utilize this box. No other mage or power has been able to use this box besides members of this house. When a member of the house uses it, they are able to grab a number of crystals from it at random. It speculated that the crystals are to represent the Gaia crystals present within the world of Eurys. Though that is mere speculation and not confirmed. Regardless, when the right crystals are in the members hand. Magical effects tend to take place. Which may benefit them or make things worse for them.  

Flaw - Despite the box only able to be used by the youngest member of house Nubia, many greedy men do try to take it. Be it bandits that have heard of the treasure, merchants who wish to attempt to profit from it, politicians who wish to use the boxes powers, or warmongers who too wish to use the boxes powers for conquest.

Name: Akar Ceba
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Solitary Shepherd of his large flock of sheep
- Living in Paradise, spending time taking care of his flock, his home and friends and family, unaware of what is happening in the realm or the Sea as a whole
- Goes off to find a missing sheep one day 
- Finds it, but gets swept away by a Realmstorm and lands on the Helm

Name: Akiko
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Ishiyama, slave under the ruling Oni clans. Along with the other children of her village, she was delegated to the mines.
- As a teenager, her affinity for Fire Qi was discovered. One of the higher ranking Oni in the current ruling Oni clan, Junichiro, took Akiko to the Temple of the Rising Sun to put her to work as a smith in order to craft weapons and armor with the old broken relics littering the ruin.
- Years later, in the quiet of night as she cleaned the temple, Akiko stumbled into a hidden passage that led her to a room-  a shield split down the center, each half laying in a corner and casting a soft glow across the stones.
- Curious, she lay the two halves together, and in an instant the hopeless fog in her mind burned away. She grabbed a half in each hand and raced away from the temple, pursued by Junichiro into a thunderstorm and nearly tumbling off a cliff before being swept away in a Realmstorm.
Quirk:
Heirloom - Amaterasu's Relic Shield
Akiko has obtained two halves of one runic shield that was once a relic of Amaterasu. Though split in half, they still hold onto an echo of the magic they once had.  

Radiant Runic Half: [Runic Shield (150z)] + [Memorize (650z) Flare Spell]
Sanctuary Runic Half: [Runic Shield (150z)] + [Antistatus (500z) Poisoned Condition]

Susanoo's anger towards his ashamed sister chases these shields even across realms. Wherever these shield halves are, storms pursue. Upon Tian Yan, Susanoo's followers seek out this broken relic, and the pieces are a beacon to hungering Yokai.

Name: Akino
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Hanae, Akino always lived as an outcast due to their oni heritage.
- Was treated more harshly then most within Hanae, but regardless they kept their kindness
- Was raised by one person who lived within the outskirts. A non-yokai folk who was simply just kind. Over time they taught them Sun cultivation as she fostered heavenly qi.
- Read tales of the  past involving the gods. Specifically about Amaterasu. Which she grew curious about.
- She dreamed of wanting to bring back the light to the skies in anyway possible. Despite how impossible such a goal may be.
- She wished to accomplish her dream. Sadly she could only stay at home.
- Regardless she wished to accomplish it by giving mercy to all. No matter what. Even if it was irredeemable. She had to try atleast once. As she believed the sun should be comforting and merciful to all.
- And if she wanted to do her dream, she needed to imitate its merciful warmth
- While thinking about her dream, a realmstorm took her away.
Quirk: Qi Specialist - Heavenly (Light) - Order Rituals - Vulnerability: Dark (Demonic)

Name: Alan Reverie
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Alan was born blind; tried to learn self-defense regardless
- Actually got somewhat decent at maneuverability with a shield
- The Night of the Red Sky happens
- Against parental judgment, Alan tries his darndest to fend off monsters, with a big shield
- Does surprisingly well; still fails and gets knocked into coma
- Though Midholde inevitably gets destroyed in the ensuing Night, Alan's effort does earn him the favor of Qilin, whom he is bound to
- Alan wakes up, miraculously alive
- Being bound to Qilin gives heightened awareness, which helps further accommodate his natural blindness
- Being bound to Qilin via violently-induced coma makes him sleepy as a chronic trauma response

Name: Alaska Vertigo
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Experimental LUA backup of a Lorel.AI software engineer, intended to be brought online in the event of the original's death.
- Circumstances under which she was *actually* brought online are still unknown, as is what she did immediately after.
- First thing she remembers is rebooting on the floor of an abandoned gas station in Central, connected to a bunch of probably stolen hardware.
- All memory files between that and initially coming online are corrupted.
- Quickly finds out she's also a fugitive.
- Goes to ground and ends up doing work for shadier individuals to pay for maintenance, using her expertise with the soul network.
- Gnawing questions in the back of her head about who she is and what she was doing before the entire time.
- Eventually gets wrapped up in escapades of some Goldhearted, and jumps at the chance to get on board the Worldhelm and evade Terra's authorities longer-term.

Name: Albreich Surtova
Backstory Bullet Points:
✦He was born to a family of knights in Brightshield and raised to become one in the future.

✦For many years he aspired to become a knight of great renown but as he became more familiar with their work he became disillusioned with the ideas of chivalry and whatnot that they touted so proudly.

✦Before he was to be knighted, he departed for Tradefair, From that day forth he would serve his own interests rather than the crown's.

✦Life outside the capital was rough and he would struggle to make do without the luxuries he could once afford. He would get used to it with time but he would miss the comfort of his old bed from time to time.

✦Two years after his departure he would join the Golden Claw Mercenaries. In them he saw what the knights of Brightshield should have been and though he lathes to acknowledge it, the flickering embers of chivalry would start to ignite in his heart.

Name: Alder
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Lived primarily within his mother's domain with his nomadic peoples, the Deerfolk, following the guidance of the elementals through a Hearer, nurturing life in the process. 
- Before he showed up on the Worldhelm, he was suddenly, mysteriously, shunted out of the domain, and can't find his way back or his family.
- His mother was part of the Spring Court and managed to get in Caladrius' favor to bestow some of his power on Alder to protect him. (he doesn't know this)

Name: Alec Lyon
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a working class family in Babyl City, Dawnstar Valley.
- Has a natural gift of controlling light and spiritual magic.
- Attended school normally, where he met and befriended Mae Lavery who was a grade year above him.
- Enrolled into a NTTech college that focuses on training mages, and hiring them after. He started working as a magic detective after graduating.
- Due to budget reasons, ended up moving into an apartment with Mae about 3 years prior. Then eventually formed a romantic relationship with her.
- 1 year prior to today, Mae Lavery suffered a tragic accident and died. Then she became an Insolvent with a debt over her head. Doing their best to live with the circumstances.
- Thanks to the use of his own spiritual magic and martial training, he was able to successfully mitigate casualties during the events of the Skyfall. Soon leading him to arrive on the Worldhelm, becoming a Goldhearted.

Name: Alexander Romani
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and Raised in Mount Providence having a passion for classical songs by hearing it from a radio

- Passed away due to illness before he could get a proper start in the singing industry and became an insolvent due loans from education as well as equipment

- After almost a decade of trying to pay the debt off working entry level jobs in Central, Alexander moved back to Mount Providence almost ready to give up and become a ghoul.

- Instead his passion for the classical music reignites as he a found a old oprea piece and sang his heart out.

- With a new sense of duty he goes out to abandon buildings and churches to find more pieces like the one he found that day to preserve them so that others can still listen

- Currently works at a SWORD affiliated branch at the Fortune Valley Casino where he entertains guests with songs and help remix classic sheet music for SWORD to reuse in their products.

- Got picked up by the realmstorm when scavenging for more antiques

Name: Alexandra Stuart Lancastrian
Backstory Bullet Points:
"* Born to the Prestigious Lancastrian Noble Family. Her father, Charles, is a Mid level Noble in charge of administration of one of the larger Imperial Provinces

* Was always a brilliant girl, and to many considered a Prodigy. 

* Joined the military on her 18th birthday.

* At 25, she was placed as part of the Sky Service, working on the Vigilant Watch to hunt down people who Violate the Delver's Code.

* Six months ago, upon the retirement of her Captain, Johannes Kranston, she was promoted to Captain.

* Two months ago, a confrontation with Charlotte Morgan caused a stir as Charlotte was briefly put under custody. This led to decommission of the ship and her being placed under leave.

* With her ship donated to the Adventurer's Guild, she followed the ship and agreed to join on the condition that she is allowed to keep control of her ship.

Name: Alexei Volka
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Alexei grew up in his parent's tower, a day's or so journey out from Grey Fox Castle
- His father is a graduate of Gnosis academy, his mom is a necromancer/dark mage that was formerly a member of Ursakk's Hoard
- In his teens, their tower got attacked by members of Ursakk's Hoard, during which he got magically shunted to a random part of Dreadlan
- He got picked up by a roving band of vagabonds and lived with them for some months, until his parents eventually found him
- Turns out his dad had died during the attack, his mom had then revived his dad using advanced necromancy and now he's back to normal (minus the undeath). Think something along the lines of a Paladin-y lich maybe? A Death Knight? A strong revenant? Yea.
- The group that took him in was invited to settle at the tower, having built a couple houses around it by now where they live.
- Eventually, Alexei enters the academy after convincing his parents to let him. He excels at written exams, but Teamwork is a big weak point

Name: Alice Aschenwald
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in a poor family outside of Reven.
- Passes a magic test from a visiting sorcerer.
- Get's an apprenticeship at Bennigsen Military Academy as a mage.
- Magic too unstable, bad grades ensue.
- Teacher Erasmus Bonafide takes her and her friend, Brenno, under his wing.
- Manipulates them into being his experiments, implanting crystals on them and playing with their minds.
- Brenno is brainwashed to kill her parents to make them fight.
- Parents are dead, they fight, but Alice makes him wake up for a second.
- Brenno dissappears.
- Alice runs away from Delsatz to get away from Erasmus.
- Heads into Runewall as she had nothing left to lose.

Name: Alira Spector
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up constantly doubting the world around her
- Studied in Korala in the School of Physics, specializing in optics
  - Came into trouble with the authorities after kicking up a fuss about a news article she found to be bogus, quieting her in regards to politics
- Graduated with flying colors and becomes a professor in Korala
- Becomes disgruntled due to academia placing their focus towards military application
- Meets a gifted student named Polli Magnic who becomes like a daughter to her
  - Takes Polli under her wing, instilling her values into the girl
- The two work together on prototypes for a holographic projector and hard light tools
- Polli disappears after exposing the son of a military official's misdeeds
- Loses faith in the Academia, escaping with their work before the Empire can get their hands on it
- Almost gets captured; ends up in the Worldhelm right before she can be
  - Rededicated to the truth, she now strives to find Polli and uncover the Empire's lies
Other Names: Professor of Optics With a Masters in Illumination

Name: Alistair
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in Snowmaw.
* Was never really gifted enough to do much in his life.
* Managed to work hard and open up a little coffee and tea shop/library/place to chat. 
* Didn't see a lot of business, but did well enough to keep going.
* Had many conversations over the years with adventurers and harbored a secret wish to be one.
* Spent 40 years lending an open ear and a welcoming heart to the community, helping when they can to whoever - and he means whoever.
* On his 63rd birthday, he suddenly developed psychic powers. 
* Unknowingly, he had made a deal with a Fey visiting his shop. They would share their powers until Alistair turned 70, then the Faerie would have the rest of his life.
* At the urging of his employee, Alistair leaves the tea shop to them and retires... into a new life of adventure.

Name: Alois Wagner
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born an ambitious boy in Markensburg with a magical talent and a burning desire to improve his skills. Parents were supportive of it.

- Pulled by the desire stone into the cave and guided to it. Touching it and revealing his truest desire, his mind repressing the memories to prevent him from going mad. He remembers the feeling of contentment.

- Is carried out of the cave unconscious by the Desire Beacon, who introduces him to the new gem embedded in his eye, marking him as an Heir.

- He returns to his parents and they still accepted him, he felt a shred of contentment, but they tried to ensure that his new power and path never consumed him. 

- When he was in his late adolescents, he came back to his house to find his family killed and his house burnt to the ground. Going to the Desire Beacon.

- He swore his desire was to find those responsible and get his vengeance, became an agent of the Desire Beacon.

- Went to the expedition as an agent of Desire gathering information.

Name: Alwyn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Is a up and coming sky pirate, captain of his own ship (He's the only member.)

- Born from a Merchant's family, he tried being a merchant but eventually was kidnapped by Sky Pirates and then rescued by Privateers known as the Red Roses.

- Became a Privateer and had a mentor/mentee relationship with the captian, Kaivont Ruber. Kaivont was killed by a noble who was using criminals to expand his influence. Taking their old ship, he was given a bounty for the death of Kaivont and his crew.

- Is currently seeking the "Greatest Treasure in the World". What it is, he has no idea.

Name: Alysone The Shadow
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Orphaned at a young age due to the war.
- Joined the military when she hit recruitment age.
- Slowly defected over the years in Markensburg until becoming part of ex-military bandits outside the city.
- Cursed by a dying witch whom she and her band killed, scarring her face.
- Attempted to settle down after the curse and start a family, but husband was murdered and son kidnapped.
- Failing to find her son, she has decided to travel and enter the Runewall to die in the realm storm.
Quirk:
Cursed To A Life of Restlessness
When Alysone experiences heightened emotions, is vulnerable or intimate with others, the curse causes her a jolt of pain and intense anger which has caused her to physically lash out at others or at objects near her.
The curse can be lifted, but because of Alysone's violent outbursts, she is denied help on Eurys.

Name: Alyx Fauxmont
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Alyx was the well-loved only child of the Fairmont merchant family in Markensburg, Wulforh. 
- Spoiled and secure, she was taught to ignore the struggles of others, but rumors of heroes risking life and limb across Eurys gnawed at her conscience. Every head turned for coin fed a growing resentment: life had to mean more than just cashing in Zenit, didn't it?
- Reaching her breaking point, she claimed she was traveling to Pragstenburg to study, but instead began moving across Eurys delivering much needed wares to those struck hardest by the calamity. 
- Meeting heroes inspired her. Giving them respite brought her great pride.
- Things changed when she came upon a strange creature in Grestazs. It longed for a home, somewhere beyond the Runewall. If she didn’t help, who would? After all, a merchant truly is a weary traveler’s best friend.

Name: Amaranth
Backstory Bullet Points:
In a remote corner of the Prosperity Plains in Wulforh, a cruel bandit leader that had recently escaped a battle fell, and succumbed to their injuries. 

The bandit's body laid there for days, unnoticed by all, save for a strange magical beast who would stop by periodically to eat the insects in the area.

Grain began to grow at the site, infused with the magic of prosperity. It grew through and around the body, suffusing it with magical energy, until a new consciousness had formed in the body, fused with the magical plants.

With no knowledge of the world they were just born into, Amaranth rose from their place in the ground, and began wandering Eurys, with the strange beast following them close behind.

Name: Amber
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born in Hedgeburg
-Went to Korala to study medicine
-Met wife Cassandra in Acadamy
-After war began, had her daughter Jessica
-Left wife after disagreeing over where their help was needed
-Moved to Pikeway with Jessica.
-Moved again to Ionian Village a few years after Vale's destruction
-Opened a clinic in Ionian Village
-Her daughter runs away from home after a fight (about a month ago)
-Caught in a realmstorm while she was searching for her daughter

Name: Amelia Green
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was born in North Rock and had an uneventful life, coming from two hardworking, low-income parents.
- Taking a leap as a young adult, she took out some loans to begin her college education, reasoning that she could surely pay it off once she found a proper career after graduation.
- After graduating, her friends treated her out to celebrate. Being as ecstatic as she was, she overindulged and died that night due to alcohol poisoning. This also soured many of her friendships once she returned as an Insolvent.
- She spent the last 5 years trying to live a normal life, having found an entry-level journalist position for one of Galeforce's smaller newspaper subsidiaries and struggling to move up in the company.

Name: Amelie d'Artois
Backstory Bullet Points:
- born to the noble d'Artois family, which governed over a small stretch of land at the border to Rocade in Silverdale
- the family fell out of public favor soon after Amelie's birth and Amelie and her mother were driven out of the country, the fate of her father and brothers unknown to her
- Amelie and her mother moved to Lithos in Rocade, where she continued to grow up
- Her mother eventually fell sick, succumbing to her illness, but not before Amelie joined the druidic circle surrounding the Beacon of Longevity, which had cared for her mother
- she continued her druidic training over the years before eventually returning to the border to Silverdale, this time as one of the guardian's of Ardevor
- some time later, while protecting the town from a wave of spirits that had been driven insane, she was inflicted with a crystallized form of that madness 
- the druids fashioned a pair of manacles for her, which prevents the worst of  the curses effects, though it also bars her from much...
Quirk:
Cursed

Amelie is inflicted with the same maddening magic that the spirits of Rocade are suffering from. A set of manacles staves off the effects to a large extent, but it also bars her from successfully interacting with anything related to souls (Anima).

Name: Amina Grace
Backstory Bullet Points:
In the ancient history of Terra, the Grace clan of Providentists, known for their extreme magical aptitude for fortune telling and divination, were faced with a calamity that they didn't have the capability to endure. They used their divination to search for a solution, and in the future, encountered a shadowy cabal who would inform them of how to avoid their fate, in exchange for the life of one of their descendants in the modern day.

They agreed, and in modern Terra, Amina, the clan's only known heir and practitioner of their ancient magic and traditions, was caught in an elaborate plot that required her to either forfeit her life, or become Insolvent, and lend her talents to ETA, the cabal her ancestors had made the pact with.

Accepting her new fate under ETA, Amina began using her magic in service of the company, lending her abilities in secret to other Terran citizens in hope of offsetting some of the harm she had done. This desire for good eventually ledher to the Worldhelm.

Name: Anahi Tanglao
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Anahi was born with the "will of ONE fallen Goldhearted" who died during the War on Heaven with regrets. This manifested with a bad/dead eye as a child.
- She grew up in her village w/ parents, friends, community happy until she was 12 and discovered she was a wood cultivator
- By 13 she left to train with Arjo Caringal, an earth cultivator, in the Tikba forests for over a decade before protecting her village for several years. 
- On one trip out, for old time's sake with Arjo, she encountered a beast that awoke, native to Mainland China. Her bad eye glowed gold now. 
- When she asked a village elder, Seer Patu, about it, she directed her to a realmstorm to the north where Anahi got sucked up to the Worldhelm.

Name: Anais Penelle
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Borne to the town of Stalmer, she was left to the previous town's witch Ingrid in the dead of night. The circumstance of her birth widely unknown due to this fact.
* Ingrid raised the girl as both her own as an apprentice.  Teaching her the ways of Anima and Thauma, for life in Stalmer required a hand to heal and a hand to harm.
* Late into her life, Ingrid left Stalmer to pursue what she called a "call" to her and headed east, that was 3 years ago. Anais now acts as Stalmer's local Witch. 
* It was only a year ago today, that a man visited Anais, first for healing, but later claimed Anais to his "wife reborn". Confused Anais denied him, but the man took things too personal and invoked an ancient art to curse Anais. 
* Anais suffering from her curse, took to leaving Stalmer to avoid hurting it's citizens. Now she makes for the expedition, intent on putting as much distance between herself and Stalmer.

Name: Anatalya
Backstory Bullet Points:
*Born outside Lostbrough
*Taken in by the Temple of Virtue
*Followed the temple’s teachings closely
*Held people at arm’s length because of visions of misfortune
*Joined the Blades of Virtue to repay the temple
*Stationed outside Silverdale as a member of the Order of Absolution
*Being surrounded by constant war/loss and her visions wore her down
*Had a vision of the end of the world
*Joined an expedition to the Runewall to prevent it
*Woke up on the Worldhelm

Name: Ania
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Ania is a 23 year old Gilded from the Pavilion's 7th floor, with long golden blonde hair typical of her people and a friendly, obedient demeanor, a habit born of her specialized upbringing and training.

* Her family referred to themselves as "Mantle-Blades." They are Regal Vessels who dedicate themselves to be paired with honored Regents, for the sake of social status.

* Ania dedicated her youth to the rigorous discipline required to be considered worthy to bond with a Regent, yet she remained unbonded long after the customary age of 18.

* Following the liberation of the Pavilion, she immediately departed for Polis, searching for purpose, be that as a Regalia or some other future that had eluded her at home.

* After hearing tales of the Goldhearted and their vessel, The Worldhelm, during her months in Polis, she decided to join them, believing her true destiny lay with their cause.

* Full bio linked in sheet

Name: Anki
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Anki was born among yokai. As the child of two oni, he was not torn from a human life and into a wild one. 
- He was raised as a devoted servant of the fox mother, and trained as a warrior under the Doom Seers of Tsukamu village. However, in recent times, their teachings have proven fruitless. Their visions are thwarted by outsiders. 
- After a heated argument turned battle with his teacher over their purpose, Anki fled to Sunfire City, where he was caught up in a Realmstorm, and arrived on the ship. Now free of his prior roots, he searches for a reason to exist.

Name: Annelise Klein
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Annelise was born into a notable Merrani family, though the Klein family has been known to be one of the more stubborn families against the crown.
- Annelise herself was given proper education and training in Korala before joining in her family's footsteps
- She gained a leg up due to her family name and gained a promising path ahead of her.
- When she entered her first proper task, she took well to her role until it came to the fact that she and her squad were sent to interfere with the transportation of supplies. When arriving it was also found to be transporting citizens.
- Annelise failed to commit to Merrane's edict and was caught trying to sabotage the mission to allow the citizens to escape.
- She was labeled a deserter and a traitor, being sent to Heaven's Gate due to her family name and those above her wanting to have one of the Klein's children with the intention of bargaining.
Quirk:
Heirloom
**Merrani's Intended Edict**
A weapon made specifically to work towards the expansion of the Merrani nation, the wielder is either assumed to be Merrani or identifies the wielder herself. Those of Karlsgard view her as a Merrani those of Merrane identify her as a deserter and traitor.

Name: Annette
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born in Korala
-Possessed the Gift of Magic
-Dad leaves to fight in the war
-Went to the Academy to improve her skill
-Summoned an elemental familiar
-Specialized in art
-Pressured by the Empire to become a battlemage
-Flee Korala and end up on the Worldhelm

Name: Anri
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a family of Tubalcain devotees in a small village in the Kald forest
- Quiet and lonely by nature, made few, if any, lasting bonds troughout his life
- Learned the craft of blacksmithing from his mother, Sana
- An ald raid saw him taken from his home and separated from his family
- Was seen as a high-value captive due to his smithing skill; exchanged captors often due to trades, leadership changes, and short-lived escapes
- Eventually, gained freedom as a consequence of what he would one day learn were the actions of Goldhearted.
- Brought to Hearthgarde, but didn't stay long, as he journeyed to find his old village; on arrival, found nothing but burned homes and shallow graves...
- ...Two of which were marked with the names of his parents.
- Convinced Aldistir held no future for him, he journeyed north, intent on reaching the world's edge and walking past Seraph's barrier
- Before he could get anywhere near there, was picked up by a Realmstorm.

Name: Antigone
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Having woken with the rest Delarian in the Castle of Ladon, Antigone was one of the first to seek adventure.
- She left to explore Deleria with the dream of exploring every inch of the island, rivaling any other mortal of her knowledge of the land. Innately it has tied to her like a beloved freind.
- When the Dream of Deleria ended so did hers, but she has some time before things are final and maybe she might find…something.

Name: Anzai Midori 安斎 緑
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A Samurai in service to Ito Hakage. When Lord Ito is slain, rather than end her own life or swear into the service of his successor and killer, Ito Kumiko, she runs.
- Flees on a friend's fishing boat, leaves the Ito demesne, becomes a wandering rōnin, and starts working as a mercenary. 
- She witnesses the worst of Bushi taking advantage of lower classes while Daimyo turn a blind eye. Her swordsmanship improves even as health declines. She sleeps less, eats less, and works more.
- Lost during a caravan escort and presumed dead. Found starting to ice over by a priestess at the temple near Mugetsu.
- With their help, she gets a second chance from a low point in her life, and starts wandering anew.

Name: Arashi
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Was born during a Thunderstorm
* Became an Orphan
* Lives because others cannot
* Enjoys exploring
Remort Changes: Nothing

Name: Aria
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born to one of the Matriarchs of Tangbawan from (insert a village here)
-Was taught cultivation from Kabiya and traveled with them from a very young age
-Powerful Yokai assaulted a group she and Kabiya was apart of. Kabiya passed but Aria found a new mentor among the group
-Soon after fell into a realmstorm and brought to the Worldhelm

Name: Arin Sylvester
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in a Rich Family in Lumina Prime

- Was Born a Septid

- Was actually a really gifted Kid and had high grades

- Dropped outta school cause he hated the pressure and never got proper loving from his mother and father due to how he was born. Unlike his Brother and Sister both of whom were normal human born. 

- He left to live in Vacay City in Dawnstar Valley away from his family

- Became the Drummer for the Local band called "The Misfits"

- The moon started being destroyed and it's shards crashed down onto terra. He got caught too close with one of them and it rapidly altered him giving him abilities he dosen't understand.

- One of those was Empowered strength and the power to control sound waves.

- The Second was the power to Manipulate electricity that empowered him but it's too chaotic for him to manifest.

- The band disbanded after that but he was able to get some work with SWORD getting him a Temp License

- Then Realmstorm happened

Name: Arisaka “Saki” Sasaki
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Their mother is Sayumi Sasaki, an executive in 100G Security.
-  Saki had average to high scores in school, more out of lack of effort than academic struggles, she was however a star in gymnastics and track and field and was offered scholarships to 100G  advanced training programs which she declined.
- Became a TEMP with her twin sister, "Saki", using Sayumi's connections to get a license.
- Both of them briefly worked with the Goldfingers.
- Their main goal is to help gather funds to send their younger Sister “Mina” to a good school and look out for her.

Name: Arsene Flamel
Backstory Bullet Points:
Arsene was the main help at his fathers small shop down in midhole until he eventually they had to sell the shop soon after Arsene's father passed away from a mysterious illness.

Shortly after that Arsene enrolled at hudal academy and researched alchemy so he could find a way to develop a cure for the illness that killed his father. 

Arsene tried many times but one night he accidentally blew up the lab when one of his alchemy experiments went wrong. 

Because of this Arsene was expelled from the school. 

Now Arsene has become an adventurer in order to make enough money to independently fund his alchemy research so the world can be a brighter place.
Birth Realm: Arsene was born in the realm of Kor'Tarion in the town of midhole.

Name: Artemis Anderson
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born to a comfortably wealthy family in South Rock
* Diagnosed with a disease in her youth that would rob her of the use of her legs
* Her parents paid for a surgery to augment her spine to halt the damage, but the process was botched
* Parents tried suing the hospital but were destroyed in court and lost almost everything
* Parents then put themselves deep into debt to get her a far more underground solution from an independent lab
* Given her new lease on life, Artemis has decided to push her new augments to their limit to try and earn enough to save her parents from the possibility of insolvency when they pass.
* A mixture of running her top speed and her unstable augments misfiring at the same time transported her to the Worldhelm!

Name: Arthur Birkett
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born into a noble family in Silverdale

- Natural talent for Virelia Magic, spent most of his time in his families garden tending to the various plants

- Had a teacher named Rayne Kellryn that helped him hone his magic

- Works side by side with his companion VIX, a fawn gifted from his teacher Rayne to keep him with at least one person always with.

- VIX is the product of experimentation with Virelia magic to attempt to use animals as walking farms for meat and various fruits & vegetables. While naturally, all subjects were failures this fawn was saved by Rayne Kellryn and later given to Arthur Birkett and through their journeys experiencing the calamities VIX bloomed into a capable beast and companion.

- Disliking a luxurious lifestyle of repetition, he left home with his fathers blessing and began travelling Eurys to experience and learn about the calamities from the natives and the land itself

- Eventually found himself at the Runewall, venturing forth in hope of great things

Name: Arzen Algnost
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Borne as the eldest of give to the royal family of Hearthome.
* Grew up afraid of the world around them, labled the coward of the family. 
* In effort to combat this mental condition, his father hired the old bat Gojko as his mentor.
* A particularly painful lesson saw Arzen run away, to which he met the Moth Caellica.
* A singular night, where a blighted creature infiltrated the kitchens of the castle. Arzen in an act to save a maid drew a knife and murdered the creature. 
* Working through his cowardice, he was granted the lion's boon. 
* Now years later his father has tasked Arzen with assembling the Fellowship to combat the growing blight..

Name: Asahi [旭]
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Mugetsu nearby a shrine devoted to Inari Okami to a pair of kitsune parents. Named Yuuka.
- Reached an age where found themselves traveling around across the isles of Nishibi, until they spent majority of their life within Ishihara. Living amongst a house of courtesans, where they picked up various tricks over the years. As well as learning to befriend humans while under a human guise.
- One day, their visit to a shrine devoted to Inari Okami brought about a peculiar visit from one of a many tailed kitsune that is said to be a divine servant of the Kami themselves. They befriended that divine servant, who in return enhance a blessing they always had since birth. Allowing them to call upon the blessing of Inari Okami.
- They found themselves under the employ of a woman named Miyuki around ten years ago. Seven years later, Miyuki became the Kujō daimyo and bestowed a new name for Yuuka: __Asahi__. Working as a spymaster since then.

Name: Ashtilla
Backstory Bullet Points:
-  She was born many year after as a solitary egg and a surprise to her parents. 

-  Many of Ashtilla's siblings have been lost to the Blight and hunted by wolves. 

- Most notable feature is that her eyes are like a midnight sky filled with stars

- One night while she was just a younglings she decided to stay up all night drawing up plans for a new project. She preferred to be out on the surface where the sky was at it's brightest. She saw what looked to be a Mothkin bathing in the moonlight emanating a silver glow. She said the moth spoke to her and said her hammer would change the world. Her parents found her on the beach front the next morning.

- She seeks out the Mothkin in search of who she saw that night. 

- Supported by her parents she sets off for Hearthhome in her father old transport beetle Simon.

- While on her way to Hearthhome she is caught in a wild Realmstorm and spirited away!

Name: Aslatiel
Backstory Bullet Points:
Aslatiel was originally a fae bound elf in Kor’Tarion. After leaving the fae realm, he traveled to the Hudal academy to learn magic and human culture. There he learned his trade but grew inside of him a deep curiosity for the secrets of entropy and the elements.
One night, he stole ritual materials to perform unauthorized rituals. He tried to unlock more power to the secrets of entropy but it blew up into his face. The accident caused the destruction of that side of the building resulting in many injuries to other students. He was thus banished and left with a shadow scarring half of his body.
He tried to make his way back to his home realm, but during the blood moon, he fought off demons to protect humans. This act granted him his goldheart. After his fight, he continued walking into the forest until he fell over exhausted. He woke up by the fountain.
Quirk:
Quirk: Fae Outcast
Fae downside: Scared of canaries and similar song birds.

Name: Aster Vayelia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- For generations the Vaelia family has trained one child to serve the Order and one for the Coven. 
- Aster's older sister Laurel joined the Order and rose quickly. Aster was initially clumsy and nervous but showed connection with nature and the Soul Stone, and slowly built her sense of confidence and self-worth.
- Laurel was selected for an expedition to the Runewall, but grew more erratic as the dangerous mission approached, expressing doubt that the constant fight was worth it. She abandoned the mission and the Order, and rumors circulate that someone fitting her description is with the Rimelz Hounds.
- Blaming herself for not seeing her sister's fears, Aster prayed to the Soul Stone for the ability to make things right - and received a vision to bind the Stone as an Arcanist and go to the Runewall in her sister's place.
- Frightened but determined to fight for a better world, Aster took her sister's place on the expedition, and survived to join the ranks of the Goldhearted.

Name: Aston Aldebrand
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Little Ottington in the Kingdom of Karlsgard. One older brother living in the Tundra, one niece who moved to the Bastion.
- Joined the military when his tavernkeeper parents died around twenty years ago. Assigned as an army cook after training. 
- Survived the destruction of his battalion during one of the first Angel attacks of the Merrani invasion. Spent months in recuperation afterwards.
- Eventually helped with feeding and housing of refugees and wounded, instead of returning to the frontlines.
- Taken by the Realmstorm to the Worldhelm some time after, where he then joined the Goldhearted's embassy to the Dragon's Den, and learnt the true stakes of the Lhodos war.

Name: Astrid Engstrom
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born and raised in the outer ring of Genesis
* Eventually joined the Vignettes out of financial need
* Offered an odd job by 777LC as a body guard for high pay and took it
* Moved and lived in the outer ring of Fortune, was allowed entry into the jewel for work
* Checks from the 777LC allowed Astrid to purchase prosthetics and mechanical augmentations - as well as her old, beat up car detailed in the Old Transport quirk
* Amazed by the improvements the augments made, she fell into a downward spiral of augmenting herself
* In the end, she removed both her arms in favor for four prosthetic and augmented mechanical arms - as well as removing and replacing much of her body in general
* Contractors from 777LC were 'concerned' with her behavior and mental health, which led to her termination - in reality, they thought her a safety concern 
* Astrid refused to go back to the Vignettes out of shame for losing such a high-paying contract

Name: Asuka Senko
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Asuka was born and raised in Tokusou. At the first chance she got, she joined the Trailblazers to escape the life she had lived and to explore and travel.
* On her journeys, she saved a Folkin Critter named Kumo that became her companion as she travels. Helping her utilise her skillset.
* Eventually she even left the Trailblazers to then join the Adventuring Guild; to explore further and to help others across the Land from the Taint.

Name: Atticus Blackburn
Backstory Bullet Points:
Atticus Blackburn was born three decades ago to a relatively well off family in Vale.
Atticus always had a knack for machines and a love of the outdoors from a very young age.
At the age of 14 after Vale falls he joins up with the KPLA initially serving as a mechanic.
At the age of 18 Atticus joined a small reconnaissance team called Phantom Squadron led by Mack Knife serving as their sniper.
Atticus was skilled enough as a sniper to take down Merrane’s Walker with Karlsgard Artillery and to hit targets from 3,871 yards away with a regular sniper rifle
Phantom Squad ran an operation to steal a bunch of mana batteries from Rust mountain the Merrane Empire. During the mission it was discovered that an angel engine core was stored in a Merrane base in Rust Mountain. Not wanting it to remain in enemy hands Atticus devises and executes a plan to steal the core and is successful.
For his continued service he was granted the rank of Wyrm and he was chosen to be added to Goetia Squad.

Name: Auro Benites
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born and raised in Windhaven
* Joined his father working as a smuggler as a teen 
* Father decided risked his life on a risky job and didn't come back
*Auro's mother was distraught at losing his father, and all but mentally shut down, going through the motions of life but not living. 
* Auro left to find what happened, got lost in the desert
* Rescued by Blue City guys
* Eventually joined up the revolution
* Got introduced to Nimue's Icon who gave him magic (dance stuff)
* Went on to free slaves, was directed to a realmstorm by a seer and joined the worldhelm

Name: Avani
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Originally a resident of the Faerie Realm, living close to a Fae Crossing near Tradefair.
* As they grew up, they were inspired by the human and faerie adventurers who lived inside both worlds, seeing the many places in these lands, helping towns, saving princesses... like those tall-tales you see in books.
* They recently decided that now's the time to leave home and become an adventurer, just like them... go on their own adventure, save their own princess.
* Even with all their courage and innocence, it still ended up with them on their back, having to get saved by the "cool golden flying ship".

*They're now taking this opportunity to explore more, even with the risk of getting curbstomped once again.

Name: Aven Elmhorn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Aven was a knight tasked with hunting down Fae and would travel most of Kor' Tarion to do so. 
- Three years ago his squad went missing after being sent to the Howling Woods.
- Aven with no recollection of events after having arrived in the woods woke.
- Found himself questioning if he was himself or if he was something imitating himself.
- A thorny plant seems to be growing though his body and armor and wrapping around it, any thoughts of trying to remove it quickly leaving him.
- Saved Fae-Touched in the Gwaed when before he would have never, as a desire for retribution to those who wronged Fae and Fae-Touched built.
- A few days after his run in with Fae-Touched he was swept up in a strange storm and awoke on the Worldhelm.

Name: Axel Reed
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Son of a frontier blacksmith from Jamestown and a witch from Copsehaven, Axel grew up between two worlds on the far frontier.
- Everything changed when a nearby gold vein drew Gold Standard and Proudrock west. Rumors spread that his mother hid liquid gold with witchcraft.
- When officials came to take her in, a scuffle broke out and Axel's brother was shot dead. The forge was ransacked and his family driven out.
- That night a devil answered Axel's grief, gifting him a fragment of hellfire to forge a gun and take vengeance.
- After killing the men responsible, Axel became a wanted outlaw.
- Years later, he sought pardon through a bounty on the witch Antikythera and her apprentice Isolde. 
- Realizing the bounty was unjust, he turned on the other outlaws there. He and Isolde became gravely wounded in the fight, and Isolde saved them both by entwining her soul with his.
- Now unlikely partners, Axel and Isolde travel together handling personal business until being caught in Realmstorm.
Quirk:
Lawless - Desperado
In Axel's early days as an outlaw, he once shared a fire with a quiet drifter on an open trail. The man never gave his name and spoke little, but when Axel told him his story and warned him about the law on his tail, the drifter only chuckled.

"Ain't no law out here but your own."

The next morning, the stranger was gone without a trace. But his words helped clear any remaining doubt in Axel's mind. He's taken those words to heart ever since.

Name: Axel Therogaard
Backstory Bullet Points:
Bullet Points -

- born in North Rock, near the inner city
- started stealing at a young age
- stole from the Goldnails on accident
- took out a loan from an ETA subsidiary to repay the Goldnails, and never bothered to repay it
- used part of the loan to buy a nice suit, and applied to be a bodyguard with 100G
- died while protecting a client
- brought back by ETA as per his Insolvency clause
- kept working with 100G security, as a bodyguard
- was escorting a client during travel and pushed him out of the way, being consumed by a Realmstorm

Full Backstory -

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1fWezD3wBI3_eRdbopcxnPGAmkPN1YgCtMKmvm_5NBWo/edit?usp=sharing

Name: Ayan Jabir
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to slaves, given his name as a prayer to the Icons for a better life.
- Escaped slavery when the Sikhaari Order assassinated his masters.
- Joined the Order hoping to better Nezmira and help the slaves and downtrodden more directly than the Blue City Revolutionaries.
- Learned the art of assassination, killing several Nezzim slavers and slave masters, helping many humans and mages escape slavery.
- After the Revolution, left the Order when they decided to continue killing Nezzim with no cause, following their hatred and resentment rather than what would lead to a better Nezmira.
- In his flight, he stole Nightblood and Nalthis, two of the sacred artifacts of the Order, leaving behind the sacred mantle, Sel.
- Shortly after he left the Order, a raid from Zalfira nearly killed him, surviving by jumping into a realmstorm, appearing on the Worldhelm.
Quirk:
Heirloom
Nightblood and Nalthis, the Blade of Shadow and Hand of Compassion, sacred artifacts of the Sikhaari Order, stolen by Ayan. The Order wants them back.

Nightblood is a dagger meant to destroy evil, and can enhance the good or evil intentions of those around it when drawn. It can also cause non-evil creatures to become violently ill if they attempt to wield it or just touch its scabbard. Nalthis allows the wearer to wield Nightblood without succumbing to its effects. Due to their pairing, they both draw evil to them, though only Nightblood can entice evil doers to destroy themselves. (More info can be found on the character sheet)

Name: Azhtang Tenker
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Azhtang was an orphan from a small village at the foot of the Tanggula Mountains
- He was a pickpocket and a thief
- He tried to steal from a member of a local martial arts school, and got beaten half to death
- He vowed revenge
- He joined the Empty Monks to gain power
- His qi was incompatible with void qi, so he tried to develop his own cultivation method by journeying to each of the Temples
- At the Temple of Fortitude, he found tablets discussing a god that could grant him strength and a cultivation method to emulate the god's power
- While training with one of his new techniques, the Unbound Steps, he stepped into the void and found a realmstorm, which brought him to the ship

Name: Azik Eggers
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Born and raised as a regular everyday citizen and ended up getting a law degree and becoming a government official.

• Had convicted a man in tattered clothing with a crazed look in his eyes who had then later escaped from the authorities.

• I was attacked and brought to unknown location a few days later by that man who by that point I have had completely forgotten.

• I didn’t understand what was happening but I was concerned about the crimson candles and glowing runes in the room alongside the chanting of a figure.

• SIA Intervened during the climax of the ritual, whatever the outcome was supposed to be was altered and I was changed as a result. They took me under their protection as I grew accustomed to the change before I was allowed to go back to society. I still can’t look at anything the same way…

Name: Azra Yıldıran
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Grestazs, Azra was a gifted child raised amid dust, salvage, and invention.

- As a teenager, she protected another during a leyline rupture. After the act, signs that she was an heir to the Prosperity stone started to appear.

- Wulforh took her by force, ignoring her village’s refusal and shattering her childhood.

- At Bruesen Academy, she designed her own prosthetic arm using her heir-stone and Enarch knowledge.

- She now studies magic while secretly rejecting Siegfrieds's despite her complicated relationship with him.

- Sent beyond the Runewall by Siegfried, she sees the mission not as a test but a chance to change her fate.

Name: Baaxee
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Grew up amidst the tree of the Gwaed Forest like many goblins
* Would watch the actions of passing adventurers with rapt fascination
* Often attempted to perform heroic deeds like returning lost objects, finding children gone astray, and chasing away wildlife from human villages, to mixed reception
* Was taught the ways of the protector by an old hermit in the woods she kept bugging
* Found an abandoned keep and swiped equipment from it, right before being brought to the Worldhelm in time for the Bloodmoon
Sheet Link: [I'm the greatest hero, everyone's gonna know me!](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13V2sbrhGf10vEd3-BKao8dNdqRgFz4v_MGVOIT899SI/edit?gid=0#gid=0)

Name: Bai Ziyun
Backstory Bullet Points:
•Born in Wujing Guo, to a family line of cultivators
•Trained as member of "Heavenly Imperial Court: Divine Flying Sword" sect. Focuses on nimble sword techniques, aggressive strikes, masters learn to fly on their blades.
•Greatness was expected of her, childhood was short and training was long, grueling, but she excelled in training.
•Temple attacked by corrupt cultivators and she fled to keep her life.
•Caught in a Realmstorm after hiding out in the wilderness.
•Seeks to explore a rebuilt homeland, helping those she meets, gaining power and influence along to way to build a better future.
Birth Realm: Heavenly Isles, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin

Name: Barry Strike
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born and raised in Vale, inspired by the arts and stories of grand heroes & stylish gunslingers
* Loses father as a young child during the attack on Vale ten years ago
* Family takes refuge in Bastion, persists through scavenging and survival skills
* Joins the KPLA as a teenager in hopes of fighting for freedom and becoming his own man
* Faces death's door when fighting to save allies during a skirmish
* Miraculously saved by a Realmstorm transporting him to the Worldhelm
* Aims to one day return to Lhondos with new allies and more experience to aid the resistance

Name: Beatrice Verdenhart
Backstory Bullet Points:
*Abandoned at birth, raised by a mother bear with 1 sister and 2 brother bear cubs

*At the age of 9, was brought to Willowbough, a village in the Gwaedwood to be raised by humans. She never saw her adopted mother again

*Her second family, Emilia & Dandy Oakelad were honest hardworking farmers. From there, she learned of a castle abandoned by beast mages, much like herself. She became this villages protector

*At the age of 27, 12 long years of protecting her village with scavenged weapons from the abandoned castle, she was chosen by Yubel.
Remort Changes: Esper became Empath, kept her "Life force" energy flavouring.

Name: Beck
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Raised from birth under 100G along with many other assets-to-be.
- Missed out on a lot of training on account of a saboteur from ET Acquisitions interfering with her "batch".
- Side effect of this interference included developing personal agency
- Eventually busted out, spent most of her life as a vagrant with augments.
- While wandering the wasteland she found an old tank drone that had fallen into disrepair, which she then shoddily put back together. It barely functions but at least it functions.
- She's been eager to see if any of her "batch siblings" have escaped, or if she can otherwise help them.

Name: Bellamie Ghoroznovich
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up on a farm on the outskirts of Little Ottington. Two little brothers and a mom, dad was dead long ago.
- At 22, she enlisted in the military.
- at 30, her family home, and the family themselves, got caught in a bomb during a Merrani push into Karlite territory.
- After that, she enlisted in a program led by Dr. Doskik. The following procedure gave her a lot of metal, an engine, and a massive gun arm.
- She began to lose herself to the war and the violence over the next 8 years.
- Bella was then taken by the Worldhelm.
- She has changed a lot since then.

Name: Benedikt "Benny" Vasilyev
Backstory Bullet Points:
Benny has spent the last few years running guns and other arms, taking weaponry from underground manufactories or "lost" shipments and ferrying them around the Haven deserts in his van to sell for a profit. Why? Well, it's damn good money, isn't that reason enough? What his clients do after his merchandise changes hands isn't his concern.

Really, it's every man for himself out here. Sure, he'll chip in sometimes, help people out, he's not heartless. But ultimately, the only man he takes orders from is himself. He just considers this whole 'Goldhearted' business a particularly interesting freelance gig.

Name: Benício Galhardo
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Benício was born in a traveling trailblazer caravan with a very large family.
- His father through the travels kept the peace and the caravan safe as they traveled through Aranova.
- Eventually Benício left the caravan on his own due to being "Heavy Handed" when with dealing with outlaws and the like.
- He left of his own accord before relations could sour but was handed his father's old badge before leaving as a memento.
- Benício made home in Tessalia for a while and helped keep the peace of the roads.
- He ended up living along with some Drifters taking a proactive approach around Tessalia, changing his hunting to dealing with drifters who go too far and turn into outlaws and the like instead of the whole.
- His image became synonymous with three things, the Eldentech weapon he carried with him, the aged badge on his chest and the shadow of jaws that accompanied him when on the hunt, eventually earning a reputation for putting down many outlaws before leaving and ending up as one

Name: Bernard Cooke
Backstory Bullet Points:
Bernard grew up with relatively humble upbringings, never wanting to make trouble for those around him.

Growing up was personally as uneventful as it gets, always dodging the metaphorical axe when it came down by the government. Education turned to be a form of escapism, as physical labor wasn't much fun.

Eventually he turned from a citizen to more of an asset, even though there is clear ideological discrepancies with the results of his studies.

Given enough time, and seeing enough negative behavior from those around him, be it middle management tightening down, or laborers dissenting, the call for change starts to resonant within.

With the burning desire for change in a well governed city, there was but few opportunities to exercise such desires, and not but close to the start, was old Bernard already picked up and investigated, found guilty for crimes he has yet to commit, and taken away.

Afterwards he was finally claimed by the Helm.


---This is a bit more than bullets, sorry!

Name: Bernhard Klausner
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in a small town on the southern border of Delsatz.

- Raised as a woodcutter, joined a local garrison to defend against the Calamity.

- Met a merchant from Mastrazs named Eleanor, fell in love and married her. [14 yrs ago]

- After four years of peace, a surge of Calamity activity forced him to arms.

- While defending the town, news reached the garrison that the Eleanor's caravan from Mastrasz had been attacked. 

- He deserted and ran to the caravan, finding that his wife had been killed by a corrupted drake. [10 yrs ago]

- He was then blackmailed by his superior officer, having to choose between obedience or jail.

- Now a chained beast, he was cast into danger with no regard for his life.

- A Briar Mage known as the Fellgraft Witch assaulted the town using a Calamity beast, and Bernhard was sent alone. [5 yrs ago]

- He stalled long enough for mercenaries of the Scarlet Roar to reach the area.

- The witch cursed him before escaping.

- The Scarlet Roar recruited him.
Quirk:
**CURSED**
__Curse of the Calamitous Hunt__
