An insidious curse inflicted upon Bernhard by the Fellgraft Witch, the Curse of the Calamitous Hunt manifests physically as a purple crystal forcefully embedded in Bernhard's right eye socket which upon inspection is heavily infused with the corrupt energies of the Calamity. 

In addition to afflicting him with violent transformations influenced by the magic of the Calamity, the cursed magic seeps into his mind, twisting his thoughts into those of a beast (an effect which is reinforced by his perception of himself). In times of heightened emotion or distress, Bernhard may succumb to its influence, acting in a manner befitting a destructive monster.

Though the mechanism is unclear, confronting the Fellgraft Witch who cursed him will be undoubtedly be necessary to remove the curse, assuming his mind is not consumed by the corruption before then.

Name: Bio | Ananda Hassan
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born into the Great House of Vasu
- Grew up admiring the Lady of the House, Ananya
- Practiced cultivating Purusa to become like Ananya
- Was banished due to copyright infringement (was actually for cultivating without permission)
Birth Realm: The Great House of Vasu, Bahata Kajaana, Tian Yin

Name: Bio | Beryl Reynaud
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and raised in the Barrio
- Wasn't poor, but not very well off
- Some financial instability caused their parents to turn to gambling and drinking to cope
- They despised seeing their parents a mess and got into work ASAP 
- Coincidentally got into work in DHK
- Dislikes who they work for, but it helps keep their parents stable so they deal with it
- Got caught tagging one of the stores near the Barrio and got hired to make art for some bird guy as a side gig
- Was swept away while out tagging during a particularly bad storm, turned out to be a Realmstorm

Name: Bio | Peri Ozeyn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From the Last Hold
- Previously branded Hiear
- Usually does work hunting monsters for parts
- Occasionally does mercenary work escorting merchants to and from Last Hold

Name: Bishop Ruthven
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a family of strange elves who see themselves as nobility and have the ability to siphon life force from other living things

- They originate from the Fae Realm under the worship towards a being called the Lady of Blood

-They moved to Kor'Tarion after it's moon shattered due to their aversion to moonlight

-Bishop despite being a member of the main family that leads their kind dislikes blood and sees himself as a savior for those he considers lesser

Name: Bjorn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- The son of a blacksmith within Dryholde

- As a youth, occasionally visited the cemetary in which spoke to the elder who oversaw operations.

- Years passed, and eventually the old man passed away, never getting the chance to learn his name. In spite of this, Bjorn promised him to oversee the cemetary in his sted.

- One night, he stumbled upon a small white shard, a font of magic (unknown to him at the time) that blessed him with the powers of elementals; he felt the heat as his fingertips, and felt more sturdy with the earth below him.

- Word spread quickly of this revelation though, it was said that Bjorn was touched by "foul magic", something that was grounds of banishing within Dryholde.

- His own parents turned him away, considering Bjorn 'cursed' and to never return to Dryholde again.

Name: Blackthorn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to rangers in Dryholde
- Hunted for food and was out of the city with her mother when it was destroyed.
- Mother taught her to survive in the woods
- Father taught her to care for nature
- Mother was injured in the fighting and they both moved to Concordia afterwards. 
- Father was in the city when it was destroyed and he went missing. Blackthorn is still looking for him.
- While Blackthorn avoided the tainted food, her mother didn't, caused a strained relationship.
- Eventually fled the city to live in the woods full time
- Raised Rosebud (wolf companion) since they were a pup
- Saw Goldheart Coalition liberate the city, so they joined up after feeling bad about not doing anything to help on their own.

Name: Brandr Vol Seive
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was born an Ald within a warband known as Foxhunt, hunters of Yokai.
- After being separated during an attack, he was left to wander the Kald Forest alone.
- Starving, he found the body of a near dead Yokai and in desperation consumed it's body and killed it.
- Due to this act, Kuzunoha cursed/blessed him with a Yokai's body (elemental soul & Mutant) 
- He tried to return home, was almost murdered by his own family until he fled.
- Living out in the woods as a "monster", he stumbled onto Olia as a child. 
- Her genuine innocence and sweet nature moved his heart, and he decided to raise and protect her.
Remort Changes:
Unbreakable change happens, big for the community 
D10 Dex becomes D8, D6 Wil becomes D8 Wil

Name: Brigitta ᵀʰᵉ Superstar
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in the ruins of Heartdom, to a family of Lhodosian origins
* Would use the echo when climbing atop the metal skeletons of ruined skyscrapers to carry her words and song
* Applied to Gnosis Academy, intent on furthering her stage and find a cause
* Underwent the Rite of Bonding due to wanting to amplify other people's message, too, and be an echo for everyone
* Heads the Gnosis Student Radio, and spreads both upbeat song and a message against all tyranny
* Sent to remedial class due to a general flaunting of rules, especially dress code

Name: Bun
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Trained by retired shinobi, Watanabe Mai
• Sensei (Watanabe Mai) went missing
• Bun left Kenbuki to search for her sensei
• Swept up in a Realmstorm

Name: Burkhardt Stahlgren
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Raised in Gerlund by his mother and father, Ilva and Anders, along with his older brother, Liam
- Father was a soldier and told stories of their ancestors and their family history
- Brother became a recruit when Burkhardt was 7
- Became a soldier when he turned 12
- At 16, during a training drill near the Permanence Stone, he snuck off to see the stone, and through means he still doesn't fully understand, took some of its power
- Spent his life on the border of the Wasteveil, fighting undead, as did his father and his brother
- After years of fighting, his brother and his brother's squad died when undead swarmed him during one of Waste Warden's bouts of wild magic. Only the scout that returned the shield was left alive. Liam left behind a wife, two daughters, and a son
- Joined the Expedition to find a better way to help Liam's family and to maybe put an end to the undead scourge brought about by the Calamity
Quirk:
Heirloom
Waste Warden (Dual Resistance [ice/dark] Runic Shield)
The fire/heat magic granting the resistance can sometimes overload, drastically increasing the temperature nearby, causing burns and worsening ones that are already there, and other things that could happen when the normal temperature is cranked up by dozens of degrees almost immediately.

Name: Bàthte
Backstory Bullet Points: Born and raised in Sestiaz, he tried to be a defender for the town as it rapidly declined due to the Cataclysm, but eventually conceded that it was a lost cause. While on a boat headed towards Sagneron, his ship was attacked by Rimelz Hounds, and he went overboard, only to find himself half-drowned, shrapnel-torn, stumbling through the Runewall hoping against hope for some kind of second chance at a life worth living. He pushed through, powers awakening as a Goldhearted, and awoke hours later aboard The Worldhelm.

Name: Cadence Claudia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Hycanthius Town.
- Father abandoned her mother before her birth.
- Particular about spelling.
- Her mother was cursed to a slow death from a curse inflicted from a demon disguised as a friendly fey.
- Cadence does not know the identity of the demon or its whereabouts.
- On cremation day, it was found out that her mother's heart had been turned to magical ice with a moon shard encased within.
- The heightened emotions and pain, awakened Cadence's magical potential and she swore to avenge her mother.
- Since then, she has been distrusting of all fey, friendly or not.
- Travelled with her life savings to Brightshield to train.

Name: Caellica Ronara
Backstory Bullet Points:
- One of the youngest seers of the Moth Tribe.

- Their birth was unusual. As a pupa, they had a vision of themselves as a warrior,  wandering an endless expanse of ice and snow as a blizzard rages against them. They have no idea where they are or where they are going. All they know is that they must go. A voice rings out, echoing throughout the pure frigid white.  

- "Grant us clemency. Grant us benediction. Grant us salvation. Grant us light."

- Cael was born shivering, housing an Elemental Soul from the Rootway. The prophecy and the pleads from this dream convince them to become a Seeker of Fate, trying to find the truth of their visions while trying to protect the land from the vicious Blight overrunning the wood.

- Cael joins their childhood friend's Fellowship  and is lured into a raging storm where they soon awaken to a cloudless sky and trickling water.
Quirk:
Elemental Soul

You are deeply infused with the power of a natural element in some way.

Elemental Damage Type: Ice
Vulnerability: Fire

Additionally, whenever you deal damage, you may change its type so that it matches your elemental damage type. However, you also become Vulnerable to a different damage type chosen among those five. 
You also gain the ability to perform Rituals of the Elementalism discipline, but only if those Rituals manipulate your chosen element (respectively air, electricity, earth/rock, fire, and ice/water).

The Vulnerability granted by this Quirk cannot be altered or overwritten by Qualities, or by Skills that grant you permanent Resistance (such as the Dark Blood Skill or the Glass Resistance Quality).

Name: Calibre Harmony
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From Pikeway, a town taken over by Merrane and made into a labor camp for honorary citizens
- Deported, saved by Goldheart though they didn't know that at the time
- Joined the KPLA, and assigned to 21st Magitech Procurement squad meant to track valuable tech
- 21st Magitech followed the trail of a Dupartist lab where they were trying to link mortal to machine
- Merrani find them, ambush the lab, Calibre is forced to soul-link to the Gallant which contains a fraction of Lilith's power as glue for the link to function
- On the run, was picked up by a Realmstorm and joined the ship before they could be caught

Name: Califex Aleactea
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Califex is a masked fae-touched who found herself lost in the Fae Realm of Kor'Tarion, eventually becoming into a beast-like creature capable of otherworldly, often frightening transformations. 

* She became a court magician for a small hedonistic court because of her devious card tricks, which blossomed into actual magic which could alter the concept of luck itself.

* She fell in love with the king of this court, but was exiled to Kor'Tarion for accusations of cheating a royally sanctioned duel and attempts to seduce her way into queendom.

* She spent her days of exile seeking challengers that could best her in games of chance, often becoming notorious around the Jarwood by Brightshield.

* She makes her way to Hudal Academy, hearing of masters of magic who would provide the thrill of games she seeks, but is swept up in a storm which eventually sends her to the Worldhelm.
Quirk:
Outcast Fairy (Spell: Divination)

Califex carries a lucky coin from her time as a court magician that she has a compulsion to flip whenever she is faced with a decision. If she loses this coin for whatever reason, she will go into a panic and become confused, lost, and dependent.

Name: Caliste Poe
Backstory Bullet Points:
Caliste lived amongst the streets of Haven her entire life, living off whatever she could fine on her own. She found she could not trust anyone, as like her. They were trying survive and eat.
During her late teens, when she was readying herself to apply for a TEMP License. She found herself an injured raven. Usually such a beast would be easy pickings for a meal. However for some reason, she helped it back to health. Why she did such a actions was a mystery to herself. When it was able to live on its own again, she then left it.
Though to her surprise, the bird stuck with her. It was strange, but for the years to come. The two were unseparable. The raven was her one and only friend. Something for the now roaming hirable soldier to trust. Something that won't hurt, nor betray her. Eventually she named the raven Edgar and took care of him. No matter how little she made with her work. He was going to stay till she laid dead upon some street

For now, its time for the two to survive here.

Name: Calliope Florence Maier
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born within Wulforh as a servant family serving under House Baudouin. 
- Held an affinity for Eidola & Enara magic.
- Baudouin family agreed to pay for her schooling within Breusen Mage Academy so long as she continues to work and serve the Baudouin house.
- She agreed, taking the opportunity to gain further prestige in magic. 
- Became the charge of Callum Baudouin, and after she graduated Callum was sent off to travel the world in becoming a better leader.
- During her travels, she developed a resounding faith in all the Gaia Crystals and their Beacons, becoming a devout follower of the faith. She always held a love for the crystals but during this pilgrimage zeal manifested. 
- Returned to Wulforh a changed woman along with Callum, and when he was casted out by his family she continued to walk alongside him. 
- The duo now travel to the Rune Wall, Callum believing himself an exception. Calliope hoping her prayers get him and many others past the wall.
Relevant Arcana:
Anarchy. This stone holds the power of Lilith.

Desire. This stone holds the power of Vanagandr.

Eternity. This stone holds the power of Seraph.

Freedom. This stone holds the power of Banshee.

Longevity. This stone holds the power of Caladrius.

Memory. This stone holds the power of Antikythera.

Permanence. This stone holds the power of Tubalcain.

Prosperity. This stone holds the power of Dahaka.

Soul. This stone holds the power of Kuzunoha.

Victory. This stone holds the power of Nimue.

Virtue. This stone holds the power of Lorelei.

Wisdom. This stone holds the power of Qilin.

Name: Callum Baudouin II
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Callum the Second, named after one of his Fathers, was born in Markensburg. He was raised by the family until her was old enough to work on his own, at that point he began to work within his fathers company, the Obsidian Protectorate.
- When he turned 21, he was told to travel the world, and return a better leader. So he left, and ventured through every nation in Eurys.
- Along the way, he arrived at the Eternity Stone, and learned from them. He made a vow to protect Eurys and put an end to the cataclysm, abolishing selfishness from his own spirit.
- When he returned, his new way of life contracted the families growth, at least to his parents. While a public exile would be a scandal, he was informed he must 'go on another journey', specifically, to the Runewall. His parents expect him to die there, though the action is masked in glory to outsiders to the family.
Quirk: Hairloom (Baudouin's Left and Right Hand are a pair of weapons designed by the Baudouin family. They are designed with a fatal flaw, that their magical properties can be disabled, tracked, or otherwise manipulated by the family-and thusly, those in the know of the Merchant Council.)

Name: Cameron Relsea
Backstory Bullet Points:
In the old days in Lhodos, the Saelre Lepkin clan succeeded in defeating a Designation: Dahaka creature of great strength, and within its corpse, found a beautiful heart-shaped gem, infused with lingering magic.

Over time, the clan dispersed, the gem passing through many hands, generation to generation, until the current day.

Cameron Relsea, a Lepkin scavenger, minor mage, and descendant of this clan, discovered the gem while searching through her Father's belongings, and decided to keep it with her, feeling that the magic in the gem resonated with her own.

During a routine scavenging expedition, in search of valuable metals from mech remains far from home, her and her group were attacked by a group of Collosi spawn, attracted there by the heart. She ordered her friends to run while she tried her best to distract them, and moments before her demise, she was whisked away by a realmstorm, onto the Worldhelm.

Name: Carine Eyt
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born on Terra (Helios)
- Carine took after her mother, who was a doctor working under sparrow. Even though she strived to become a doctor, her father forced her to be a mechanic for a good part of her life.

- Once she was able to leave her fathers grasp, she became a doctor working under sparrow like her mother. She would work as a traveling doctor with them, using her custom vehicle The Pharmacy to travel from continent to continent where she was needed.

- During her journey as a traveling doctor, she learned different ways of turning cooking ingredients into various types of medicine. Allowing her some freedom of aiding those from more, unfortunate backgrounds.

- Carine inherited Mercy and Grace from her grandfather, who worked as a mage hunter for central terra, capturing illegal mages. Carine made an oath not to harm anyone unless necessary to defend herself, she only uses Mercy and Grace when given no other option.

Note: Owns a temp license with sparrows assistance

Name: Carnot
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born in Genesis, Terra

Was created in order to research entropic and elemental magic to create a “perfect combat engine”

At first he willingly helped the researchers in genesis with this project, however over time he wished for something greater

Deciding he needed to do more than research, he took it upon himself to leave genesis and move to Dawnstar Valley

While in Dawnstar valley he used his magic to work as a freelance mercenary

The researches have decided to let Carnot be, quoting that “they needed field data anyways”

One day when helping an envoy carrying various materials from a mining expedition, he gets swept up in a realmstorm

Name: Carol Belle
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Caldera, but moved to a frontier town at the edge of the Merreni border.
- Raised as a keen merchant, trading with travelers and Karlsgard militia away from the eyes of Merrane officials.
- Grew *very* fond of a militiaman from across the border, stationed at a fort nearby.
- Was sent up to Korala for a proper education, while attending assisted Merreni in the development of a number of weapons and military technologies.
- Brief stay at a military academy in Caldera for compulsory training.
- Returned home to find it bombarded by Karlsgard soldiers.
- Boyfriend across the border was killed in the ensuing retaliation.
- Defected from Merrane, leaked blueprints and engineering logs to the KPLA, and went into the resulting no-mans land to assist.
- Became Goldhearted

Name: Caspian Riviera
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to House Riviera, a knighted family that originated from Kor'tarion that serves under Galeo Empire currently. Renown for their combat prowess.
- Caspian is the third generation of this family, with a very strict upbringing. However he is usually overlooked often in Ripplith society, and thus developed an inferiority complex to his peers.
- Enrolled in Gnosis Academy at age 17 under The Regal House of Paladins.
- Was chosen to be the Regent of Aelina Van Deivoet, but then promptly chose to reject their ceremony in front of everyone. Internally reasoning to break Aelina from blindly following the expectations set for her. He never openly stated this except to a select few.
- Became an Arcanist of Lilith for the rebellious act itself, seeing him as someone who shows promise.
- Caspian does suffer a very negative reputation in the Academy as a result. Becoming much more distant than initially, feeling a perpetual sense of guilt around Aelina.

Name: Cassandra Maldonado
Backstory Bullet Points:
✦Raised by her grandparents through her early years after mother's death and being abandoned by their father.
✦Develops an interest in engineering and is taught how to drive and repair vehicles by grandparents.
✦Shitty old man bites the dust and leaves her with his debt. Grandparents pass away some months after, leaving her to take care of her younger siblings by herself.
✦She would acquire a clandestine temp license allegedly administered by Tubal & Cain. Taking jobs as a mercenary while doing under the table deals on the side.
✦Almost crashed into a building after being summoned by the Worldhelm while in the middle of a grocery run.

Name: Cassidy Hertz
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Cassidy was born in Morgan. Her family is forgotten, except for the Hertz name she carries with her.
- She was five when the bombstrikes struck her city, surviving by pure chance and strategic location in the collapsed building with her childhood friend Esmon. 
- The children were rescued by Lady Charlotte Luther Von-Hardwick, and they grew up together.
- Cassidy was always timid, but yearned to give back to the nation that had saved her and Esmon. When the researchers approached Lady Charlotte's door and asked if she'd be willing to participate in a study, she agreed.
- The surgery went well. Cassidy was unnervingly suited for the demon, and would have been put down were it not for Lady Charlotte Luther Von-Hardwick's influence. It was agreed that so long as she entered WWA and fought within the Merrane Military, she could be spared. 
- Cassidy knows nothing of this, just readily agreed and graduated with flying colors.
- She grieves the lives lost, but Morgan will not happen again.

Name: Cassidy Price
Backstory Bullet Points:
Cassidy was born to a poor family, raised in a crowded apartment with her ma, pa and 6 siblings (2 older brothers, 1 older sister, twin sister, 1 younger sister and 1 younger brother)

She trained to become a 100g officer like her pa and grandpa before her, unfortunately one day while walking home from the grocery store she and her pa were ambushed by armed thugs.

Her pa died and she was paralysed from the waist down, only able to follow in her pappy’s footsteps as a self styled sheriff by volunteering to field test an experimental mobility unit meant for mounted officers.

Now she’s fixin’ to do her pa proud and keep the streets safe for her ma and siblings.

Name: Cassius Mordred
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Moth Tribe with a promising life as a seer

- Shows them a grand vision about how the kin must ally themselves with the wolves. They all ignored them and chose to remain enigmatic and distant

- Saw how reclusive and inactive the Moth tribes were and despises them because of this causing them to leave the Tribe

- Would Journey about the Firwood leading to their Capture by the Wolf Tribe lead by Volga

- Was saved by a new wolf friend that wanted to change the fate of their tribe

- Cassius would receive a vision that would help lead them to the Brave Asphodels' home

- Amidst the Journey both are swept up by a realmstorm

Name: Cecil Wagner
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born into the city as the child of retired SIA operatives, inheriting a legacy of duty and sacrifice.

* Carries the scars of an experienced agent within the Department of Supernatural Enforcement.

* Joined by a lycanthrope partner from the Sundiszno tribe, forming a bond that evolved into a deep, sibling-like connection. Even though they acted as their handler.

* Spent years hunting and maintaining the fragile peace between humans and all the supernatural entities.

* Became the target of a relentless pursuit by other lycanthropes, who sought to reclaim his partner’s "potential."

* Endured repeated ambushes in the forests until there was nowhere left to run.

* Faced a final, desperate choice when his partner asked to be killed so their potential could be saved from their enemies.

* Fired the final shot as their enemies closed in, absorbing the power to keep it safe.

* Carries the weight of his friend’s power while continuing the hunt for his family and his mission.

Name: Cecile
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Appearance and Personality:
Cecile is a short, lithe girl with distinct chameleon-like features. She is an Ophidiya, a race she is unwelcome among due to her lineage and kleptomania. Known for her nimble movements and sly demeanor, she thrives on quick wit and improvisation.

- Life Before Running Away:
Cecile was isolated and carefully watched by her Nezmiran father, who sought to protect her from the dangers of the outside world. However, Cecile came to resent her isolation, seeing it as a cage rather than protection.

- Escape and the Worldhelm:
After several failed attempts to run away—often thwarted by her father’s influence—Cecile finally succeeded by stowing away in a storage crate. By sheer luck or fate, this crate was mysteriously taken aboard the Worldhelm, granting her freedom and opening the door to new adventures.

- Reputation as a Thief:
Cecile is widely regarded as a no-good thief, her kleptomania earning her a less-than-reputable name.
Remort Changes:
Removed:
Stolen Time 1
Entropic Magic 1 - Acceleration

Added:
Winds of Trade 1
Private Stock 1

Name: Cecilia-Carmillia (Ci-Ci)
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Cecillia was born in Ripplith as a man, Her family carried a gift from the Ocean Singers, a magical weapon that resonates with songs of the ocean. She at first couldn't lift it.

- Even before her transition, she was talented in the roles of a woman, taking the skillset far easier than the ones given to her as a man, this helped her realize that she was more comfortable presenting as a girl. She sought out a Seamother. 

- After going through the ritual, she found a weight lifted off of her and was able to carry her family heirloom. Her family sent her to Gnosis Academy.

- She is quite the character, and so regularly had friction with stricter teachers due to her bubbly and excitable personality.

- She didn't get into too much trouble thanks to good grades. But that all changed when she heard about remedial classes and the opportunity to go to new places.

- Despite the look on her academic record, she tanked her grades to get into the remedial course. She is hungry for adventure.

Name: Celestyn Sokol
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born as the child of a Winged Blade member in Cneldra
- Helped tame and raise the gryphons the Winged Blade members use
- Mother was badly injured in an accident during a mission
- Trained to take his mother's place in the Winged Blade
- Meets Josef during his training years
- Manages to become a Winged Blade member
- Hears of the Expedition from Josef and sets off with them and Leopold to the Runewall

Name: Ceri Raposa
Backstory Bullet Points:
Raised in NTT territory by a senior scientist. Joining the armed forces as early as possible as recon operative making use of the fact they are attuned the elements and have minor telekenesis allowing them to easily operate drones and scout equipment.

A couple years in had a incident during mine cleanup, losing her legs and therefore leaving the armed services and returning to live with their familly.  Their mother eventually took them into the special research project she was involved in, designing a exosuit to help provide mobility as well as support her elementalism and telekenesis as a weapon system. During said procedures, her mom artificially added a booster to her telekenesis, making it stronger but wild.

While at the research project, they grew attached to Marina becoming close friends and spending most their time together.  They fell asleep after partying together too hard one day and woke up together on the realm storm.
Quirk:
Cursed

Ceri's telekinetic augmentations allow her to maneuver technology around her - however, technology can also react badly to her presence, shutting off or reacting in unpredictable ways. This includes her exosuit, which she uses even for day-to-day locomotion.

Name: Chance Dastardly
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Integrated into human society early on, taking jobs in theater to eventually reach his target
* Eventually snagged the internship at a large radio station and worked his way from fetching coffee to DJing
* The eccentric behavior he used to hide his vampiric nature made him a strong personality on the air and finally netted him host status
* His personal show, a write in advice segment called "Chance at a better Tomorrow" took off like gangbusters, but in truth was a way for him to gather intel for the Atent family
* After years of his show however... he began to genuinely enjoy helping his listeners solve their problems and the info smuggling became secondary.
* This change of heart eventually led to his chance encounter with a realmstorm and arrival on the Worldhelm.

Name: Charlotte
Age: 73 (Oh please I’m not a day older than 30~)
Backstory Bullet Points:
• In her past she used to be a spy and assassin for nobility as she did the work that was best to not be associated with their titles.

• She retired under the service of the mouse king as a nanny for the oldest child, a welcome change from cutting bloodlines short.

• After getting far too attached her skills numbed almost entirely as she cared for the small prince even after they matured. After all, the young master is still just a whittle baby in my eyes.

• Joined the fellowship alongside the young master and that old bat she knew back during her dirtier work to fight against the blight as a small unified task force.
Quirk:
Heirloom 

Silk of the Weaver (Elemental/Powerful/Transforming) (Potent damage: Dark)

Name: Charlotte Morgan
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to the esteemed Morgan family in the capital. Her family is responsible for vast swaths of factories across the Empire and a great many sponsored inventors with shining promise.
- Charlotte gleefully indulged in the plenty, but she possessed an uncontained avarice beyond even her peers... accompanied by a potent pride, fundamental disbelief in others to do what she could, and a passion for craftsmanship.
- This led her to the dungeons, diving alongside the delvers for ancient artifacts to repurpose and going beyond in a reckless contempt for safety. However, sheer ~~luck~~ skill kept her alive and well alongside her cocky attitude.
- Her parents quickly had enough. Delving was for the lower class, not heiresses. Sternly they demanded her to join the Adventurer's Guild instead if she so insisted on getting her own hands on things. She has begrudgingly complied and left the dungeons. For now. She supposes there can be sufficient material goods in heroism too.

Name: Chime Hong
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born into a small village in the Lhasa Outlands of Leytik to the leader of a dojo.
- She was born with an affinity to both Heavenly and Demonic Qi and was trained in the dojo early on to be able to combine it and use Hell Qi.
- Has a twin brother who she was trained to practice dual cultivation with to improve their abilities together.
- Father and mother fell ill when a challenge from Empty Monks came.
- To prepare her and her brother Dujom began the meditation for dual cultivation but something interrupted it.
- Due to the interruption Chime's ability to speak and her body were stolen from her, her soul attaching to her brothers.
- Managed to defend the town and dojo from the Empty Monk's challenge with her brother.
- Left in the state of being bound to her brother with no body and no knowledge on if she can ever regain her voice and body.
- Wishes to be able to be herself again but worries about the state of her brother's body, as he pushes himself to find a way to restore her.

Name: Chloe Fant
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in a small town about five miles away from the Karlsgard/Merrane border.

* Was a quiet, gentle girl. Was learning how to be a mechanic

* When she was 14, her village was hit with a chemical attack while she was out exploring a forest. She was the only survivor. The chemical cannister had the name 'Nausicaa' on it when she found it later

* In her rage, she joined the KPLA.

* Was not allowed to fight until she turned 17, but used that time to learn how to pilot.

* About 3 months ago, on her first assignment in a border fort, A Sub-designation of Vanagandr attacked. She jumped into a mech and distracted it to give the rest of her team time to prepare and sortie.

* She lived through the experience, but her mech was destroyed and she was badly wounded. Recovery took a month

* When she returned, she caught the attention of Goetia Squad and Vertigo Abrams.

* Promoted to **Rank**, and given the experimental GKS-312 Belial.

* During a routine mission, her heart becomes gold...

Name: Circuit
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Commissioned at the [request of a LUA couple](<https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1170110466299809873/1291077076010668072>) in Silver Rock, Haven.
- Really enjoyed watching boxing and gladiator style matches, "growing up".
- Wanted to become a prize fighter, but they could not make the cut for a SWORD sponsorship.
- Eventually saved up for an ETA license and started doing Temp jobs to make ends meet. Has cultivated the suit and gauntlets image to make themselves seem more professional!
- It was during one of these jobs where they (and some others) fell foul of the leader of the Olympians...and they made their escape through a Realmstorm to safety.
- They're still looking for that big break that will make them famous...and maybe this Worldhelm can help them in that regard!

Name: Claire le Blanc
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From an orphanage, never knew birth parents. Briefly adopted by a retired People's Guard who owns a coffee shop, Louis le Blanc.
- Enrolled into White Wing Academy around age 12, meeting eventual Angels such as Moritz, Azzurra, Hailey, etc.
- Became an Angel, with Prince Dion overseeing her ceremony.
- Went on missions in either the warfront with Karlsgard or fighting the Colossi. Lost fellow teammates from the Colossi.
- Had to execute people in her squad after a disastrous loss in Karlsgard. Including her tactician, a loved one, named Estelle Richter. Driving her to desert from the military.
- Was declared KIA by the public.
Remort Changes: Removed Stolen Time; Obtained Entropic Magic: Omega

Name: Clarissa Aspenfield
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Legenried to a decently wealthy family
- Her intelligence and acumen were immediately apparent
- Her parents died early into her life and left her a small inheritance
- She grew up alone and without parental guidance
- She ended up in questionable social circles and picked up harmful and self destructive habits
- When she reached adulthood, she decided to move to Breusen and attend the academy
- She invested what was left of her inheritance to enroll. Her natural gift carried her far but not far enough
- She ended up failing her last school year, in large part due to her questionable habits, and could not afford to try again.
- Desperate and penniless, she made the highly illogical decision of joining an expedition to cross the Runewall, hoping to find some manner of purpose on the other side

Name: Clement Carmichael
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born in Wulfroh to two merchants who used to travel.
-Raised in a trade school and learned cartography
-Decided to leave the city and explore the world to further improve his cartography skills.
-After leaving Wulfroh territory, came across downtrodden citizens being harassed by cultists in favor of the calamity.
-Doesn’t believe in the calamity’s coming, but wants to prevent whatever is coming.
-Traveled beyond the runewall in the hopes of finding a solution to alter the prophecy and quell the many pointless wars.

Name: Clover
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in small Karlite village called Yarde, right on the highway from Karlsgard to Constance, which was made so unsafe when she was young that her family left
- Flee to Bastion and sign up for the military as soon as she turns 18, eventually ascends to the second lowest rank
- Sometime after basic gets into an ugly battle and loses her left hand to a landmine. Instead of medical discharge, asks for transfer into a rural refugee camp and become a cook
- Meets Dahlia by saving each other in a wildfire set ablaze by Merrani bombs. 
- Dahlia gifts her a hand made of wood that she can actually use (when she straps it on, it's not fused to her body), it also gives her heightened attunement to the elements. Uses this attunement to invoke the elements and infuse food with beneficial properties, leading to the nickname Auntie Left Hand
- Summoned to the Worldhelm with Dahlia
Other Names:
Auntie Left Hand
Left Hand of the Hearth

Name: Cole Grant
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Cole was raised on the stories of Sheriff's Cavalry, romanticized them all of his life. It was no wonder that when he could become part of the sheriff's department, he started his training.
- Then he sent to Rivermouth as a greenhorn and truly, he panicked. At least the first three expeditions there. He didn't run, just fired wildly and otherwise gave a poor performance in field testing.
- As opposed to giving up, he continued to believe in those stories, having faith that through this he can be like them, he just needs to try harder. 
- Eventually the day would come where he completed his sheriff training and joined the Cavalry proper. Though the day that he was meant to go out in the field, he was swept away by a realmstorm.
Relevant Arcana:
Nimue
Seraph (but that's because Sheriff stuff)

Name: Colin Subar
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Genius boy from the village of Hemsway in Karlsgard
- Village sponsored him to go to the Academy of Korala
- Felt like a failure because he could never perform magic or utilize magitech crystals
- Was offered a chance to gain magical powers through experimental trials
- Experiments ended up being an attempt at creating daemon-less espers by using physical parts of monsters instead of soul network daemons
- Sickened by the experiments, he dropped out and began his investigation into the Academy
- Still no magic powers, and no ESP abilities, but he feels the presence of the monsters within him and knows they can be used for something, he just has to figure out what and how

Name: Cora
Backstory Bullet Points:
Conceited academic sent out to learn humility and worldly knowledge. 
Respects her instructor Theodore and dislikes the other students, especially her rival Grace
Dislikes getting herself dirty
Researching the past events and is looking to learn more about the shattering of the moon
Starts off with little interest in other realms

Name: Coraline Silvermeadow
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Coraline has lived a relatively quiet life in the bustling city of Veyrhold, a small bakery near various govermental buildings, a place at her brother's behest.
- Little does she know, her brother is a part of the Department of Supernatural Enforcement, masquarading as a public defender for the good people of Veyrhold.
- One day, her brother disappeared, she made several missing posters and went through the proper channels but when nothing showed up, she took matters into her own hands.
- Just before she did, however, a realmstorm stole her away.

Name: Cordelia Hartwood
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Reporter working undercover for the SIA 

* Creates cover stories regarding supernatural incidents

* Was investigating a rogue group of SIA agents to avoid information leakage

* Found a werewolf girl named Petra who was kidnapped by said group 

* Took her in since Cordelia was looking for some muscle & having her running around unsupervised could cause public to ask questions.

* Petra now acts as her assistant after saving her from a "kidnapping." Cordelia teaches her how to blend into humanity and the SIA agency.

* Is known for being quite callous in her approach to her work, IE taking in a werewolf purely since having muscle makes her life easier.

* Prioritises public safety , seeking results through whatever means necessary.

Name: Corgaven
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Lieutenant in People's Guard

* Saved trapped civilians of Karlsgard from haywire machines

* Received engraved rifle from surrendered medic, explains it kept him going, seems to be blessed by the divine. Reminds Cor of his goal, to save as many civilians as he can

* Clandestine rescue of civilians on both sides

*Arrested for treason

*Realmstormed to Worldhelm on night of trial
Quirk: Heirloom granted by rescued KPLA medic

Name: Cornelius Ribbib
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Fresh after his tadpole years he joined the tutelage of Old Alabaster Croak.

-Spent a long time learning the various songs of the world and how they all weave together to create the fabric of the world's story.

-Through Alabaster's Songs and Teachings he learned the Magic of "All That Is."

-It is at that point that he became enamoured with the world as a whole, fully devoting himself to uncovering all the wonders the world holds.

-He typically has joined travel caravans to help wherever he can and to experience whatever he can.

Name: Corvin
Backstory Bullet Points:
* The daughter of the head of the Aletti family, a small-time crime family
* Life of crime from an early age
* Skilled, creative, ruthless, became family hitman 
* Found a knack for studying and adapting to targets
* Lost most of family after a failed hit turned out to be a supernatural creature
* Got arrested with remainder of crime family
* Scouted by SIA partway through sentence
* Joined to both avoid prison and turn her life around
* Eventually selected for DSC
* Became a Goldhearted

Name: Corwin Kruzik
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born to a poor family in Silverdale whose ancestors were originally from Grestazs.
-Family had found an artifact back home that spreads entropy and decay. Went around the world to gather more magical knowledge to try to deal with it. 
-Ended up settling in Silverdale, in the region near Startford. With the Axe spreading decay and entropy and with its powers being fairly close to briar magic, alongside the scant resources in the countryside family is forced to roam from village to village.
-Due to being poor family is mostly self taught, and burdened with the safety and use of the axe. Received adequate magical and physical training.
-Without much progress into their familial quest and slow but steady progress of the calamity, 3 years ago they decide to seek refuge back in Grestazs but find none.
-By the end of the grueling journey he is the only one left, leaving him lost and desperate.
-In a last gamble for clarity and solace tries his luck in the Runewall.

Name: Cory Cash
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born to a father who led a corporation but died when Beyton died and so did his company

-The family fell into poverty, and the mother fell into an abusive relationship with a gang leader

-Worked his life on the street gathering odd jobs and peddling  goods

-Wants to raise his community and family out of poverty and recreate the days of prosperity he remembered as a child

Name: Crystalia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Blue collar upbringing
- has a magical voice
- got borded by SWORD early
- is a very small performer
- augmented to look "perfect and sirenlike"
- sold her face to sword to join, doesn´t own her identity as "Crystalia"
Remort Changes: None, we ball.

Name: Curly
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Developed in secret by Prof. White of Lorel.AI, as an attempt to transfer his son's mind to a LUA body after an accident left him unresponsive 
- Remembers little of its life as Oliver, develops a distinct personality much to White's frustation
- Given freedom once the ethics board caught wind of it, but hostile design choices made it's maintenance unusually expensive. Ends up financially dependent on the company.
- Gets fed up with its situation, voids their contract and flees with nearly nothing to its name. 
- Avoids Lorel.AI, body starts breaking down from lack of maintenance.
- Chances upon an old junkyard mechanic, Mr. Rock, who fixes them up. Becomes his apprentice, learns to maintain its own.
- Finds his mentor's old broken mech in the junkyard, secretly fixes it and enters Pulsefire to help raise money
- However, the return of the "Wyvern" brings Mr. Rock's old debts to the workshop. There is a confrontation, and Curly ends up fleeing with the mech-- right into a Realmstorm
Other Names:
Oliver White
Prototype c0.1.13b 
"The Wyvern" (Pulsefire alias)

Name: Cynthia
Backstory Bullet Points:
__**Old Life**__ 
- Her old name is Yaroslava. A Kikimora Fae of the Home
- She was created by another Fae 62 years ago. Their name was Gormal, father of the woods. Her purpose was to help protect his home from trespassers due to the shattering. She also had other duties like providing service at his abode.
- Due to unknown motives. One night, Gormal returned to the cabin wounded and told Yaroslava that she needed to live for herself.  Sealing her memories and shunting her to a different part of the Realm.

__**Wanderer**__ 
- She was alone in the Fae realm for 24 years, Unaware of herself. Sometimes in her dreams, she finds herself in a Cabin by a fireplace.
- One day a scholar wandered into her domain by accident. He was studying Fae, She was intrigued by him. 
- Not knowing what to call her, the man gave her the name Cynthia.
- the man would periodically return w/ friends, but at some point, he just stopped showing up. Prompting Cynthia to travel Kor'Tarion as a traveling healer.
Quirk:
Outcast Fairy
Weakness: Strong smells and Polluted Air

Name: Cyph
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was placed into an experimental program of 100G's as a child by her parents for them to make a big paycheck.
- Most of her childhood is a blur because of this program.
- Program involved experimental weapons produced by Tubal & Cain that were biologically tied to the users.
- There were many complications behind the program that lead to its abolishment.
- Cyph being one of the promising users of one of these weapons came to an agreement with 100G that allowed her to continue to use her training and weapon for freelance work.
Quirk: Heriloom - Sanguine Song & Acceleration Stabilizers: These are experimental pieces of equipment that may malfunction when put under stress.

Name: Cypher Yuten
Backstory Bullet Points:
* A faceless worker who went under the radar for most of his life
* Quit work on a whim to follow the dream of theirs
* Developed a system of a card game, utilizing the soul network in a localized field. 
* Almost was eaten by daemons, but saved at the last moment. 
* Along with Devon, escaped in his Granpa's inheritance and ended up on the Worldhelm 
* Became goldhearted

Name: Cyrus Sand
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born in the City of Scales to the K'zzek, a wealthy merchant family. A free spirit from a young age, suffocation from constant societal expectations and a growing disgust with his family's decadent lifestyle led him to run away as a teenager, joining a caravan and beginning his new life as a wandering no-name.

As he grew, he gained confidence in his strength of arms, eventually adopting the "testudo" style of melee combat, hardening his scales and numbing himself just a little more to the pain with each and every blow.

He took on the surname "Sand" to sever ties with his family and Nezzim society at large, taking on his own humble identity as a wandering sellshield. He sought to become just another grain in the vast desert.

A boozehound and gourmand, always to excess when there's plenty of it. And yet, they somehow leave him feeling empty. Is there more to life than just existing, he wonders.

Name: Céline Brighttail
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a community of rat-like fae native to a underground domain, she was forbidden by tradition to leave her warren
- Unsatisfied with simply following convention, she'd have recurring dreams where she climbed up to the moon, and asked the stars why the world was as it was
- One night, the stars answered
- She was told there was an order to the universe,  and should she wish to glimpse it, she must go where the sky would lead her
- She promptly left her old life behind, following the star-map in her dreams beyond the fey realm, and into an ancient temple
- There, she was offered a bargain: She would be taught the secrets of the stars, and in return, she'd one day return there and restore the site to its former glory
- She accepted, and bound Anykthera as her first Arcanum
- From there, she traveled Kor'tarion in the pursuit of knowledge, eventually joining Hudal academy
- After Project Bloodmoon, she resumed her wanderings, eventually investigating a certain anomalous storm...

Name: DRAKE
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Mikkel was poor, growing up the Northern Thundra.

- He was raised to hunt small game to survive.

- At a young age, his town was invaded by Merrane, where anyone who didn't escape was killed.

- Mikkel was strong and young, so they sent him to The Great Library.

- He lived here, allowing his rage to build for 17 years.

- Thorne, his mentor, taught him everything he knew. How to cook, clean, and care for others, but also how to fight.

- Mikkel broke a rule, going into the forbidden section of the Library and learning Necromancy.

- Necromancy was the catalysts for him becoming a Graveborn.

- Mikkel left the Monestary when Thorne could not teach him anything else.

Name: Daga
Backstory Bullet Points:
Daga was born in the Realm Of Nezmira, his childhood was a bit tough, being born human in that place was a hell. Little by little he became aware that his way of thinking was wrong it wasn't him who was in a hell, he just felt it and made himself seem small.

Making his mind at the age of 12, he decided to become a new self, starting by learn how to speak to people, deceive, run and even steal, with small steps became one of the best scammers in all the City of Sandsailor, gaining a fortune good enough how to buy rations and materials, his life was good enough how to be called decent.

However he always wanted more and more, even more than he could hold, a good life, to get out of that hell. Daga's Greed had no end, so he started to hold money, enough money how to make a trip to go to Samsara, his ambitions were aimed to the sky, he wanted to be rich, rich enough how to retire and live a good life, the life that he deserved... and he would do anything for that goal.

Name: Dagna
Backstory Bullet Points:
•Born in Lindstroffe, the youngest daughter in a family of 5 until her little brother was born.
 •She was conscripted a couple years after her older siblings.
•While defending a town from raiders she seemingly met an unceremonius end, 
left for dead only to wake covered in snow.
•Her time in the army lit a raging inferno inside her, she could no longer abide a king
that would sacrifice his subjects without a second thought. 
•Resolved to end his tyranny one day, she fled south to Grestazs in order to obtain funds and allies for her quest.
•As fate would have it, she would join one of the expeditions into The Runewall and awakening in the ship.

Name: Dai Shuye
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Family served the emperor (the ruler's family lost most of their power after everything went to shit)
* Her family's job was to protect the mental of the royal family so that they could rule fairly and withstand the stress of leadership. 
* She had a strong platonic bond with her Onjin (superior/mentor), the Emperor (in their 30s).
* A blue oni named Himeji infiltrated and managed to corrupt the Emperor with demonic qi (her family was only used to protecting against heavenly qi historically), causing their cultivation base to collapse and the Emperor to turn into a tengu.
* A Red oni (in charge of Himeji) then took over that part of the ruined capital ruling as tyrants
* Shuye served the new tyrants under threat of death, grieving and ashamed but too "cowardly" to kill herself.
* Joined the worldhelm via game
Remort Changes: Moving 2 levels of encourage to Condemn (now Condemn 6 Encourage 1)

Name: Daisy Starbloom
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Unlike other Deerfolk families, Daisy grew up isolated, living with a sacred coven of Forest Witches hidden in the far northeastern region of the Gwaed Forest below the Star Peaks.
- Raised as a young initiate, she learned the art of herbalism, gardening, and alchemy.
- Gained the personal tutelage of a Hedge Witch in the Coven named Althea Starbloom, who became her mentor-mother figure. 
- When Althea was called to perform an odyssey across Kor’tarion to seek out other covens and earn the High Priestess title, she passed down her verdant locket with motherly love. 
- Althea didn’t return. The Coven’s Crone looked reluctantly to Daisy as Althea’s closest successor. After undergoing more rigorous training, upon adulthood, Daisy finally left her coven to attempt the odyssey herself, in hopes of one day reuniting with Althea.
Quirk:
Heirloom: Verdant Heart (Accessory)
Biofuel Quality (1000z)

A pentagram necklace passed down by the Hedge Witch, Althea Starbloom. It serves as an intimate bridge between its wearer and the natural world. 

Flaw: This necklace thrives on reciprocity and the natural order. The more power drawn, the more its wearer must find ways to reciprocate (e.g, through personal energy, offerings to nature). Otherwise, negative effects may arise. This can manifest as sudden exhaustion, altering the wearer's connection to nature, unexpected transformations (e.g., temporary changes to their physical form or affinity), or even the necklace ceasing to function until its wearer restores balance.

Name: Dane Alston
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Grew up in Central, and was on the move a lot for a lot of his childhood.
-His parents could not hold much of a job that was anything close to secure or consistent so they had to get creative. 
-He picked up the habit of keeping useful things from his mother, and eventually got curious and began putting things together.
-Parents fostered that habit by helping him put useful things together as they search for scrap to sell.
-Him and his parents parted ways a while ago, as they decided they wanted to venture east to try and find a better life.
-Genuine likes searching for scrap and making stuff with it to solve problem.
-Has been basically living zenit to zenit with a salvaging crew that he eventually left his parents to work for.

Name: Danny
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Former 100G agent in Haven
-After a case goes wrong, he leaves and goes private in Downpour City
-Starts noticing occurrances caused by Goldhearted activity on Terra
-begins investigating it as a conspiracy out of curiousity
-As he's investigating further, he's caught in a realmstorm and brought to the Worldhelm

Name: Dante Cavaliero
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in Brightshield
- Regularly saw knights and other valued heroes
- Failed to become a knight, too independent and flashy
- Became a street performer instead
- Substitutes martial prowess with solid crowd work and stage presence
- “Fake it till you make it”

Name: Dante Sterling
Backstory Bullet Points:
- The youngest son of 100G Board Member Anderson Sterling, Dante grew up surrounded by a corporate, morally compromising environment that he loathed.
- Rejecting the corporate game, Dante's father redirected him to a different role: 100G Strategic Visibility Officer. Sariel's Golden Boy.
- The role was exhilarating. Live missions, public trust, real impact. Dante felt he had something genuine, and 100G could drive up recruitment and showcase cutting-edge technology with a charismatic face behind it.
- Eventually, Dante learned the trade-off. Visibility wasn't power, it was containment. If he pushed too far, the spotlight was used to pull him back in line.
- Dante realized he would never become more than a managed symbol. At the recognition, he snatched some tech and left 100G to go rogue alongside his bodyguard Emile.
- Now an independent mercenary and corporate pirate, Dante carves his own path forward and turns his skills and spectacle against the very systems that tried to own him.
Other Names:
Anderson's Kid
Ex-100G Strategic Visibility Officer
Golden Boy
MITAMI Bearer
Quirk:
Heirloom
MITAMI Resonance Suite
A pair of experimental magitech armaments developed by 100G that draw in and interface with ambient elemental magic. Designed to allow non-magical operators to wield elemental forces without magical talent or knowledge, the MITAMI consists of a bonded blade that gathers and projects latent environmental energy, and a specialized glove that enables direct physical interaction with, guidance of, and release of that energy. 

In Dante’s hands, the system performs far beyond experimental projections, generating such a strong resonance that minor elemental spirits coalesce around him and willingly lend their aid. Unfortunately, activating the MITAMI is not without risk: the disturbance it causes in the ambient magical field is akin to lighting a signal flare within the magical ecosystem. It's presence is impossible to fully conceal, making Dante easy to track and occasionally drawing the attention of entities far more dangerous than the spirits that aid him.

Name: Daphila Tinkertop
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in a small community of fae creatures who are adept at magic

- Never learned how to wield magic, instead learns how to craft toys.

- Gets inspired to leave her home when her toys brings joy to those around her. She leaves and starts a career as a traveling toymaker

Name: Darius
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Grestazs to merchants.
- Struggled preparing for the coming calamity as a child.
- Taught how to inspire moral support.
- Tells others he hears voices coming from other places.
- Oracle proclaimed him an agent of calamity.
- Resisted prediction, learned channeling for people.
- Spent a long time proving the prediction wrong.
- Caravan attacked by deadly bugs riding on the wind.
- Accused and tried for being an ally of calamity.
- Escapes confinement.
- Runs to the Runewall to escape persecution.

Name: Darius Kallis
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Darius' ancestors were forced out of a village in Rocade.
• They settled in Silverdale, built a name as merchants & informants over generations.
• Eventually acquired minor noble status for monetary contributions and vital information to support Silverdale's defense.
• The house gained a shady reputation. They began manipulating criminals for their benefit before taking credit for their arrests. Smugglers would be baited to importing large shipments before their confiscation.
• Their Leirsin blood also brought suspicion, snow leopards that could understand undead arriving as a blizzard of undead encroaches.
• Darius, recently made head, took a gamble- suggesting personally taking part in the first expedition to the Runewall.
•He also announced that employees of Kallis could be 'adopted' into the family, and that the heir is decided by rank, not blood.
•If the expedition is successful, house Kallis are heroes. If not, the heir at home will not have the blood that aroused suspicion.

Name: Dax Starflare
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Dax was found alone in a small  boat that washed up along the docks of Lasport.
- Raised by the population of Lastport
- Always happy, cheerful and willing to help
- Due to his large size he was always working and doing the heavy lifting
- He always volunteered to lead groups
- Considers the population of Lastport as family
- Very friendly and very protective
- During the revolt of Warlord Gaul, Dax fought hard to protect the people of Lastport but was defeated.
- Exhausted, he was pushed  back towards the edge of the pier where he was hit in the shoulder by an arrow and fell in the Lachfair Sea. 
- His unconscious body drifted at sea before getting caught in a Realstorm.

Name: Deckard (5)
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Experimented on as a child in a secluded facility. Grew up sedated from several medications causing them to never really remember anything inside the facility.

• Was disposed of like trash after the experiments were concluded and was assumed dead by the facility. Survived disposal and found a suit of armor to hide their grotesque body in.

• Traveled the world avoiding civilization as they try to find themselves. Ended up in a portal that led them to the world helm while exploring the sea.

Name: Dehua & Jiu You
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Dehua was born in Xuanwu City, and as soon as she showed any promise of cultivation potential, was sent into the care of a weak local sect, the Golden Cicada Sect, focused on bodily cultivation and honing the art of medicine. 

- The sect was strapped for resources, and in search of any way to increase the speed of their progress, would venture off, looking for ancient relics or rare plants to make into medicine.

- On one such expedition, Dehua found Jiu You, an ancient drinking gourd made by a long dead winemaker, which possessed the ability to pour forth a seemingly limitless amount of wine, as well as a manuscript on the winemaker's path to following the Dao of the Drunken Master

- With Jiu You's help, Dehua began the path to being a much better cultivator and healer, and eventually, the lives she had saved and the progress she made allowed herself to be seen as Goldhearted material by the Worldhelm.

Name: Delphine Fiore D'Myrdel
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Once a commoner, Delphine had grown up hearing tales of adventurers, and left home.
- Trained under a knight serving the Lord of Fortress Town Myrdel, Ser Laugon Vishar. His tutelage came with a price, service to Wulfhor as a soldier, one Delphine gladly paid.
- Working as a career soldier under Wolfhor's banner, Delphine carried an impressive field record during a short border war against SIlverdale.
- Delphine would find herself battling against one of the Scarlet Roar's Prides. Defeating a number of Partisans before being wounded and retreating, catching the eye of Valeria Fiore Moretti.
- Her accomplishments could not win a war as countless brothers-in-arms fell, the nobiles negotiated peace. The conflict ended with a bottle of wine, going on to be named the Vinifera Vendetta.
- Delphine wandered aimlessly until Valeria sought her for the Scarlet Compact.
- Going on to succeed in the trial, Delphine became a Firebrand, living only for zenit and without a banner.

Name: Desiree
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Desiree was born a LUA, and without the direction of her parent company, wandered the dreary streets of Terra for a long time, searching for something to give her existence meaning

- The years spent aimless made her bitter, causing her to involve herself with unsavory people and activities where she carried out the dirty work for various people in the pursuit of something she was passionate about

- Eventually, while browsing the web, she discovered ENTROPrism's channel, and was amazed by the love and validation being given to the members of the group. Having finally found something to set her sights on, Desiree marched to their headquarters, and refused to leave until she was given the chance to prove her potential to the company. Her display proved sufficient, and she was crowed with the name Galvanized Gem Nacre. She would go on to perform operations alongside ENTROPrism, until she was eventually pulled away from one of her missions by a Realmstorm, and landed on the Worldhelm.

Name: Desoka Targandr
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in Aldistir to a Swordswoman and Elementalist
* Trained from birth by parents
* Lost parents to a draugr and was abandoned outside Camp Von Kibo
* Joined a foster family and finished his training
* Became a monster hunter
* Elemental User and Expert Swordsman
* Almost died before arriving at the Worldhelm via a Realmstorm
* Is hoping to use his skills for the survival of the Worldhelm

Name: Despina — The Deliverance
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Humanoid born in Dreadlan to Lost parents who lived with a pack of Wild Souls (striped hyenas)
* Was the 'runt of the litter' but definitely loved and felt loved by her packmates
* Constantly tried hard to prove her worth, unlike her parents who were more hopeless, listless, just trying to get by
* One day her pack saw a lone human and the attempt to hunt them went poorly
* The human was a mage and killed a lot of the pack, including her parents
* The rest scattered, but she was seeing too much red to run
* He saw some use in a humanoid who still had a spark in her and so after forcing her to listen, made her an offer
* Desperate to cling on to life, she swallowed her pride and sorrow and agreed to be his servant and student, studying magic under him for the next few years
* Eventually his own patron proposed to send her off to Heartdom to get a Knight in their service
* Enrolled in the House of Treasures because she wants to be something stronger than a puny little human

Name: Devendra Tharvani
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the House Bhavya lands

- As a child became inspired by Dharnim Savvat when he constantly spare those who tried to challenge him

- Devendra ends up joining the Slayer legion once he became of age.

- Showed great promise as a warrior in the legion though he always tried to do more beyond his station. (Be it move in to save a fellow soldier despite a retreat order or challenge demonkin before the main legion arrives)

- Soon he was starting to show signs of Purusa due to his deeds.

- Before he went to the wastes to practice his new strength Devendra was swept up by a realmstorm

Name: Dhata Mithril
Backstory Bullet Points:
Dhata Mithril had worked tirelessly to further one goal: to imbue everyone in Lhodos with psychic abilities. To her mind, it could end Merrane's tyranny for good, elevate humanity, and usher in a new era of unity, peace, and joy in Lhodos. She went so far as to make herself the test bed for this experimentation, becoming an Esper and gaining incredible power at the cost of instability and pain, all in pursuit of this utopia. Then, suddenly, he gave up, seemingly abandoning his ambitions.

But during a recent mission, they lost nearly all of their memories. Now, they call themself Stem, as they acclimate to an unfamiliar world and strangers with a lot of expectations of them, forging new connections and trying to find their way. All the while, their past self looms over them, with all of her flaws, misery, and hatred. They can't help but wonder - will they be able to confront and overcome Dhata's painful past, or are they doomed to repeat it and become that tragic scientist once again?

Name: Dira
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Family of 7. Is the second youngest.
* Most family handles the crafting and running shop.
* Her eldest sibling and her go out to collect material for family business. Either comes back the same day or a few days later.
* Knows how to craft, average at it compared to other members.
* Knows Starbo while outside and took back to family to help make something for them.
* Knows Gadget (fox merchant) because of exchange of goods with family.

Name: Doctor Love!
Backstory Bullet Points:
-pirate radio host
-parabellum field researcher 
-living in a very condemned mcmansion 
-thinks the best way to help people is to educate and organize

Name: Dolce Amoretti
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and raised deep in Soda Gulch
- Exposed to extreme levels of Pentanoqium
- Befriended snakes within the well of Pentanoqium
- KAIJU PR Representative thanks to Septid relations
- Loves KAIJU and Terra
- Her two mothers are very proud of her

Name: Dominic
Age: 1000 in nightmare years but 20 in the way that matters
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Lived in Deleria with the rest of the dreamites, generally a happy-go-lucky guy
* When Regus was creating his spell to preserve Deleria, he approached Dominic
* Needed someone to act as a vessel to contain all the utopian energy left from the attack
* Dominic was the only one with the right mental to not die in the process
* Dominic agreed, spent the whole time in a nightmare parody of Deleria
* When Deleria was freed from the dream, Dominic was too, but came out with fantasy CPTSD
* He still acts as a containment unit for oblivion, pushed into action in order to seek a death that properly completes his journey

Name: Doragon
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Doragon is an Ophidiya, born from a human servant and a Nezzim Master in the City of Scales.   
* Doragon was immediately hidden away or else risk the disgrace of the Nezzim parent’s bloodline.  
* Soon it was discovered that Doragon had the ability to shape shift as either pure human or pure Nezzim.  
* Someone discovered their true natures and the tattling began. 
* They escaped to the City of Sand Sailors where they were fully excepted by the local citizens while they were in Nezzim form.
* A year ago they left for the Worldhelm when it was possible to travel to their to forge their own path.
* They will never return to Nezmira again.

Name: Dr. Dorian De'Angelo
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Vampire from the Porumbel Family
- Became a doctor at Brindlewatch
- Quickly became influent amongst humans and other vampires alike, becoming a small time aristocrat within the city
- One day, while on shift, confronted a forsaken that tried to invade the hospital he worked at
- Accidentally helped a DSE squad neutralize the threat by keeping it occupied and de-escalating the situation with civilians, maintaining the veil of normalcy
- Voluntarily joined the DSE because he feels pity for the poor humans and disgust for the forsaken
- Now conveys the saving of lives with keeping the normalcy around Brindlewatch

Name: Dr. Eno Somata
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in the high-tech city of Haven, emotionally distant but intellectually gifted.

- Earned a PhD in Genetic Bioinformatics, experimenting on himself to improve emotional processing.

- Worked 10 years in biotech, specializing in genum-based health and cognitive tech.

- Grew disillusioned by the lack of real impact of his work. Emotional numbness returned due to the sterile corporate environment.

- Joined CLAW (QiLink) to apply his science in direct, real-world situations. The field work rekindled his empathy and gave him a renewed sense of purpose.

Name: Dr. Henry Calvin
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and raised in New Jamestown

- His father was a doctor who Henry lost during childhood after he died due to a deadly Standoff

- With limited notes from his late father and a sponsor from a shell company of Gold Standard, Henry was able to afford a custom wagon at the cost of being a Snake Olier

- Henry then started his journey going town to town going back and forth from New Jamestown and Proudrock peddling his wares with each stop in between.

- During his ride Henry's heart ache when seeing the Ghostowns though keeping that feeling suppressed in the dangers of traveling in the Gulch

- He ended up in a realmstorm after preventing one of his customers from dying due to using one of his own products.
Quirk: Old Transport (Land Vehicle): A Snake Oil wagon with the logo "Dr Calvin's Curiosity!" across from it. It is filled with flammable liquids despite its sturdy exterior causing dangers if tilted too much.

Name: Dr. Lawrence Faust
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Nearly twenty years ago, he took out a simple and manageable loan to open a pharmacy with a friend. However, not long after, just as the business was beginning to take a dip, the Baylore Company collapsed. 
- His loan was now in the hands of ETA, and there was little he could do about it. In a stress-enduced bender one evening, Lawrence attempted to return home, intoxicated. Unaware, and delerious, Lawrence stepped out into traffic, and passed away. 
- Since then, he's managed his pharmacy as a diligent, passionless worker, with glazed red eyes. ETA had returned him as an Insolvent, and he was now to work for the rest of days.

Name: Dr. Sable von Nausicaa
Backstory Bullet Points:
11y: Sable is accepted into Korala Academy. Studies BioMagical engineering and surgery using the powers of the Colossi, she gets an internship.

4y: Sable begins having doubts about the Merrani methods, and begins trying to find ways to prevent or inform on the worst of it. Leading her to gain a contact high up in the government.

3y: Sable was given an opportunity to work in a lab in the Tundra 

2y: A bomb goes off in Caldera, KPLA terrorists are blamed. Hazel (y-sister)  is caught in the blast, hospitalized, and Sienna's (o-sister) husband is killed. 
Sable returns home for a visit and is told Hazel won't make it. She performs a surgery saving Hazel.

Ca year ago, the  lab in the tundra has an incident. Sable barely escapes alive. 

Sable secretly tips off her contact and the public about an experiment inside Merrani borders that Sienna is expanding to revenge her husband. Sienna is jailed, but not before several civilian lives are lost. The killer gets away.

Name: Dr. Sienna Black
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in South Rock to two wealthy middle managers
- Forced to study business and finance as she grew up, her parents wanting her to follow their footsteps
- She eventually grew tired of her life being forced into a box, and began studying genetic modification and cybernetics
- Her career path changed completely and she became a doctor instead of going into management
- She developed a serum to alter the genetic codes of a living creature and decided to test it on herself, lacking subjects for “safe” testing
- While traveling to Termina City to explore ruins and acquire DNA samples from monsters, she was caught up in a Realmstorm

Name: Duan Nüying
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a one of Xiexie’s servants, Nüying showed a promise for death cultivation quite young.
- Quickly Xiexie took Nüying under her wing and she became enamored by Xiexie’s gifts.
- Seeing the positives that not only came to her but her family as well under Xiexie’s praise, Nüying took to her training with more vigor than any would expect from someone her age. Any negative side affects of taking in so much death qi was waved off by her.
- Now with Xiexie’s guidance and training, Nüying would be proud of her skill but still strives for more.

Name: Dujom Hong
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born into a small village in the Lhasa Outlands of Leytik to the leader of a dojo.
- He was born with an affinity to both Heavenly and Demonic Qi and was trained in the dojo early on to be able to combine it and use Hell Qi.
- Has a twin sister he was trained to practice dual cultivation with to improve their abilities together.
- Father and mother fell ill when a challenge from Empty Monks came.
- To prepare he and his sister Chime began the meditation for dual cultivation but something interrupted it.
- Due to the interruption Chime's soul attached to his.
- Managed to defend the village and dojo from the Empty Monk's challenge with his sister.
- With his sister's soul bound to his in his body it began to deteriorate.
- Needs to use his Qi to regularly keep his body in a stable state.
- The desperate desire for knowledge to find a way to return his sister to her former self or to maintain his own form long enough to return hers caught Wen Qu's attention, to slowly guide him.

Name: Dull Ahan
Age: 26 before he became Dull, 1 year since (27)
Backstory Bullet Points:
Soul protector of Village
tried to fight a necromancer who killed them and stole there soul treasure
necromancer used the soul treasure to create an monster general for an undead army
Dulls creation killed necromancer, leaving him clueless of what to do
came back with no memories of who they were, just there personality
tries to go good for people despite being treated like a monster or an undead freak
(Full backstory is in Bio)
Remort Changes: Removed 2 levels from rogue, placed 1 into necromancer (fear is key) and one into Fury (Provoke). New levels are 3 Necromancer, 1 fury, and 1 orator

Name: Dustin Ryder
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in Netherhill, parents and many of the people he grew up around died during plague
- Moved to and lived a quiet but pleasant enough year at Eckard's Rise until Gold Standard Inc. took notice of the place 
- Saw them looking to stir trouble with Kereti, didn't want his current living situation disrupted with pointless warfare
- Has not been to Kereti, but this started since one of their witches helping one of his neighbors, and that'd be an unkind way to repay them
- After speaking to a certain drifter and realizing he couldn't leave things alone, procured a pistol and elected to take matters into his own hands
- Began sabotaging Gold Standard's properties, hijacking their supply wagons, doing whatever he could to try to drive them off
- Was cornered by their thugs when he was taken by a spontaneous Realmstorm

Name: Ebb
Backstory Bullet Points:
-A Cecrae
-Was in hibernation when the moon broke
-Awoke in Elder's Crag and watched people take the  beach glass
-Started doing the fate Cecrae thing a few years ago and never met another Cecrae till Kviss*

Name: Edith Bonamy
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Was a street urchin in Nezmira with the idea that only the night sky held a chance at freedom
* Used simple magical ability to survive
* Was drawn to the lost Ancient Observatory by the stars
* Locked herself away there to study, killing scouts of the Scalefire Empire that would come
* Was invited unto the Worldhelm during a larger-scale assault on her claimed home

Name: Edward Lowell Jr.
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Edward Lowell Jr. (Ed) was raised in Silver Rock, Terra within a mansion with his mother and two brothers along Billionaire Lane. 
- His mother is a former DHK executive of some kind and his father is at least an ET Corporation board member. 
- When he turned 21, he left to start his own company called "The Million Mystery" (Mystery Gang) which solves dead end cases and supernatural suspicions. 
- Two weeks ago he was blackmailed on exposing his identity as the son of an ET corporation nepo baby. 
- He tried going into hiding, got kidnapped, and was being transported outside of Haven when a realmstorm saved him. 

Family: Edward Lowell (Father), Winona Mescal (Mother), Edwin Lowell (Oldest Brother, 28 y/o), Edbert Lowell (Middle Brother, 27 y/o)

Name: Edwin Fairwright
Backstory Bullet Points:
born and raised in the southern colonies under NTT researcher parents

had a love of magic he could never engage with for years even after joining them and his parents became the heads of a project involving a dangerous beast.

Approached by olympia after an argument with his father where they offered him a deal. access to the project in exchange for knowledge and magic

Accepted, bot due to frustrations and being unaware of their true nature

once they had accessed, they sabotaged the project, and released the monster who proceeded to way waste to the area, killing his parents and barely surviving himself

The incident was quickly covered up, his parents disappearing off the face of the web, and leaving him to survive on his own

managed to repair a magitech mech and has been forced to survive until swept up by the realmstorm. he's found himself much more comfortable on the worldhelm then terra ever since. finally able to study magic fully.

Name: Elagabalus
Backstory Bullet Points:
