-A... very, very weird anomaly in her own family, Elagabalus had a very specific reason to leave her life of comfort in an upper class family in the land of Lastport: several visions of the sun, the beginning of time, and the end of everything that she could only describe as a religious experience. But why did she have such a premonition? 
- Elagabalus was born with immense magical power, the most of her siblings in fact. This has led to jealousy among her brother and sister, who have tried to one up her in ways she's deficient in (strength for instance)
-Elagabalus may travel the world detached from her hometown, but she still has a decent relationship with her parents, who are willing to assist her should they meet her by circumstance.
-Elagabalus has a fear of needles, due her higher sensitivity to pain making them absolutely torture to endure. Shes afraid of knives, similarly. She also has a distaste for alcohol, but that's mostly because she hates the taste more than anything.

Name: Elaine Sejr
Backstory Bullet Points:
Traumatic Childhood that lead to her Psionic Powers
Ran away from home. Stole Model from her father's account (works as an admin for SWORD games)
Lives in a van. Donates blood andplasma to support herself as well as working for 100G
Remort Changes:
Reduced damage from Weapon Module.
Going from Darkblade 1 to Guardian 1

Name: Elara Lockflint
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Orphan from Merrane at 7yo
- Adopted by Caden Lockflint, a military scientist
- Enrolled at the Academy of Korala with fake documents at 11yo
- Failed Magitech classes for exploding crystals on touch
- Dropped out and became a mercenary

Name: Elasandros Pavaros
Backstory Bullet Points:
-  Grew up in a family of Hunters and warriors, who's existence is focused solely on those two things. 
- Didn't quite gain his father's skills with a bow or his mother's strength. 
- Was trained to fight and hunt from an early age but didn't quite have the same resources or skills his parents had. 
-  Slowly Elas began under taking tasks that were less about the targets and what could help people. 
- Little moments of Bravery or helpfulness , began to resonate with El but put him at odds with his family. 
- For the first time he has a chance to discover who he really is as person. Not just a tool or weapon but a real person. 
- Despite the distrust of Fae touched folk , or in his case Elves , he hopes to do some good for the relem and maybe make things a little better.

Name: Elias
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Eugene is a comic artist and makes onomatopoeia symbols
- He's chronically narcoleptic
- Has a strange supernatural plant familiar ||from Hollow Vast|| that draws on his blood 
- By drawing his blood, Eugene becomes more and more like minded with Elias, relishing in his comics and creativity
- Under surveillance of the DMI/SIA
- Together, they make Elias' art come alive with Eugene as it's main action star.

Name: Elijah-2615
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to human parents living outside the Civilized Zone. Very sickly youth.

- extended family chose to get barcoded and move into the Civilized Zone for his medical care

- treating Elijah was deemed inefficient. Family had to prove the value of this child by working in the mines.

- Elijah was unable to leave bed for more than brief periods. Expensive and difficult to keep Elijah alive. 

- Watched as mother grew ill and died, and his father came to resent the burden that Elijah was.

- Put in written application to Gnosis activity as a Warden. Good academics, but couldn't visit in person.

- Visited by a recruiter who took interest and pulled strings to get him an Envirosuit for mobility and disease prevention

- Joins the recruiter and goes to Heartdom, recruiter wants him to join Regalia, but he chooses Paladins instead out of fear of changing that much.

- Tries his best to fulfill duty to Lilith and family in Steelbin, doesn't want to be a burden anymore
Relevant Arcana: Lilith, because Gnosis provided him with a suit that lets him operate like a normal person

Name: Elora Moonleaf
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in the Winter Court a mere 34 years ago.
* Was a quiet, but always kind child. This, of course, did not ingratiate her to the more severe Winter Court.
* So it was that a kindly summer Fae saw her nature and took her in, teaching her how to manipulate the world to help people.
* A particular Winter Fae did not like this. And so about 10 years ago, this Fae slew her teacher and had her banished from the Fae Realms.
* Elora traversed alone for a while, until she met Familade and Melancholia. Deciding that these people might need her, she began traveling with them and studying magic.
* It was in this moment that she found out about her fae weakness. Familade made an off handed comment about how warm it was, and she began sneezing uncontrollably.
* Despite this, they traveled together until they were suddenly picked up in a realmstorm together.

Name: Eluna
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Set out from her home looking to try and help make things better between fae and humans.
- Grew up in a village where singing is as second nature as breathing.
- Village did not fully support her goals, and doesn't wish to return until she has done so or has a very good reason.
Quirk: Outcast Fairy - Weakness: Can't leave a song unfinished and can't deny an encore no matter the situation. If they do they lose their voice, until asked to sing without promting it or until they soak in a bath infused with flower petals.

Name: Elvis Aldin
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Raised by a strict family to strive only for academic excellence.
* Enrolled in Hudal Academy the moment he was eligible.
* Spent a decade in research rarely ever leaving his room becoming a total shut in.
* Forcibly Evacuated during the Night of the Red Sky during which his room was destroyed.
* Upon recovering from the shock, took a good look at what he'd become and decided to see the world rather than waste away.
* Spent another year studying how to travel...
* Travelled for less than a year before he stumbled upon a portal dropping him unceremoniously upon the WorldHelm

Name: Ember Wake
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Came from a poor family
- Went into debt with ETA to get qualification through higher education
- Worked for Orrery for a long time, and finally got a chance to work in sub-orbital satellite maintenance through a work-visa for the Trans-Orbital Relocation Colum
- Skyfall destroyed many orbital structures, one of which he was working on
- He died, and was brought back as an Insolvent, and then got picked up by a realmstorm only days after

Name: Emi
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Firstborn daughter to a well to do family.
- Refusing to go along with her families wishes and the duties and obligations that came with it, she ran away from home.
- Always loved music and decided to pursue her dreams, becoming a Rocker and eventually working with SWORD.
- Her signature instrument is a guitar she inherited from her uncle, who always encouraged her to do what she loved. 
- Right now, she mostly plays shows and supplements her income by working as an artist for SWORD.
Quirk:
Heirloom

A guitar gifted by a famous rocker. To most, its just an instrument. To you, it's the world. 

Orphean (1350z)
Custom Weapon, Arcane Ranged
[WLP+WLP+2] HR + 9 Bolt
Properties: Elemental (Bolt), Defense Boost, Accuracy Boost
Quality: Energy Vamp
(Cost Breakdown: Custom Weapon 300z + Same Stat Accuracy 50z + Energy Vampire Quality 1000z)

It's almost impossible to quench its sound. You can't help but play loud. People will notice, for good or ill. The authorities don't like sound complaints. Get ready for trouble.

Name: Emil Stoneheart
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A demi-human born from the Stoneheart Nobles in Brightshield, Emil was sent to Snowmaw as a baby and was adopted by peasants. This was due to the unwelcoming view of the fae in brightshield before the Bloodmoon incident.

- Joined the Knights of Brightshield, hiding their Fae nature, but was expelled after the Bloodmoon events revealed their true identity.

- Returned to Snowmaw and became a local guard. When demons attacked, Emil merged with a mysterious power called Seraph to help protect the town.

- After defeating the demons, Emil was recruited by a former Brightshield Knight now with the Goldhearted Coalition, who helped train Emil in Arcanism.

- Upon completing their training, Emil was entrusted with the Oathkeeper’s Blade—an heirloom tied to a secret order devoted to Seraph—marking Emil as its worthy successor.

- Emil now aids others through the Coalition but was swept into the Worldhelm during an expedition to help struggling villages.

Name: Emile Holdermann
Backstory Bullet Points:
- His parents are both well established officers in the  Haven PD
- Was stuck to a hospital bed throughout the majority of his life due to an auto-immune disease
- During that time period, his Psionics revealed themselves
- During his treatment, Hospital fees and medicine cost so much money his parents were struggling financially. Being such a massive burden to his family heavily affected Emile and how he views himself.
- His father got into some shady business so he could afford getting Emile Chrome to counter act the disease
- Worked for the Investigative branch of the Haven PD for roughly 2 years. Has read through their files multiple times.

__**Recent Info**__
- Got into some stuff with Tubal & Cain and has since had his badge removed. Now works as a temp for 100G

Name: Emile Ripley [C0M.3T_M31-0117]
Backstory Bullet Points:
- One of nine survivors of 100G's PERSEUS Program, M31 was taken as a child and subjected to invasive augmentation to turn her into a "MEDUSA", a super soldier capable of synchronizing with GORGON-unit mech suits.
- Raised as an asset, M31 was trained to view themselves and their peers as human weapons. The life of a human was considered distant. Irrelevant.
- At 18, M31 was deployed onto their longest and most unusual assignment: an ongoing protection detail for 100G's public-facing asset, Dante Sterling.
- The corporate son was the first person to treat M31 as a person, naming her Emile and treating her as an equal rather than property.
- Through trust, honesty and friendship, Em's loyalty gradually shifted from corporate obedience to personal devotion. When Dante went rogue, she followed suit, marking her first true decision in life
- Now, Em continues to work with Dante of her own will, learning bit-by-bit about her own wants in life and what it means to be human as best as she can

Name: Emilia Baumhauer
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Served as a knight sworn to a noble of Wulforth, near Hasseldorf
- Was sent to go attack a bandit camp that turned out to be a peaceful village. She deserted instead, and spent the next 5 years as a mercenary.
- Her former lord caught up with her, captured her, and had her sent on an expedition through the Runewall as punishment for deserting
Birth Realm: Realm of Eurys, Territory of Wulforth

Name: Emmaline "M" Daley
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born on the southern side of North Rock. 
- Emmaline spent her childhood gaming, obsessing over the nature of code with prodigal focus and, kindling the magic she had, eventually becoming a Soul Runner.
- With this talent and early experience with dev work, her application was quickly accepted for SWORD, and became an apprentice dev by 18 fresh out of school.
- M rapidly climbed the ranks and spread her roots into many game dev skills, and became a higher level dev and Soulrunner for Tri World. She proudly has never taken a PTO day.
- This finally came to a halt as her manager forced her to take holiday after a dangerously long binge of work to release a new update.
- As she wandered her way to the store on three days of no sleep or food, with strange new free time, Emmaline lost consciousness crossing the street and woke up on the Worldhelm.

Name: Emrik Renvald III
Backstory Bullet Points:
Grandson of Emrik Renvald I, a living legend (if retired) of the Knights Wyvernia; father also had a promising start of career but an injury forced him to retire from riding
Trained from a young age to also join the Knights, a snuck joyride with a member of the rider division leaves him in love with them
Hard work pays off, is able to join the division at 15; receives the family dragon rider weapon and armour
When he accompanies his father to Silverdale, meets Galavan and they become pen pals
He drifts more towards careful strategy than daring stunts, so the gear starts rebelling against him
Grandfather imposes unrealistic standards on him, father doesn't really intervene
Pushed into more and more dangerous missions as the Calamity approaches by grandfather, mostly carried by his gear
Eventually signs up for the expedition to the Runewall out of desperation to distinguish himself and earn his grandfather's approval

Name: Engh, Runaway Empty Monk Trainee
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Orphaned at a young age by a Spirit Beast attack
-Joined the Empty Monks as a trainee trying to find purpose
-Grew disillusioned with them after seeing the suffering they inflict on the people of Leytik and their own
-Actively hunted by the Empty Monks for betraying them, hid out in an abandoned outpost for a mountain village scavenging food and trying to remain beneath their notice.
-Nearly dies to a sudden Spirit Beast attack, but a Realmstorm passes at the right moment, saving his life and putting him aboard the Worldhelm.

Follows the Dao of Journeys, which is about self-discovery, wanderlust, and constant effort to be better than one was before. Uses Ink Qi, a combination of the Void Qi utilized by the Empty Monks and a natural inclination towards Water Qi

Name: Enkh Tsering
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Pravaha Mandira region
- Enkh grew up around the Empty Monks and eventually began helping them keep order
- Enkh eventually stumbled onto a manual labeled the Path of the Yeti
- During her attempts to learn more of this path, the Empty Monks found out about her discovery
- Enkh leaves the Temple of Flow, searching to understand more about the path she has found
- Enkh becomes swept up in a bad storm, arriving on the Worldhelm

Name: Enlai
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A humble Vanara farmer within Bingchuan for his whole life, content with a relatively peaceful existence
- Has an uncanny talent for raising the land, and is often rewarded with the bounty as rice wine
- Drinking buddy with an old Jinshi cultivator who over the years has enlightened them on the Dao of the Drunken Master
- One day a spirit beast destroyed a swathe of crop, causing Enlai to chase after it, incensed, stumbling into a realmstorm outside the village
Birth Realm: Bingchuan Village, Jijing Xiantiao, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Quirk: Hunted Emissary - Boon of Felicitous Mischief / Curse of Heavenly Enmity

Name: Ephraim
Backstory Bullet Points:
- An orphan bandit operating in the areas where Nezzim control was not so tight. Quit after a raid gone wrong became a village massacre.

- Captured and became slave to Nezzim masters. Eventually finds his way out of direct servitude and into 'working' for them instead, as a slave catcher. 

- Becomes Goldhearted, and is shown a truth that the Nezzim and Humans share a common ancestry. Starts helping slaves escape from the Nezzim in secret. 

- The Nezmiran Civil War against Theoris begins, and Ephraim throws in his lot with the Revolutionaries.
Relevant Arcana: Has a healthy respect and fear for Akhir (Nezmira's Vanagandr)
Remort Changes: No remort changes

Name: Epsilon J. Affogato
Backstory Bullet Points:
- HR/Corpo worker
- Does gigs on the side
- Bartends a lot
- Aims to have his own company (All's Well LLC)
- Currently being inducted into the Olympians (Codename: Sisyphus)
- Quietly planning to depose and remove Julius Augustus

Name: Eques
Backstory Bullet Points:
Having lived for  200 years without sentience  in the faerie realm as a Mushroom of no duty he was called to action by the mycelium below him feeling changes in the Gloom.

So he took up armor and weapon and underwent combat training at the Court of Spring.

With the shake up of the old Order, Eques is sent out by the Milras to be an Ambassador of Spring.

Name: Erdene
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Erdene (ER-deh-neh) is a towering apothecary specializing in herbal teas and remedies. A Cultivator of Crystal Qi, he has developed a unique means of delivering his remedies in hardened packets of natural sugars for ease of administration. 
- Despite his scarred face and brawny appearance, he bears little desire to pick up weapons unless in the necessary defense of himself and those of his community. 
- A follower of the Holy Harmony, he has no love for the authoritarian control of the Empty Monks, and his village is one of the few left in the western riverlands that have escaped their influence.
Quirk:
Qi Specialist: Crystal (Earth)
You gain resistance to the Earth damage. Additionally, whenever you deal damage, you may change its type so that it matches your elemental damage type. However, you also gain Vulnerability to Poison damage.
You also gain the ability to perform Rituals of the Elementalism discipline to manipluate earth/rocks.
The Vulnerability granted by this Quirk cannot be altered or overwritten by Qualities, or by Skills that grant you permanent Resistance (such as the Dark Blood Skill or the Glass Resistance Quality).

Name: Erin Glassvelle
Backstory Bullet Points:
- I was born In Silverdale to the Glassvelle, long standing retainers for the Morris house of nobles.

- My father is a well-regarded advisor to the current head of the household.

- I worked as a tutor/retainer of their heir to the house, Master Lucien Morris,

 - He, alongside my father were falsely implicated in a scandal regarding stolen jewelry from the queen and for conspiring against her.
 
- I managed to make a deal with the judge, to travel to the runewall in exchange for them to not be jailed and or executed if the worst comes to pass.

- "I'm hoping behind the Runewall I'll find the answers I'm looking for. That information could be the leverage I need to find my father & lord, alongside tracking down who is truly behind all this."

Name: Erin Shephard
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and raised in Steelbin's Civilized Zone with her older brother, Anthony Shephard. Their parents made their living being mechanics for Machina.
- The two siblings were raised to be skilled craftsmen and Anthony gained patronage to the Academy due to engineering skills. Anthony then brought attention to his younger sister Erin, who held the same promising skills but seemed more focused on using it on her own projects. 
- Under Anthony's recommendation, Erin received the same patronage but was more eager at the chance to leave Steelbin behind than learning new skills.
- Erin has been a student now for two years and while her brother was a perfect student, she failed to meet those expectations so she focused on proceeding to do the bare minimum to stay enrolled and no more than that.

Name: Esmon Stark
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Esmon was born in Morgan. When the bombstrikes happened in Morgan, he survived from luck, chance, and strategic placement.
- As the building collapsed, Esmon was with Cassidy, the two children huddled under the ruins of Morgan for shelter until Lady Charlotte Luther Von-Hardwick appeared to save them.
- Charlotte took the two children under her and the two grew up together. 
- Esmon growing to be overly aggressive and hot headed, especially when Cassidy would receive negative remarks - even from Cassidy themselves. 
- When he learned about Cassidy's condition from Charlotte, he did what he was always going to do. Protect Cassidy.  She doesn't need to know. Not until she can stand up for herself.
- Esmon joined the Angels at the same time of Cassidy.
- After graduation, Esmon was in a pair grouping with Cassidy, making sure that her condition is under check. This is shown in the design of their mechs, both of them designed to meld with one another.

Name: Estelle Dubois
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Single Daughter of a family that held the old teachings from forest spirits dearly, having taken the forest spirits' belief of caring for the land to heart.
- She was taught in the magical arts of Virelia and Anima due to her family's connection to the land they spent generations caring for.
- As time continued, the spirits began to become silent and no answers for the hostility that was once considered guardians and Leirsins who warned of worse to come.
- Estelle would try and beseech the spirits, but at no response, she began to look outside Rocade for help or answers.
- At the news of the Expedition to the Runewall, Estelle took it upon herself to join the numbers to find answers and something to help her home.

Name: Estrella Von Gilded
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A poor lass with big dreams, parents died of starvation in Belfrost

- Her innate talents in Magery got her relatively far, but not far enough for her goals

- Adopted by a "Baron" Von Gilded as a deal to participate in various magical experiments using herself as a catalyst

- Most of her time spent in isolation within the Hold, learning from various teacher brought in

- Time alone brought her to the delusion of royalty and power, the idea she's a Monarch bringing forth the future of Eurys

- While the experiments from Von Gilded were a success, it left her soul overcharged with energy cracking her physically and mentally

- Sent to the Rune Wall to prove her potential, and if returned alive well. Maybe Von Gilded will have other plans for her
Other Names:
- "Crimson Blaze Searing The Corrupt"

- "Gift of The Great Stars Above"

- "The Burning Monarch From Beyond Space and Time"

Name: Euri
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A Sparrow who was born and grew up constantly on the move, his family never staying with one group or community for very long.
- His constant movements led Euri to learn a little about many cultures around the Firwood, absorbing the stories and survival lessons of different groups.
- Those stories would become seeds he would inadvertently plant among the flocks he briefly encountered before moving on.
- Lacking in strong social anchors or sense of community, he is a flighty and eccentric bird who treasures his freedom and always looks for the next new discovery on the horizon.
Quirk:
Flight
You gain the benefits of flight. When you suffer air, bolt, or ice damage during a conflict scene while flying, you suffer additional minor damage for your level of the same type, and lose the benefits of this Quirk until the start of your next turn. You also lose the benefits of this quirk while you are in Crisis.

Name: Eurydice
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Eurydice was born within the Bazaar, not only an accidental birth but one believed to be born stillborn or sickly if the birth was even successful. 

- she had a normal upbringing, her father a blacksmith and her mother a merchant so life within the Bazaar was tame for her. Her parents were Keepers of the 4th Grave, Ogum.

- however, at a very young age she was discovered to be a Herald, a walker of Eminence's Path. 

- due to this, she was picked up by the Seven Slaying Arms Sect and trained under them to better foster her abilities. 

- either by her own desires, or the sects, to better honor the Path of Eminence, they set out to conquer an impossible challenge of taking a pilgrimage to the 5th grave, Apep.

- many lost their lives on this pilgrimage, and once they did get to the grave they were attacked by ghosts and spirits. Eurydice herself doesn't remember fully what happened.

- Eurydice now has a connection to ghosts and the Afterlife, having spirits bound to her.
Other Names:
6 Unstoppable Dawn Purges the Horizon
Horizon

Name: Eusebiu Atent
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From highborn branch of the Atent family, became affected by the Thinning as a child
- Thinning made exposure to other people and their emotions dangerous, grew up withdrawn and mostly sticking with his family
- Affliction had gotten worse upon reaching adulthood, started to feel his existence fading
- Believed staying with his family wouldn't lead to any change, so he decided to venture out on his own to learn more about the Black and how to control it
- Crossed paths with a DMI agent while performing his own investigation of an area
- After negotiations, decided to join the DMI himself, wanting access to their research in exchange for letting them experiment on him
- As a test subject, used largely to see the limits of Vlach magic and how it differs between vampires and humans
- Working there for a year or two enabled him to be permitted use of the DMI's arcana within restrictions

Name: Evelyn Antonov
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Orphaned before she could even register who her parents were, brought to a charity that took in kids of fallen soldiers at 1. 
* Said charity received a sizable donation from Lindsey Beck, granting the children opportunity they otherwise would've not had.
* Enrolled into Korala at a young age, diving deep into the engineering classes learning the ins and out of the Empire's technological advantages. 
* In Korala, it is where she found her dream of creating mechanical wonders that could not only attain peace but sustain it long after. 
* Upon graduating, she was assigned onto the now [Gleaming Goose] an airship that'd been commandeered by the Merrane Military. 

* Once the [Gleaming Goose] had been taken in a mutiny, she'd come to meet the very man who kick started her life, Lindsey Beck along with Percival. 
* In these critical moments, Evelyn had her eyes opened. Creating weapons for Merrane would not attain peace.. she'd find another way. With the Violet Barons.

Name: Ezekiel Faranda
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born into a rich family of a Start-up CEO and an entrepreneur, Lived a good early life.
- Goes into mechanical engineering and with an interest in machinery and weaponry gets Military training
- CEO Father fucked up royally and his company imploded on itself, was never able to stabilize, mother filed for divorced, and so turned to gambling to try and keep his bougie lifestyle, did not go well.
- Loan sharks step in and, while trying to resist, father dies. Insolvency starts. Forcing Ezekiel to pick up temp work.
- While trying to deal with an job regarding illegal drug dealing, Ezekiel ends up shot dead in an alleyway. Wakes up in ETA building as it's revealed how *bad* his fathers contract was. Generational Insolvency starts.
- Becomes ETA's lapdog and outsourced to multiple experimental projects with other companies, predominantly weapons testing with Tubal and Cain.
- Is now a personal lapdog for ETA, but continues Temp work on the side to try and get some semblance of autonomy.

Name: Eʞo
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A cactus that somehow gained sentience
- Lived near the Hives, hunting down Kiir and scaring the travelers away from the hives
- Really likes plants and gardening. Futile as it may be in the desert, but there's ample fertilizer
- Managed to save a girl from dying once when her loved one ditched her
- Got picked up by a sandstorm and thrown aboard the ship in the same sack this one sleeped in
- Ended up appearing only once during Bloodmoon, but stopped demons from trampling this one's precious ones

Name: Fabri Caetspells
Backstory Bullet Points:
Comes from a family of rich celebrities from terra
Fabri's mother, Vindi, working for NTT is trying to rebrand magic to become a face of a group and gain even more fame
This skyrocketed the family into even more celebrity status due to controversy
Vindi as part of a magical rebranding stunt claimed that her daughter was a spell caster
Fabri being her oldest child was set up as said spellcaster despite not being able to cast spells
Uncle teaches Fabri to create spells via magisphere
uses it to "fake it till she made it"
Vindi uses Fabri to try and push magic to be more "friendly and light hearted" to change public opinion
uses her connections to make Fabri a storm "superhero" as part of her brand
Fabri believes every word of it

Name: Familade
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Familade was born in the winter court, in a domain whose residents were committed to opposing the encroaching influence of Vanagandr

- She was a picture perfect daughter in most regards. Noble, imposing, powerful, all things that would serve her well in navigating the politics of the winter court. However, deep within her, she harbored a bestial hunger within her. 

- Despite her best efforts to maintain a noble, dignified persona, she would oftentimes need to sneak off to hunt dangerous beasts of the faerie realm, in order to sate her thirst for battle

- In one failed hunt, Familade was injured horribly, and in her frenzied state, she lashed out at her family members who tried to heal her.  

- She was promptly exiled from her community, and was forced to wander the edges of the mortal realm, hunting weak monsters in the forests, and helping wanderers whenever possible. Eventually, she met 2 travelers, and through the deeds she did alongside them, was whisked away to the Worldhelm

Name: Fayn Silverheart
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Fayn is a progeny of  a Cold Patriarch from the Court of Winter and a Nyad from the Court of Seas 
-  he found himself wandering the mortal realm , he met and feel in love with a mortal man in the Vicinty of Lastport
- Fayn uses his knowledge of magic to help elevate the Mortal's teashop.
-    the mortal passes away.
- Ice physically manifest after the death of the mortal, their time together and even the mortal's name become diffcult to recall still there but hard  to access. 
- with the Mortal's death Fayn's welcome in Lastport end's and he  goes on an adventure to try and find " the warmth he once knew."
- His Journey eventually leads him to a Realmstorm and then to the Worldhelm itself will he find the Warmth he is missing here?

Name: Felicia Rehinsfel
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Second daughter to a Wulforh noble family, and deemed a failure by her father due to her inability to use magic in a family filled with Mages.
* Was seperated from her twin sister when they were sent to Gaius Military school and  Breusen Mage Academy respectively due to her (intentional or unintentionally) distracting her twin sister, excelling in trouble making. 
* From a young age, she could not explain why, but she always felt a hunger inside of her for as long as she can remember. It sometimes manifests as cravings for food, and biting.
* Upon hearing of what happened at the Breusen Mage Academy regarding her sister, she packed her bags, and abandoned the school without a notice to find her sister, and subsequently join her as they enter the Runewall together.
Quirk:
Cursed
Part of her soul is missing; leaving a gaping hole within her being. Creating an everlasting hunger inside of her being, ever since birth has this hole existed. She knows of no life that does not have this. Often manifesting itself in spotus of anger or aggression, or simple hunger and need to eat as much as she can. Making her tunnel vision in many situations where this hunger consumes her.

Name: Felicity Rehinsfel
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Eldest daughter to a Wulforh noble family, and entrusted with their magical crest which carried with it the legacy of their magical knowledge since before the colonization of Eurys.
- Was seperated from her twin sister when they were sent to Breusen Mage Academy and Galius Military School respectively. Excelled in her magical studies and met an heir of Prosperity named Alain Meyer.
- Alain convinced her to help him practice Briar magic in secret. She followed along in hopes she could make a name of herself sooner than later.
- A magical accident occurs and harms those around her in class along with an heir to Desire named Anastasia Fischer. Causing her to be sentence to execution via the Runewall for the damages done to the school and harming an heir of Desire.
- Before stepping through after being cast out from the Academy and the family she was joined by her twin sister to know that she wasn't alone in wherever they ended up.

Name: Fenja
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born before the fall of Baylore
Was chosen for an experimental project 
First successful merge of a seaborn and human
Was put into stasis as the bombs fell on Termina.
Just woke up and out of the loop of the current day.

Name: Fenn
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Part of Autumn Court
-Pulls a prank on the queen
-gets thrown out into Kor'Tarion
-Noble asshole takes advantage of her weakness to make her a servant
-Escapes and leaves him for dead
-Lives in the Gwaed Forest as a thief
Quirk:
Outcast Fairy:
Speak to Beasts, Elementals, Plants
Learn 1 spell ( Drain Spirit)
Do rituals
Use rituals to transport creatures into/out of faerie realm
Weakness: When Fenn loses their mask, they have to obey all commands they're given by the first person who's eyes they look into.  This effect is broken if she wears her mask again.

Name: Fernia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Used to just be a traveling botanist studying plants.
- Went into the Irathwood to study rumors of strange flowers.
- Was attacked by some unseen assailant while looking for the mysterious flowers.
- Woke up with wounds stitched together by a mysterious plant, attempts of removal or actions that seem to displease this plant cause her extreme pain.

Name: Ferry
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Can't remember his life before the night of Operation Mute, a fog of smoke and flame in his mind.
- Raised as an orphan by the scientist Professor Hagen Arzet, another survivor of the raid on Vale.
- Lived as a scavenger in his youth, helping Prof. Arzet with his research by collecting scraps used as materials. Eventually led to the creation of his mechanical arm, secretly a prototype weapon made for revenge against those that ruined the Vale.
- Left behind in his mid-teens when Prof. Arzet joined with Merrane nationalists that had convinced the scientist the Karslguard had destroyed their own city as a conspiracy cover up job.
- Spent his days admiring the ruined arts of old and his nights scrounging supplies, sometimes trading food for knowledge of what used to be in Vale.
- Began seeing Merrane activity within the Vale as an adult, and after a few close calls realized they came for Prof. Arzet’s research: his arm.
- Sheer luck had a Realmstorm whisk him away before he was caught.

Name: Flynn Hyacinthus
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Raised in Tradefair to a single mom (poor)
-Born from a fey deal since parents couldn't have a kid
-Was a servant to a noble house / learned to dance from them
-Trained himself how to fight from watching the mercenaries in Tradefair
-Worked against L.U.T by being a mercenary till he was brought to the Worldhelm
Remort Changes: Soul Steal SL1 -> See You Later SL1

Name: Forest Smith
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From a family of civil engineers. Has a brother who is a really prolific Triworld player. His parents only really focus on his brother and not Forest.
- Through Twinworld, Forest met someone who he became friends with. Said friend helped land him a job at a weapons workshop called "Sodalite Workshop"
- They were a pretty tight knit group until they had a massive falling out due to selling out information.
- Forest and one other are now the only ones left at the workshop. Has to do temp work on the side in order to keep himself and the business afloat

Name: Fox Kensington
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born within Empire of Merrane borders; raised amongst a large family on a vinyard close to the Capital. 

- Age 18: Conscripted into the Merrane Imperial Army at the 

- Age 21: Trained as a Cavalier at the; assigned to the 8th Light Cavalry Regiment with his first MSTNG 44 Automaton Steed named Houston. Assigned to the Frontlines against the Kingdom of Karlsgard

- Age 24: Promoted to Sergeant, loses Houston during a siege on KPLA Outpost. Achieves Pyrrhic Victory. Grows a reputation for a determined yet stern Officer amongst his Regiment. Is given a new Automaton Steed named Odin. 

- Age 27: Promoted to Lieutenant. First Assignment would later be known as the Massacre of the 8th, Miscommunication sees entire 8th Regiment caught in a machine gun nest by the KPLA. A strange storm overcomes the battlefield and several soldiers; Including Lieutenant Fox are counted as KIA.

- Fox awakens onboard the Worldhelm with his Automaton Steed, confused, scared and wondering if he's dead...

Name: Franz Alberic
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Reven Delsatz, began studying the magical arts of Thaumaturgy and Animism in his late teenage years, in the time since then he has struggled to grasp these disciplines beyond a fundamental level but is quite decent at blending those fundamentals with swordplay
- Unfortunately even a vassal state as neutral as Delsatz can avoid the quarrels caused by the Calamity forever, so Franz set out to the runewall to further his understanding of the arcane arts and acquire 
perspective on the wider world for while Delsatz is for the most part neutral, in Franz's eyes no answers have been found in this neutrality as all the greater powers seem to be doing in Delsatz is talk with very little actual solution making.
- So with a clear goal, Franz Alberic would join the Expedition both to sate his own hunger for knowledge and to find a potential solution for the Calamity

Name: Fraux K.
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born and raised in North Rock
-Lost both parents at 14, due to a thug breaking in and killing both the parents while he was away.
-His mother had a ring which he decided to hold onto and wear, being one of his Heirlooms
-Eventually turned to the gambling world where he'd earn big, but never enough.
-Met a guy when he was 20, bought a deck of cards (one of his Heirlooms.) from the guy and hung out with him for a bit before departing.
-He mostly wanders through Haven now, pick-pocketing random people and giving the stuff he gets to the unwealthy, or gambling his money away.

Name: Frederick Schmidt
Backstory Bullet Points:
*Hailing from the isolated kingdom of Silverdale, Friedrich, or Frederick Schmidt as he likes to call himself was born into house Schmidt.

*House Schmidt is a relatively new noble family, therefore they do not have much political influence. As Frederick was raised with his twin brother Alphonse and his older sister Morgan under their mother to express themselves however they wished.

*Private tutored by a young age in eidola magic. 

*Frederick often tried to go on adventures out into the cold for most of his life. Needing excitement.

*Found an odd set of crystals which resonated with his musical magia one day and brought them home. 

*Morgan fashioned them into pistols for him. Skilled tinkerer she is.

*Friedrich and Alphonse were recruited one day to go to an expedition to The Runewall

*Frederick wanted the adventure. Alphonse wanted to keep his brother safe.

*The two got separated in the storm during their expedition. They screamed for eachother...neither heard an answer.

Name: Freyr Branson
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born the Eldest Son in to a Widowed Man in Gravslenge, Karsbren
- Watched his father "acquire" two more sons. Though he refuses to speak on how they arrived, he loves them both deeply.
- In his early years, loved the sounds of the Forge and the smells of the smithy.
- Managed to gain an apprenticeship to a smith in his early teens.
- Began working in the Great Forge in Gravslenge in his early 20s after having half a decade of smithing experience, and found his talent went father than most, being able to channel the magic of Permanence into his craft.
- Spent the next decade being a mentor for a talented slave smith, and he helped her escape when she couldn't take it anymore.
- Decided after a few lonely years in the forges, he should take his craft outwards to the rest of Eurys, in order to seek his own brand of Permanence.
- Once he heard about the gathering of Expeditions to enter the Runewall, he decided to head there to offer his talents. Maybe he'd find his old friend there...
Other Names: Smith Branson, Battlesmith Branson, Freyr the Fair

Name: Frigg Engstrom
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born between a union of Niklas Engstrom and a Hedge mage Sarya Vespertine. 
- At around 9 their father wins the tournament to become the next Jarl of Karsbren. 
- Seeing his ambition and love for power grow, their mother decides to take them out of the country, to learn from their extended family of Hedges
- Around 5 years ago they return to Karsbren and get apprehended at the border
- Brought "home"
- A story of having been kidnapped gets circulated, their mother gets enslaved
- They try to  stand up to their father, gets put in their place, and eventually gets the Rune of obedience (Curse Quirk)
- Gets sent to the Realmstorm to pass through, and are not expected to survive, but lets them die honourably without smudging the picture of their father.
- Survives.

Name: Fuchiko
Backstory Bullet Points:
- One of the experimented individuals from Lumina Prime
- After a while, one of the researcher grew attached to Fuchiko and tried to run away somewhere out of the region
- The researcher got found, but not before hiding Fuchiko somewhere in Haven
- The experiment gave her mutant and esper abilities; this caused her to constantly hear things
- This led to her believing that she can listen to the will of the universe itself
- She roams the region aimlessly, until one day she found a sermon talking about Providence, the One True God
- This led to her believing that the sounds she kept hearing is God calling out to her, and the dying religion is a sign of her to become one of His Messengers
- She tried hard to 'connect' to God in a literal sense; finding a tall building, calling random numbers, meditating near a telecommunication tower, until she finally stumbled upon a Realmstorm in the expanse of Central.

Name: Fuji Iwai
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Fuji Iwai was born in Twin Peaks, to a nomadic group of Birdlike Yokai.

- 5 years ago, during an attack on her nomadic family, she was captured and enslaved by Sakura the Skalded.

- Her wings were clipped to prevent escape, and also for the madman's amusement, being a fan of irony. Instead of being used as an experiment, she was tasked with handling toxic reagents.

- This exposure to dangerous chemical mixtures and general maltreatment caused her to lose most of her memory.

- At a point in her captivity, she was given the call of the edge.  In a spur of decisiveness, she ran, as far as she could. She followed her urge, hoping it would bring her safety. 

- She was cornered at the edge of a cliff, was she forced to make the choice of life in servitude, or freedom no matter the cost. With a scared breath, and the yelling of her master behind her, she stepped off the ledge. 

-  Before she could meet her demise, she was swallowed by a realmstorm. Her life starting a new chapter.
Quirk:
__**Elemental Soul (Air)**__

You are deeply infused with the power of a natural element in some way.

Air: Resistance, Earth: Vulnerability

Choose your elemental damage type: air, bolt, earth, fire, or ice. You gain Resistance to the chosen damage type. Additionally, whenever you deal damage, you may change its type so that it matches your elemental damage type. However, you also become Vulnerable to a different damage type chosen among those five. 

You also gain the ability to perform Rituals of the Elementalism discipline, but only if those Rituals manipulate your chosen element (respectively air, electricity, earth/rock, fire, and ice/water).

The Vulnerability granted by this Quirk cannot be altered or overwritten by Skills, Spells, Qualities, or any other effects besides the Guard action.

Name: Fungee
Backstory Bullet Points:
🔹 Grown from the [mycorrhizal network](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mycorrhizal_network)—a vast, living fungal web that stores memory and emotional resonance across the land.
🔹 Formed in a grove centered around Echobark, an ancient tree that serves as the deepest node of the local network.
🔹 Regarded by some pilgrims as Echobark’s spirit or child.
🔹 Spent early life listening and interpreting the network, gently resolving spiritual imbalances in the realm.
🔹 Joined the Goldhearted seeking connection through joyful presence and emotional resonance.

Name: Féin of Lionheart's Reach
Backstory Bullet Points:
- She is the daughter of a once more noble family of the name Faolán.
- During the Great Hunt one of the Great Wolf's Fangs was said to have broken off by The Lion. This came in to possession of her family.
- The family's social favor with the people dimmed drastically due to their name, even though they had nothing to do with the great hunt. Even more so the fact they kept said Fang decreased favor even more.
- The family which initially held wolves favorably, all but officially exiled themselves from Hearthome to subject themselves to eternal vigil over the Murkwood due to feelings of betrayal and responsibility.
- Féin is the current wielder of The Great Fang, Cú Faoil. Having been passed down from generation to generation of those who stood vigil as Lionheart's Reach over the Murkwood as a Knight. She is called Faolán at times as a means of disrespect by some rather than her name or Wolf Knight Faolán by those who respect her and the sacrifice being made by taking the mantle.

Name: Féng Líhuà 「冯丽华」
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Bishi'e born into a normal loving family within Yuānshì due to fervent prayers wishing for a healthy child. Seen as a great omen and overall liked by her village.
- Is told by villager elder Sūn Wǔhào that her parents got killed while out foraging in the Mòguāng jungle. A fabrication of events that Wǔhào created to keep Líhuà out of trouble. She is unaware of the truth and believes his story to be fact still to this day.
- Is taken in as one of Wǔhào's students in the form of body cultivation, creates a rivalry with his grandson Hàoyú.
- Is shown to have a massive innate affinity to Sun Qi, Reaches Qi condensation at the ridiculous age of 16 before Hàoyú even with a 9 year age difference, rivalry turns bitter as the clear Bishi'e advantage she has is obvious to anyone.
- Progress slows to a halt in her perspective so she starts her journey. Now trying to further hone herself to become as strong of a body cultivator as possible, while broadening her coddled views of the world.

Name: G0BLIN
Backstory Bullet Points:
An orphan Raised in this very circus,known enough to be welcomed from place to place,since his youth adamai was strong yet naive he was taken in by the circus crew as their own and he saw em as his family,as boy grew so dis his strength enough to surpass most man around him,as participated in dangerous stunts and plays.
Yet the circus owner saw something else in adamai's talent,he took him to fight rings here he won and it paid well.
If he came back hurt,he laughed it off it nothing to worry about.

But one night adamai lost,when he woke up the next day,the owner ran way with his money and the circus too.
Leaving all desperate, yet adamai endured,he went back to the rings to fight again and again all the way to the top.

Name: GARIK GAURDER
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Hails from brightshield

-Travels hold to hold under the guise of protecting caravans

-The harsh region has conditioned him to never take off his helm, so no fae may know both his face and name

-large merchant blames him for losing their supply to a raid, started hiring brigands to hunt him down

-he was backed into a corner by a fake carriage of false merchants, stood with his own shield and the shield of a fellow guard, middle of the night, the witching hour, if the thieves didn’t finish him, the fae would, a long trek home- but when he felt all was lost he found himself standing on a platform… perhaps death had taken him all he could see was endless sky, until he was shooed inside by golems into a large… sky carriage?

Name: GR-3-G-0-RY
Backstory Bullet Points:
Gregory was contrusted under the Species Preservation Equality Clause. In which two fully fledged LUA could form a family and legally order the creation of a child. He worn “born” to a family of guard units serving under shady contracters and violent gang members, all rich and power hungry in their own little way. For 26 years he was trained to protect and serve for the most immoral people imaginable. People who worked with companies whom held a tight and unyielding grip against the local populace.

He was armed with deadly weaponry; sleek, efficient, the best of which TERRA could offer. He lived large too, about as large as a LUA could anyway. But despite everything he rejected it, he rejected his parents, his lifestyle and just about everything connected to it and ran away…

Nowadays you can find him, near the outskirts of vinyard in a scrapheap, trying to set up a… flower shop?

Name: GREY HOWLER
Backstory Bullet Points: *The Orwell Family is a small family of demon hunter, but also is a undead creatures

Name: Gabieta Galsas

The Wounded Fowl
The Red Hearth Spirit

Name: Gabriel Astrea
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was raised in a 'paycheck to paycheck' kind of family. Eventually wanted to make something of his life and started learning anything and everything he could.
- Eventually became a rising star in the area of Soulrunning. SWORD took notice of his work and hired him to lead a small team of Temps.
- Worked as a Temp for a few years till a new hire was assigned to his team by the name of Yuna. Soon after that the team was killed in an ambush besides for Yuna and Gabriel.
- ETA took notice of the failed job and forced them both into a debt that they needed to worked under ETA to pay off.
- Was assigned the Callsign "Fox" and Gabriel Astrea was pronounced KIA on the mission they failed.

Name: Gabriela Josephina Caladrius
Backstory Bullet Points:
- The Daughter of High Priestess Caladrius, Gabriela's birth was ordained years prior, on a Solar Eclipse

- On that faithful day, a Lunar Eclipse covered the sky instead, blocking the sun from the prophesized blessing of the High Priestess' Daughter. Gabriela has lived in the shadow of that event her entire life, far weaker than she should be.

- She took solace in her older sister's guidance, and her nephew, who was similar of age, and acted like her sibling. She found talent in her physical capabilities, a side effect of the Eclipse.

- Not a month after she turned 11, her sister was killed by demons during a mission to a Coven Town. This changed both her and her nephew's lives forever.

- She threw herself into her training, molding herself into a vessel for Exorcism, her touch of the eclipse able to channel the Sun's Wrath at high intensity.

- She continues her path of Fury, with Heron as her stalwart guardian. Following the path of righteous indignation.

Name: Gabu
Backstory Bullet Points:
- demon of Envy whose essence was tampered with by the Dream Weaver
- spent 72 years claiming humanity
- makes a name for himself as Gabu, protector of the Mirland Coast
- turns back into his old form due to succeed at a cost
Remort Changes: Esper skill names (nothing else)

Name: Gadget
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born within Firwood, frequented the Hand of Omoth with his respective coven

- Always had a knack of trinkets even as a child/teen, and was just under the "cut off" for being sent off for the Fox's crusade against the Blight

- Survivor Guilt wracks his brain, and decided he needs to live on for the Foxes that perished in the attempt, and decides the best way to do so is the improve the livelihood of all the citizens beyond the foxes.

- Today, he works closely with the Fellowship at the behest of Arzen to make his dream come true.

Name: Gaius Decimus
Backstory Bullet Points: Born in Last Hold, swayed to become a Kiir Hunter to hide his nascent magical abilities and escape the oppression of the Nezzim. While out hunting, he one day found a tablet talking about Falak-Khan. Now he tries to gather as much information about the forgotten god to entice his fellow oppressed into rebellion against the Nezzim.
Remort Changes: None

Name: Galavan Riverstone
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Simple young man from Belfrost
- Seeks knowledge to the Sanctuary of wisdom in Stratford
- Becomes a follower of the Beacon of Wisdom Julius Miquel, admires him a lot
- Julius sends his disciples out to seek wisdom, Galavan is one of them
- Tasked with understanding the Watcher's Tome by Julius himself
- Joins the expedition and goes through the Runewall/Realmstorm
Quirk:
Heirloom - The watcher's tome

The Tome is a transforming custom weapon (arcane and sword) with the Magic Up quality.

Terrible Flaw: The odd magic of the Tome tends to react badly with the power of the stones, and with the arcana in general - almost if those powers were anathema to it. The Tome is also a conspicuous magic item and as such it might be very coveted by thieves and brigands. Finally, Not even rituals of great power can seem to understand what the tome is, making it sought after by ruthless mages.

(this was discussed with Path)

Name: Gareth
Backstory Bullet Points:
-died, enough time passed in Barza that he doesn't remember Terra 
-met Mya, began travelling with her to descend the layers and escape
-got stuck in Sum
-Mya turn to stone
-spend the last 2 years dragging along her statue as he works to fix her and escape

Name: Garmir Eidolon
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Raised in an orphanage in Silver Rock, has no idea who his parents were
- More or less had a decent childhood, destitute but had a sense of community around him with the other orphans and his neighbors to make up for that
- When he was 16, was kidnapped with some others and taken to Cabre by T&C to be used as test subjects, using cybernetic augments and mind control to develop the ideal living weapon
- Garmir's body specifically was augmented with cybernetic tentacles
- Next couple years of his life he can't really remember, but one day the device controlling him failed, and using his newfound strength he escaped
- Stowed away on a ship and returned to Haven, where he took up doing odd jobs to make do while lying low in North Rock
- Got a TEMP license using a fake name, Kevin Thompson
- Biding his time right now, trying to get strong enough to make those who modified him pay... but more importantly, find out what happened to the other test subjects and save them if possible

Name: Garmyth
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Originally from Grestazs; lost his family young during a “haunted storm.”
- Discovered by a traveling family and brought to Delsatz for his magical potential.
- Rose quickly as a prodigy, earning the title _Great Sage of Delsatz_.
- Traveled the world with a fellow mage, performing heroic deeds.
- Retired as the Great Sage at 45 years old; his companion became the Figurehead of Delsatz
- Returned to Grestazs to live peacefully at a settlement with his newly found wife.
- Another “haunted storm” struck—he repelled it, but lost his wife and residents
- Guilt-ridden at his inability, he renounced magic and secluded himself within the Erdelward Forest at Mastrazs for the next 15 years
- Despite solitude in Erdelward Forest, he quietly saved lost travelers over the years.
- Recently received a letter from an old friend calling him to join an Expedition.
Other Names:
Gustav Weisberg
The (Former) Great Sage of Delsatz
That Surly Hermit of Erdelward Forest

Name: Garnier
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a peasant family in Pragstenburg
- Always admired knights, but couldn't join any due to birth status
- Trained on his own, until he heard about an order named "The Company of Fellows"
-Despite his lowborn status, he joined as a squire/page at 17
-Worked his way up to a full knight over four years, emulating the unorthodox Company's ways of equality under service, dispensing justice, chivalry and heroism
-The Company took a mission to try and depose a particularly powerful bandit lord, who posed as a sort of merchant king
-They failed, the entire Company died except him. He had been delayed to the mission due to a small dalliance.
-Falls into a deep depression, carried by charity borne from infamy at first, and then general pity for a shell of a man.
-42 years pass, and joins the expedition into the Runewall in order to finally die in a way that would befit a "knight".
-Worldhelm.

Name: Gaspar Pianissimo
Backstory Bullet Points:
- formerly a high class musician (until he dies)
- reaches Paradise before the corruption gets to Idyll
- after Vanagandr gets to Idyll, publicly contests Caladrius' thought police ways
- gets cursed by the lord of Paradise so he can't speak ill about him (will die for real if he does it too many times)
Remort Changes: Gaspar was left untouched by the patch

Name: Gawain Elysia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a family in the New Moon Tribe. While growing up, other Leirsin would often keep their distance as Gawain never had the same potency Omen seeing abilities as others. 

- He would receive visions of great battles and other aspects of Victory in his dreams. Leading him to fight a Caravan along the road with some others of his kin when he was a teenager.

- During the attack the Victory beacon showed mercy to him and took him to the Victory Stone to hone his abilities. Training him for years to come on how to best practice the teachings of victory and battle.

- Now an adult, Gawain seeks a battle that could sate every desire he could ever want from life. Pushing him to leave the Victory Stone for now in search for his own way in life. His own victory.

Name: Gerald Alighieri
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born to a family of Guilders in Providencia. Gerald would have lived a fairly normal artisan life were it not for a chance encounter with a group of Delvers known as the Forge's Inferno.
Gerald would join the Forge's Inferno initially as one of their many blacksmiths traveling throughout the land in search of ruins, treasure and glory.
This would continue for a time til Gerald found a mysterious Elden relic in a ruin, protocol dictating that all relics are to be appraised upon surfacing in order to prevent any unfortunate activations.
However this relic seemed extremely unstable, rapidly engulfing Gerald and the rest of his team in flames.
Gerald would awake, alone but mostly unharmed save a literal burning in his soul that seemingly will not be going away any time soon.
Wanting to get leads on where his lost comrades might have gone if they are even still alive, Gerald would join the adventurer's guild to make adequate use of what time he has left

Name: Gerard de Montagne
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Veteran Mech Pilot of the Merrane Military.
- Born and raised in Caldera as the son of an engineer, attended the White Wing Academy.
- Married a seamstress who made the bulk of her income making and refitting military uniforms.
- Became disillusioned with the empire after years of following orders he’d generously call questionable and the death of his mother, father, wife and unborn child in a political conflict while he was at the frontline.
- Worn down and filled with Guilt and Regret he follows orders while desperately seeking any way to escape, feeling there is nothing left for him in the empire except duty and bitter resentment.

Name: Gianna Tomaris
Backstory Bullet Points:
- former factotum at her family's inn in the tundra
- house/inn gets burned down
- father hands her the family heirloom, she tries to save her family but fails
- saved by a realmstorm
- during her time as a hero, discovers she can cast magic. still unsure how to feel about it.
Remort Changes: none!

Name: Gin
Backstory Bullet Points:
Origin
> Gin was born in an unnamed village that has been migrating towards Hanae.
Kidnapping
> Gin was given as a sacrifice to the Oni of The Shrine of Inexorable Tides because of their knack for water cultivation. They somehow brought him there from the mainland.
Training
> An Echo of Musashi appeared to Gin during his captivity, who then taught him how to create and fight with swords and eventually escape

Name: Gladiolus Amendola
Backstory Bullet Points:
- septid, born and raised in South Rock, in an apparently well-off family.
- used to be a problem child until the age of 14, kind of a jerk and a bully.
- parents die and they're suddenly responsible for a younger brother.
- turns out parents charged a *lot* of debt on them. Millions of zenit.
- decides they'd better work to repay every single zenit of it. Gleans himself up, tries becoming a better person.
- works for ETA as a debt collector, enjoys the job quite a lot. Has a decent enough salary to provide for them and lil bro.
- went to get a payment, debtor pulled a gun on him. "Guess insolvency it is", they thought. Instead, they were summoned to the Worldhelm

Name: Godric
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Mage heir to a [corrupt merchant family](https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1310205180972896357) that hates mages
- They cause a magic accident and blame him for it
- He discovers the truth years later and abandons family
- Becomes a mage mercenary with a magic armor
- Fails because too haughty and desperate for validation
- Gets clerk jobs, including at Orion Marduke's shop
- Fails because of personality and family's influence
- Decides to go to Hudal but gets to Worldhelm first

Name: Gojko
Backstory Bullet Points:
- used to be a high rank soldier among the mouse king's forces a long time ago
- made friend with the king and a certain former spy spider
- had to lead incursions against the Blight, a moth predicted he'd flee
- was scared and ran away, returned to the mouse king with great dishonor
- was exiled instead of being executed, roamed the woods for years and found a mentee in a blight-affected frog
- was called to the mouse king to mentor his oldest son

Name: Grimalkin II
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A young cat yokai that has lost his mama

- Became blessed with speech by Kuzunoha one day

Name: Guiying 「桂英」
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a family of mortals, seen both as a good omen and as something to hide not to be persecuted
- Grew up passing from minor sect to minor sect, fleeing every time they were destroyed
- Learned cultivation from a manual from Wen Oina’s sect, teaching about music Qi
- Lived mostly as a beggar and hiding his horns until the realmstorm took him
Quirk:
Hunted Emissary: Boon of Auspicious Wisdom, Curse of Heavenly Enmity

Name: Guo Mùchén
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a human mother and Cultivator father within Bingchuan Village. Marriage was unhappy, father abusive/prone to anger.
- Mother prayed to the God Li Jing, bearer of the hundred-tiered pagoda and god of protection. Desiring a son who would protect her from her partner and the village as a whole.
- Born a Jinshi with an innate connection to Blood Cultivation, a mixture of Wood & Water Qi.
- Raised into a protector of the village alongside other Jinshi. 
- Upon being older, discovered his father was indulging in Corrupt Cultivation through cannibalism in secret.
- Had him thrown out to safeguard the village. 
- Recently buried his mother as she succumbed to old age.
Birth Realm: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Jijing Xiantiao, Bingchuan
Quirk:
Hunted Emissary - BOON OF SELF PERFECTION
Natural Weapon [MIG+DEX+1]

Name: Gwendoline of Hearthome
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Daughter of a noble family of mice, notable solely for her father being a knight to the king alongside her brothers either being squires or knights themselves. 

- The youngest and only daughter, grew up within Hearthome a life of security and safety. Was a known face around Hearthome, constantly helping folk and solving people's issues.  

- Constantly strived to be a knight herself, much to the disapproval of her family namely her father. Noting it was dangerous work.

- Despite those warnings, she still trained with a sword alongside her friend, one who watched over the walls of Pride's Keep along with her siblings willing to teach her. 

- Learning of the Fellowship setting out though not a part of it herself, she stole her family's gear and departed alongside her friend.

- Was taken by a Realmstorm and now here, doing her best to be the knight she knows she is.

Name: Gwydion
Backstory Bullet Points:
Was raised and has lived in the fae realm most of his life

While in the Realm, he was in service to the Spring Court

His fae nature makes him friendly and agreeable, making him suited for diplomacy (though he doesn't necessarily enjoy this)

He as a passion for the art of dueling, and cares deeply about the formal agreements behind them in a similar vein to other fae's interest in deals and 'gifts'

Wants to master his craft to be the best he can be, started journeying to hone himself and see the world

While journeying, he realized how many people were hurting in the wider world

His travel led him on a brief journey across both Kor'Tarion and its Faerie Realm, during which the Realmstorm caught him, drawing him to the Worldhelm
Quirk:
Fairy Outcast
Spell: Heal
Curse: I must always put on a brave face, and be kind and courteous, no matter the situation

Name: Gwydion Tlepsh
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A blacksmith for Castle Ladon’s knights, so dedicated to the forge he was blessed to always have a part of its fire in him
- Dreamed of crafting marvelous legendary weapons during the mystical sleep created by Regus
- Woke up and realized his legendary crafts were just dreams, but instead of crying over it he became thrilled at the idea of bringing those marvelous dreams to life
- Joined the Goldhearted as where heroes go, legends follow, and he wants to see the stories of new and old friends become grandiose

Name: Gwyneth
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Found in a basket, fished out of the ocean by fishers in Traeth Village.
* Grew up taller, stronger, much hungrier than a normal person.
* Took up the axe and armor to be the local guardian of Traeth.
* Inspired by the acts of heroism spreading throughout the realm, leaves to help who she can.

Name: Gyalwa Jigme
Backstory Bullet Points:
- grows up as a monk in the Temple of Strife, absolutely hates it
- decides to make it a problem to the monks
- becomes passionate about math and physics, cutivates that
- develops her own very odd dao, cultivates Heavenly Qi
- gets to the worldhelm and has her soul messed up with on Terra's soul network
- she's fine now
Remort Changes: exoskeleton weapons dealing 2 less damage

Name: HIVEKIN
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Ritveja was born to a collective of void monks in Leytik, and was taught techniques on how to cultivate her own special kind of void Qi by intaking new experiences, and meditating on them to flush the ones she could not learn from out of her mind and body

-  When she came of age, she left the monk's compound, in search of ways to learn about the world, and apply her teachings to make it a better place. She began setting up a fledgling trade network between settlements in Leytik, trading things like beads, furs, clean water, and nonperishable food in exchange for their unwanted items, so that she could determine what things were good and bad for society, and more precisely flush out that which caused harm.

- Eventually, her altruism and charity led her into a Realmstorm, which she almost cluelessly wandered into, ending up on the Worldhelm

Name: Hamra Al-Ayn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in Ormen, Grestaz until she was around 10-12 Wulfroh mercs captured her 
- Sent to Gravslenge, Karsbren to work in the forges until she was 17
- A dragon egg was to be hatched by the Jarl, but even with the enslavement magic, it imprinted on Hamra as the first person that they saw saw/fed them
- Frees the dragon, dragon helps her escape, she's on the run for several years, trying to make her way south/survive
- Joins the Caravan for safety to avoid capture, choosing potential death over it
Quirk:
World Heir - Next in Line [Prestige Quirk]
- Path of Permanence (Tubalcain)

Name: Haoran
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Bishi'e born in Secret Fern Village
- Affinity for Metal Qi
- Selected as sacrifice
- Fled the village, ended up on Worldhelm
Full backstory:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QUSg03N5hyLfRrpnGWNR8jt1LifS6h4b_pMpGZFGXG0/edit?usp=sharing

Name: Haru Whittlee
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was abandoned to an orphanage at a really young age, parents faces are a blur in their memory
- Was taken in to be a part of a socio neurological experiment. It was about seeing how much one could influence and foster a child's cognitive capabilities. 7 other children were a part of this.
- Grew up getting very intrigued and attached to mathematics and how it interfaces with the rest of the world.
- Was "homeschooled" until college, though even with a sizable drop in motivation, they were able to get their degree a year early.
- Got multiple job offers after graduation, but turned them all down due to a lack of interest.
- During their free time they joined and participated in online programming and arithmetic circles under an anonymous alias. Users were often confused because they would post their work without proper explanations
- Eventually gets scouted by QiLink to join their Horn department. and after a short apprenticeship became a full employee

Name: Haruka Satsuki
Backstory Bullet Points:
Haruka Satsuki was born in Sakai and at a very young age was blessed by an Aosagibi. 

The shrine maidens seeing this knew it was a sign from Amatarasu that Satsuki was blessed by her.
Satsuki would spend most of his days with the shrine maiden learning their practices.

Honomi Moku, one of the Shrine Maidens and a older sister figure to Satsuki, taught Satsuki the basics of qi cultivation. He discovered that the qi he had affinities that mirrored what is understood about Amaturasu.


They would often sneak off to either train with some of the warriors or pull light hearted pranks to bring joy to Sakai.


As an adult he was assigned to go out with the samurai of the village as their assigned Shrine Maiden to fight Yokai Primarily fighting Tengu.

One stormy night in Sakai He gets caught up in a realmstorm getting sent to the worldhelm

Name: Hazard
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Taken as a child to cover the debts of their parents
* Tested on for may years
* Upon failing to produce expected results, was shelved and forgotten
* Time or conflict eventually damaged the facility enough to release the creature.
* Named itself after the warning markings on its storage container "Hazard"
* Wandered Terra a while without purpose until realizing what it had become
* Soon was possessed by a seething hatred for unscrupulous companies.
* Upon finally finding purpose, staggered into a realmstorm

Name: Heinrich
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Merrane, wanted to fight for it
- Got dragged into military human experimants to create a human weapon
- He was a success, gained powers over elements
- Was brought to the frontlines, saw the truth of this war
- Managed to Escape, got brought to Ship soon after

Name: Helios, the First
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Comes from the Islands of Samsara
- His people revere the Dragonlords
- Studied the ancient art of fighting like a dragon
- He's the first in many generations to do so
- Wants to use his Dragoon skills to be a hero
- Stays aboard the Worldhelm to get strong enough to liberate the enslaved of Nezmira

Name: Hemlocke Perditos
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Born and raised in a small town in Lhodos, as a Perditos family member, Hemlocke was subject to strict education and high standards since his childhood.

• He ended up in Korila by having to escape his hometown. He ended up separated from the rest of his family in this occasion. Their current whereabouts are unknown to him.

• He finished his studies in Korila, and started working as an apothecary, starting his journey of neverending discovery.

• All of the Perditos family tree's names have been inspired to flowers. Most times poisonous. The meaning of this "tradition" has been lost to time, but maybe it could be unearthed again?

• Some members of the Perditos family display peculiar ability in magic. All of them share one common detail: a white strand of hair.

Name: Henrik Nagy
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born from two members of the Sündisznó Tribe, one the Thorn Sovereign (if not allowed then a Warden) and lower ranking Werewolf.
- To keep having a child hidden, leave him in Veyrhold to be raised.
- Has a normal upbringing for the most part, even gaining a close fondness to a girl named Viola.
- First change happens and life is now in ruins, found by members of the Sündisznó tribe and taken to the Thorn Dominion.
- Raised as one of their own since he is, a member of the Ironbrood with expected potential of becoming a Warden. 
- A Forsaken Vampire cause his people issue by spilling blood within the Great Wolf's Maw.
- Said individual is also a problem for the Molie Family, now the two factions are working together through Henrik and Viola as this lone Forsaken threatens to expose both races to humans.

Name: Henry
Backstory Bullet Points:
Was a member of the peasant class meant blessed by the heavens with martial abilities to punish bandits and criminals.

Trains with Sifu Silver Wolf who has an odd religion. 

He is part of an international group of shapeshifting martial artists.

He is very long lived and he seeks out strong opponents that are as powerful or more powerful than him.

Name: Heron Caladrius
Backstory Bullet Points:
- The grandson of High Priestess Caladrius. Heron was born to the Priestess' first born, only a few days before her second born would come into the world.
- He was close to Gabriela, and watched over her by order of his mother. He was practiced athletically, as well as regularly ran youth practices and sermons at the astonishingly young age of 9 or 10.
- They were close, being born only a few days a part. Despite being her nephew, they were more like siblings.
- Not a month after he turned 11, his mother was killed . While the details were mostly kept from both Gabriela and mysteriously on a diplomatic mission to a Coven Town, it changed their lives entirely. 
- In place of his mother, Isadora Caladrius, Heron was assigned to Gabriela as a guardian. A year after the claim, he was anointed and mutilated, entering his teens as a eunuch.
- Since then, he's diligently watched over Gabriela as he aided her in her journey, and looked after the city their mother left behind.

Name: Heywire
Backstory Bullet Points:
- One of the three daughters of Marie Annette of Anette Line. 
- Adopted as a child in reality after the death of Marianne, Marie's first daughter. She was named Marianne as well.
- Had been raised by Marie as a stand-in, unable to accept her daughter's death that time until she let go of that
- She takes up the Identity and looks of of her missing sister, the real Heywire, who had suddenly went missing,
- It was her own decision to take her missing sister's place out of a sense of duty and respect, and admiration, not wanting to have her sister's reputation dwindle as a renowned exosuit test pilot. 
- It came at a cost of her wellbeing, as she made the said decision headfirst without considering the consequences and a good reason of taking another person's identity.
- In the middle of a field test, Heywire gets caught in a realmstorm along with a prototype exosuit Anette Line had Developed. She had been testing as assessing the said equipment focused on beam based barrages.

Name: Hibiki Fujimori
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Raised in a yokai settlement in the Feywyrd by two fathers, one a master martial artist and one a legendary chef. He grew obsessed with perfecting his skills, incorporating the preparation and utilization of his meals with the art of combat. This prestigious tutelage made him overconfident however.

-He would go on a long expedition for rare ingredients to prove himself to his masters. He finds a yokai, a kitsune, face down in the snow, hunted down by a tribe of vicious Ald. He stands up for the injured yokai, only to be humbled instantly. They manage to flee, but only barely.

-He returns to his village, only to be harshly reprimanded by his masters. With a clench of his fist and fire in his heart, he runs away willingly, claiming to never show his face until he can prove his strength to them.

-With a careless stumble, he finds himself on the Worldhelm, his first step to making a name for himself. Maybe he'll open a restaurant himself. Maybe he'll reunite with the kitsune he saved.

Name: Hira Mae
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born in Brightshield 

-Grew up having visions/dreams of the future, they're near completely out of his control and are often unrelated to him 

-He's always wondered why he has them

-One day, he sees a vision of his friend Heath being attacked by a demon, and was able to save him before it could happen, leading him to want to use his power to help others when he could 

-Years later, enlists with the knights to do so, reuniting with his childhood friend and developing a friendly rivalry with him

-Hira was in support of the martial law and crusade against demons, while Heath was seemingly more apprehensive, but accepted it

-Heath disappears one night, and word amongst the other knights was that he defected to Lastport, though he left behind no indication of his real goals

-Out in the field, he meets Aile(Nikki’s character) who’s also searching for Heath and chooses to work with her, getting swept up in a Realmstorm shortly afterwards

Name: Hiya Salamin
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Born to a lineage of glass cultivators in Pagapalay Village, a village at the base of Mt Magayon.

• She grew up under the tutelage of the fire cultivators and her father in spite. Because she was born a man, and is currently a Bakla. She didn't receive the same opportunities as her mother did.

• She was trained in both alchemy and general medicinal expertise as well, being trained to be partly a guide amongst the volcano with her fire ki. 

• She carries a urn that was an heirloom passed down from generations, carrying molten glass that she can control.

Name: Holt McLeod
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Father (deceased) was a DHK warehouse worker when he had an “accident” after attempting to form a union
- Mother was a secretary for ETA but was fired due to layoffs
- Dropped out of high school to help out, becoming a furniture mover and lead guitarist for rock band Stray Hounds
- Rose in popularity after band released “PRIME Suspects”, an album attacking every Prime Company
- Transformed with wolf augments bought by the lead singer from a black market vendor, but augments were stolen and are unstable
- A fixer, possibly hired by a Prime Company, tracked the augments to the vendor and had him lure the band into a trap
- Fixer said he had a "cure" at some facility, but the band doesn't believe him and fights back
- Lost consciousness after seeing bandmates die (quirk triggered) and woke up to find the fixer and his goons dead
- Been on the run for years, used powers to protect North Rock from corpos and gangs
- Entered a door to the Worldhelm after saving a teenager during a pursuit

Name: Honeycomb Goldthread
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Honeycomb existed long before he was brought to life; originally a doll created in the image of a lord’s son and abandoned due to said lord’s displeasure, and passed from hand to hand before ending up in the faerie realm, where his creator- or the one he considers his creator- found him.
