- Met Josef Hrudwoulf, who convinced him to travel with him 
- Went to Silverdale with/for Josef and started writing about the warriors there
- Felt stagnant until Josef suggested going to the Runewall; A congregation of heroes with new stories
- Met Celestyn and got to know them on the way to the Runewall
- Found the Runewall.

Name: Leslie Shay
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Proudrock, spent his early years traveling the road with his family's caravan business. As he grew older he helped with the business, which he learned was a front for a smuggling business.

- The law eventually caught up with them, but his parents managed help him slip away with, leaving him to try and salvage what he could.

- While moving the last of their cargo, he was ambushed by outlaw, and a firefight ensued. Wounded and out of ammo, he started to lose all hope of surviving the encounter when another set of shots rang out, coming from a certain drifter.

- After the fighting ended, they had a chat that resonated strongly with him. When the drifter left, Shay picked what he could from the remains of the caravan, contemplating their conversation.

- He spent the next couple of years travelling around, taking on odd jobs until eventually finding himself caught up in a Realmstorm.

Name: Levan
Backstory Bullet Points:
Known History

- Born into a Hiear merchant family in Windhaven; younger twin to A'shibah.

- Grew up inseparable from his brother, bonded in both spirit and habit.

- Lived a peaceful life traveling in their family’s caravan, steeped in tradition and faith in Musta’khan.

- On their 17th name day, their caravan was ambushed by Kiir; A’shibah died protecting him.

- Levan attempted a forbidden revival ritual—however the ritual failed and drew someones ire.

- Akhir answered instead, but A’shibah’s spirit returned and forged a pact to save him.

- Levan refused to lose his brother once more, as he'd forcibly alter the rite. His desperate plea would be answered by Musta’khan who would bind their souls together permanently.

- For years, wandered Nezmira with A’shibah’s spirit dormant within him.

- Recently awakened together after a strange event that brought them to the Worldhelm.
Quirk:
heirloom : Turul

The bow of the first son, handed down through generations in Levan's family.
 While it was not meant for him, the original wielder is no more.

Drawback: Occasionally the bow refuses to obey Levan, choosing to rip themselves out of his hand during a turn and looking for a more worthy wielder, or simply flopping on the ground.

Custom Weapon ◆ Bow ◆ Ranged [300z]
[DEX + INS] +1, [HR + 14] light
+ Elemental [Light], Powerful, Magic Defense Boost
+ Accuracy Boost [100z]

Quality: Charge shot [1000z] : If you have acquired the Hawkeye Skill, treat your Skill Level in it as increased by 2 (up to a maximum of SL 7).
1400z

Name: Levius C. Kennedy
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the slums of North Rock
- Was a delinquent, reformed by boxing
- Close ties to Keith Walker (boxing mentor)
- Wants to be a hero like his idol
- Wants to do Mama proud
Quirk:
Cursed
At a young age, Levius was indoctrinated to a life of crime by his father. The most egregious of these offenses involed the grand larceny of hundreds of thousands of zenit from a 777LC casino. For his crimes, Levius' father was blacklisted by the corporation executives; and eventually, Levius' further involvement after his father's sudden disappeance left him blacklisted as well. Since then, Levius' seems to suffer bizarre streaks of bad luck, if one believes in such a thing.

Name: Liberation
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in Charizs, to a set of parents possessed of great wanderlust.
* Because of this, she was often on the road for a long time.
* Once, on the road, her family was beset upon by bandits. All seemed lost, and the threat of being sold into slavery was present... until the Freedom Beacon suddenly appeared. 
* After being saved by the Freedom Heir, the girl was obsessed. It was also during this time that she began noticing the tell tale crystals growing around her neck.
* When she was 18, she traveled to the Freedom Stone. It was there that she came to realize that she is, indeed, an Heir of Freedom.
* Eager and excited, she immediately ran off, trying to emulate the Beacon of Freedom in freeing those bonded with... mixed results.
* Realizing she needed allies, she made the only logical choice she could make. Going through the Rune Wall.

Name: Liliwen Bremblebery
Backstory Bullet Points:
* From a common-born family with a history in and around Tradefair (and Honeydew before it). She was born in Tradefair.
* Her father had an encounter with a fae that left him changed, marked by the ears and tail of a mouse. He has not spoken of what happened or what fae he encountered to Liliwen. She inherited these features herself.
* Liliwen grew up a scrappy little rascal and matured into a scrappy little lady. She channeled her competitiveness into work as a mercenary, and made a name for herself despite some misgivings and prejudice.
* In the middle of a job gone bad, Liliwen approached a Realmstorm and was whisked off to the Worldhelm. She has done heroics while also returning home often to do her job there.

Name: Lillian Vox
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Arianwyn Wood, born and (mostly) raised in Brightshield.

- Tired of the city's constant pessimism and gloom, she took to the roads as a performer under the name Lillian Vox.

- Known for sleight of hand and clever illusions, many believe her a true mage. Though she disagrees, not entirely conscious of her own power.

- Others whisper she’s faetouched, letting her playful and whimsical nature speak louder than reason. Citing that only a fae could hold such a level of optimism.

- Wanders from bustling cities to quiet hamlets, guided only by the need to spark joy and wonder.

- Discovered a realmskipper by chance and, believing in her best friend Lady Luck, stowed away unseen.

- Arriving at the Worldhelm, she quickly realised it wasn’t mere luck that brought her there—it was the fate of a Goldhearted.

- With charm, mischief, and a flair for the dramatic, Lillian keeps a card in hand and a trick up her sleeve for anyone willing to stop and smile, no matter their realm or background.

Name: Lin Baimei
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Older woman, once married. Husband died, child missing. Became a hoarder and isolated. Lives in Xuanwu City
* Was sent to the Blood Mines, almost froze to death. Lost her arm to hypothermia
* A Spirit Snake found her, saw her potential and fused with her, giving up it's own life to save hers.
* Taught Cultivation by the Intelligent and Powerful Spirit beasts to learn to control her new power. 
* Returned to the City, reborn anew.
Quirk: Heirloom - Black Ice Pendant of Xuanwu

Name: Lin Shen
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a relatively prosperous family, Lin's life was marred with tragedy before he was even born.
- Lin struggled under the weight of expectations from his family and pedigree both. Having been born a Jinshi he was expected to achieve more.
- He struggled with fundamentals that others took to easily, however he had a strange connection to the wildlife around him.
- Having had enough, on his 17th summer he vowed to prove himself. After saying his goodbyes to none save his mother, he'd take his fathers Guandao and leave the village swearing to prove his worth.
- In the bamboo forests surrounding Bingchuan he'd find his prey. A spirit beast beset by corrupt cultivators. In the end he'd choose to aid the beast, giving it a chance to fight back.
- As a reward, the beast would instruct Lin. Imparting their knowledge that in turn would allow him his own breakthrough.
- Lin now prowls the forests with Xuhu a descendant of the spirit beast, hunting corrupt cultivators.
Birth Realm: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Jinjing Xiantiao, Bingchuan
Quirk: Hunted Emissary : Boon of Self Perfection

Name: Lindsey Beck
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born to an affluent military family in Caldera
* Spent his youth rebelling however he could from his strict father
* Upon inheriting the family fortune upon his father's passing, and with no other family to speak of, he donated all but a small fortune of his wealth to various charities, dissolving his estate.
* Using what remained of his fortune he purchased an airship "The Gleaming Goose" and an exosuit named "Throne"
* Spent a few years blissfully independent until he and his ship were comandeered for the war effort.
*Many years with the military wore down his hope to ever escape his legacy until a plucky young Welkin pilot was assigned to his ship.
* When she realized she no longer wanted to serve Merrane he followed her happily into Vigilantism as the Violet Barons!
Quirk: Heirloom: Beck's Bulwark, the signet ring of his family. A ring laden with history and sweat, it bears the will to live till the war is over inherited from the Beck family line giving its wearer resistance to physical. On the finger of the man who threw that legacy away, no matter how righteous an act it was... it feels incredibly heavy...

Name: Lindwa Ddraig
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Lindwa is a dreamite who languished in solitude and apathy in Deleria, having grown incredibly tired of the monotonous daily life she had become accustomed to. 

- Seeking to create her own paradise through her dreams, she used magic to fall into a deep, deep slumber, and try and live out her wildest fantasies within a dreamscape of her own creation. It was, however, ultimately just a pale reflection of the reality she can become accustomed to, and her apathy only increased.

- After being awoken alongside the other Dreamites, Lindwa gazed out into the heaven's sea, and was overcome with emotion at the vastness of the world, and all of the possibilities it held. With a purpose to finally chase after and sate her curiosity and wanderlust with, she soon boarded the Worldhelm, to search for good deeds to accomplish, and to fully immerse herself in the waking world.

Name: Linus & Lumi
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was a commander for a fey detachment holding a treshold into the Gloom
- Blood Moon happened, most of his detachment got killed, they lost that portion of the Fey Realm
- Good news! Found Lumi being assailed by demons and saved her.
- Court didn't like that he lost, so they kicked him out into the Mortal Realm
- Told him to only come back when he gets gud
- He said "aight"

Name: Lionel Il'Hrarra
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a noble family in Ripplith, Lionel was the firstborn daughter, and the heir apparent, set to inherit the authority of the family.
- They come out as trans, and go to a Seamother to undergo the ritual to fit into a body of their own.
- Now a man, and unable to hold authority in the matriarchal society of the Galeo Empire, their family looks down on him for throwing away his birthright and responsibility.
- He is then sent off to the Gnosis Academy to find his own path, and so as to no longer be in his mother's sight.
- Lionel takes well to the classes and the trials of becoming a Regalia yet all the while there is a sense that something is wrong. He struggles to make friends and socialize, and after some months his grades begin to slip...
- Thus, he is in the remedial program.

Name: Lisa Aeingradt
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Merrane raised aspiring pilot and technician who tries her best to go above and beyond at what she believes in for her people.

- Used connections to become a subject for Esper projects to become better use for the military service of the empire.

- Due to the shift of roles, she came under the protection of Johnathan Southworth, a POW turned to asset for the military.

- During a mission near Suntower, she was protected by Johnathan from the sudden emergence of Vanagandr, nearly costing his life.

- She convinced and authorized the use of the Pandora serum in the hopes of saving Johnathan's life, though at a cost.

- She remains protected by Johnathan but is now in constant worry about his state of being and feels an panging guilt about being the reason he is the way he is now and the fact he so readily nearly died for her.

Name: Lissander Velkov
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Eurys, Grestazs
- Lissander and his brother K'relt would be trained by their father, an old mercenary, in combat
- When the Catacalysms hit, the settlement their father lived in got hit by a Haunted Storm. During the storm the brothers got separated and had to retreat
- Lissander found himself wandering the desert, lost for a while before being saved by a group calling themselves "The Order of The Sand Dragon". With nowhere else to go, he decided to join them
- Lissander would never really get much recognition in the order, finding himself with the things no one wanted. His mount Coraline, is a large sized worm that was abandoned by its original rider.
- Lissander would find himself quite isolated, tending to the various animals and creatures. He would discover an alcove of centipede eggs, in which he would hatch and take care of. Naming one abnormally large one Ryke, and even training with it as he would a partner.
- He heads to the Runewall to represent the order

Name: Liz
Backstory Bullet Points: When she was a child, Merrane's forces attacked her town and destroyed it, leaving her as the only survivor as far as she knew.  She wal rescued and brought to Ionian Village where she joined the KPLA at a young age.  Liz acts as a member of the KPLA, fighting to free the land from Merrani rule.  One day, she and her allies discover the location of a prototype mech, and plot to steal it.  Lizbern is trained in the basics of piloting using stolen acadamy materials.  Getting to the mech goes as planned, but as they make their escape, Merrani angels descend on the rebels.  Liz chooses to fight, holding them back with the prototype while her comrades escape.  The prototype is badly damaged and Liz mortally wounded, but as the enemy approached to finish her off, a pillar of light rescues her to the Worldhelm.  Laughing at her fortune Liz christens the prototype "Liberty Wing", and resolves to return to Lhodos and finish the fight against the Empire.

Name: Lochlann Carlisle
Backstory Bullet Points:
Story Summary
- Created as an augmented clone of his father, Magnus, the necessarily ruthless CEO of Regenekhan Pharmaceuticals
- Employed as the head researcher of Regenekhan using his knowledge of medical science and product development
- Experiencing a mid-life crisis after the events of Skyfall and his disillusionment with the suffering that Terra’s corporate regime imposes on everyday people
- His best memories are of his time in high school alongside Caelan Blacklaw, but he has lost touch with him since then
- Raised by Magnus to be second in line in the influential Carlisle family and supports his older brother and top executive, Alistair
- Has Ph. D degrees in business and medicine, worked a decade as a mid-level manager at Parabellum
- Carries an heirloom device previously discarded by his father called C.A.T.S. (Chemically Adaptive Thermo-Synthesizer) that fabricates randomized compounds, but is a prototype other companies want to copy or steal

Name: Lock
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Got awakened at a young age and is now making it everyone else's problem
* Pre-awakening, she saw alds bartering and coming out better for it. This has been made a large part of her personality post-awakening.
* Managed to scavenge enough to trade for a backpack, then started scavenging materials and goods to trade. Made her way upward from there, trading amongst yokai and the occasional friendly (or at least, non-hostile) Ald.
* Jumped at the chance to board the Worldhelm. More customers! :D
Relevant Arcana: Kuzunoha (by virtue of being a :fox: Fob)

Name: Loveno Beaumont
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Loveno grew up with his father, Guillaume. Guillaume was a mechanic and inventor, who passed along his love of vehicles and other mechanical marvels to Loveno. 

- When Loveno was young, he and his father were practicing how to drive his new motorcar prototype, far away from civilization to ensure that any crashes or malfunctions didn't endanger anybody else. Absorbed completely by the thrill of driving, they accidentally drove into Werewolf lands, and Guillaume was killed in an ambush by a Werewolf.

- Loveno took the wheel from his father, and drove as quickly as he could, eventually crashing into a building in Veyrhold, and was quickly taken to the SIA for questioning.

- After their car was repaired, and Loveno was soothed, he entered the SIA, driven by a cold, calculated drive for revenge. He quickly climbed the ranks, becoming an agent within the DSC. Tirelessly working to protect others from the fate he suffered as a youth, Loveno eventually became a Goldhearted.

Name: Lucia
Backstory Bullet Points:
Lucia lost her parents to sickness and overwork when she was young.
Her brother was adopted less than a year later, while Lucia was not. She eventually did get adopted, but ended up just jumping from one family to the next, unable to fit in.
Quickly growing into a problem child, Lucia eventually ran away from the orphanage at about age 13
Got picked up off the streets by a low-ranking Goldnails gang leader, by the name of Hado
Hado provided food and shelter, while having Lucia work for him doing odd-jobs and errands.
As she grew older these jobs to be more and more criminal, but Lucia refused to cross the line of killing people.
Lucia picked up how to fight off of watching street fights and adapting her own style to make use of her light build.
On a recent job, things went south and Lucia was cornered by law enforcement. Before they found her, she was whisked away by a realmstorm and found herself onboard the Worldhelm.
Birth Realm: Realm of Terra, Haven, North Rock

Name: Luka Penrose
Backstory Bullet Points:
- his mom used to call him 'angel,’ so he adopted it as a nickname
- began messing with magitech in his free time
- created Seraphim, his exoskeleton suit
- became proficient in hard light tech
- learned how to replicate spell effects
- the ascension of Prince Damian in his hometown made him wonder - why would he change sides if Merrane is supposed to be great?
- in a moment of rebellious curiosity, he wandered south of Suntower, and after some time, he came across a battlefield, strewn with bodies
- found a dying soldier named Vincent, who told him about how Merrane truly is
- Vincent gave him his jacket, Servare, asking him to continue the fight and defend justice where he found it
- he explained that there were runes in the jacket, meant to protect one’s allies when they may not be able to protect themselves
- he inscribed ‘Angel’ along the sleeve, wanting to protect Vincent's ideals
- used Seraphim to fly back to Suntower, but she malfunctioned, sending him into a Realmstorm
Quirk:
Heirloom - Servare, the People's Guard

Obtained off of a dying KPLA soldier (Vincent) south of Suntower, this jacket is meant to help its wearer protect their allies. This soldier also told Luka of the truth behind Merrane, and the reason the KPLA fight. This information turned Luka's views of Lhodos on their head, for the better. Though Vincent may be dead, Luka is intent on carrying his legacy forward - and sometimes, the jacket's magic mixed with Vincent's latent desires causes him to act uncharacteristically.

Flaw - Soul of a Warrior - Luka is, by nature, not a fighter. He prefers to let others handle danger, though he is happy to heal and support the team. However, the runes imbued within the jacket, mixed with the soldier's latent desire for justice, may spur him forward, causing him to act against his will. 

Quirk - Healer’s Ward - When Luka heals an ally or allies, they have resistance to the next instance of physical damage that they take before the start of his next turn.

Name: Lumio
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Carson does not remember their life before the afterlife. They were a soldier, they fought in a battle, and they died protecting their friends.
- Carson woke up in the fourth layer, Maze Elysia, the maze filled with hallucinations and illusion.
- He went along with caravans to escape but ran whenever things went wrong.. 
- Again and again, Carson watched friends die as he ran. Each person he heard or met became another voice in his head..
- Carson started having full hallucinations of dead people yelling at him to help them. 
- Carson decided to change their life. They chose to LEAD caravans to escape, and renamed themselves to Lumio to inspire hope. 
- A hundred or so years later Lumio's last caravan died, but Lumio managed to escape and enter the Worldhelm.
Remort Changes:
Esper Gifts -> Emotional Locas
- Physic Backlash -> Cry of **Rejection**
- Reassuring Presence -> Hug of **Acceptance**

Name: Luna
Backstory Bullet Points:
*  Parents left when she was young Kitsune
* She started hearing rumors of people needing protection and started to learn to be a lightblade
* She quickly learned how to wield a sword from her uncle
* Set out on her own adventure to find her parents
* Fell through ice during a storm and woke up on the world helm

Name: Lupo
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Lupo used to be a trainee for the KPLA Sapper Core (orphan that was took in)
- Manifested Esper powers after a nightmare one day (not much known about his past)
- Commander tried to lock him up as a threat to the camp
- Fled with his training mech, hijacked an airship, flew into a realmstorm as his fuel ran out
Remort Changes: N/A

Name: Lyle Whitlock
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Lyle was born in Heartdom to a family of Couriers and has a robot companion, Vial, from Steelbin, who loves exploring the Reflections of Lilith.  

- Vial met Lyle while Lyle was making deliveries and being chased by a monster. Lyle trapped the monster under debris, saving Vial.  

- A Warden, impressed by Lyle’s quick thinking, recommended that he enroll at Gnosis.  

- Lyle’s parents approved, though hesitantly, and he joined Gnosis after finishing his deliveries.  

- Vial, rebellious and independent, enrolled at Gnosis without their parent's knowledge.  

- After 3 years of studying, Lyle discovered his body couldn’t channel any magic.  

- He joined the Remedial class to uncover why and to support Vial, who sought distance from their family.

Name: Lynne-4
Backstory Bullet Points:
Lynne-4 was born into the hierarchy of Steelbin to a non-native family who had climbed the ranks of local governmental service to the Machina, specifically in regards to resource gathering, distribution, and management.

One day, while outside of the civilized zone, a rogue group of machina, targeting her family for their resources and connections, ambushed her, seperating her from the rest of the expedition party, leaving her to roam the zone by herself.

Her wandering was ended abruptly one day, when she was saved from the brink of death by a wandering Paladin and their Regalia, who saw in her a grit and determination that would be better put to use at Gnosis Academy.

After accepting their offer, she trained day in and day out, passing each of her various exams with flying colors, and eventually being chosen to join the exchange students on their first trip to the Worldhelm.

Name: Lyrric Dust
Backstory Bullet Points:
*Travelled with his family and helped train magical beast as mounts and work forces.
*Deserters from an army turned bandits attacked while they were on the road. During the attack Lyric desperately prayed for help and Something answered.
-This Gifted him his Elementalist powers and gave him his staff.
-The deal meant he would be called on in the future by said power.
*He left to travel the world so that any stigma of him being a "warlock" as his magic was not really his, would not stay attached to his family or the lively hood.
*During his travels he was caught in storm near the Runewall and the winds forced him and his mount through.
Quirk:
Heirloom-A Steadfast Desire-Staff [WLP+WLP] +1(100z) [HR + 7] Dark(100z), Immunity to Dazed (500z),
Flaw:Due to the indirect connection with the Desire Stone when Lyric or those around him make requests of what they desire may it manifest in their most literal sense of the matter

Name: Lyssa
Backstory Bullet Points:
A Lerisin that practices Anima as a Shaman by learning from the forest spirits of Rocadian
As the spirits began to go mad through the calamity, a morbid curiosity leaned practices into Thauma 
Despite the spirits of the forest going mad and being more violent, has a fascination with possible strength that chaos can bring
Wants to protect her homeland and believes chaos must meet chaos to restore order with the spirts
Desires to explore and study other places and magic

Name: Mabilis Na'ulan
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Righteous Cultivator in the past
- Got betrayed by another cultivator
- Cultivation base was shattered
- Given 50 years to live before they would be hunted down again
- Recovered a small measure of their previous cultivation skill

Name: Madhuri Somasundaram
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Demonkin born in Little Lantern in the Bahata Khajaana.
* Her mother is a fire cultivator, and Madhuri pestered her for training from an early age.
* While hotheaded and impulsive, she is also stubborn and dedicated. She put in the mental, physical, and spiritual work to become a cultivator, in the old ways, banned in the Khajaana.
* As she came of age, she was chomping at the bit to somehow *help* with things. To resist the Maharaja's forces, somehow. To venture elsewhere to help defend a smaller demonkin village. Or to hunt down dangerous spirit beasts before they struck. *Something.*
* Did not take well to being told she needed much more time training first.
* Eventually set out to assist someone on a journey, only to one night be swept into a Realmstorm, leaving the one she was escorting behind.

Name: Mae Lavery
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and raised in Babyl City in Dawnstar Valley.
- Raised by a single father who worked in one of the manufacturing plants ran by Tubal & Cain
- Proved to accel academically and skipped a grade during school where she befriended Alec Lyon, who was a grade below her.
- Preferring to do engineering work Mae had an aptitude for working with explosives and eventually started doing work for T&C
- Moved in with Alec to help keep bills easier to manage, and shared an apartment. The two eventually formed a romantic relationship.
- Does Temp work to give field demonstrations of T&C explosives.
- About a year ago while working with an experimental explosive in her lab, something went wrong leading to an explosion that claimed Mae's life, but due to debt from research this lead to her being brought back as an insolvent.
- Using her unique explosives she was able to help clear and break down many of the rocks the fell during the Skyfall, leading to her being taken by the ship as a Goldhearted.

Name: Mafqud Gazzlan
Backstory Bullet Points:
- starting money and ingredients: https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1170106164625813656/1349197697500057632
(name is earlier version of this char, had to change )

- lived in Skamos with family, all being guides for people wanting to dive into the ruins, also selling random knick-knacks, all wear a costume with skeleton-mask

- Mafqud was always inclined to tinker around but only in secret, in fear it could be seen as magic

- before his Grandpa died, he gave Mafqud an artifact he found in ruins, which he used for selling the trinkets that seemed to gather in it (see Quirk). 

- Mafqud panicked as this was clearly a magic item. Not wanting to be Branded, he fled, trying to look harmless as a peddler of trinkets in his skeleton disguise . 

- started to tinker with the stuff from the cabinet, actually making working items

- got the call when he was about to found out from guards, so he is still on edge

- wants to find out more about the Ruins where the cabinet was found
Quirk:
Heirloom: The Cabinet of Lost Things. An old item Mafqud's Grandpa found in the Ruins of Ista near Skamos. It seems to be a cabinet that doesn't really becomes full even though it seems to attract  things other people lost as well as random knick-knacks, trinkets and gewgaws. 
Being cautious because of the control of Magic users, they kept it secret - till Mafqud got his hands on it. And with his innovative spirit, the random trinkets and doodads in the cabinet actually start to work.

Accessory: Qualities: Formulaic (Quality: 1000 z, allows 1 extra d20 to be rolled for Gadgets(Alchemy)) - to explain why Mafqud's creations are more probable to work.

Name: Mahuizoh
Backstory Bullet Points:
* A wandering exorcist following the path of finality, worked with other like-minded nomad exorcists
* An unknown, great evil was discovered
* Exorcist gang decided to seal it away
* The sealing ritual was interrupted by an unknown faction, most of those exorcists died
* The great evil ended up sealed in Risata (other PC)
* Now job is act as guard/warden combo for Risata
* Fell in love after a long time of that, now looking for solutions to the great evil situation

Name: Mako Torres
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Descendant of the Goldhearted Iroh Torres
- Studied and trained in the ancient technique of memory cultivation
- Was hidden within Kuliling Village
- Village was destroyed by Mabisa's Forces

Name: Mara Zofia Jedvaj
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Veryhold Myist and grows up as a bit of delinquent to a family selling and repairing crank cars. 

- Gets into a whirlwind romance with a werewolf, unknowing of her nature until she one night lost control even just for a second. She was saved by the SIA, and  begged for her partner to be saved. She was, but was sent out of the city, joining a heretic group.

- Mara for her part, now knowing of the unseen world, joins the SIA, and bounces around the different departments for a few years, until she settles as a werewolf liason for the DSE.

- She has spent many years with werewolves, learning their ways, traditions, ways of suppression and magic, doing experiments on herself, sometimes with the help of the heretics she is helping and gaining the power to harness the magic of the land.

Name: Marcus Robinson
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the poorer areas of North Rock and lost his family during childhood, Marcus was took under his wing by an expereinced Goldnail to be brought into the family.

- Was unable to afford any martial weapons or proper training so  Marcus relied on his fist, training and using them on various jobs to the point he did not need other weapons

- He saw the Goldnails as new form of family in his teenage and young adult years gleefuly taking on missions to prove himself earning the title of "Goldnail's Fist" when he offically joined the Goldnails

- While the year goes on by Marcus started to notice the corruption that runs rampant in the crime family which he had ignored due to blind faith until an extortion job went wrong in which he took a bullet for a hostage with the remaining Goldnails leaving him behind.

- The hostage ended up being an 100G asset which thanks to their explanation of the scene granted Marcus a path he did not think would get after so many years, one of redemption.

Name: Maria
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Lost place of residence and employment during the events of Skyfall.
- While searching for new work to be able to pay the bills stumbled upon a job listing for SWORD.
- Mistook the listing as just running and action on a social media account for a character created by SWORD.
- Had a history of being in fights and the ability to use some magic. 
- SWORD found reports of her abilities and police records of fights, which helped her actually become a good candidate.
- Got the job and became part of a SWORD TEMP group called EntroPRISIM who act like a magical girl team for entertainment reasons while handling proper jobs.
- Took on the role of "Flare Gem Phixia" as part of the EntroPRISM Squad
- Loathes her current employment but is stuck with a long-term contract she doesn't have a good way out of. Despite this she plays her character well.
- Is always thankful when work is out of the way of public eye and she can drop the character act and really let loose with her true feelings.

Name: Maria "Sabueso" Irene
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born In Ashreach
- Respected officer in Ashreach, before being transferred to the Investigations branch in Veyrhold 
- Her desire for chase always ended her in trouble, even moreso when it comes to interactions with The Black & The Supernatural
- SIA Picked her up to keep her on watch, a part of the DMI as an on field investigator & evidence collector for studies
- Disliked by the DMI branch due to her often predator behavior, and ending up in fights or chases with monsters
- Has friends in the DSC that provide her with special foci called Bloodbound Tools. Designed to be consumable foci to use with her firearms to channel her magic properly
Quirk:
The Thinning - Spell Known: Regression

Unique Weakness: Away From Home? - Maria is always used to being within the dark and isolated from others. When in areas of bright light or large crowds her mind falters and begins to create delusions of darkness from anything shadowy or suspicious. When this happens, paranoia overtakes her emotions, making her act irrationally as if she is being hunted or should be on the hunt

Name: Marianna Caletre
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Daughter of a coven witch of Hermandad de las Estrellas and a graveyard keeper. 

* The two travelled Deadstone via wagon as a pair of fortune tellers using tarot cards. Specialized in giving closure to the loved ones of the deceased.

* Marianna was born with the ability to speak to ghosts, and she'd communicate with the dead for those who'd use the wagon's services,

 
* When she took over the wagon, she'd travel as her parents did, befriending a demon-touched mariachi she had met as a child due to both being seen as outcasts.

* She invites him to travel with her, the two travelling and meeting a "buffalo demon" Miguel was familiar with.

* In return for a tarot deck portraying spirits during their time of death and teaching Miguel how to control his demonic magic, the duo are soul- entwined and tasked by the demon with sending the restless undead to the afterlife until being brought to the Worldhelm.
Birth Realm: Deadstone Gulch, Hermandad de las Estrellas

Name: Marie
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born to farmhands in a small farm off of brightshield
* Was a bright, cheerful child, but sometimes prone to anger
* At age 6 During a small fit of anger, her magic manifested when she accidentally caught the fields on fire, ruining half a season's harvest
* Hudal Academy was quickly called, and she was taken to learn
* Took to Fire magic very well, and did not have any talent outside of it beyond being able to preserve some of the magic from casting
* Graduated about 2 years ago
* Quietly returned to farm work, but got a little antsy and bored because she wasn't allowed to use magic.
* Snuck away to find an adventuring party like the old stories. This is when she was pulled into a realm storm.

Name: Marina Evans
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Orphaned at birth, lived in an orphanage in Secura until 11
- Found by prof. Estrella Raposa in the search of a compatible host for the artificial conscience of an incredibly powerful daemon under NTT’s control, moved to Downpour City
- Aces all tests but is deemed too old. Still, an attempt is made
- The procedure is a success, but Marina’s willpower survives and she’s put under prof. Raposa’s care, befriending her daughter Ceri
- Eventually the two become close and even work together as TEMPs
- One night they party too hard and somehow find themselves on a weird huge ship
Quirk:
Next in Line - host of the F-Zero-X Daemon

Marina is the artificial host of an extremely dangerous cognitive specter, known as "F0X". Initially made an empty shell for the specter to inhabit and be studied in, Marina’s personality has survived and taken over. 

**Weakness**: Marina harbors the power of a daemon given humanity, one that is destined to become the nexus of all NTT operations. However, as of now, F0X is unstable and raging, and fighting against Marina for control.

Name: Marlo Serracosta
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Youngest and sole male of the Serracosta family, loansharks from Cavelle, a town near Littocia. He was used as their messenger and hated the job.
- Left home at 15 and survived through dangerous jobs, like shipwreck salvaging, patrolling external Highways and escorting vessels. His magic and loudness kept him alive.
- Got scouted by air-breathing dock workers and found good friends. One of them, Edgard, passed the Gnosis exams and pushed him to try too. He studied between jobs and barely passed at 19. 
- At Gnosis, he wanted to be a Paladin but his magic pointed him to Treasures.  
- After Edgard kept getting hurt, Marlo accepted the Rite of Arms.
- Marlo and Edgard fought together well. But he felt like he was being treated as just equipment. 
- Last year, at 21, he made a scene on his Rite of Binding, cut ties with Edgard, and has been Regentless ever since.

Name: Marzanna
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Served as a vessel for the Aesir Vanagandr under the Black Wolf Warband of Aldistir.
* Followed one clear purpose: Enact the cycle of death, exorcise that which should not exist.
* Eventually, realizes that she is being used as a weapon, begins to change and self-actualize.
* Bonds with her companion, Fenrir, another effigy of Vanagandr imbued in her shadow.
* Breaks away and becomes a wanderer, acting as a conduit for the cycles of change and death.

Name: Matilda Shaw
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born to the Shaw family, a perfectly normal family in Brindlewatch.
* Always talked to what she called imaginary friends. Her parents assumed she was just an odd girl. None really knew that she was talking to a creature of the Black.
* One day, while traveling to Veyrhold with her parents, creatures of the Black assaulted the trolley they were on. Her parents pushed her to flee, and she fled until an SIA operative found and protected her.
* The agent brought her to an SIA facility, where they initially were just studying her connection to the Black. This eventually, though, turned into splicing experiments where a particularly unscrupulous agent began splicing her with a gargoyle. These efforts largely failed, but she did end up with a pair of eerie horns from the experimentation.
* The agent was eventually found out, and she was set free.
* In that aftermath, she joined the SIA officially.
* On a routine mission, she is realmstormed.

Name: Maverick Redpath
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and Raised in Herring Harbor
- Raised as a Botanist, Studied as a Bio-Technician
- Serious natured, Dedicated to studies, far from the smartest student
- Started a family, loving wife and daughter
- Working tirelessly on restoring the soil
- Offered a position to create Bio-Materials / Weapons for the State
- Works in secret with the State, makes good money for family,  life is good
- Creates Deadly Bio-weapons to combat against monsters and other threats
- Mishandled Chemical causes deadly gas inside the city. 
- Chemical gas blights farmland, kills few, scars the land
- Mistake was blamed on Maverick, reputation tarnished, threats made, family broken up
- Maverick returns to roots, studying Botany and a way to undo the mistake
- Travels into the South to study Monsters and irradiated grounds
- Swept away by a Realmstorm while on his travels

Name: Max Volume
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Max was born as the eldest of three in his family in North Rock.
- As the older brother, he's always had to protect and safeguard his younger siblings from the shadier people living in the district.
- A life of perpetual struggle hardened both his body and will into being nigh on unbreakable, or as close to it as anyone can achieve.
- Once he had grown up, he joined the Saitos to help with the protecion of North Rock, and acquired a TEMP license to do some work on the side.
- While he operated with the Saitos, he acquired his signature exosuit, as well as an experimental neural implant, a decades old relic of the Baylore era (if more info is required, I'd be glad to work together with staff).
- He made a name for himself, partly due to his boisterous nature and his tendency to blast music from his exosuit's integrated speakers at maximum volume.
- While on a mission in the deserts of Central, he got caught up in a realmstorm and was transported to the Worldhelm.

Name: Maxilos
Backstory Bullet Points:
Maxilos was a kid born on the  streets of Carbe. They had a really rough bringing as they were poor to homeless for most of their life. 

They learned entropic magic which they developed an obsession with due to a need for control. They used it to help criminals with a variety of jobs like robberies, sabotage and hacking. They used a fake Temporary Limited Enforcement License to get by at this time 

They get strong armed into joining the Black Viper Company, a criminal org with the threat of turning them in for their illegal use of magic. The BVC do a lot of corporate sabotage with one of their bigger jobs being against ETA.

The ETA catches on to the schemes of the BVC and offers Maxilos a deal as they want someone with skill in entropic magic on retainer. Join ETA as an insolvent or die with the rest of BVC. They accept as they’d prefer to live. The ETA kills the BVC with Maxilos surviving due to their contract. The ETA also grant them a real Temporary Limited Enforcement License.

Name: Maximilian (Nickname: Max)
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in a Military family from Merrane, specifically the Wall.
- Raised to be a hardline believer of Merrane propaganda.
- Believe hardened further from living at the Wall and seeing the Colossi.
- One day transferred as part of war effort against KPLA and as test pilot for prototype magitech, an Exoskeleton.
- The war against KPLA causes him to doubt.
- Doubt intensifies after the easy abandonment of Pikeway and their citizen.
- Doubt reaches its peak when Prince Damian defected.
- Feels lost
- Doesn't know if what he believed in is right or wrong anymore
- Results in running away with the prototype Exoskeleton to try reaching Suntower City
- That's when he found himself in Worldhelm

Name: Maximillion Unicron
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Max was born in Haven
- Grew up always trying to come up with ways to have fun, or making up new games
- Went to college for Business, but switched to Game Design
- Approached SWORD with an idea for a Card game where people could submit their own cards
- SWORD's R&D department humored Max, and gave him a mix of experimental AR and Hard-light tech.
- Max now shows off his fledgling game, while a decent number of the creatures he summons are ones from various SWORD games

Name: Maxwell
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A self taught roboticist who thrived in Babyl City. At a very young age, she was very fond of robots and machineries to the point where she finds joy in recreating most of what she sees through trial and error, and a few books she either found or borrowed.
- Given how useful her intellect and proficiency with machinery is, she was given a job at the Steeldome Facility. 
- She gets caught in an accident during a test run that rapture her legs, and left arm while searing her lower body at the same time. 
- Maxwell would later be outfitted with cybernetics of her own design. She can only feel what's left of her torso and right arm. She still struggles with the off feeling she has wish her current body.
- Maxwell owns an old, run-down cargo aircraft she bought and modified to her needs to transport equipment and cargo easier.
- While transporting her exosuit she bought from the Zhuanli Union, she was caught by the Realmstorm before making her way to the Worldhelm in a nick of time.

Name: Mayhew Henry Harren
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Tradefair
- Father worked as a merchant
- While no proper schooling, his mother taught him to read and write. In doing so sparked his thirst for knowledge, he would often observe people from afar and take notes, especially people of importance if any
- Due to his curious nature, he would often find himself in more than compromising situations and would have to often talk himself out of them one way or another
- When he came of age, he would be sent to Brightshield by his father to assist one of his friends running a shop
- While in Brightshield, he would often find himself on the wrong end of the law, while not due to any crimes and mostly due to being present around crime scenes
- He was offered a job as an inspector/investigator so that he could continue his pastime of people watching without the added risk of getting arrested, granted he turned in any illegal findings to the right people. He would often find himself having to deal with both human and fae at times

Name: Mei Takamaki
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Central, Terra.
- Her mother and grandfather were notorious adventurers that tend to live on the verge of death and persevere.
- Takamaki family has a legacy of armed service through TLEL, engineering and maintenance jobs.
- Mei works in the same fields till she's 18.
- During this time, she discovers she is a Soulrunner. A different field from her entire family, keeps it to herself, but slowly trains her skills with it.
- Mei is given a private offer by Tubel and Cain to participate as a test subject, due to Soulrunner traits.
- T&C trains Mei and experimented on her to transform her into a super-soldier. Fitted with an experimental powersuit to supplement her magical energy and prototype technology.
- Present day, she lives in Vacation City and lives a lavish life due to her service in the network. Feels unfulfilled. Officially is a white collar worker, but fakes it.
- One day, when she tries to go on vacation to relax--she gets sucked into a realmstorm.

Name: Mei-Mei
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Adopted by Anzhen, an old (probably powerful) sage who lives by himself in a cabin in the woods within Xiaohai, with her twin brother Lei-Lei
- They grew up for most of their life learning games/reading/fishing/survival basically everything from Anzhen
- When they became adults, they felt the call for adventure, saying their goodbyes to Anzhen before doing a Chaos ritual to randomly warp somewhere in 
- They ended up in Bingchuan Village in the mist, saved by Jiafei Lanying, and became his friend
- The three adventure together for a big, running into some big ass fuck all monster, but they get saved by a realmstorm! Yippeee! :D

Name: Meindra
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was a troublesome child who was always breaking things.
- Had delinquent teenage years and regularly got in trouble with Hedgeberg law.
- Was sent off to join the KPLA to put her destructive nature to use as a punishment initially but has become loyal to the cause.

Name: Meira Sarasti
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Nest within Helios

- Got tired of the nice life there, saving up to move to Haven

- Her job within haven as as a TEMP in a small times Debt Collection office

- Also did work with more underground groups, her innate time magic making her ideal for it

- Found herself in a tough spot when trying to falsify a persons contract in their favor with one of the businesses she was hired to work with and got nabbed up in a storm

Name: Mel Monroe
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Mel was one of the best monster hunters for P.A.R.A.B.E.L.L.U.M in Terra.
- She wields a Negative Edge Weapon (N.E.W) called Severance, a special weapon that is akin to a portable-nuke if left without maintenance.
- She retired after her wife died in a tragic incident that never really got explained.
- Mel simply accepted that she wasn't getting her wife back, and lived a boring life for the rest of her days.
- After 10 years out of combat, she got dragged into a realmstorm while defending her building from a sudden monster attack.
Relevant Arcana:
Boundary Inc.'s Minor Arcana:
- BLADE (Boundary License for Advanced Destructive Equipment)
Remort Changes: N/A

Name: Melinda
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a noble family in Caldera to parents that controlled her life. Left her family on bad terms to start a life as an anti war activist in Hidela.

- While working as an activist she met a thief that would become her husband.

- She has a child, and slowly falls out of doing activism wanting to raise her child without worrying. Before she could quite she was captured by Merrani soldiers.

- While under Merrani control she was experimented on, her body mind and soul fused with a colossus. This gave her strange new abilities that she used to escape form her captors.

Name: Melinoe
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Before she was born, the Village of Morde was under attack by a powerful Winter Fey called Meillath 

- the people made a deal with the fey, promising “All the love and joy they would have, and every wonderful sight they would ever see” of the next baby born in the village in return Meillath would instead protect the village from other fey hoping to claim it.

- Melinoe was born with her sight taken by the fey, and the inability to feel any positive emotion. 

- growing up a pseudo outcast, when she was old enough she left to wander Kor’tarion.

- learned to fight, using the magic her connection to the fey gave her, and became a wandering helper of sorts, drawn to the smiles she couldn’t have.

- eventually met Familade and Elora, who sort of adopted them as a friend and started traveling together.

Name: Melissa Reina
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A budding Chequeromancer in training and one of ETA’s most fanatical supporters, Melissa gave everything to the cause, even opting to volutarily enter insolvency to prove to herself and to other that it was the way forward.
- As one of the biggest up and coming soulrunners and her skillset into Chequeromancy, wealth came easily, and her insolvency almost became a null-issue. This left her with a broken view of insolvency, seeing it as simple and easily manageable, no matter what others said.
- Though she clung to her beliefs, she was swept up onto the Worldhelm, some say just weeks before her point of no return, before she became a corporate monster like so many others. 
- Now she stands at the precipice, at the edge between her blind faith in the ETA propaganda and the cold realities of corporate life. Perhaps there are more out there willing to invest in such a “great opportunity” to become the best version of themselves, just as she still believes.

Name: Melody Chère
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in a poor family living in Brightshield
- Stayed indoors mostly and experimented with alchemy
- Her family eventually started doing worse and struggled to make ends meet
- Set up a potion shop to help them out which eventually attracted a wealthy patron
- After working with them for months, discovered they were using her potions for evil
- She collected evidence and tried to get them taken down, but they disappeared first
- About a year later, while looking for ingredients in the wild, she found herself in a realmstorm

Name: Mercedes Soto-Mendoza
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born to a poor family near Soledad Church on Mount Providence in Haven
* Father started a labor movement and was killed for it, mother grew sick afterwards
* Lived with uncle's family, was largely raised by her elder brother Mateo
* Three years ago, Mateo was entrusted with a strange, ancient power known as the Stormwill, which enhanced his strength and granted him electrical magics
* He began fighting organized crime around Mount Providence as the vigilante *Blue Bolt*
* Mercedes and Mateo's wealthy best friend Santiago were both skilled with tech, and so built Mateo a combat suit, the Battle Frame: Ω
* Mateo made many enemies, one of them rich enough to hire an assassin that killed him
* Just prior to his death, Mercedes found him. Then, Mateo passed on the Stormwill, Ω, and the title of Blue Bolt
* Mercedes had barely stepped into the role when the assassin came after her, wanting to forever destroy the Blue Bolt.
* Mercedes fled into the Liberty Desert, was saved by a Realmstorm.
Other Names:
Full name: María De Las Mercedes Soto Mendoza
Nicknames: Mercedes, Mercy, The New Blue Bolt

Name: Merlin Orien
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Merlin was born in Wimcomb, his father a blacksmith and his mother a Merchant.
- Soon after his coming of age he was drafted to serve into the Silverdale military against the forces of the calamity.
- Throughout his service he acted as an encouraging force towards the rest of his unit, raising them up in combat and tending to their wounds.
- During a particularly brutal battle, he lost his left arm to shield a comrade from injury; whether because of his conduct or due to happenstance, a drop of the Longevity stone's power flowed through him.
- Soon after, his arm was restored and he developed Animist powers; because of this, he decided to travel to the Runewall.
- Along the way, a chance encounter with a mysterious knight wielding an ominous blade led to an unexpected duel. After besting them,  the cursed blade inexplicably bound itself to him, revealing the knight to be nothing more than an empty husk of armor.
- Burdened with this artifact, he made it to the Runewall and entered it

Name: Merrick Wolfsgar
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born on Aldistir in the Blood Grotto
* Learned Runic Magic (Symbolism)
* Battled for years alongside best friend
* Best friend suffers mortal wound as Godblood begins to rain on the battlefield, becoming a Draugr
* Forgo running to cover to slay best friend, become infected (ruh roh)
* Lay down to die, wake up on Worldhelm

Name: Mervei Retz-Yiloğan
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Mervei was born to a fisherman and a seamstress in Atreus. 
- As soon as she was old enough to hold a fishing pole and spear, she joined her father on his daily ventures onto the gulf for the day's catch.
- When she was in her teens, a monstrous sea creature and its brood attacked the coast. Her father was mortally wounded on their vessel, and she violently staved off the attackers with a fishing spear. Before she too fell, a knight swooped down upon their drake and rescued her.
- They found her after the attack, commending her ferocity and tenacity. She was offered a squireship to the knights of Daermon.
- She accepted and grew her skills. Mervei eventually was given the opportunity to be imprinted upon by a rusty-scaled drake named Rhauzaten, and took on the title of Knight. She added the Knight's family name of Retz to her own.
- The pair grew their reputation as protectors and do-gooders, and when the Runewall opened, Mervei offered to brave the first expedition with Rhauzaten.

Name: Metztli
Backstory Bullet Points:
- The eldest daughter of a coven member, she showed promise and connection before one of the last acts Lorelei did in person was to claim her as a possible successor.

- Was raised mostly secluded, only having been visited by Lorelei her toddler years before Itzel took over her studies.

- Once she entered young adulthood, she was tasked with learning from her the other coven members. So preparing to learn for some time, she joined in being one of the students who made the Hermandad de las Estrallas.

Name: Michael Adder
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Kígyó tribe as Mihály Kovács, raised to be one of the Shapers
- When he was 13, was nearly killed and assumed dead during a territory skirmish with the Sólyom clan near the Veilroot Hollow
- Was quietly rescued by a heretic cell and bandaged up and let go, but curiosity and desire to repay his benefactors led him to learning of them and lived with them up until adulthood
- Became adept at incorporating silver into his shedskins during this time
- Learned of the Forbidden Research and wanted to investigate the theories on werewolves further
- Went to visit Ashreach to find information, got curious about city life and took to living on the outskirts for his own salvaging
- At some point, found a discarded work harness and refurbished it to be used for protection, also incorporated silver elements to it to further restrain his transformation

Name: Midori Escudo
Backstory Bullet Points:
*Wants to protect people
*Aspires to be like a hero in a storybook
*Has a pixie ally called "Dust". (Note: this is how she casts Spiritual Magic, but it has no other mechanical effect.)

Name: Miguel Calavera
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Parents made a deal with a devil to be able to give birth however the demon marked their child with vulture wings.

• They dropped me off at Hermandad de las Estrellas where Aurora took care of him as they would any Gemini orphan until they could fend for themselves.

• They left home with a guitar and hand and the goal of trying to control their demonically influenced magic before meeting the Buffalo devil, a kind hearted devil that took more of a mentor role.

• They met Marianna Caletre, a like-minded spirit medium, along their journey. She didn’t outright despise him for having demonic wings and instead joined them in their mission to let the dead pass peacefully.

• To achieve their goals together they signed a deal with the buffalo devil for Miguel to better understand his powers and for Marianna to more effectively track down spirits. The clause to this however was for them to never split, leading to their souls being forever entwined.

Name: Miike
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a clan of snow leopard yokai living around the Kullroc Glacier. The patches on her fur were seen as portentous.
- Taught her clan's techniques in illusions, symbols and fate magic, in order to aid them in hunting and avoiding danger.
- Her clan fell to misfortune when they were massacred by a horde of Draugr from the Blood Pools. She only managed to escape when the Realmstorm spirited her away.
- Since then, she has been trying to rebuild her life and find new friends on the Worldhelm. She even has a shop now!

Name: Mika Uhara
Backstory Bullet Points:
"* Born as a test tube baby. Biological parents unknown.
* Experimented on as a child to create a perfect soldier.
* Was one of ten children to survive trialing. Considered too head strong and anti authoritative to be sold to 100g or the like (plus Chihiro Uhara, the chief scientist, took a liking to her)
* Instead was given limited freedoms on the basis of becoming a Tester and Agent for RWO and other SWORD properties.
* Chihiro adopted her officially to give her cover and be able to properly supply her with Identification.
* Began playtesting new RWO expansions. Showed a penchant with her Swordsmanship and use of SWORD proprietary technology. Started being used for lower level raid testing.
* It was during an RWO playtest, in fact, that she was ripped from her pod by a realm storm."

Name: Mikael Everest
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was found in the middle of a field near the Broken Vortex
- Adopted by Professor Everest after the roamed and Arrived near Hudal
- Now studies at Hudal Academy
- Is now in their last year and about to graduate from the Academy

Name: Mikail Arlae
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Mikail was born in Sandsailor's city
* At young age he got interest for books
* Being a human in Nezmira his access to books was short
* Having no more options he started to steal them
* Quickly his talent for stealing was recognized by a group of pirates with the promise of giving him food and books he was recruited in a crew
* years passed and he was captured
* He lied about being the captain as thanks for his captain help giving her less time in jail
*When he became 19 he was placed in the execution list
* There, in jail, at few days from his execution, he was transported to a different place, starting his adventure

Name: Mikkel Oaks
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Mikkel grew up poor, hunting rabbits and other small game. However, he could not afford a bow and arrows so he hunted with a wooden dagger.
- His home, Yorme was attacked by Merrane when he was 9.
- His entire family was killed, or they escaped and he will never find them.
- Mikkel was imprisioned by Merrane, shortly moved to the Great Monastery.
- Mikkel learned how to clean, cook, and fight from his mentor and the scholar Thorne.
- He ignored his mentor and went into the forbidden part of the library, learning Necromancy.
- Learning Necromancy was a part of his downfall. 3 years after reading these books, he became Grave-born.
- The Necromancy books that were locked away were, because, they messed with the person both physically and mentally.
- These books messed with his mind so badly, that he thought Thorne could not teach him anything anymore and left the Monastery.

Name: Milo Fleiss
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Milo was born in Hedgeberg to a small family. Aravik and Yvette Fleiss. He was the eldest, with a sister eight years younger than him named Reeve. 
- When Milo was 16, his father left to Bastion to work on the ramping production of his design for the Undercity. Aravik was a member of the KPLA, working alongside Angelo Letterman as their earliest chief engineers.
- During that first year, a strike meant to kill both Letterman and Aravik Fleiss, executed Milo's father. In the wake of this, Milo become the man of his house.
- Within the first few years, he snapped at his family. The housework and the many cousins he'd been left to as his uncles and extended family joined the war effort had gotten to him. He had an argument with his mother and sister, then left home.
- He's been a distant caretaker of his family, fighting as a Drake in the KPLA (despite attempts to promote him) since. The Resistance's Ace Courier.

Name: Mira
Backstory Bullet Points:
- got moonscorched (Kor´tarion moon mutation)
- was part of the brightshield guard
- joined the guard early
- went MIA for 10 years due to mutations
- remembers little in regards to details
- Had a humble life before joining the guard.
Remort Changes:
Biophagy 3 -> 4
Akromorphosis 3->2
Thats all

Name: Miruna 'Rue' Dzata
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born into the Dzata family, the closest thing to a noble or royal house in Akala city, mama is Dzata and mother a warden from Heartdom.

-Was more protected than most Dreadlan people, protected by her status, her three eyes, and her parents, but in a place where might makes right she quickly discovered that she needed to hold her own somehow.

- Was sent to Gnosis academy to grow stronger and become the best Paladin she could.

- Became a Regalia :)

Name: Mithreign the Fourteenth
Backstory Bullet Points:
* From a deep layer of the Faerie Realm that bordered on the Gloom, Mithreign's grasp on more stable timespace reality is still forming. He is endlessly curious and may ask humans simple things about their lives.
* One thing he's clung to is his concept of human Order. Ground that doesn't move. Things that stay in the same place. Rulers everyone bows to, acknowledges and recognizes.
* He had a formative moment in asking a drunk old man in a bar one day, "What makes someone a King?" The old man looked at him and shrugged, then started laughing. At this moment, Mithreign decided if this old man did not know, he did not need to know either; Mithreign laughed, decided he was the Ruler of All Fae, it was funny, and that's that.
* He tends to wander, forgetful but curious. Exact moments do not matter to him, but his experiences nonetheless become him. He's on the Worldhelm now, someone having been curious enough to take him there, and sees so very much he doesn't yet understand.
Sheet Link: ["*What do they think of, when they dream?*"](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1F6hgfQ0FntPBMidVZgoXhXkeo0bvtYFKESMdZdPBF6s/edit?usp=sharing)

Name: Mitsuhime
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Descendant of one of Amaterasu's bird youkai emissaries ( White Heron ) with a human husband. 

* Raised inside a small clan of loyal Amaterasu's worshippers who try to keep as much of old religious and cultural practices intact. 

* Was taught sacred rituals since an early age. Been helping in the safekeeping of the small pockets of divinity still present around Sakai as well as healing those in need of sanctuary. 

* One day while meditating in front of the sacred fire, was granted a brief vision of incoming danger by the strained voice of the goddess herself. Soon after she found herself on the World Helm.
Other Names: Shrine Maiden heir of the sun goddess' teachings.

Name: Mizuki
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Abandoned by her parents due to her ability to talk to the spirits around her only she could see

- Grew up in a Temple to Hotei that raised young orphans and taught them trade skills. Mizuki was taught the ways of the Kami as a shrine Maiden

- Was a lonely child shunned by her peers, she found friendship with a traveler named Kanae in her times wandering the forest near the temple

- When it as time to age out, Mizuki was purchased by the Konoe Clan, specifically on behalf of Lord Konoe, as a gift to his Niece Shion, who was a Spirit Medium who worked as an exorcist in Mugetsu.

- Arriving at the Temple of Izanami, she began her apprenticeship under Shion for the next two years.

Name: Mo Jun-Hie
Backstory Bullet Points:
- In the cold Xuanwu city, There was a family consisting of Mo Tengfei, Ink cultivator and head of a minor sect. Mo Meilin, his wife. Wu Liling, Tengfei's concubine.

- From fervent prayers, wishing for a most fortuitous child, and wishing to give birth before Tengfei's wife. Liling gave birth to a Bishi'e, which they named Mo Jun-Hie.

- Seeing it as a blessing of the Heavens, Tengfei and Liling showered Jun-Hie with love. However, while Meilin didn't visibly show it, she was repulsed by the child.

- Jun-Hie followed in his father's footsteps and joined the sect at a young age. Picking up Ink cultivation rather quickly himself. With time he started to give his own spin on it by focusing more on painting rather than just Calligraphy.

- One brutal night. Tengfei betrayed his sect and killed most of its members. The only survivors were the ones helping Tengfei, and Jun-Hie, who shouted out to his father, but was given no response. After the incident, Tengfei hasn't been seen since.

Name: Mok Yangwon
Backstory Bullet Points:
> Yangwon was born with a certain instinct to crave bloodshed

> He was found as a baby by his foster father and teacher, a wandering hero with great ideals

> This person raised him secluded in the mountains until he came of age, teaching him to how suppress his base instincts, how to wield qi and defend himself

> As such, Yangwon grew up with a great admiration and fondness for the idea of wandering heroes

> At age 19 he finally climbs down the mountain on his lonesome

> Almost immediately ambushed and narrowly escapes capture from a group of Yokai

> Wanders the forest whilst injured until he gets caught up in a realmstorm

> Profit???

Name: Mokah
Backstory Bullet Points: When one travels the western region of Aldistir, they may come across a silent cloaked yokai.  This figure would use the bells on their staff to get the traveler's attention, and then guide them safely through the wilderness towards nearby villages and towns, vanishing without a word once their job is done.  Mocah lost their parents to a blizzard when they were younger, and chose to become a guide, helping the lost in the best way they can.  Too shy to speak to most people, they usually gesture with their staff in order to communicate.  Mocah lives alone in a hut in the Silver Spire mountains.  A follower of the Aesir Seraph, they're a small kindness in the harsh lands of Aldistir.

Name: Monique Valentine
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Monique was raised as a son of a petty thief in Smokeside in Hidela Lhodos, after her mother disappeared 11 years ago.

• During a change of heart, she suffered a horrible accident in the middle ground from a landmine. Her father abandoned her to die instead of being shackled with debt.

• Despite being a ne'er do well in general, the people of Hidela committed to her recovery, and with their help and ingenuity relearned how to walk.

• Once she recovered, she took on a new name and new look, promising to be her authentic self and repaying the kindness of those around her forward.

Name: Morgana
Age: Physically 30; Chronologically either 2 or 1000+ depending on what you count
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Morgana was once the guardian of the Brecilient, a sacred grove that saw many of Deleria's most notable stories
- The grove was lost during Vanagandr's attack, the Forest of Loss overtaking it over the centuries
- His power and identity inseparable from it, Morgana remained asleep even as the rest of Deleria woke up, as Regus hid away the memories of what they had lost
- But when part of those memories began to return, Morgana opened her eyes.
- For weeks, Morgana wallowed in his grief, refusing to leave the Castle's garden.
- However, Ladon's brief return to defy the Utopian Archangels stirred something in their heart.
- "I am nothing. I am an echo of a being created to guard a place that no longer exists. And yet; I *am.* I breathe. I dream. And I *refuse* to let it be for naught."
- Resolved to find a reason to keep living, and wishing to repay the Worldhelm for saving his people, Morgana joins the ranks of the Goldhearted.

Name: Morgia Sophus
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Thanheim, with the Balefire cult.
- Was experimented by putting a moonshard into her as an infant.
- Taken away by a priest named Lucius Sophus who ran away to the western continent. Raising Morgia in a forest with just the two of them.
- Imparted the religious beliefs of Caladrius for what they stood for: to heal ailments and to exorcise the wicked from people.
- Began a journey at age 20 to practice her tenets as a healer.

Name: Mori Yuma
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Mori died in Kor'Tarion when the moon shattered at the age of 28
-Her spirit is now contained within a temporary vessel that harbors it
-She gained her magical powers from her companion/familiar, Bloop, sometime postmortem while her spirit was lost without a proper resting place or vessel
-She is on a journey to reconcile with her death and remember who she was and how she died
-Her Empath powers come from her having a high emotional aptitude for this type of magic, hence why Bloop was attracted to her and decided to bond to her
-Bloop also took pity on her and saw her death as a tragic way to die, so he is taking it as his duty to see that Mori finds a way to the afterlife

Name: Morideth Cadwal
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and raised in Brightshield. Grew jaded of urban life and wanted to see what else the world held.
- This made her an easy target for the Veiled Stewards, a group of fae who insisted they were doing her a favour with her abduction.
- Made her into a bird-based chimera, and kept her in their Menagerie.
- Spent many years in a gilded cage as a songbird to entertain strange fae nobles.
- Escaped in a disturbance caused by one of the Stewards' newest "catches".
- When she returned to the mortal world, she found only a few months had passed. Her family and community shunned her due her obvious fae nature.
- Took up courier work within and between both the mortal and fae realm for the feeling of freedom it grants.

Name: Moritz Abel Von-Hardwick
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Moritz was born and raised in Vale. When the bombs dropped, he was forced to care of his younger sister by himself. Due to a lack of resources, he undertook a mission for the KPLA. General Von-Hardwick caught him, but instead of execution, took both him and his sister in.

- He quickly enrolled in the WWA and excelled in his classes. This caught the eye of the now-celebrity, Hailey Bennett, who used him to propel herself forward. Despite being relatively overlooked, Commander Erich Valn saw his talent and took him under his wing as an early, quiet graduate.

- Working in Caldera as a Strategic Supervisor, Moritz helped with research and strategy for Valn. However, his work caused his mental health to deteriorate. He stopped visiting his sister, but trained a small squad of new WWA recruits. However, when tasked to drag them into his “type of work,” he snapped.

- He went off the grid without his mech, suffering a terrible mental breakdown. After a few days, the ship picked him up.

Name: Morrigan Nequiz
Backstory Bullet Points:
- The life before Morrigan was found by his Adopted Mother, Patli, is mostly unknown to him. However, he was born in Providencia, and a great evil was sealed inside of him by a group he has no knowledge of. He has been cursed to be unable to die.
- The people who sealed the evil in him presume him 'disposed of', however, his miraculous ability to evade death gave him a second chance.
- He was found in the woods, unconscious, and alone, a number of years ago. Patli raised him as if he was her own child, and he has acted as an assistant of sorts ever since.
- He travels where she goes, and has followed her lead to join the Guild.

Name: Mort VanSigil
Backstory Bullet Points:
*Memory of his early Past is hazy
*Believes He has always lived  in the area outside the Academy
*Remembers a Mentor or Teacher, but no record of them at the Academy
*Will sometimes teach new students the fundamentals of Symbology 
*He has started to travel to "Find Inspiration"
**If pressed he is not sure what he is looking for just that he needs to find Something
-----------------------------------------
*Things Mort is not aware of*
-Mort's Current "condition" is the result of a Ritual that backlashed that he assisted his Mentor in
-- This resulted in Mort starting to fade slowly over time. This fading is what is driving his travels now as the first of his Last Goodbyes is coming.
--This act had him removed as a teacher of the academy and his name redacted, the Academy wants to keep an eye on Mort in case the backlash proves to be dangerous and not just unfortunate

Name: Mr.C
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born in Little Ottington, raised on the streets in grime and filth
-Parents were homeless and died of sickness when he was at a young age
-Forced to use his expertise in cleaning to survive
-Finds comfort in talking to constructs and his tools
-After serving for years to a family, he saved enough money to purchase his vehicle from some old dude
-Owns a cleaning service in Little Ottington
-Created a product known as the "Dispeller", can clean and remove "anything" off of a surface.
-Finds the Undead to be filthy, wants to "cleanse" them form this realm(s)
-One  day he had cleaned in a magic office, leaving the residue in a bucket, to which it came to be sentient, and now assists him with his work.
-Is adept in supportive magic due to workplace hazards

Name: Msrah
Backstory Bullet Points:
- He was one of many children who lost their parents, either due to illness or combat. He was given few freedoms during this time.
- Sold into slavery once he was able to perform manual labor, specifically in the Romani house. 
- He found solace in the arts like dance that were used for entertainment but he rarely found freedom to practice it for his own enjoyment.
- While he was treated better than most slaves due to the Romani house, he still was a slave and knew little beyond service.
- Eventually was urged by his owner Sloan to join her with the Goldhearted on to the ship, which occurred on a mission.

Name: Mutt
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Verdancy to a traditional Grazer family, left his home, name, and gender behind to chase his fortune in the crystal rush in Baazar
- Instead of getting rich quick, he ended up destitute, having to resort to stealing food to eat
- Got arrested, met a Drifter by the name of "Jesse Blackburn" who convinced him to help stage a breakout.
- Joined the Knucklebone Gang, led by Blackburn, as a scout. 
- With time, the gang grew in infamy as their exploits became ever more ambitious-- and bloody.
- One day, got sent to scout a town that supposedly hid a huge Shardglass vein. It was supposed to be a quick look-over, but Mutt didn't return for days.
- Rumor started that he was planning on defecting, so Blackburn went to deal with him personally. But when the rest of the gang caught up, Blackburn was dead, and Mutt was gone-- along with the boss's prized gun.
- Wasn't seen again for years, but recently reemerged in the adventurer's guild, looking to "pay his dues."
Quirk:
Heirloom
> __The Sinner__
> Custom Firearm 
> Quality: Finisher
> Flaw: There's a lot of people who would like to take that rifle off your hands. Vigilantes, Treasure Hunters... And the ones loyal to the man whose corpse you pried it off of.

Name: Myffa Sirrokh
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Daughter of a secretly magic blacksmith on a southern merchant caravan
- Father fends off Kiir attack with a magic sword but gets ratted out as a mage
- Slavers come get him but he fights back and burns Myffa and himself
- He cures her the best he can but dies in the process
- She becomes a mercenary and travelling artisan while secretly using the remnants of the magic sword
Remort Changes:
Agile Defender Style changes, she literally increased her HP god damn
Minor changes to Soul Steal, Peacock Dance, and See You Later
Increased 1 damage on Perplexing Orb
