Name: Naiki'tari [Nai]
Backstory Bullet Points:
- In the far north of Kor'Tarion's Realm of Faeries, there was a tribe of feline eared humans. As a culture, they revered and worshiped magic.
- In the lead up to the moons collapse, the tribe was entirely wiped out. Their will to understand and claim all that is arcane remaining, however, as their last sentiment in the lands they lived.
- Seventy odd years later, Nai awoke in a clearing at the eastern edge of the Gwaed. Little memory to be had, he stood, and began to walk. All he had was a yearning to understand magic, and the collective skill of his peoples last will.
- This condensed memorium come sapiance is on a clock, fading slowly with time, reclaiming more memories of his past life with each step he takes towards his end.

Name: Nanashi
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Was always a fighter, whether against bullies or those who deserved it.
* Thought Kuzunoha's war was pointless. Doesn't believe in harming others who are not involved or are innocent
* Left to seek out Nimue, fighting her way there with glee and joy. Caught the attention of Lilith. Accepted her deal, and bound her power.
* Took shelter in a Blizzard when a Realmstorm came and snatched her up.

Name: Nanri
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Wanted to be a knight since she was little.
-Got unlucky and got cursed by a fae when was little to have rabbit features. She wasn't thrill about her new appearance as it made her stand out more and cause problems (such as strange looks or even being accursed of being a fae.)
-Optimistic and kind hearted
-Wants to protect people from the darkness of the world.
-She was driven out of midholde due to being mistaken for a demon force to flee from there.
-Even after this event she still held on to her dreams but with the addition of figuring out how to remove her curse.

Name: Naomi Falken
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Recruited in the KPLA in early teens
- Found a prototype mecha called Scylla, and fought using it for a while
- She was not skilled enough to use that mech, and it was destroyed during a battle. Naomi did not surrender however, and picked up the Scylla's weapon.
- After picking up the weapon, Naomi awoke her Esper powers in a violent backlash. Unwillingly, she bound some of her mind to the blade, bonding to it even if the sword was not initially supernatural.
- She was later deemed unfit for active battlefield, as a danger to both herself and those surrounding her.
- While wandering Lhodos aimlessly, a Realmstorm picked her up.
Quirk: Heirloom - FLAW: The Remnant can flare in painful headaches that can induce blind rage or confusion in Naomi

Name: Naomi Ohm
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Naomi was born to a soldier. A mercenary who worked on behalf of 100 Gates Security. He enrolled her in a special program when she was 14 that was training soldiers.
- The "Debilitation Squad Project" was meant to train soldiers capable of utilizing the volatile 'Debilitation Blade', as the prototype was called. They trained under harsh conditions, made to be sturdy, and resilient. Mentally and physically.
- The Project came under scrutiny, and after a few intense back and forths between superiors, it was shut down. However, the project lead continued it.
- Within a month of relocating the facility, security offers swept the building and killed all present. Her Squad she'd been training with, her teachers, the project manager, and her father.
- She escaped, luckily, and in the years since has worked as a Temp for Galeforce. Simple muscle, and simple security work.

Name: Naomi Sevalis
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Slums of Belfrost, Naomi was raised by her community as a slightly sheltered child, raised on stories of story book knights and nobles.

-Joined the Belfrost defense force at 14 and showed surprising talent for combat magic in her defense of the city against undead incursions.

- A year after she started service, the mark of the successor appeared on her legs and she was picked up by the beacon of the stone of Virtue.

- Left to train in Lostbourgh to master her abilities for the next few years, becoming a knight errant that did what she could to serve the people of Silverdale, and protect her home. She frequently visits her family in Belfrost and does what she can to help her community.

- Has been working under Eremon Louhi now that the Beacon has sequestered away. Doing what she could to help the realm and work on her secret mission to help cure the Beacon

- It is that quest that led to her volunteering to go beyond the Runewall in order to find a cure.

Name: Nara
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A vulpine yokai who was once part of "The War of Fox and Hound".
- Was sealed away at one point and was eventually awoke when a follower of Nimue broke the seal.
- Sparred with the one who freed them and would have lost had they not spared them.
- Was forced to make a promise to guide and help those who need it in return and has wandered Aldistir to attempt to do exactly that.
- Had an old pact brought around to payment and became an entity known as "The Grim Welder" adopting a more shadowy form. An entity capable of reshaping death and bringing a new cycle of life and who acts as a guide to the souls of beast who have received Kuzunoha's blessings. Due to the recent gain of these powers however they are currently "leashed" by Kuzunoha.
Relevant Arcana: Kuzunoha - Fought for her in the war and currently has Grim Welder gifts leashed by her.

Name: Narantsetseg
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Used to be part of Temple of Growth
- Empty Monks didn't approve of her aptitude for Metal cultivation
- She and several others left the Temple via caravan to establish the village of Daringanga
- Started practice in Holy Harmony with Organa Baatar as her bonded. 
- Uses a spear and a jade slip from Baihu to learn techniques

Name: Narmandakh
Backstory Bullet Points:
Narmandakh is a Yakshi born in a village on the lake just north of the temple of flow as Batbayar.
When he was about eight the vvoid monks came took young villagers.
He was taken in by the void monks along with his sister, Battsetseg. They were taught the ways of the monks and given new names he became known to the void monks as Nergui before being put through terrible trials.
When he turned twenty he went through the trial of the whirl, pulled under the water he nearly drowned before being washed up.
A stranger finds him and nurses him back to health. This man, Altan, becomes his new mentor as Nergui is taught ways to help oneself through helping others. Renaming himself Narmandakh after baptism.
Narmandakh is plagued by nightmares due to a heart demon and cultivating new dream qi. Odd visions of distant lands and thriving villages fill his mind.
After a few years he befriends a spirit beast that helps him travel between towns helping out. He was chased by spirit beasts into a storm.
Birth Realm: Tian Yin, Leytik, Temple of Flow

Name: Nasaya Valsieve
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Nasaya was born in Cronis with Yuel, a childhood friend.
- She was 10 when she began to feel the pull, both the dreams and the crystalline formation under her left eye.
- She went to Erdelkeith with Yuel and the rest of her family for the pilgrimage
- As the two were taught by the Soul Witches of the Erdelward Order, she took to like oil and water. She couldn't connect to the stone and use the stone powers at all and at the same time, Yuel could.
- Through the various teachers she may have had, the underlying belief that Yuel would have been a better successor remained.
- She managed to understand the other forms of magic to a certain degree, magic inspiring wonder in her as always.
- They left for the Runewall, surely even this can be understood as it is terrifying as it is wonderous. The land must be protected and surely even she could learn something from what lies beyond.

Name: Nasim ibn Khaled
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Windhaven, the City of Sandsailors.
- Sandship racer under Mustafar, the Racemaster of Windhaven, like his late father before him. Trusted enough that the *Sand Serpent* was a semi-permanent loan.
- Went into smuggling with Auro Benites, and continued after Auro left to join the Revolutionaries. Some of the smuggling jobs were to get people safely to the Blue.
- Was caught out by Nezzim patrols when returning from one of those trips, but a Realmstorm brought him to the Worldhelm. Suspects that Mustafar may have ratted him out, but he has no proof.
- Has pivoted towards being a sandship artisan rather than just a racer during his time on the Worldhelm. Recently reached a breakthrough after lessons from Huong Jin and Kurso Armstrong and exposure to Terran tech, allowing the *Sand Serpent* to fly.
- Considers the *Sand Serpent* his own sandship now. And with Mustafar dead after the liberation of Windhaven, there's no one to contest this.
Sheet Link: [I must plot my own path through the sands...](<https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1HpWZO5OrBlAn41FW7paFDiB32wcmdR0cicNxJheYjHw/edit?gid=0#gid=0>)

Name: Natalia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was the daughter of the wealthiest man in a small village near The Creagins that has sense vanished to The Calamity.
- Father was a corrupt man taking advantage of those around the village, with his wealth and sway.
- When she was 10 a group of Crownless passed through the village, its residents hiding as they do from their presence but Natalia took advantage of this.
- She took the opportunity to kill her father, sick of suffering his abuse and seeing him abuse others. Dragging his body out before the group and demanding to be taken with them.
- From her scene it was evident her father's negative influence from his abuse of power, as some brave folk stepped forth in support of her actions.
- Seeing her having support from villagers from her actions they agreed and brought her to the Dissenter's Tower.
- When The Beacon of Anarchy returned to their tower next she was there waiting, and she received their blessing. Not long after signs of her being a Successor of the Anarchy Stone.
Quirk: Next In Line (Prestige) - Bend the power of chaos in her favor to incredible effect for surprising feats of power. However at times chaotic eneries can run wild around her producing effects similar to those around the Anarchy Stone.

Name: Nathan Porumbel
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Pale Mercy, left at the age of 20 as he felt the ways of his family a bit too suffocating
- Lived in Veyrhold for some years, joined the SIA due to a personal interest
- Bounced between divisions for a while, eventually landed in the Black Overlay Phenomology Unit (though he still assists other units, mainly the Aura Dynamics & Vampiric Studies Unit, when requested)
- Is currently stationed in Veyrhold, mainly in charge of monitoring and curbing emotional surge events and hotspots in the city's nightlife quarter

Name: Neishin
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was formerly known as Villr while she was a wolf.
- Was abandoned by her pack when she was injured and dying for being "weak" and passed out from exhaustion and injuries.
- Awoke to Kuzunoha offering her the gift of becoming yokai, which she accepted as she was not ready to die.
- Travels from yokai settlement to yokai settlement as they do not trust her but will give her place to rest as she did receive Kuzunoha's gifts.
- Actively seeks to rebel against Vanagandr and his followers.
- Was captured and intend to be offered as a sacrifice to Vanagandr in a ritual, but was offered gifts by Lilith, should Neishin continue to amuse her by fighting Vanagandr.
- Still wears the collar from when she was imprisoned as a reminder that she isn't truly free because of her nature.
Relevant Arcana: Vanagandr (Beyrayed), Kuzunoha (Turned to Yokai), Lilith (Gave blessing (Arcanist))

Name: Nene Tapaya
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A happy-go-lucky girl from Sampaguita Village
- Raised by two sets of loving parents, her human birth-parents and a pair of giant chickens which she was raised alongside with
- A chance visit from the Kabiya opened her eyes truly to the perils faced by those outside her (relatively) prosperous home
- She now sets out to provide those around her with even a portion of the peace and happiness she did.

Name: Nero Roux
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born into an elite assassin family under the umbrella of the Vignettes; one of five siblings, each from a different father, bred for excellence.

* Trained in a close-knit group of assassin hopefuls; formed deep bonds with his peers.

* Final test revealed only one could advance. His closest friend betrayed the group first.

* Nero defended his comrades and killed the traitor, only to see the rest executed by handlers.

* Traumatized, he abandoned weapons refusing to ever lift another something so overtly deadly. Instead, he now fights with twin shields constructs.

* Soft-spoken, elegant, and unfailingly polite. He became Vigil of the Vignettes.

* Though this is the world he has known, he has also vowed to never to fail those he guards again.

Name: Nestor Anargyrosidis
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Nestor is the child of a fisherman near the Gateway to Mercury, the temple knew that the was to be born through an prophecy given by Hermion.

- He left his family before he could truly remember. It is not so difficult to visit them, but it was hardly a childhood where he lived with his parents. 

- In his time at the temple, it was engrained into him the importance of their work, their beliefs, their practices. To emulate the life of their god, stoicism and frugality was valued highly, one should not sully the words of their oracle with their own emotions. 

- As part of his training, he began to do small prophecies of his own, until he saw far too much. A battlefield until Hermion themselves stopped him from continuing that vision. He was brought under their wing.

- It was some time after that he started his travel, first with a small group from the church and eventually on his own. And so we come to the present
Other Names:
Chosen of Hermion
Nestor of Mercury

Name: Nettie
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up as the only child of a devout family in New Jamestown; had an early gift for sunlight magick that the local church nurtured, setting her on the path to becoming a Dawnspeaker

- Her magic soon expanded beyond the church's holy framework; the land began reflecting her emotions and caused disruptions within the community

- Esther casted herself out into the Relnion Woods; her best friend, Josiah Bennett, caught between his faith and his loyalty, chose to continue serving the church in the end

- Nearly succumbing to the forest, a coyote found Esther and became her saving grace; it stayed by her side, guiding her until she arrived at Copsehaven

- Recognizing her commitment to Kuzunoha's traditions, the Elders soon performed a rite of ceremony, bestowing her Nettle Roots Deep

- Losing Shae to the demon raids, Nettie desperately headed into the wilderness to seek out one of the great spirits for help; however, the forest answered her not with a spirit, but with a Realmstorm

Name: Niaouli
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born from a shoot of an ancient tree blessed by Kuzunoha in an attempt to save it from being corrupted by Godsblood. Giving Birth to a tree yokai.
- Awakened but the corruption made him like a Draugr, violent and lost.
- Spent many years fighting and surviving but was very hard to kill, probably a mix of the Draugr corruption and the nature of the tree.
- After years of violence realized that violence tasted better against strong and evil creatures. Specially evil wrathful humanoid people. 
- Decided to travel to a less violent place to see if he could hold back his nature
- Visited cities of the Alds, finding a somewhat peaceful life helping protect people against Draugr and Yokai
- Evil people kept inspiring violence and he could feel a strong yearning for an end to the corruption he is under, and every time he protected the weak he felt less corrupted
- His humanity and selflessness made him a Goldhearted. One day he woke up in Worldhelm

Name: Nico bastion
Backstory Bullet Points:
- His entire family was murdered at a young age, scaring him into never picking up the blade. 
- Wanting no one to ever experience what he had before, his desire to protect the people is driven to the extreme.
- Whilst not being the brightest of the bunch, he has learned through trial and error that to protect others better, he has to become far stronger than imagined.
- His infatuation with fighting Kaijus is stirred on by legends of old, that he wishes to recreate for himself, and to show the people that he is Here!!

Name: Nicolás Castillo
Backstory Bullet Points: Poor Terran habitant goes to a slightly good school thanks to how much is his single mom working and taking care of his younger brother. Realizes they're so poor that makes him search for works instead of using the time at the school to study or make friends. When an adult, can't get into a good job so becomes a mercenary, which he doesn't like but pays well. Tries to become more famous so he can get better contracts, and recently buys metal bear ear implants that can don onto him an exoskeleton and fight better.

Name: Nikki Lovemoon
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Faerie Realm to a pixie father and an absent mortal father
- Was always curious about her human father
- Loved to read about the Mortal Realm
- Left the Faerie Realm and travelled the Mortal Realm to search for her father

Name: Nora Farkas
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Born within the forest of the Hollow Vast, raised among the nomadic Sólyom tribe
• Taught from childhood that the wolf is freedom and that captivity is the greatest sin

• Now walks the cities she once raided, a wolf in an uneasy alliance.

Name: Paraluman
Backstory Bullet Points:

Through her wish to not wanting a life of savagery, she had cultivated her magic and wit, and used those to escape to greener pastures. She ended up within a Grove in the Tikba Forest. 
- Among the residents and travelers of Sampaguita Village, there were rumors about a mysterious maiden exuding a comforting, revitalizing aura, yet shy enough to remain elusive. On sightings of her, the abundance of blooming flowers is one thing people say consistently - prevalently Sampaguita, its scent filling the area.
- Then one day, Paraluman shook off her born distrust of people keeping her isolated in the grove and stepped out into the village. She was easily accepted by the locals, maybe mistaken as one of the Kabaya. Paraluman nowadays is often seen resting besides the shade of a tree or walking around, greeting them with a gentle smile.

Those he was made to steal from would have their goods returned in secret, those he intimidated would be met with a sly kindness repaid to them. Little things he could get past his captors became his only means of real escape. Until the day he disappeared.

* Percival grew up in Caldera, Merrane from a prestigious military family. She is recruited to White Wing Academy and trained to be a fearsome riflewoman and pilot.

* She is traumatized by her first battle, where she violently loses her squad and forced to fight against a people who only wished to survive, blood staining her hands. She loses an eye due to an explosion.

* When she recovers, she is assigned to a small airship owned by eccentric noble Lindsey Beck. She takes this opportunity to steal the ship for herself and defect from Merrane, becoming a sky pirate fighting for the freedom of Karlsgard and peace for Lhodos.

* They end up at the Worldhelm due to getting caught by a Realmstorm during a squall.
Quirk:
Old Transport

Perci captains the Gleaming Goose, an airship that sails the Violet Barons, originally owned by Lindsey Beck.

Name: Percival Blackwell
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Percy grew up with his twin brother Corwin to a commoner family in the lower districts of Reven, Delsatz. 
- Due to the struggles brought on by Delsatz's social stratification, they quickly learned to live defiantly in their own way. Percy found his stride in community, connection and cunning, and Corwin in conflict and change with the Liberation Army.
- Percy was cautious about the prospect of a bloody revolution, whereas Corwin felt emboldened by the promise of independence.
- Things came to a head when fighting drew near, up until the nobility unexpectantly offered concessions to halt and uprising.
- Percy was relieved with the resolution, but his brother grew frustrated and bitter, seeing it as a temporary fix.
- After an emotional argument, Corwin disappeared. Percy learned later that his brother had traveled towards the Runewall in search of power to overturn Delsatz.
- Percy followed his brother, intent on stopping him from making a mistake, ultimately ending up in Worldhelm.

Name: Perseus
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born from Dreadlan Paladin Argos and Dreadlan Witch Aegea. 
- Raised to serve Queen of Beasts Akala as a knight.
- At the age of 16 was sent to Gnosis Academy to grow his combat talents and be educated.
- Met Apollo, a fellow Paladin in training who was struggling in school.
- Apollo instead became a Treasure, deciding to become Perseus' Regalia so both their dreams could come true. 
- Perseus now aspires to be one of the best Paladins to ever live, and rise to a similar if not same position as Akala for his people's benefit.

Name: Petra
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Daughter of the Solyom tribe
-During a Winged Pilgrimage, became separated
-Had to survive with a small group of other young wolves
-grew up away from her tribe.
-Kidnapped by rogue SIA agents for study
-Freed by an SIA agent working as a reporter
-Can't find her home on her own so she stays with her new friend
-Brought by her into the SIA to help despite her wild nature

Name: Phoebe
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Once a military officer, Pheobe was one of many to undergo esper surgery. She failed. Reason of insanity. Then sent away. 
• Woke up in the Hart Forest with no memories of their previous life dressed in a military uniform. All medals upon her character are damaged beyond recognition so one cannot tell of the achievements they had done before or what their rank was before.
• At first, she had nothing but negative thoughts. The thoughts almost overwhelming. She was able to process them. Despite the time she had to process these thoughts. Some moments she would experience mood swings due to these thoughts. Becoming more cold and callus during this time. Her words and thoughts becoming negative during it
• During her weeks within the woods, despite the fact she was nowhere near people. Every few days there would be a clean uniform by her resting place. She had no clue who did it, but appreciated it.
• After a few weeks, Phoebe was caught up in a Realmstorm, then arrived at the Worldhelm

Name: Phor
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Apprentice herbalist from Hyacinth VIllage, Kor'Tarion
-Teacher and colleague killed while gathering herbs together with him
-Rescued by travelling Adventurers
-Has survivors guilt
-Took up magic to avoid a repeat of events

Name: Pierre Galois
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to minor noble house Galois

- Grew up privileged, never seeing pass the upper quarters

- Trained in dueling and was able to win his family heirloom, a rapier called The Vituroso, with a inter-house dueling tournament

- One day in his teenage years he was able to sneak off to see where majority of Belfrost live in poor conditions.

- When he just reached adulthood he spoke out about the poverty in front of the Major Houses causing a scandal

- Galois's head of house first reponse was to disowned and exile Pierre to save face in front of the other houses

- Pirerre left for the Rune Wall with his family sword The Vituroso to prove that he is worthy of the blade and hopes to one day return to Belfrost.

Name: Pip
Age: Inanimate object, but has existed for over 40 years.
Backstory Bullet Points:
A plushie that once belonged to a woman researcher at Hudal Academy but was transported into the faerie realm during a freak accident.

Was found by a faerie and was brought back to life, giving it a chance to explore the world and experience many things before they return to being a plushie.
Other Names: Pip the Juggler, Miphomy (the name given by their previous owner)

Name: Pit fighter adamai
Backstory Bullet Points:
[Physical description 5,7ft, orange eye's,black hair and a athletics physic]
"Adamai was adopted and raised in a circus on the settlements of mastrazs,he would grow found the circus crew as if they all were his family,and they did the same,training him,and improving his skills a Malabar,later as he became a adult he became stronger than most man of the circus,participating in several dangerous stunts,that would however get attention of the circus owner,seeing his strength he took Adamai to fight in rings,and win.
It paid better,and if he came back hurt,it was just from practicing. 
But one night adamai lost a fight,when adamai woke up,the owner have fled both with his money and the circus money,leaving all desperate. 
 but adamai endured his wounds and went back to rings,he would win all back all the way to the top.

Name: Poppy Sparks
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Lumina Prime, Zhuanli Union to a TEMP father and a strict mother.
- Since she was young, Poppy has a very natural affinity to primal magic that used to be common in Terra's history many years ago. However, it lacks control and causes constant issues around her.
- Poppy has a limiter implant granted by QiLink to control this magic, also serves to monitor her. Requiring semi-weekly visits to a QiLink-affiliated doctor who practices magic.
- Currently a student in one of the most prestigious universities in the world, attending on scholarship due to her intellect.
- As part of a contractual agreement for her scholarship, she is to immediately work for QiLink upon graduation. Granting her an early access to their arcana under certain conditions.
- Works part time at a coffee shop.
Quirk:
Neo-Human (Prestige Token Used)
Flaw - Upon releasing her limiters, it can cause an unintended consequence based the on primal magic. This power is barely controlled.
Relevant Arcana: Qilin (QiLink) - Student from their school and bound.

Name: Primrose
Backstory Bullet Points: Used to live life as a dancer, then accidents and run ins with gangs led to her being thrown down a hole where an ancient plant was that merged its existence with her.

Name: Priscilla
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Formerly Devout Priestess of Merrane:
A dedicated follower of the Theocratic Monarchy of Merrane, she spent much of her life spreading her religion and serving the divine.

- Coordinator Training:
Beyond her role as a healer of faith, she undertook advanced courses to act as a combat coordinator. Her primary role involves guiding and commanding Merrane Angels in battle, making her more of a strategist than a traditional priestess.

- Unique Perception:
Priscilla possesses an unusual way of perceiving the world. Instead of seeing people as they physically appear, she sees glowing lights and auras that reflect their true nature. For Goldhearted individuals, she sees a brilliant glow, while others are perceived through the emotional and spiritual essence of their buried selves.

Name: Professor Sigma
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Born and raised as Logan Briar in Haven, university student turned professor. Focus on both physics and metaphysics.
• Scouted for R&D by PARABELLUM, began working as a researcher.
• Breaches in containment by monsters & para-normal entities that were studied couldn't be wholesale prevented, watched a few colleagues die and almost lost his life a few times as well.
• Drew up specs for S.I.G.M.A., Suppression & Immobilization Guardian Mobile Apparatus. An exosuit with protective functions to handle breaches.
• LOGI approved the design, commissioning Orrery for the suit's base hardware, and Lorel.AI for base software.
• Logan was assigned the codename Sigma, and assigned the suit to handle research & containment. Was granted a temp license to provide on-the-field post-capture support with BED on occasion.
• Was part of a mission to capture/eliminate an entity on the moon. Went to investigate when the BED team's comms went down, stumbled onto a realmstorm.

Name: Qu Fuling
Backstory Bullet Points:
- She was just a statue of Kami Jizou near a simple village in Hanae
- One day, the curse of Yato no Kami manifested in a red-headed boy who often stayed near the statue with his brother Kidomaru
- Once the boy grew older, the protection of the statue was gone and could no longer stop the curse
- In response, the statue animated
- Qu Fuling was too weak to save him, so she sent him "on a different road"
- Afterwards, spent few years cultivating to delay her return into a statue. Ship picked her up after those years

Name: Quill, of Iburra
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A member of the Iburri Coven, who practice their witchcraft through song and music.
- Raised by his mother with his older brother, Asher.
- Asher joins the alliance who ventures into the Blighted Steps and never returns. They say the grief killed his mother only a few years after.
- Granted his magic in a traditional coven rite: a performance of sufficient beauty for the Roots themselves. Impressed, they give Quill the privilege to call on their aid with only a note, as they have the rest of his coven.
- Grows discontent with the vague, idle secrecy of the foxes, and leaves to travel the Firwood with the aim to make their prowess and goodwill clear — or at least, his prowess and goodwill.

Name: Quincy Ashlock
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was the only child of a minor company beneath Lorel.AI in Genesis. Father wanted a son so he named her after himself.
- As she grew up she was forced to work under her father to study the Soul Network. She was a natural at manipulating it and controlling it to assist her with magic.
- Realizing her potential her father tried to tie her down to the company as a worker for its offices. Keeping her always nearby for whatever experiments they wanted to attempt.
- Over time she grew to hate her father's work and eventually ran away with her close friend Odette Cordelia to escape Genesis.
- Using her status as a Temp Worker for Lorel.AI to find odd jobs along the way. Mostly taking jobs that involved protecting people or cargo till she eventually was picked up by the Realmstorm during one of the missions.

Name: RVN-A77 "Reaver"
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Sold his identity and naming rights to a cybernetics corporation - in exchange for installing his prototype cybernetics suite, still in development - that was later bought out by 777LC, so his identity is now 777LC intellectual property. He would be in breach of contract if he ever disclosed his "real" name.
* A flashy pit fighter and modern gladiator by trade, he's viewed as an up and coming talent by some. Corporate interests gambled on him. If he winds up becoming a star, livestreams of his fights viewed through his optical implants could be a hit. He could also appear in advertising - he doesn't have rights to his own identity, afterall.
* Corporate ownership has given him license to perform combative magic related to his profession: fighting. He's pleased as punch to simply be able to stand up to other cybernetically-enhanced fighters.
* RVN stands for "Regenerative Violence Nexus." The coming development cycles will push him further into self-enhancement via forward violence.

Name: Racheal
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Lived a decent portion of their life before the attack on Deleria, forgetting everything and falling into a coma

- During the coma Rachael had a dream of her living a regular civilian life, experiencing what felt like a decade, even raising a son named Ywain who she became extremely close to.

- Woke up in Castle Ladon, was horrified to realize the decade of her life she had built and the son she had were nothing but something made up in her subconscious.

- Became solitary in her grief, spent more and more time studying magic in some vain attempt to figure out how to make Ywain real to no avail, gaining the attention of Archmage Regus and earning her apprenticeship with her dedication.

- After the goldhearted intervention, Regus told her to leave the island before it was destroyed. Forcing her out of solitude.

- Now pursues studies on the Worldhelm, hoping to become a powerful enough mage to honor Regus, and find a way to reunite with her son in a real manifestation.

Name: Rahim
Backstory Bullet Points: A slave living in The Last Hold of the Nezmira Empire and a victim of the Empire's disregard for human life. He was abducted by scholars and was used as a test subject.  In his confinement, he was force-fed Kiir  parts and Kiir blood to figure out its effects on Humans.  During one of the experiments, he manifested mutations which allowed him to escape the facility. He survived but  not unscathed - the experiments resulted in both his body and his mind being damaged resulting to permanent mutations on his body and amnesia.  Deformed and mentally scarred from the experience, he currently roams as an escapee, he seeks to figure out his true identity and the truth about what happened to him. The only thing he knows about himself is what he assumes to be his name written in a band attached to his legs - Rahim which is Ironic as it means Merciful.

Name: Raia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was a normal fox, almost starved until Raia was fed by a figure with wings and a red scarf.
- Founded by Kuzunoha, blessing him to become a kitsune with the ability to create foxfire.
- He trained to use simple weapons, both to hunt for food and to fight in the war against Vanagandr.
- Learned to cook food, and wanted to recreate joy for others.
- Became a shaman after deeply befriending a sacred fox, who later was killed by Sakura.

Name: Rain
Backstory Bullet Points:
- An Orphan from Terra.
- Kidnapped from the slums to undergo a dangerous series of experiments by an illegal group of scientists who were striving to create the ultimate weapon.
- Escaped after a test that introduced a pair synaptic neurolink shields that destroyed the testing area and leading her to escape the decrepit bunker where she was held.
- The shields are an extension of Rain’s body, silently following her and reacting to Rain’s emotions autonomously.
- After arriving in the Worldhelm, she tends to keep to herself. Finding home by the empty warehouses that reside on the ship.

Name: Raine Levia
Backstory Bullet Points:
• A Septid from the slums of Terra who was abandoned by her mother, a higher-up from GaleForce, to avoid a scandal.

• She is noticed by the companies due to her skill in navigating the Soul Network, and was moved to Haven as a part of PARABELLUM to work as a "cyber mercenary" to handle Daemons and other threats.

• She uses her talents against various other black companies and rival hackers, proclaiming herself a guardian of the digital realm she was so closely connected to, beyond the Daemons she had been hired to fight.

• She reaches out toward a storm and wakes up on the Worldhelm, somewhere that is much more pristine than she's ever seen. She becomes an adventurer to bring order and solitude back to the realms, hoping to grow stronger herself.

Name: Rajke Kolev
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born in the deserts of Grestazs
Family wasn't well off, traveled
Parents made up grand tales of the World Heirs
Parents disappeared in a haunted storm
Learned to fight the evils of the deserts
Defended travelers, traders
Pictures himself a hero
Traveled to Wulforh to try to become a successor
Failed, thinks he didnt try hard enough
Continued fighting in desert, disappeared into the Runewall

Name: Rama (राम) Huracupriya
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Shiva Tribe near Second Grave*
- As a newborn, was blessed by the Mitos of Wind
- Spent her teen years following the Shiva Tribe on hunts, using her connection to the winds to fight
- During a solo hunt, got injured and lost her right eye
- Decided to strike out on her own, leaving the safety of her tribe

Name: Ranmaru
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A yokai without human form, at first; an ordinary fox, awakened.
- Unable to participate in conflict, grew doubtful of Kuzunoha's cause; efforts to speak out to those who *could* act proved only to tarnish trust in him.
- Discontent mounted, and he departed to seek guidance from Lorelei's faithful, and perhaps a human form.
- Found sympathy with her followers, and was given his mask, which provides his human form.
- Wandered the material & the Sea of Blizzards thereafter, exercising his newfound power to do as he saw good.

Name: Raphaël
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Melery, Rocade.
- Weak of constitution since childhood, Raphaël found solace in his loving parents and his good friend Sacha.
- Taken on a ten-year pilgrimage to the Longevity Stone at 12 with his parents to find a means of curing his constitution.
- Over the ten years he remained at the Longevity Stone, he dedicated himself to intensive study and ultimately underwent a trial given by the Beacon. He passed, and was gifted a portion of the stone’s magic.
- When he returned, his condition had not been cured, but he gained a passion for healing the sick. 
- His gifts from the Longevity Stone and his Leirsin foresight allow him not only to heal, but to turn the tables on those who inflict harm and suffering, weakening the oppressors with inverted healing magic.
- Now on another pilgrimage with Sacha to the Runewall, aiding the group as both healer and seer.

Name: Rasho Shield of Hearthhome
Backstory Bullet Points:
- An Otterkin of great stature and size! An imposing figure that strikes fear in the heart of evil!

- Claiming Hearthhome and its Kin has as a place that will be protected at all cost

- Protector of the weak! Defender of all who cry out for help!

- The eldest and last surviving pup of his litter when his family was killed in an attack by Wolves

- His mother and father gave their lives to ensure his survival. Staring down a rather large wolf with fur as black as night, two different color eyes and the stench of The Blight

- Upon reaching Hearthhome he is taken in by the military where he began his training and becoming known as The “Dam” for his sturdiness, resolve, and unbreakable will

- He looks to his comrades and within himself for strength. He also believes that The Lion is watching over them.

- While out on a night patrol he was swept up in a Realmstorm

Name: Ray Midnight
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Member of a Travelling Carnival/ Circus/very large extended family
--Midnight Carnival
--"Everyone deserves an Escape"-Family motto
-Was contracted to/Joined 777LC to ensure they could continue what they do
--Gambling, performances, and some shady dealings
-Acted as Barker and Poker dealer for both Midnight Carnival and for some members of the 777LC corp.
-Was selected to run a poker game for a member of 100G Security
--Over the course of the game, he convinced them to give the 777LC a better deal
--Undermining the goals of the 100G Security agent
--This led to him being able to Bind with 777LC
-Continued to work as a deal softener for 777LC
-Eventually returned nearly full-time to Midnight Carnival and became a full-time dealer there
-Inherited his grandfather’s Van, old, but it works well.
-On a trip from the Carnival to a 777LC office, he ends up getting caught in a world storm, ending up on the WorldHelm.
Quirk:
OLD TRANSPORT
Terrestrial Vehicle-Fit up to 6 people, An old van with a fold out tent side and a gambling table an enough space for people to sleep.

Name: Rayla Castia
Age: "22!" (Actually 19, she lied on her job application when she was 17)
Backstory Bullet Points:
*Born on the streets of Fortune's Outer Ring 

*Was raised by older sister 

*Found she had a talent for beating up thugs (Much to her sisters concern)

*Lied about her age to partake in betted street fights around the Outer Ring to make money

*Saved up enough to get her, her sister and her nephew citizenship in the walls of Fortune 

*Works non-stop to procure the money for the three of them 

*Employed as a bouncer at a club but also partakes in the same fighting grounds from time to time to make more money for her family

(Link to backstory)

["You wanna know about me? Sure thing! I'm an open book, ya know?"](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1JMDhHp1BkC9kJaltMOYNMeLl5uEN1xUEZtAuBN6By8Y/edit?usp=sharing)
Sheet Link: ["Hell yeah! Just watch what I can do out there!](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1G3-R3TUn-3d88eceU2joawrkDFpKUU5TXCwxv0AoS_w/edit?gid=0#gid=0)

Name: Reeve Arya
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born in a small town in the Southern Colonies
Abandoned at age 6 by parents and brought up by neighbors
Met childhood friend Klein around age 7-8, drawing him into his band
Leads uneventful life until Klein goes off for medical treatment, where he begins training
Klein returns to their town with new friend Triss in tow
Builds friendship with Triss, but not as strong as his friendship with Klein
Band gets transported to the Worldhelm
(Triss and Klein are characters played by my friends)

Name: Reflection of Summer's Shine
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Emerald Forests of Summer.
- Curious about the world, learning from the creatures and fae there, but something always felt missing.
- Eventually, they came across something new, stepping through it and passing into the Realm of Mortals.
- Immediately set upon by a human hunting party in a strange forest under a strange sky, Reflection of Summer's Shine fled. But this meant something to them. Experience.
- Eventually finding another Crossing, the season had changed. They stepped into Autumn, and another unfamiliar sky.
- Wandering the fields, they found something else. Maybe this will lead to answers.
- They found themselves next to a strange fountain in yet another strange sky. But this felt right.
Quirk:
Outcast Fairy:
Learn Mirror.

Prone to following orders and requests literally.

Name: Reginn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up begging in Hallenrup, as he grew older, to avoid conscription, fled to Wulforh with his best friend.

- Becomes a fence in Myrdel, his friend gets involved with the wrong crowd. One score that could set them for life. A clutch of dragon eggs from Mastrasz. A time. A location. A dangerous group of desperate men gather with a vicious plan.

- They are successful, killing a knight and stealing eggs to sell in other nations. As they're travelling Karsbren, the convoy is attacked by a monstrous moth. Reginn is blasted by the monster's magic while clutching an egg, and falls unconscious.

- He wakes. The convoy is scattered, his best friend nowhere to be seen, the eggs broken. The egg in his arm hatches. Seeing this baby dragon, he is wracked with guilt and chooses to raise it in exile in the blizzards.

- Four years later, a fellow nomad tells him a man who looks like his friend is going to the Runewall. He exits his exile to investigate, and is swept up.

Name: Reino "Archangel" Valerius
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in South Rock, Haven

- Family very quickly fell into debt after bad business deals, discovering the debt was under his name without him knowing

- Was given a deal to enlist with the ETA Elimination Squad. A not publicly known group, ETA Elimination Squad is a group of heavily indebted people who's task consists of 1 thing. Eliminating high threat subjects from other companies who've made a breach of contract, or possible criminal organizations.

- Once he died within the service of ETA Elimination Squad, he had his contract bought out by 100G so that he could be apart of another group, 100G Gate Crasher Squad.

- 100G Gate Crasher Squad is designed to deal with high threat criminals. Their goal to create a highly weaponized group of people who're capable of assessing crimes during combat, as well as passing judgements to said criminals on the field and executing the proper sentence.

Name: Renard Sinclair
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Doesn't really remember when he came to be, but has always enjoyed adding to his collection of baubles and trinkets
- One day, picked up an earring that turned out to be a family heirloom belonging to a high-ranked noble
- Was discovered on him, and he was given the choice between exile from the realm or to be skinned and used for the noble's next coat, he somewhat preferred the former option
- Was stripped of his belongings and booted near the city of Lastport, where after wandering into Karl's Glasswork he tried to pocket one of his potion bottles
- Was caught and made to do work at the Glasswork, where it turned out he had a knack as a merchant
- Offered an apprenticeship, which he was initially offended by until it was explained to him that he could use the money he earned to acquire new treasures
- After some time working there, actually finds living and negotiating with the pitiful, delicate mortals around him strangely fulfilling?

Name: René le Sanctuaire
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Found as a child within the Sanctum of Ashes, taken in by a smaller camp by the People of Ashes on the outskirts

- Often found adventuring into the forest nearby to dance with the Phoenixes, befriended one spirit by the name of Ishara, who was infamous for her more volatile nature. With Cathal, she took on the role of a strict mentor, seeming to take offense to his dancing skills

- Grew up as a capable fighter and leader, often fighting off the wild elemental spirits or wayward travelers. Though as time continued, he grew to worry about the state of the world.

- When the assault on Rocade started, Cathal was horrified at the destruction wrought. Other heroes were the ones to help the Phoenixes, showing mercy and compassion to aid the spirits. Humbled and disheartened, Cathal fled from the people he called family. As he fled, he was joined by Ishara, who carried with her an artifact from the Sanctum that had often fascinated the dancer as a child

Name: Requiem
Backstory Bullet Points:
* One of the Gilded, Requiem is ageless and has spent so much time in the forms of stringed instruments that it barely conceives of being anything else; some might have thought it cursed, but it has come to simply prefer life as a stringed instrument.
* Since being "freed," Requiem is glad but still not entirely thrilled about it. It feels lost and aimless but would never admit this, excepting through melody.
* Requiem seeks a worthy musician, hero, warrior, and/or luxurious setting like it preferred in the Worthworks ages ago before its master Coia went insane.
* Concerned that bipedal things regularly go mad and very wary about this, including time it spends. Its "Abandonment" theme is about IT abandoning OTHERS.
* Has long since communicated through telepathy, and generally tries to make others think that the voice in their head is their own or a "Narrator," until cornered.
* Also attempts to make others forget it.

Name: Retti
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in the Faerie Realm in the Fae Domain of Pryn.
- Always wanted to be a knight, protecting people from injustice and peril, but never quite had the skills to bring it to fruition. His magic was weak and needed crystal catalysts and foci to help, and his skills with sword and bow were lacking.
- Spent years training under other fairy knights, but slipped through a Fae Crossing into Tradefair, Kor'Tarion. Retti took it in his stride, helping people against injustices and evils with chivalry aplomb, although it was no easy task and many hard lessons were learned.
- Years later, Retti considers Tradefair his home away from home. He continues to work to become his ideal knight, at which point he shall return to his Fae Domain and take the trial of knightship.

Name: Reynaud Girardin
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born to hardworking and humble parents.
-Yearned to see more of the world.
-Left at 18 and tried lots of jobs, failed at all of them. Gave up on them quickly. 
-Tried being a mercenary, was bad at fighting. Titled himself as a The Snow Covered Swashbuckler as a cover up, wrote a poem about it.
-Tried being a thief, could not pick locks. Titled himself the Brilliant Bastard as a cover up, wrote a poem about it.
-Tried being a bard, cannot sing. Titled himself The Steel Poet as a cover up, wrote a poem about it.
-Tried being a sailor, was okay at that. Got bored after the first voyage and titled himself The Mistcutter as a cover up. Wrote a poem about it.
-Now is an adventurer and calls himself the Wandering Comet. Has a poem about that as well.

The poems are all hyperbolic. They are also written. Will provide them on request.
Other Names: The Snow-Covered Swashbuckler, The Brilliant Bastard, The Steel Poet, The Mistcutter, The Wandering Comet, Reinosuke the Wise

Name: Rhea Hart
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Grew up in a low income family in North Rock, Central Terra

-Parents were musicians, lived and breathed music and tech

-When she got older her music got darker and more angry reflecting the inequality in the world

-She protested and wrote political songs as she screamed into the night

-One day while headed out to a gig in an old abandoned motel in Liberty Dessert she got caught up in a Realmstorm and transported to Worldhelm

Name: Rhys Caldrith
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Stratford, gifted with uncanny wisdom, sharpened through study in Silverdale’s archives and something less tangible.

- Guided his family’s pearl-diving, leading them to small fortunes beneath the waves.

- Lost his elder brother Aelric to a leviathan despite his warnings.

- Grief left crystalline marks upon his skin, sign of a deeper calling.

- Summoned by the Beacon of Wisdom and named a Successor of the Stone.

- Traveled distant shores, peaks, and ruins to seek greater knowledge.

- Formed a lasting bond—and occasional rivalry—with fellow disciple Galavan.

- Now called to the Runewall, where peril and discovery await.

Name: Rika Carpenter
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Rika was born to a squalid Mother and older Sister in Hidela, He met the right man, on the right night, who encouraged him to do so. A moment of doubt, that Merrane used to bring him in. 
- He sent money regularly back to his Mother and Sister, who lived much better lives as a result. They were able to move to a better neighborhood, and that made him happy.
- During an operation two years ago, Rika learned harrowing news. Insurgents in A-Sec were hiding out in a neighborhood not far from his family home. In the end, it went wrong, as he'd feared, and both loved ones were lost as casualties.
- In the event, he dissented, and was promptly arrested and taken to Heavens' Gate. Unbeknownst to him, during this time, an experimental drug was laced into his food and drink. "Reactive Adrenaline-Genetic Enhancement", or RAGE. He had the right build, and the right mental state. 
- (Pretty sure Miguel plans to introduce me in a game so no 'how did I get to the Worldhelm?' bullet point.

Name: Riley Knight
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Riley grew up without a mother and memories of a father who didn't deserve the title. 

- When she was 13, her father died due to a job as an assassin. This was a positive for Riley as her sister took over as her guardian and pushed for her education.

- Riley discovered that she had an innate skill in the soul network that she ingrained into herself, even at the detriment of herself, as the soul network was unstable.

- Was prepared to follow her sister into the crime part of Terra, learning more backhanded skills before she was reprimanded and pulled away from it by said sister.

- Became the more educated between her sister and later...adopted brother? She took this privilege and did well with it, learning to become a soulrunner for a small subsidiary of Qilink, AEC Network.

- Realmstorm picked her up with her two siblings.

Name: Rin
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born in Murata, and forced to leave at a young age
-Kitsune attempted to corrupt Rin with corrupt heavenly cultivation teachings
-Started using the teaching but is countering it with their own demonic cultivation
-Forced to leave Murata after villagers found Rin with his body cultivation. Making Rin seem like a monster

Name: Rina Kusanagi
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and raised in Silver Rock.

- Employee of QiLink in the cybersecurity department.

- Has an aptitude for analysing data and security logs.

- Has a side-gig where she repairs tech, and recovers/destroys data with very little to no questions asked.

- Installed an aftermarket patch to her ocular implants to unlock advanced features for free and to prevent third party access. Overusing the advanced features gives her severe side effects from migraines to seizures. (Fugitive Experiment quirk) 

- Duct tapes her webcam.

- Wants to buy a red motorcycle.

- Occasional cosplayer.

- Stumbled into a Realmstorm while dumpster diving for electronic waste.

Name: Risata
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Risata grew up in an orphanage in Providencia, when she turned 18 she was appointed by a councilman to take over as the matron due to the previous one passing. 
- After 30 years, an incident happens that causes several children to die/become kidnapped. Her failure to protect the children causes the councilman to revoke her position. 
- Risata joins the exorcists to try and do good in the world/gain power to protect people.
- After 11 years they discover an ancient evil, she seals part of it in her, but fails. Mahuizoh and her are the only survivors.
- After 9 years on the road, she learns how to keep her magic stable at the cost of all those years of training in magic. She's back at square one for the third time now.

Name: Robbins
Robin
Age: 25 [in Apprearance] over a thousand due to Idyll
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Arrived in the Ring of Barza after dying for the Goldhearted
- Roamed the Realm until they Reached Nirve
- Spent their entire time there for the rest of his life
- Kept a Diary of his past life while in Nirve
- Has watched the corruption of Idyll
- Fought for the people until he was betrayed by some citizens of Nirve
- Retires from fighting spending most of his time just being lazy and not doing much

Name: Rococo
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From teh porcupine tibe and travels the world both in the physical world and the Rootway
- Home in the Grand Repository was destoryed in recent Wolfkin raids
- Consequentially, goes from place to place; never staying too long, but enough to improve the lives of local Kinfolk and does his best to uphold the Hedghog's code
- A great focus of his is emotional stability, prioritizing mental stability (or lack thereof) who he meets
- While not attuned to older traditions, his spikes have a natural coating that pierces the spirit

Quirk: Old Transport - Hedge Homestead
- Magical fauna that has congregated into a small home, walking on long plant-like legs. Provides refuge to Rococo, magically records all past travels, and means of travel for the Rootway and beyond. During the Blighted Tragedy (Caravan travelling to Kiln from Hand of Omoth), Scylla, a good foxkin friend, had passed and Rococo has been using it and carrying her memory ever since.

Name: Roland Pearce
Backstory Bullet Points:
• A child left at Hearthbright Orphanage, a Brightshield based orphanage known for training children to become professional servants should they not become adopted.
• Was taught how to cook, clean, garden, and even some basic hand-to-hand self defense.
• A request was made for a servant, from a wealthy out of town mage. The price was too significant for the orphanage to ignore.
• Others at the age of 'servant in training' rather than orphan were wary.
• Roland opted to volunteer. Though the mage immediately traded him in to a family of elves.
• On top of the normal duties expected of a butler, he was subject to magical experiments.
• He did not protest, and while the family didn't find the results they hoped for, Roland's biology became adaptable, he was able to summon the flowers he gardened and sprout wings of the bees he cared for.
• Furious with his incompatibility, the family fired him. On his way back home, he was caught in a realmstorm.

Name: Ronan Ashwynd
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Black sheep of the Monster Hunting House Ashwynd. 

* Born of a forbidden love between his father and what's understood to be a Fey. 

* His mother is an Arcana of Kor'tarion (made this concept initially with Incog on creation.) Ronan does not know this.

* Was banished as a teenager to the wilds of Kor'tarion and that's where he learned to survive alone. Continuing to hunt the dangerous and dark creatures that go bump in the night.
Quirk:
Heirloom: 'Dread Tamer'

The chains he wields are a manifestation of his Fae heritage, transforming what was once a simple Ashwynd Clan whip into a weapon infused with dark, otherworldly power. They serve as a devastating tool in combat, channeling the darkness within to annihilate those who revel in such forces. 

Drawbacks: The chains are unpredictable, reacting to his half-Fae blood at the most inopportune moments. Particularly when his heart races. Worse still, they are a glaring symbol of his dual identity, immediately marking him as both an Ashwynd and a half-blood, effectively painting a target on his back.

Name: Rongshi Hui
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and Raised in Xiexie village
- Grew up with a natural talent with cultivation, and an Affinity for Shadow Qi.
- Would occasionally adventure beyond the village
- On one such occasion, got placed in a Life-or-Death situation
- Took in large amounts of the ambient Death Qi to survive, at great personal cost
- Now, he looks to find a way to prevent the inevitable death that seems to be creeping throughout his body.

Name: Rook
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born kind and altruistic, always willing to offer help and support to those in need.

Inspire to become an adventurer due to the events of The Night of the Red Sky.

Took up using twin shields in combat to maximize his ability to protect others, as well as to leverage his great strength.

Rook traveled a great deal assisting adventuring bands to better round out their numbers and provide a dedicated defensive front, before moving to the next band, trying to help as many people as he could.

Ever since he started adventuring, Rook has belived that his role in the party was to attract the danger, the monsters, the traps, the spells, all to make it more likely for everyone else to survive, and if one day that would mean laying down his life for others, then he would accept it.

Name: Rory Messalina
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in a decent enough neighbourhood, but with neglectful parents, too focused on work, on their careers, that they left their pretty young kid alone.

- Started wandering the streets, skipping school, stealing food and other small things, always hungry, always afraid

- Got an offer from Famine of the Horsemen, take his hand and never be hungry again. She takes it.

- Becomes part of his crew, and eventually when older one of his 'lieutenants'

- Makes an effort to help other kids in similar boats to herself and dreams of opening up a place for them one day.

- Meanwhile Famine is missing and she needs to find him.

Name: Rose Meiki’tari Albertus
Backstory Bullet Points:
- The Ki’tari tribe of Kor’Tarion once worked with humans to prevent the moon from falling, but failed.

- They persisted through Naiki’tari, who carried with him a grimoire filled with the remnants of the wills of the tribe.

- Through his own story, Nai found a partner in Zophiel, and together they would eventually confront Zophiel’s Father.

- As the soul of Zophiel’s Father was fading, Nai asked of the grimoire for his story.

- The remnants of the tribe merged with the fading spirit, and became a girl. They became Rose Mei.

- Although the girl doesn’t have the memories of those she was made from, she’s inherited their will, and their love of magic, and she’s ready to step out into the realms, to carry on her parents legacy.

Name: Rowan Vale
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Veyrhold, Rowan Vale survived the brutal murder of their parents as a child, an event they have completely repressed. In the aftermath they were placed in a crowded city orphanage, unaware that the trauma of that night triggered their Thinning, leaving them subconsciously attuned to The Black.

- Growing up among the dense population of Veyrhold, Rowan struggled with overwhelming emotional noise from others, slowly realizing they could perceive emotional residue, lies, and violence in ways no normal person could.

- Their abilities drew the attention of the SIA after they unknowingly helped lead authorities to a murder scene by following the emotional afterimage left behind.

- Recognized as an Empath, Rowan was recruited and put through the full education, psychological conditioning, and operational training required to become a field agent of the DSE while simultaneously monitored by researchers from the DMI due to their unusual connection to The Black.

Name: Royce Blackwood
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Royce Blackwood was a young face on the docks of Lastport who learned many of her skills to survive and thrive.
- While trying to rob one of the docked ships, she was caught.
- Rather than suffering any punishment, Royce was given the chance instead to join the ship that was named the Red Otters.
- During a terrible storm, Royce fell overboard and nearly drowned before reaching out and making a deal with a demon out of desperation.
- The effects of her deal have left her mark with visual effects, a supernatural bloodlust, and the ability to call on the demon’s power.
- Upon returning to the crew and a member leaving, she was caught in a realm storm.
Quirk: Cursed: Royce has obvious affects from making a deal with aa demon, the nature of the demon having left its mark on her physically and mentally.

Name: Ruby Rivers
Age:
Unknown
(Biologically 25+ but there's been some accelerated aging; she's not a test-tube baby but she was absolutely placed in one of those green goopy tubes at one point)
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Created as a biological weapon for the war effort - a soldier that's grown rather than trained, capable of infinite adaptation. Apparently was also used as an attempt to recreate the powers of the Arcana.
* Crafted by DNA recombination and grafting of assorted creatures, including a human child as a base. Ruby has no memories of them.
* As far as she's aware, she's the only "successful" result of this project.
* Proved to be VERY brutally efficient and effective in combat testing.
* Swiftly broke free of control and broke out, slaughtering many in her path.
* Got yoinked by the Worldhelm, presumably in an attempt to redirect this force towards good.
Relevant Arcana:
Artificial Neruo-Grafted Energy Reactor (attempted Nimue replacement)
Yubel

Name: Rulekeeper
Age: Older than 20 but hard to determine now
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was a human student pulled into the fey wilds

- Nearly was consumed by the gloom but saved by the Rulemaker

- Gave up all his human aspects and was reborn as a fae in service to Equinox

Name: Runihura
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A captured slave in Nezmira, brought to the City of Scales to serve the Alaoui family.
- During the destruction and decay left by Akhir/Vanagandr within the Alaoui family due J'yuto's ritual, the death god rampaged through the palace before reaching Runihura.
- The slave walked towards the god of death, out of pure curiousity to see what could be their unmaker, Akhir was interested in this young slave sensing potential as a vessel of his as thus he was bound to him.
- Using the decay and chaos, he escaped the City of Scales, moving from city to city until they got swept up in a realmstorm.

Name: Russo Abetti
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to parents both who worked within QiLink, both parents killed during a "hostile takeover" when they were younger.
- Adopted by the company, raised and joined QiLink's Paramilitary as one of their mech pilots.
- Piloting a full dive suit mech after undergoing extensive surgery to perform within a mech called "The Dauntless" the runs on QiLink state of the art technology. 
- Works under the AEGIS branch of QiLink, their handler being Tiberius Crowne. 
- Has built up loyalty to Tiberius Crown & QiLink, more so Tiberius due to the shadier aspects of the company.
- Also performs in Pulsefire/Mech combat during his free time as he simply enjoys mech piloting both leisurely & workwise.

Name: STATIC OOZE
Backstory Bullet Points:
(Maiko) geisha in training under a palace geisha in Teisei

Duel cultivation

Teisei fell he became a slave.

A proud geisha who's only real intelligence is that, a himbo in most aspects

Name: SUN BEAR
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in Morike, daughter of a sex worker, part of the Kikugumi, a network of sorts of pleasure districts and bathhouses all over Nishibi.

- At 14 she helped a young woman who wanted out of a marriage to a semmi notable samurai, gaining the favour of a smaller kami Chimata, but gaining the samurais ire, and was sent to Ishihara.

- In Ishihara she was trained to be part of the Ikugumi private protection force and has spent the last few years stationed there, every so often travelling to other cities as escort.

Name: Sable
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Fallen Ixitali:
Sable is a female Ixitali who fell from Samsara, her celestial home, and became stranded in Nezmira.

- Ritual of Wind:
In an effort to regain the momentum needed to fly back to Samsara, Sable created a powerful ritual of wind. This ritual disrupted the ecosystem and magic in the area, causing turmoil for the people living there.

- Goldhearted Transformation:
The Goldhearted discovered Sable and convinced her to stop the ritual for the greater good, becoming Goldhearted herself.

Name: Sacha Astier
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and raised in Melery alongside childhood friend Raphaël
- Was protective of Raph due to his chronic condition
- Stayed behind when Raph left for the Longevity stone, but stayed in correspondance
- Trained to commune with the Rocadian forest spirits, as well as in their primal magic, never once stepping outside his hometown
- Grows to be dependable, but always finds himself wondering about the world on the other side of the fence
- 10 years after leaving, Raph returns with news of the other kingdoms, and of the expedition to the Runewall
- Leaves Melery and accompanies Raph to the expedition, seeking to reconnect with his friend, as well as to discover why the spirits of his homeland have gone quiet.

Name: Saga
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Saga was written through several generations of sages that lived in isolation in the Hollow Mountains trying to document the history of Aldistir
- The last sage that wrote her suddenly disappeared without warning.
- Many decades past since the last sage, many parts of the book ruined with time and Aldistir's weather including her title and the names of the authors past. 
- Eventually, a follower of Kuzunoha had come across the book and brought it to them out of curiousity, and thus Saga was created upon being given their blessing - taking the partial form of one of the authors that wrote her.

Name: Sama Shihitsugi
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Parents died when he was a baby so he was raised by his grandfather. 
- His grandfather was a respected figure in an organized crime family. 
- As he grew Sama began to develop magics within his voice that allowed him to subdue and harm people without actually laying a hand on them. 
- Because this would leave very little to evidence behind he was quickly put into an enforcer position for the family. 
- While the family does deal with crime they also focus on trying to keep random street violence and more dangerous substances off the streets in their territory. 
- Between his skills and the family's teachings Sama makes it a point to keep things like gang violence and drugs off the streets. Being a bit more strict about such things personally than the family does.
- While wandering the streets during a storm enjoying the rain he gets wrapped up in a Realmstorm and finds himself on the Worldhelm.

Name: Samir Zaid Jabari Castiel III
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Ormen
- Learned fencing from his late father who was killed by bandits and dancing from his late mother who was caught up in one of many calamities.
- Was saved from bandits by Sir Fredrick Valdera of Markensburg
- Raised as part of the Valdera family and became their attendant
- Helped raise The Valdera twins and taught them just as his parent taught him
- Through mysterious means the twins went missing in the middle of the night
- Gathering a small group of Bodyguards he set out in search of them following leads that lead him back to his old home of Ormen
- Rumors of them being taken South towards the Runewall
- Samir without hesitation walks into the Runewall

Name: Sara Langely
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in a small frontier town called Blackwood
* Lived with her mother, Tasha Langley, a miller, and her father, Jeffrey Langely, a sheriff.
* Learned to shoot from her father. He also taught her the importance of Law and Justice.
* When she was 14, the town was attacked by bandits. Her father died trying to protect them.
* Her mother was able to get Sara out of the city before it burned to the ground. They traveled until they reached Jamestown, 
* Her mother remarried a year after they arrived. Sara's Stepfather was an asshole and treated her like shit.
* As it turned out, he was involved in a smuggling operation, which was discovered by Three Star Sheriff Miley Janeway. 
* She asks to join the Sheriffs on the spot.
* For 5 years, she trained, and eventually she earned her first star.
* Was traveling to investigate a frontier town when she was snatched by a realmstorm.

Name: Sarah of Lances
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up amongst a wealthy family in suntower. Was sponsored by the House of Lances and attended the White Wing academy to train to become a Merrani angel

- At the academy she was put in charge of a squad of seven others. As she worked with them they grew attached to each other acting like a family.

- During a field mission she led her team straight into an ambush. Her mech getting critically damaged and getting severely injured as her cockit was set ablaze. Before her entire squad could be massacred a regiment of People's Guard managed to save them.

- Due to the severity of her injuries she was discharged from White Wing Academy, being separated from the remaining survivors of her Squad. She would remain in the city of Caldera ashamed to return to her home.

- In the wake of the end of the cease fire she is called back to her duties. Being offered to undergo an experimental implant that would allow her to link to a mech. Eager to get away from the monotony she agreed.
Quirk:
Fugitive Experiment

When a rule or ability requires you to spend 100 or fewer Hit Points, Mind Points, or Inventory Points, you may suffer 1d8 Instability Points to ignore that cost.

At the end of each session (approximately four hours of play), you lose 1d6 Instability Points (to a minimum of zero).
If your Instability Points ever reach 10 or more, you are immediately reduced to 0 Hit Points and Surrender. The consequences of this Surrender should be tied to you losing control of your abilities. Then, you lose all Instability Points.

Name: Saricola
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Orphaned at birth
- Taken in by Martial Artist
- Trained whole life under him, raised by him and his wife, they became adopted Parents. 
- Grew up in Dojo, set to inherit martial art and dojo
- Master/Father and Mother were taken by violent gang

Name: Saroja Narayan
Backstory Bullet Points:
- She was born in one of the few scattered villages in the Viper Gardens, where she was surrounded by death but knew freedom from the Maharaja.
- Became in tune to the world around her and began changing to reflect her Pakriti.
- Lost her parents to the Garden as they would have originally walked endlessly together rather than maybe facing the unknown apart. 
- After being a Goldhearted, She lost a piece of her Purusa to help a woman and lost her reflection to her Pakriti.
Quirk:
Originally Arboreal; Lost in game
Ruinbringer; Given in game

Name: Sasuke Sojizaki
Backstory Bullet Points:
- An orphan from North Rock and sibling of Kazuhiko Sojizaki
 -Used to be a professional gambler who made money at various Casinos in North Rock by cheating
- Took out a loan from End Times Acquisitions to fund his gambling
- Lost all of his money at a high stakes poker tournament in a casino 
- The final poker game was against someone known as the "Hammerhead of Haven" (real name unknown) - a powerful former gang member known for his immense strength and honor
- After it was found out Sasuke was cheating he was gunned down by agents of the casino during the attempted escape and became an insolvent

Name: Scarlet Alba
Backstory Bullet Points:
"They broke me, but they made a mistake... They made my body my weapon..."

- An escaped experiment from the labs of Secura, of which she does not know who owned it, nor does she care.
- Drained of all colour; she is simply monotone white now, but adorns her body with some red.
- All of her abilities revolve around her innate ability to use her body as a weapon.
- Dazed, lost, and somewhat still re-learning what she lost, but is not angry or aggressive; simply confused.
- Seeks to find friends who can teach her about the world, and what it truly is.
- Mental scars still remain, and she refuses to be in chains again.
- Having been in the city of Secura for several months following her liberation, she found herself onboard the Worldhelm; somewhere she could understand more than simply what lay behind her and begin to focus on what lay ahead.

Name: Selene
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Lived on the fourth floor of the Pavilion.
- Snuck around when younger to attempt to watch the Deliverers work to keep the Gilded of the floor safe.
- Being one of the few Gilded of the floor capable of fighting eventually approached the Deliverers to let her work with them when needed when she became old enough.
- Due to being of the few capable of fighting, did develop a habit of seeming insulted if not proactively picked as a weapon.
- Spent years working along side the the Deliverers to keep the other Gilded of the floor safe.
- Once released into Heaven from The Pavilion decided to join up with the Goldhearted to keep working to help people.
- Taking what she learned from the Deliverers, who helped shaped what she seeks in an ideal wielder, she closely evaluates individuals to eventually find that individual.

Name: Selene Harte
Backstory Bullet Points:
* One of her parents were Septid — the dominant gene taking over in development
* Abandoned at a young age by her parents, forced to live in her own in the ghettos 
* Later in her life, she was captured and experimented on through both magical and scientific means by unnamed individuals 
* Experimentation was a partial success — having been stopped by law enforcement before it could be completed
* Forced back into the street, she carried a latent mutation that could trigger at any time with little to no warning
* PARABELLUM was alerted to the walking hazard
* Instead of having to deal with trying to cover up the murder of a civilian, they developed a temporary solution in the form of limiters while they figure out a more permanent solution 
* Limiters are experimental — they’ll prevent any accidental triggering of mutations, but cannot stop intentional transformations
* Confused and scared, she ran as far as she could without a direction in mind, avoiding as many people as possible

Name: Sella Askelson
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Parents are nomads
* While traveling parents killed by draugr in Kald Forest
* Sella saved by passerby warrior, taken to Camp von Kibo
* grow up in Camp von Kibo, train to become warrior and protect the weak
* in nearby small settlement distributing supplies when kitsune raid
* Sella attacc, Sella protecc
* barely kills big kitsune
* Nimue blesses Sella with wings and light powers
* gets kidnapped by a prism snowstorm

Name: Selvaria Lightheart
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Known healer of Camp Bon Kibo.
- Blessed by Kuzunoha into becoming an Oni to help both Yokai and Humanity, wanting more time to help both races as she believed being a human she could only do so much in a human lifetime.
- Holds no grudge to either side and only wish to aid those who are in pain.
- Comes from a long family of healers, being a beacon for many.
- After coming to the Worldhelm, she strives to extend her helping hand to everyone who calls it home and to the worlds she has yet to set foot upon.

Name: Seraphina
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born into slavery from a human mother who was a slave and a Nezzim man who was her father, she wasn’t a wanted child but was still loved and cared for by her mother.
- Began to cultivate her hatred towards the Nezzim after seeing her ‘father’ order a slaver to kill her mother who tried to stop her ‘father’ from selling Sera away due to her being a mage, she tried to flee by was ultimately caught - costing her wings to be torn from her back.
- Was sold as a ‘slave with a pretty face’ to a business that used slaves as porters.
- Vowed to burn ‘the pride and joy of the Nezzim’ after suffering the indignity of being a slave to the Nezzim for so many years.
- After arriving at the Worldhelm, Seraphina would separate herself from many of the souls onboard - holding a facade of a smile to paint a joyful appearance and to push many away from understanding who she really is and the weight she carries.

Name: Shaw Jaeger
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Grandson of Sophia Jaeger
-Middle child of Sophia’s son Jacob
–Works in the Metalurgy side of the family buisness
-Was being groomed by the family to become a face for the family Philanthropy work
-After a Fundraiser event Shaw was kidnapped by a rouge cell of SIA scientists
-Shaw was experimented on for 6 months, He was injected and fused with material from The Black and other creatures.
-Was eventually rescued by SIA agents, though the damage was done
–Most of the Rouges got away,
-After being recovered, Shaw joined the SIA
–Works to control the new abilities he has
–Taught to channel his new condition to create radiant energy
-Given training as PI for his Cover, Shaw works for the DSC.
-He has two rings, one with a family crest and the other a snake

Name: Sheetal
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born and raised within Prince Kashika and Suniti's domain to a single refugee mother.

-Identifies more with her demonic peers than her human heritage, viewing herself fully and completely as a demon serving under Prince Kashika. (much to her mothers chagrin) A viewpoint somewhat justified by her celestial attunement manifesting as a child.

-Out of gratitude for the safety and succor provided to her and her mother, Sheetal has taken a position in guiding and protecting refugees from elsewhere in Bahata Khajaana, training intensely.

-She held idyllic dreams of freeing the oppressed and overthrowing the vile, but over a decade of fighting to scrape out the tiniest of victories amid a sea of losses has crushed her spirit (or so she likes to tell herself, to make the failures more bearable).
