-Awakened as a Goldhearted during a mission gone wrong, in which a refugee was bribed with a better life to rat out on her peers, leading to the deaths of several of Sheetal's comrades.
Other Names:
Sheetal the Hornless (on account of her antlers instead of the more traditional demon horns.)

"Scowling Shee" (only her mom gets to call her that)

Name: Shenn
Backstory Bullet Points:
Shenn, a Half Yokai born in Xuanwu city, was birthed merely to slave away in the blood mines

Witnessing the corrupt cultivation and exploitation, he stood for what he believed was right, regardless of the insurmountable opposition against him and was easily swatted away and crushed in a mere moment of hesitation, yet spared due to the cultivators amusement at his foolish, yet spirited claims, ideology, and sense of self for being duch an insignificant insect, deciding to instead exile the man and send him off to be murdered by wandering spirit beasts or cultivators, and enjoy watching their struggle 

In that moment of defeat and despair, he vowed to protect the common man without faltering, becoming both blessed and cursed by the gods

Soon into his exile, he found a cultivator with great strength, yet utterly insane ideals, that took Shenn in, traveling with him until they finished their training and journey at Matara town, where Shenn became a farmer and adoptive brother and son.

Name: Shepherd Harrison
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Born in a wealthy family in Haven learning the family trade of extorting the desperate which lead to them having enemies.

• When Edward Baylore died their investments and connections broke down until they were left with nothing. After being unable to afford their lifestyle they had to leave Haven entirely after signing a contract with ETA that would keep them afloat until they were able to get into proper business again.

• They didn’t manage to make it to their new home before they had a fatal car “accident” caused by one of his families enemies. It was a miracle he managed to survive the crash but it left him in critical condition. He managed to pull through for a day as his parent’s lawyers transferred the debts to him. He died soon after in the hospital.

• After becoming an insolvent he spent the next 19 years working for ETA before landing a position as a marketer. Using his connections he was able to get a NTT license alongside an experimental V-GEN-R neural chip.

Name: Sheriff
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Depressed Corporate Drone in Terra
- Managed to make it through life thanks to friends and wife
- Loves old cinema, collects western accoutrements
- Friends suddenly start falling to insolvency
- Still have wife, can still make it
- Wife disappears one day after "corporate restructuring"
- That's the last damn straw
- One stormy night, with a six-shooter in hand, he rides out to enact justice
- Justice looks a lot like a shootout at his building
- Windows shatter, tensions rise, and the Realmstorm sweeps him away just as he has his manager at gunpoint

Name: Shibana
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Fierce battle between ald and yokai in the Feywyrd during the War of Fox and Hound, spilling blood between both sides
- The essence of the fallen nurtured Shibana as they grew, sustaining their rosebush
- Due to this, Shibana develops with a magical affinity for life, death and dreams, and bears vague memories of the fallen
- Separating themselves from home, Shibana travels Aldistir seeking to reconcile present-day bitterness and ensure a peaceful future
- Finds likeminded folk in Camp von Kubo, particularly an ald friend named Blom, before being swallowed up by a realmstorm

Name: Shing
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born to a nomadic tribe
* Travelled with them much of his youth though harbored dreams of something more
* Often left in charge of the village children who he would entertain by playing pranks o the adults.
* As he grew older his troublemaking wore on his fellow villagers and he found himself disciplined often
* Eventually much to the dismay of the children, Shing was banished
* Nearly dying on his own in such a dangerous forest and ready to chalk it up to punishment for his hubris Shing found himself whisked away to the Worldhelm
Quirk: Boon of Felicitous Mischief/ Curse of Heavenly Emnity

Name: Shirudo Utagi
Backstory Bullet Points:
*Grew up in House of Purity in The Subrealm of Teisei in Tian Yin
*Trained in the art of Cultivation there.
*Qi is Lightning
*Suspects his Dao is the Shield, but is struggling with this concept.
*He is riddled with self-doubt that he can live up to his calling.
*Channels his Qi into protective poses, counter attacks, and restorative energy.
*Bond is his childhood friend: Aru, a half-kitsune that is free-spirited and brave.
Birth Realm: Subrealm of Teisei in Tian Yin

Name: Shu Meilin [舒美琳]
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Xuanwu City

- Was apart of the Great Tree Sect, a traditional cultivation sect with little to no power

- Eventually was crushed by the Burning Pyre Sect, a group of corrupt cultivators within Xuanwu City

- Was forced to join the Burning Pyre Sect, though her mentor from her previous sect joined with her as well. Making a deal with the leader that if he practiced corrupt cultivation, he would leave her alone

- Naturally gifted with Wood Qi but practiced Fire Qi. Specializing in Smoke Qi

- Her mentor procured a cultivation manual from before the shattering that held insights into the Dao of Death

- Eventually the sect wanted to force Shu Meilin to practice corrupt cultivation, her mentor held them off while she ran to hide.

- The night after being forced to leave her mentor, the true power of the book revealed itself. Flooding her mind with knowledge of cultivators who died during the shattering, and letting her see past the mortal bounds for but a moment
Birth Realm: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo - Xuanwu City

Name: Shēnruì' Er Xián (申瑞儿咸 )
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born a Fire Qi prodigy in Xuanwu City, was relentlessly trained from childhood, treated as a resource rather than a son, and denied the freedom his older brother enjoyed.

- The pressure and loss of a normal life burned him out; he deliberately stopped cultivating and vanished without warning, abandoning sect expectations and family ambition.

- For five years he roamed both the abandoned districts of Xuanwu’s city and its outskirts, surviving through theft, brawls, courier work, and constant motion, using his Fire Qi only in brief, reckless bursts to avoid notice.

- During his travels, he learned to read people, escape danger, and observe the rot of corrupt cultivation, pretending not to care while remembering everything, until a near-death encounter made him realize returning home was the only safe choice.

- He returned disheveled and penniless, dismissed as wasted talent, now working in his family’s restaurant as an aloof, laughing slacker.
Birth Realm: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Xuanwu City

Name: Shī kuǐlěi & Stagehand
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Left on the doorstep of a theater in Xuanwu City and adopted by the leader
* Grew up under his training and developed a talent for crafting props and puppets
* Always living behind the stage looking out caused her to become awkward but fond of her audience
* Surrounded by performers, some being cultivators themselves, she was trained in her off time to try and judge her talent, revealing a connection to Earth Qi which she used to breath new life into her shows
* Began noticing audiences shrinking as the world outside grows harsher and people had less time/desire for entertainment
* Deciding the world needed heroes outside of storybooks she crafted her finest puppet ever Shī kuǐlěi
* Despite her fear of the world outside the backstage, she took her puppet forth and began protecting people
* Letting the fiction of the character get to her head she threw herself into an impossible fight  but was saved on the brink of death by Yubel plucking her to the Worldhelm

Name: Sienna
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Hometown is Brightshield
-Went to study in Hudal Academy.
-Some issues led to her facing financial and academic difficulties. She failed the very last paper she took there before dropping out.
-She is still very bitter and demoralised by the academic failures.
-Worked various odd jobs before stumbling into the Worldheim.

Name: Sienna "Sweety" Gordon
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Allowed to work in dock security thanks to her father's security.
- Is a night owl due to working night shifts.
- Wears her father's old oversized jacket due to not having one her size.
- Nicknamed "Sweety" by her colleagues due to her short stature and sugary smell.
- Hasn't needed to use her service pistol, but has trained regularly with it in a scrapyard.
- After a life-altering encounter with a daemon, she has developed an irrational fear of digital screens.

Name: Sienna Von Nausicaa
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born into a political family in Caldera, youngest of three sisters, Hazel Von Nausicaa.
- Joins Korala academy for weapons research with her family pulling some strings.
- Caught in a terrorist bombing attributed to the KPLA. Lost much of her torso in a wound that should have been mortal.
- Saved by her middle sister using remnants of a Colossus in a graft procedure. Her body has begun to reject the foreign parts, however. [Long Dream]
- The oldest sister performs a weapons test that causes dozens of civilian casualties and goes public.
- She uses magic to transfigure herself into her sister’s form, and her sister into hers, so that she can take the punishment on her sister’s behalf.
- She is arrested as Sienna Von Nausicaa, a pariah and terrorist responsible for the deaths of dozens of civilians, and placed into Heaven's Gate.

Name: Sierra
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Initially found as a baby by a Fae and spent most of her time in the forest hunting small prey and berries for food.
- She met a hunter who happened to hunt larger prey, which caught her attention and ended up being the hunter's apprentice so she can hunt for larger prey. 
- She grew fond of the local avian species she had no idea some of them are endangered while unknowingly protected them from the very predators she hunted or poachers, accidentally catching Banshee's favor.
- She is indeed a fae-touched due to her prior contact with a fae. 
- At some point she began to hunt during storms on places where both prey and poachers would likely hide in. 
- On one of those instances, she entered a peculiar storm which happened to be a realmstorm before getting sucked in and finding herself in the Worldhelm.

Name: Silas Oristal
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born of the Kigyo Tribe of Myist, within the heart of the Rotfall Expanse. It was there he was trained to scavenger, and made use of anything he could get his hands on.

- His curiosity and knowledge led him to constantly be in the right place at the right time. His continuous support to the Kigyo involved him leading scouts and scavengers to battlefields of recent conflicts. A wealth of bones and bodies laid about--a perfect bounty of Shedskins to be made. Not only that, but he had discovered there was more than meets the eye for the residue left behind by lycanthropic reversion. What is considered waste could be used for such more, including rituals used in the tribe.

- His service and discovery had earned him the respect of the Coil-Reader and also the permission to undergo a trial to awaken his Alpha Potential. He was left alone for two weeks, a whole cycle to discovery more about the "treasures" left behind by werewolves as they had formed back to their human selves.

Name: Silida
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born in the Blue City
Practiced magic of ink and time
Came across a strange book of stories
Left the city to pursue deeper, more hidden knowledge
Sought to find truth

Name: Simone Katsav
Backstory Bullet Points:
- She has a family, and they run a butchery in the city of scales.
- A Veteran General took Simone under their wing so she wouldn't fail her military training.
- Any military personnel from her career.
- Due to Simones job as a Captain within the military, She has a lot of experience in dealing with Kiir, and has also led multiple allies to their death in the name of protecting Nezmira.
- Owns a small plot of land as part of her Military Accolades, Has an estate in the City of Scales with branded of her own working there to maintain it.
- Simone has Blood Kiir stuff in her body due to forced experimentation upon her by Theoris (Why we have wings).
- Used to be a supporter of Theoris due to ignorance and Naivety, now hates him with a burning passion.

Name: Sir Bedivere
Age:
Physically late 20s, early 30s.
Technically 2? Chronologically over 1,000.
Backstory Bullet Points:
Much like the rest of Dreamites, woke up two years ago. Possessing very hazy memories of his past life, with occasional flashes in the rare dream he has with limiting detail. The only hint was that sword he typically carries.

Chose to be a knight, as he believed his purpose is to fight for the people of Ladon. Finding himself either being sent out into the Forest of Loss, or doing weapon and armor maintenance. Though found himself listless, wanting to go out but is bound by their own sense of duty.

Occasionally experiences the dreams of various people that he's spoken to at random intervals. He has a small reputation of suddenly acting eccentric in inopportune moments. So takes to reading all about he could find on dreams, and developing an interest of reading fictional tales.

Then dream of Deleria ends. Wakes up properly is told by his King and the Archmage that they have to leave the Island. From there, he starts a new journey while still having a new home in Polis.
Quirk:
Heirloom - Latorem Somnia

Consequence: As the weapon's wielder, Bedivere would randomly enter the dreams of people he's spoken even a single word to. He has no control over when this effect occurs, and is on occasions forced to act as one of the characters of said dream or have to make the dream come true.

Name: Sir Mordred
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Woke up in Castle Ladon, memories of previous life hazy, Knows who they themself are but not much more.

- Continues his life as a squire to the Knights of Ladon. Doing typical chores like equipment maintainence, and taking care of their companion animals. 

- His martial instructor was initially Sir Octavian, Arcanist of True Nimue, and so was taught Arcanism alongside Swordplay.

- Become aware of his repetitive and stagnant life when Sir Octavian and others leave the castle, though stays out of obligation.

- When staleness feels particularly heavy, Approaches King Wulfric Ladon and asks if he could borrow some books from their study. Proceeds to gain a hobby in reading fantasy adventure novels, and longs for the wonders of beyond.

- The dream of Deleria ends, Become properly awake and is told by his King and their accompanied Archmage that they have to leave the Island for it's destruction is imminent. Takes the opportunity with excitement and over the prospects of new sights.

Name: Sirius Proudmoore
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born with the name Sirius Smith in Midholde on Kor'tarion to a blacksmith and a cobbler
* The youngest of a dozen siblings, Sirius had more opportunity to look afield from his parents' lines of work
* Constantly fascinated by the mercenaries who solicited his family and their stories, he left at 18 to join a company, Leon's Lions (led by Leon Proudmoore)
* Traveled the continent, fighting mostly monsters on behalf of local settlements
* Rose in rank through talent and charisma, eventually took over when Leon was slain in battle.  Was granted his name as dying tribute
* Recently led the Lions to ruin in a battle against the armies of demons near Dryholde consequent from the Night of Red Sky
* All but Sirius were slain, who fled to Helwir's Refuge in shame and despair (and down a left eye)
* Swearing to build an army that can succeed where the Lion's failed, Sirius is summoned to the Worldhelm

Name: Sister Durian
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was a member of a rebellious force in the fey, to which they would ambush other powerful fey for power
- One of the ambushes went awry, leading to their entire company being captured and punished. 
- Sister was banished to the human realm, where her body would begin to wither and decay.
- It was then she found the being Known as Lady Lilith, An ever-shifting being who gave her the chance to change for the better
- For next thousands of years, she does as her lady commands, following her words without concern To eventually repay and redeem herself in her lady's eyes.

Name: Siwu
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born into a family of farmers in the Secret Fern Village, a hidden settlement within Shouwang Senlin. Given a name that simply means that he was the fourth child born during the fifth month, his life would be the same as any born into that village; to live as a laborer and to die as either prey for lesser spirit beasts or as a sacrifice for the Beast King.

One day the sun appeared in the sky causing stirrings among the spirit beasts and panic among the villagers. In the confusion, a child ran off into the forest.

Siwu chased after the child, before both of them fell into a pocket realm, which could not be escaped until the inheritance within was fully claimed. Siwu accepted the process, spending several months absorbing the techniques stored within and having his meridians forced open. Now a disciple... or vessel, for the spirit within the inheritance, he and the child escaped. Having become a cultivator, unwelcome within the village, he brought the child back home and set off alone.

Name: Sizz
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a moderately wealthy human family in South Rock, owners of a body modification clinic.

- Became obsessed with body modifications from a young age and underwent the initial process as a young adult at his parents' workshop.

- Studied under his parents, though chose not to take over their shop. Instead, he decided to help them develop a series of self-defense modifications.

- Needing good (and legal) testing opportunities, he decided to join Parabellum as a TEMP and Tracker under their Battle Enforcement Division.

- Is currently still a Tracker, but hopes to fine-tune his mods enough to fight side-by-side with their top brass someday.

- Current progress is split between the "Wingtips", tiny devices at the ends of his feathers that manipulate ambient moisture to produce various elemental effects, and the Gauntlets that power them. His Call Sign is "Sizzle" for the sound his "Wingtips" make when activated.
Other Names:
Real Name: Reginald "Reggie" Edwards
Call Sign: Sizzle

Name: Skada
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Born to the small village of high pass in Aldistir
• Trained in healing, and scholarly studies. Known for her kindness and love.
• Due to her younger sister, Sigrid, picking a fight with the Jarl's son and losing. Being the first of kin and Sigrid being a minor, the punishment and disgrace of the name Skada fell upon her.
• Lost a lot of her innate kindness in the struggle for survival in exile.
• Finally was found by Sigrid after Sigrid joined the Warband of the Branded, reuniting them, they were then gobbled by a realmstorm.

Name: Sloan Romani
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born a Pureblooded Blue Nezzim noble, mother was an archaeologist & father handled politics.
- They died during an investigation of a temple being overrun by Kiir.
- Growing up she made friends with a vagabond human, two became very close, and at 18 she got pregnant.
- Had the child in secret by living in another village in the desert for a year. 
- Upon having the Ophidiyan, she left him with her spouse Micah and they went into hiding. Sloan knowing nothing about their situation. 
- This spurs her on to help Branded and the Rebellion in secret under the alias "Azure Dream, keeping her cover as Theoris' right hand woman.
- At age 30, she watched Theoris send his son to become a Branded exile, this act cementing in her mind Theoris must die for a better Nezmira.
Quirk: Had Heirloom, lost it in a session
Relevant Arcana: N/A Though will be taking Arcanist later, Qilin?
Remort Changes: No Remort changes, "I'm perfect as I am."

Name: Snigbat
Backstory Bullet Points:
Snigbat is a failed experiment, a lizard creature dumped into the squalid underbelly of Haven, an attempt by SWORD to create a marketable monster for Real World Online.  He spent his early life squabbling with his mutant siblings, chewing on the wires and getting into trouble.

He discovered that he had a talent for building junk out of scrap, and ended up taking jobs with the Goldnails and the Vignettes.  After years of experimentation, he managed to build a magitech arcane cannon to defend himself, scrounging junkyards and waste sites for scrap.  

Since then, he's gained a bit of reputation as a wildcard, willing to do jobs that few others would take.  Stealing, intimidation, hit jobs, trading in illegal TEMP cards - whatever he needs to do to survive.

Eventually, taking mercenary gigs led him to get involved with revolutionary cells working against companies like ET Acquisitions.

Name: Sol Anaphalis
Backstory Bullet Points:
Was born to a pretty normal upbringing

Kidnapped into a magitech/botany laboratory to experiment with using plantlife to create a regenerative outer hull for mechs

Their test case was rather successful so spent most their teen years learning to pilot as the new systems were experimented

Sent out on a live fire test against a hostile force, it went wrong quick. Overwhelmed with heavy fire power to the point of essentially being blown to pieces, body barely alive etc

The regeneration project worked... Way better then expected even recovering their body from the brink of death. Even the damage to the brain was restored as more then half their body was replaced with plantlife.

They were marked dead, and thus no longer trapped and thus decided to operate alone. The war was good for no one on any side, both sides were in the wrong and the only correct outcome was peace

Thus they became a fighter for the independents and for the end of the war, reclaiming areas for nature and for peace

Name: Solaris Storm
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A swordsman born to the Fire Ant Village who wandered Tian yin to learn Swordsmanship from nature itself
- It wasn't until word had spread that his village was under attack did he return to find out what happened
- Understanding Mabisa was involved, & the rumored Goldhearted actually existed, Solaris took it upon himself to investigate what really happened
- Now on a mission to take the villages revenge for Mabisa on himself, he does everything he can to one day take her down, and ensure the safety of his village. Once, and for all.

Name: Solána Olowe
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in Windhaven with her twin brother, Shakir Olowe. Raised together by their oracle grandfather, Al-Hakim Olowe.
- Learned herbalism under him; soon became self-taught the rest of the way.
- Grandfather prophesied about the Blue City; they left shortly after for a better quality of life. 
- Revolutionaries saved them during travel; safely immigrated into the Blue City afterwards. 
- Early 20s started out as a battlefield medic; after advancing more skills, she became the revolutionaries’ main emissary.
- Years later, discovered a small shrine in the Blue City dedicated to Al-Shifā. It beckoned her to stay. Night of clarity later, she felt spiritist magic awaken within her.
- Told by her grandfather a Realmstorm would appear after his death. She ventured beyond the city, and as predicted, got swept away into the Heaven’s Sea.

Name: Somnolence
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a tribe in Aldistir that waged many bloody feuds
- Her dreams would take her to another realm of blizzard since her youth
- She refused to become a shaman in her tribe
- She loves art, dance, and song
- Forced to work as a gatherer
- Lost her way one day, sent very far away
- Caught in a storm of Godblood
- Found a haori that protected her in the blizzard
- Took cover in a cave, humming the song of her dreams
- Embraced by the wind, swept away to the Worldhelm
- Awoke with hair and eyes she did not recognize, seeks her place in her new world

Name: Sonam Kham
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Sonam was born in the easternmost island of Sansarko's Gasp as the heir to the གནམ་ལ་སྔོག་པའི་རི་བོ་ཞིག (Mountain that Pierces the Heavens) Dojo in a unnamed village.
- The Dojo slowly gained more traction under the guidance of his father, the death's of several spirit beast accredited to his name.
- This trend continued until a shameful defeat at the hands of another dojo, resulting in the death of his father and the burning of most of their 'inferior' teachings, he defied the teachings of the new dojo that overtook them and left.
- He found evidence of foul play mingled with corrupt cultivation but before he was able to bring it to the attention to the ex-disciples of his dojo, there was an assassination attempt to stop any such knowledge from spreading.
- Bloody and tired, he slumped against a tree until the realmstorm took him.

Name: Song-5
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Song-5 used to be a human archer girl named Bianca Oakridge who lived in Snowmaw
- Kviss (Cecrae at the time) stopped her from entering a realmstorm and instead tried to send her to the moon and failed
- She was trapped in the dark, endless Abyss of space, torn apart, until she was put back together by Lorelei 
- When she was put back together, she heard "The Fifth Melody" and followed it
- She woke up in the Spirit's Grove, called herself Song-5, and was soon picked up by a Realmstorm again
Remort Changes: Esper -> Empath

Name: Stock
Backstory Bullet Points:
-One of the founders of Sparrow; took on personal debt to create the company.

-A realmstorm appeared during a treaty celebration and she woke up in Lhodos.

-Lived there for roughly 5 years before she came to the Worldhealm

-Since then became a business woman of all the realms; using similar but different company titles for each realm.

When she finally returned to Terra discovered:
-17 years had past instead of the 5 years she had experienced in Lhodos
-Her debt has GROWN; contract killers/collectors.
-Her parents inherited the debt became insolvents. (haven't talked to yet)
-Closest friend Darcy Pertovac is now an insolvent (Talking to again)
-How history remembers Stock: "Disappeared when Sparrow needed her most in the face of her Depts"
-Sparrow believes she died or gave up and left them. 

-Suffering from depression and alcoholism.

Name: Storm
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Not everyone who fights for the KPLA belongs to Karlsgard, and not everyone with advanced tech works for the Empire. Some take what they can, and give nothing back. Storm (Not her real name), is one of those.
- Years of fighting and have gained her an impressive arsenal of reappropriated and commandeered (definitely not stolen) technology and weaponry.
- She's never been a big enough thorn in their side for the empire to really crack down on her. She maintained this to the best of her abilities. It's the one thing keeping her alive.
- Storm has a tenuous relationship with the KPLA. She steals from the Empire because its more valuable, but she's not exactly working against them even though she hates their guts. Luckily the KPLA are willing to pay her a premium for everything she raids.
- She's not entirely sure how she ended up outside her home plane, but without her crew and her ship, she's kind of having a rough time. She's just doing her best now.

Name: Stormbringer
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Lucius was born in Haven to parents who made enough to get by.
- They worked often, so he had a lot of time to himself. He made good use of his solitude studying.
- His classes were a breeze, and he was well on his way to living a good life, but he felt deeply unsatisfied
- He figured it out after catching a news report on the Temps of Terra. That was the life he wanted.
- Work on his next first project started immediately; a weapon that would set him apart other mercs.
- His peers found his diagrams unrealistic and childish, while his parents discovering his aspirations sparked a huge fight.
- He ran. Spent the next few years with obsessive determination on his project.
- After many prototypes, his weapon was finally complete. A powerful railgun. the shock and awe from his blasts earning him the moniker “Stormbringer”. He loved it so much, a name he earned
- Everything was going well, until he foolishly took a job that lead him into Old World, where he was swept up by a Realmstorm.

Name: Strabo Brightfeathers
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born as the smallest of his nestlings, fell from the nest as a fledgling and recovered slowly.
- Never had interest in trinkets unlike other Ravens as a child, instead did weird movements that caused ridicule.
- Supportive parents disappeared one day while hunting, leaving no one to defend him.
- Revealed his talent along with his first trinket, an instrument, during his Coming of Age ceremony, shocking the murder with his unconventional storytelling through dance.
- Still attempting to be accepted by the flock, wanders the lands in search of inspiration and experiences to commit to memory and song.

Name: Sullivan 🛡
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was a bodyguard for a royal family in Merrane and was relegated to escort and security detail
- Since he was a  family friend, he got in with aspirations and admiration of the work rather than qualification like weapon mastery
- Had believed that the resistance threat was smaller and more insignificant due to propaganda 
- An assassin was able to take advantage of his naivete and passivity and worm their way past them
- Failed to protect the lives of royal family heir and was dismissed for societal and physical incompetency
- Pursuit of purpose, becoming more capable as a bodyguard, and atonement for his failure to protect

Name: Sumati
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Daughter of the Elder of the tiny village of Kata, nestled in the forests wests of the Ngari Riverlands

* Her Father began her on the path of Shadow Qi, teaching her how to defend her family by killing interlopers and Spirit Beasts Both in full shadow.

* When she was old enough, she inherited the Hearth Daggers, the weapons passed down from her family to protect Kata.

* She took over the village when her Father died. Not long after, she married her husband: Akar.

* Together, they had a child, Palkyi

* While she was heading home from hunting a particularly tricky spirit beast, she accidentally fell into a realm storm.

Name: Svetlana Nenadović
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Firstborn son (behind three sisters) to the heir apparent of the noble Nenadovićs, a family of old wealth that helped fund the Agency in its nascent years. The Nenadović Family has recently slashed its funding to the Agency and advised other wealthy donors to do the same, due to the Nenadović's hatred for all of monsterkind.
* Trained to take up the hunting of monsters from a young age, specifically the family's vlach magic (channeling the Black and using its reality-warping effects to your advantage)
* In order to fully wield the Black, Svetlana and the others of his generation were subjected to the full effects of the Black for a fraction of a moment to plant a seed of its power within them. Should their bodies survive it, they will become true hunters.
* Svetlana's childhood best friend, Sofija, is almost certain not to survive the trial, and so Sveta seeks to either find a cure to what ails her, or becomes strong enough with his family's magicks to cure it himself...

Name: Swarm
Age: N/A - Unsure what to put as age as plant. [Body is one of a 20 year old human.]
Backstory Bullet Points:
Before inhabiting the vessel they find themselves in. Swarm was a mere flower amongst many within the Gwaed Forest. 
A Sarracenia Colchicum, otherwise known as the Pitcher Crocus was once a normal flower before the shattering of the moon. After contact with one of many fallen shards, the flower changed to a carnivorous plant which now attacked wild life and at times humans. The shard has also granted it thought, with the inflorescences of these flower forming a hive-mind. Working single handedly to survive. Nothing more. That was what the hive was to do.
Decades would pass as the flowers stayed put. Never spreading, staying in one region of the forest. In recent times, bodies were dropped off. Dropped off where the pitchers hid and they were disposed. Though one did not make into the pitchers, only tossed away to the side. Safe from the horde a flower bloomed from the empty eye socket of the body. Time passed and Swarm was born. Able think on its own. Maybe able to form its own tale.
Quirk:
Arboreal
Immunity - Enraged
Vulnerability - Fire
Spell - Curse

Name: Sybil
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to Gawain’s black pack, one of the runtier of her litter
- From a young age, heard the voices and whispers of the Firwood far more than any of her kin could
- These whispers brought her to Lysethea, who taught her how to use these powers and taught her the basics of Gravetending, and it's here she met Minerva, a friend in the same practice
- Opposes the will and goals of the leaders of the wolves, seeks to bring about change from within but fails
- Seeing an imprisoned moth named Cassius, Sybil works to free him, and flees with the mark of the Traitor’s Brand to join the Brave Asphodels
- Cassius and her are then chosen by the Worldhelm, and drawn into the storm.

Name: Sylvaine Corinth
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Heartdom to a simple life and family. Often went out with friends into the ruined streets of Heartdom with her friend Myeongjun Shin.
- As she grew older she began to understand the danger that the other celestial spheres would have to her home from the teachings of others around her.
- Joined the Academy and began her training as a Paladin of Lilith. Became the wielder of the Hegemony and bonded with Myeongjun Shin.

Name: Syn3ia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Terra , Silver Rock, Haven

- Raised by her dad, a mechanic

- Helped him out in his shop as they were growing up

- Was shy at a young age but got into music to boost her confidence 

- Auditioned for tryouts with a girlband , and got accepted

- Eventually separated and went solo, rebranding herself as a DJ

- Members of her old band have started going missing, an illegible calling card left at the sights of disappearances

- The same calling card has been sent to her, so she's travelling between gigs to look for her old bandmates

(Backstory Link) 

[Can't say too much or manager'll give me an earful again! I'll tell you what I can though!](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GlqpalnjJJZTAf4Vu1y5ylzkzvdhyEmnvoihHwR0xns/edit?usp=sharing)
Sheet Link: ["Don't worry! I can hold my own!" ](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1M04wZuUaPerewUCT1NKKFyOhXxv7ws19KA2y3u3Show/edit?usp=sharing)

Name: Sūn Si Yu
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in Xuanwu Village to the mastery of a Minor Sect known as the Jade Art Sect.

* Born male, but her father had found a pill that he used to help her transition when she realized she was femme

* Trained in Cultivation under her father, showed a knack for Body Cultivation and Heavenly Qi.

* The Jade Art Sect held onto 5 magical artifacts. A Spear, A Gauntlet, a Sword, a Bow, and a Hammer

* Coveted by the Black Fist Sect, the major sect attacked it and managed to steal four of the artifacts. 

* Si Yu was able to escape only by fleeing with the gauntlet. Her father sacrificed himself to let her escape.

* Her life was saved by Dehua. She did not trust the girl at first, but eventually came to rely on her after she was healed.

* After 5 months, she was finally fully healed and ready to enact her vengeance. And then a Realm Storm happened.
Birth Realm: Xuanwu City, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin

Name: Taavi
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Human from the aldish Clan in Gravernmarq, left some years ago to learn more about cooking in other dwellings.

- Since he seldom returned to his birthplace, he often had a longing to belong to the places he studied at.

- So when a group of Wandering Merchants came along, all from different parts of the Realm he joined them. The call themselves "Catalysts of Commerce"

- While on a Trip to Blood Pools to gather some bloody thistles for a dish, he was swept up in a Realmstorm and woke up in the Worldhelm

Name: Taiki Ibuki
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Half-oni man from Sakai, mother's side descended from the town's yokai protectors
- Showed some promise as a cultivator with a dual affinity to both demonic and heavenly qi, family was able to afford training with the plan being for him to join the Shogun's forces as a magus
- His spiritual progression stagnated after a few years, he ended up learning various card games to pass the boredom, and he infuses his cards with qi for fun
- He tried incorporating his cards into his fighting style, having a 'game' to play gives him motivation to 'win' without having regards for the actual situation
- He received some training in talismans from his teachers as sort of the closest thing to what he's doing now, he makes a deck of them
- He's able to make progress again, but the ennui of his previous state of being has carried over, and he struggles to find motivation
- One day a wandering realmstorm decides it wants a snack and sweeps him away
Quirk:
Heirloom
- As the only cultivating descendent of his lineage, he received a family heirloom, a quarterstaff that can separate into three sections for flexibility in combat
- However, it has become historied enough to house a tsukumogami in it that plays pranks on him out of spite, having sensed and absorbed the disappointment the rest of his family harbors towards him

Name: Taipan Lewra
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Born among a slew of siblings to a merchant mage family that lives in a manor on the road from Tradefair, the Ardens.
• They raise their children seemingly with love, though in an effort to inspire varied magical development, each child is given a unique 'trial' to endure in their growth.
• Taipan's trial was that he would be locked in a dark, empty room upon any perceived misdeed until he could explain why he was locked there.
• Of course, said goodbye to the few siblings he liked and left home when he came of age. He changed his last name to Lewra.
• Had studied under a lawyer before then, earning certification to practice. Said lawyer recommended Hudal academy.
• Taipan's research focused on combining law and magic, hypothesized a quill that could potentially write runes of law to create magically binding contracts.
•  Treaded through a realmstorm to empower his prototype, the act allowed him to bind part of a minor arcana of dealmaking, Crete, before waking up elsewhere.
Relevant Arcana: Asmodai (custom minor arcana, seraph base but with light damage replaced with dark damage).

Name: Takano Akiyama
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a declining merchant family in Dejima, in the region of Soga.
- Most of the clan's members, lands, and stocks were destroyed in the explosion of Awadayama, whose lands bordered their own.
- Clan never recovered, eventually resulting in the current roster of: herself, her father (Denji), her mother (Bunko), their two maids (Tomoe, Nanako), and their lone bodyguard (Enofumi)
- Father charged her with restoring the clan.
- Takano is an indoor kid, and very nervous. Parents give her a hammer covered in defunct coins, sealed in a hinoki box
- The hammer is supposedly a great relic of Daikokuten, filled with his essence and said to bring luck.
- Takano thinks it's really just a fancy hammer that's gonna get her robbed.
- Worldhelm time!

Name: Takaoka Kiyo
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born to a small semi-nomadic community of yokai, mostly tengu, kites blessed by Kuzunoha and their descendants.
* Grew up idolizing her older brother Masayuki and eventually joined him as one of the defenders of their community from Ald attacks and other dangers.
* In one battle they successfully repelled the attackers, only for Kiyo to find that her brother had fallen in the fighting. He died. In another battle, a raider slipped through and killed her unarmed cousin Hisa in the camp.
* Kiyo grew very jaded about all this violence that failed to protect her family, and was pained by thoughts of the family of all the people she had killed. She retreated to desperate idealistic belief that peaceful coexistence must be possible, a rejection that all this pain and death was the only way.
* Swept into a Realmstorm by reckless curiosity, she took well to having a purpose. She may also be running away from things. Just a little.

Name: Tatsuya Sakanagi
Backstory Bullet Points:
- He has been working as an Employee of NTTech as a Office Worker for a some years.
- Recent years he has obtained a temp license from NTT for non-office space jobs.
- Doesn't have much contact with his son.
- Is unhappy with how things seem and feel around NTT as of current times.
- Was suddenly pulled in to the Worldhelm after intervening in a 100Gs operation and pacifying a monster situation.

Name: Tavian
Backstory Bullet Points:
🔹 Grew up in the industrial outskirts of Karlsgard, running with salvage crews.  
🔹 Joined the KPLA to do something that mattered—met Aila, his fiancée and field partner.  
🔹 Ambushed during a sabotage mission; Aila saved him but went missing.  
🔹 Escaped on a small airskiff just before a Realmstorm pulled him into the Worldhelm.  
🔹 Still carries the transceiver he used to speak with her—silent ever since.

Name: Tenzen Enkh
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was from a small village around the Zham-Hira Brushlands that was ruined completely by a spirit beast and in the process lost his entire family at a young age.

- Was taken in and saved by Empty Monks, who took him under to teach and train him, seeing his potential and affinity to void qi and willingness to adhere.

- For years he followed the teachings and as a part of the training began to train at the Temple of Fortitude being where he started and watched those he got to know beat each other nearly to death.

- Overtime something in him disconnected with the instilled ideology of Self Annihilation. He tried to continue to follow, the sights he saw, the memories he held and the suffering he recalled he couldn't let go of.

- He ended up eventually running away and disconnecting from the Empty monks while in the Temple of Strife, escaping their pursuit into the wilds where they believed he would surely die, but instead was saved by those of the Holy Harmony from near death.

Name: Tenzin el-Shayekh
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Showed magical aptitude and was enslaved for it
- Trapped in a mine for years
- When escaping, was temporally locked to the mine and constantly blinked in and out of existence
- Has fixed that problem
- Now somewhat drifting about, trying to help out the revolutionary front

Name: Tessa
Backstory Bullet Points:
- born in Lhodos
- her dad was a KPLA fighter
- she looked up to him and would often ask him to tell her stories about what he did
- she wanted to be just like him, and still does
- he died in the war, and she enrolled as young as she possibly could for the KPLA
- she was good at it because she'd been learning from her dad for years
- was promoted to Drake after some time
- she had been sent over to Constance to assist with a skirmish along the border of the Iron Mountains
- she made her way up the mountains, wanting to scout ahead, only to be caught off guard by a Realmstorm

Name: Teyac
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born Teyacapan, in the Teotlāni tribe at the Unclaimed Lands
* Heir to the tribe's shaman, trained under the Path of Valor
* Discovered a faceless Folkin mask, which was entrusted to her guard
* For weeks, the mask projected urges of freedom, that resonated with her
* She made the decision to wear it, and fleed her tribe, becoming Teyac
* Survived on the streets of Providencia using the mask's bead magic
* Taken in by an Exorcist named Enjiro, who sheltered and taught them
* The mask changed them, Wardens grew suspicious of Enjiro, so they left him
* Hunted by Wardens, and hid in a dungeon, surviving by helping Delvers
* A group of Delvers tried to steal their mask, and gets hurt
* Rescued by an adventurer called Ava who was investigating
* Brought to the Guild for help, but refuses to try to remove the mask
* Eventually joined the Guild as an Adventurer

Name: Thalia Cornerstone
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the slums in Tradefair.
- Recruited by a Bandit King to be bait for merchants on the road, the poor little girl act to earn her food and water.
- The Bandit King was defeated by the Golden Claw Mercenaries, a mercenary group not sponsored by any of the merchants of Tradefair, and since they did not want to kill at 14 year old, captured her and paid off her bounty.
- The Golden Claw fell in reputation and finances because of this but trained Thalia regardless and helped her become a chivalrous mercenary by the Guildmaster Theodore, an ex-knight of Brightshield.

Name: Thamalaine and Thamalina
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Thamalaine was born to the satyrs of the Autumn Court, and as such would grow up surrounded by music and dance.
- He would live life as satyrs do - dancing, drinking, living joyously... That is, until the cold started to creep beyond its wintry bounds.
- As the frost began to descend across Kor'Tarion, Thamalaine would act as a guide and guardian for lost wanderers across the Mordican Highlands that was their home.
- He would fail once... and as was that now dead woman's wish, he would take a second name and form upon himself - Thamalina, for the autumn court is one of change, and a satyr would always be a satyr.
Other Names:
Thamalaine the Broad
Thamalina the Kind

Name: The Assistant
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Came to consciousness at the Magestone Islands; seemingly as a byproduct of the magical testing and malestrom there.
* Has only one purpose: To assist, in whatever ways feasibly possible. Thus, they do.
* They didn't think twice about the summons of the Worldhelm, which came shortly after The Assistant came to cognizance.
* Though they have a generalized knowledge and understanding of the happenings of Nezmira, they have yet to experience much of it in person. They simply know that if there's something they can do to help, they will help.

Name: The Hegemon
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Heartdom, generally kept to himself, collected "lost" media and electronics as a hobby
- Sylvaine Corinth was his closest and only friend
- Eventually, he couldn't stand the idea of sitting around and doing nothing while Lilith and Sylvaine fought for such lofty ideals, and so he enrolled himself into the academy
- Underwent dedicated and difficult personal training and became a Regal Vessel; Sylvaine is his Regent

Name: The Overture
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Comes from a very toxic family of a distancing father and Egocentric mother
- Father is a well established and proficient paladin, Mother is a bureaucrat and spokeperson/negotiator for one of Heartdoms larger regions.
- At home was constantly verbally abused for his lack of strength and capability. Mother only expects excellence to make herself look good, and her behaviour caused his golden child of a brother to do the same.
- Ran away from home to enroll into Gnosis Academy against his family's wishes, initially enrolled as a Paladin to get back at them by trying to be better than his brother.
- After his first year at the academy, seeing his overall results were not up to par, he changed to the House of Treasures to become a Regalia. Succeeding in the necessary measures to achieve that, Apollo now having become the Overture, he chose Perseus to become his Regent.

Name: Théodore Pascal
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in northern Rocade to a hedge witch mother with a shady past and a father. Both leirsin.
- Migrated down to Mastrazs with parents.
- Around age 7, his father and Theodore were captured by bandits. Forcibly pitting the two together until Theodore was the one who survived.
- In a fit of powerlessness, requested his mother to teach him how to use Magia. But instead imparted a principle to not misuse Magia for wicked purposes before properly teaching him Thauma to exercise an important aspect: control.
- At age 16, climbed up the 99 Steps and performed the Rite of Vows. Then he was chosen as an Heir of Eternity.
- Furthered his journey as a Witch, learning Anima to fully control his newly gifted powers as an Heir.
- Age 20, ventured forth to the Runewall with a few trusted Followers of Eternity in search for a way to stop the Calamity. Becoming the only survivor to make it past.

Name: Tika
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Caldera, educated in Korala; graduated at 15.
- Funneled into work for defense, and contributed to proudly to spectacular breakthroughs in weapons technology.
- They overshadowed the work she really loved, but she didn't mind them until her genius 'earned' her a trip to the front to see her inventions' good work.
- The experience changed her opinions quickly, and she left government academia suddenly and without ceremony.
Remort Changes: None

Name: Tilly Howard
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Uncivilized Zone in Steelbin, Matilda Howard (going almost exclusively by Tilly) was a rambunctious child who inherited her abnormal strength from her father.

- She was raised in a tunnel network called the Warrens, which hosts a few dozen survivors who descended to escape the Treasure Hunters above.

- Enamored with stories of the Paladins of Gnosis, Tilly trained in hopes of being free to live in the sun.

- As Treasure Hunters got close to the Warrens, most of the survivors chose to delve deeper underground, but Tilly chose to risk it all.

- With her parents' help managed to get aboard the Kaiway Metro as it passed over the Uncivilized zone (albeit by being thrown headfirst at it, losing a tooth and nearly falling to her death). It was by the Conductor's grace that she survived. 

- She then headed to Gnosis Academy immediately, and by some miracle was accepted.

- Now she enters her third year, rushing headlong towards her dreams of becoming a Paladin.

Name: Timothy Maclain
Backstory Bullet Points:
Timothy was born in North Rock, while growing up in the most dangerous areas of haven was tough at times, he could always find solace in games which would eventually lead him to wanting and eventually getting a job at SWORD

Freelance soulrunner who has previous connections to SWORD (hence the arcanum) who got bad intel on a job gone wrong and ended up getting sent through a realmstorm

Since becoming a goldhearted Timothy has aspirations of turning his soulrunner gig work into a proper company which he has been growing closer and closer to every day, he does however have a very difficult relationship with the Crimson Specters which could make this difficult
Relevant Arcana: Nimue, Yubel (I spent savior energy on this like a week ago, not sure if I still need to list it)

Name: Tomiko Umikiri
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Owaga as a Half-Yokai
- Her father died when she was young, and she survived off the goodwill of her community
- In her teen years, she found her precious Cooking Utensils, and thanks Yebisu for giving her the good fortune to find them
- She got taught how to cook by an old widow
- Her Spice Rack helped her experience Vibrant Flavors for the first time
- She now wishes to share good food everywhere, since everyone deserves something delicious

Name: Topal
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From a family of transcribers practicing in secret cataloging the atrocities committed under the Maharaja's rule
- Ultimate wish of wanting to serve the Great House of Kalyani
- Purusa (calligraphy) passed and taught as a family practice, but heavily suppressed by the war
- Family Keeping and relaying written records and transcribing copies of poems, scrolls, and cultivation manuals. Some had to be disguised as coded messages through anagrams and cyphers
- Family works discovered by the forces of the Maharaja
- Father killed for practicing Cultivation and Topal was imprisoned until the Maharaja was defeated

Name: Torva
Backstory Bullet Points:
Finds his mate Skadi early in life
Skadi is a peerless hunter while Torva stays in the den under a hill with the kits
One day they hunt together, and they get back to an Ald warband battling and the rockslide buries the pups
Broken by grief, hey change territories, only sticking together for survival
Comes across members of the same warband killing a pair of foxes, kill them together in a fit of violent rage
Hears crying kits and it tugs at his heartstrings
Convinces Skadi to help them, they start developing feelings again
The rest of the warband tracks down the fox den, a battle ensues as the new parents feel even more desperate to avoid a repeat
Skadi dies and Torva is gravely injured, but he stands even with a broken body and heart, earns Kuzunoha's blessing
Torva, now also Torvoya the parent, raises the cubs as his own until they grow up and disperse
Decides to start wandering Aldistir looking for children to protect, just as he starts walking he’s swept up by a Realmstorm

Name: Trif
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in The City of Nest and worked with her father at a young age to maintain the fields or the machines that do it.
- She was raised on company values and often found herself attached to her plants that she had once she was young.
- At first, her family and company thought it was just she had a green thumb but as she grew up, it would be clear that it was far more intricate than that when they would grow a plant in front of her father's eyes.(Verdant Sway)
- She was told by her father to not show anyone what she could do, hiding it from the rest of her family members and Sparrow due to the restrictions of such a thing.
- One day as she was working the fields of The City of Nest, she would be taken by a realmstorm.

Name: Trina Fellwar
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Wulforh, Forced to go to Karsbren for a long time to learn how to become a blacksmith through an apprenticeship

- While in Karsbren, she worked under a talented enchanter within The Silver Castrum. It was during this work that she was often pressured quite hard to learn her craft, even overworked

- During her final years of her apprentice ship, she was given an heirloom from her teacher that he was keeping safe. Crafted by her great grandfather, Eternal Ignition is her motivation to become greater no matter the cost.

- Eventually went back to Wulforh, to learn business practices from her mother and crafting items to keep the business floating. She ended up working with The Silver Castrum once more, this time working with other enchanters side by side.

- Her father signed her up to go through the runewall without her knowing, and was forced to go lest her family pay the price.

- Maybe if she survives, she'll be able to finally get back at her father for this transgression
Quirk:
Heirloom - Eternal Ignition (Sage Robes - Quality: Elemental Echo)

Description: Red & Black vestments with extended white sleeves, forged by Trina Fellwars' great grandfather. It was handed down to her in recent years, it imbues its wearer with intense flame protecting them from dangers.

Flaw: While meant to protect its wearer, in times of sufficient stress it can often do more harm than good. Forcing the wearer to lose control of their actions, or force them to feel the full force of the flames made to craft it.

Name: Trinity Heartwell
Backstory Bullet Points: Trinity is a human from Kor'Tarion and was gifted with wild and unpredictable magics from his bloodline. He has the ability through magic to fly at will. He is a student at Hudal Academy, and aspires to one day become a professor. His desire is to gift magic to all creatures who want it, as he feels magic is a net benefit to society. One day while visiting a beautiful lake, a realmstorm happened and he woke up next to a fountain...

Name: Triss Corvus
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Parents sold her to scientists at 5
- Triss doesn't understand why (Doubt theme)
- Scientists search to reverse effects of Septids (Mutant Class is formed), learn that her bloodline homes an Ancient Magic
- They Experiment, inject her with a Magic Core (below her ribs, above stomach) (Entropist Class is formed)
- Documents say Triss' purpose is to reverse Septids, but Classified is learn+harness new form of magic
- Years Pass as her torture continues, Scientists learn her Magic eats her + others, takes form based on the different DNA they injected for original purpose. 
- They test the limits of her magic, they discover she grows unstable and collapses ( Fugitive Experiment Quirk )

- During one of the magic tests, Triss' body explodes with this cosmic power. 
- When she wakes. finds herself in the midst of the ruined room and surrounded by the fallen scientists, Triss begins her escape.
- Now lives with Klein and Reeve in their hideout

Name: Tristania Ovsong - ᵀʰᵉ Measure
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born on the fifth floor of the Pavilion with an older sister a few years older than her.
- At first was a normal pair of shears due to her family usually being tailored / very creative minded.
- When she was young, her family attempted to escape the fifth floor to escape Coia. They were caught in the process of doing so.
- Tristania's regalia changed to be more like a weapon in an attempt to protect her family, and was spared by Coia for being so young and seemingly roped into the escape attempt.
- Was adopted by another family of gilded after her's was killed by Coia during the escape attempt. 
- Wandered with her brother and their friends until eventually coming to the Worldhelm to try to make things better for everyone.

Name: Tsuihō Hira
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Early life he was raised by his kitsune parent who he does not have any memory of
- At 15 he was left to fend for himself near the outskirts of Hanae 
- To survive, he uses the limited range of Inari's Will he has to find and heal both humans and kitsune injured from conflict
- Before getting on the ship Tsuiho made a vow of pacifism as the humans of Hanae are still weary of him and the kitsune treats him as a foolish child at best.

Name: Tsumugi
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Born in Heavenly Mountains to an abusive Oni father and a human mother she will never meet

• People pleaser with a fake smile out of fear and neglect becoming a dancer and entertainer

• Sought the protection of of another half-Oni woman she would come to know as Yuzuki Kagayami

• The two half-Oni grew closer the cold and intense Kagayami warming to the lively dancer

• After the battle of Amagi Tsu began to grow more fearful of her father and others in the city

• Tsu and Kagayami fled the city in search of a better life after Kagayami reconnected with her human father

• A few days after they set out the two half-Oni women got swept up in the Realmstorm and taken to the Worldhelm

Name: Tsuru Inoue [井上鶴]
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Is the Daughter of a Samurai and former Bandit who used to be at conflict in border skirmishes, now work together under the Ito Clan in their military

- Had a way with words at a young age that drew people to her and caused them to listen to her at times.

- Lost her father in a battle against a Ronin with a long scar across their eyes and her mother was wounded with one of her eyes being damaged.

- She took up the Sword and Bow full time and became a samurai, inheriting the spirit of honor her father instilled in her growing up, becoming a Samurai under the Ito Clan.

- Secretly swears vengeance in her heart against the Ronin that took her father from her and wounded her mother.

- Was elevated to a Samurai Commander under the new Daimyo Ito Kumiko, serving a new role than just defending the border point.

Name: Tsutsuji
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born from the very concept of a warming breeze and the hope of new life, Tsutsuji awoke in the Feywyrd three years ago on the first day of what would become known as spring. 
- With duty written in her bones, she raced through the forests, leaving a path of flowers in her wake and providing gardens of respite for the wounded allies of Kuzunoha and those fleeing the dangers of the Blood Grotto.
- Tsutsuji seems uniquely uninterested in the combat and bloodshed of Aldistir, her focus instead on forming zones of safety for the creatures and people who may find her. Well... so long as they don't threaten her or her wards.
- An army of draugr had begun to march onto her domain, demolishing her gardens, and she realized she would be forced to flee. However, she suddenly found herself swept away by the Worldhelm.

Name: Tucker "Tuck" Bungo
Backstory Bullet Points:
-He is from a long line of guard dogs, personal protectors and companions of the defenders of Aldistir's hearths. He was adopted by a cook in the Varin Camp. 
-Biggest of his litter. Friendliest of his litter. 
-Was gifted a charm two years ago by a Yokai he helped pull from a snow bank. 
-Followed the scent of that charm to a shrine of Kuzunoha, where he was then gifted with speech.
-Was enamoured by the concept of cooking, on account of his former-owner. (Still on good terms. The Cook just felt wrong owning a sentient being.)
-Learned to cook with the held of special oven mitts with hooks on them that allowed him to "grab" pots and pans.
-Now is a cook!
-He loves you, you're his best friend.
Other Names: Tuck, Bingo Bungo, Tungo Bungo, Bungo Brown, Good Boy
Relevant Arcana: By the nature of what he is, Kuzunoha.

Name: Tucker Kawasaki
Backstory Bullet Points:
The Man
> Tucker is a manic, odd-jobs edgerunner who can't keep keep down regular work due to his eccentric attitude. 
The Method
> He takes copius amounts of drugs to keep himself going, but at the cost of his mental clarity. This disqualifies him from the less dangerous street jobs.
The Problem
> Tucker's family has always been burdened by great debt. He ended up gambling out of hope that their lives would change for the better, but not even his family knows if that person still exists behind the veneer of his addictive and abusive personality
The Situation
> Tucker woke up on the worldhelm after a particularly chaotic and hysterical night of drinking and gambling.
Birth Realm: Terra, Silver Casino Lodge, An Alleyway

Name: Tyra Halfborn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to an outcast couple, an Ald Father and a Yokai Mother. Raised in isolation, taught to fend for herself.
- They died, and in her loneliness she set out to find other outcasts. She found Olga. Olga was a witch.
- Olga taught her Necromancy over some amount of years. When she was reasonably ready, Tyra set about setting it to use.
- Tyra made meat out of various human, animal, and draugr parts.
- Tyra and Meat would wander Aldistir for some time before being taken by the Worldhelm.

Name: Tzera Crawford
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Tzera was an orphan after her village was destroyed by monsters. The Mercenary group the White Saber’s led by Gerald Heartstone arrived in time to rescue a battered young Tzera.

- Gerald asked the Winter Witches of the Lunar Mountains to look after Tzera, which they agreed to take her in until she turned 16.

- at 16, she rejoined the White Sabers as a mercenary, working with them until reaching the rank of Lieutenant.

- The White Sabers took a job leading up to the broken vortex and were ambushed by followers of Vanagandr. In the process Tzera was cursed with endless hunger by the wolf and the rest of the White Saber’s were slaughtered.

- Tzera then stumbled onto the Worldhelm where she is now. Recently she has even been cured of her curse thanks to Kuzunoha.

Name: Uto Masahide Miyabi [宇土 将秀 雅]
Backstory Bullet Points:
- After being lost and abandoned, found by an former samurai
- Feeling sorry for the pup, the former samurai takes the pup with him to Ishihara
- Raised as the man's son, as a merchant, and learned the sword
- They suffer hardship and difficulty together, but they have each other.
- The man is recognized as a former captain of the Imperial Guard and killed, but by hiding away, the kitsune escapes
- To honor his father, the kitsune now wears his form, though slightly altered to keep anyone else from recognizing him
Other Names:
Uto (last name)
Masahide (chosen name)
Miyabi (given name)

Name: Val
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Street Witch who grew up in working class neighborhood
- does gig work, using scooter to go from job to job repairing arcane  devices
- soft spot for outcasts/punks
- self taught magic
- somewhat reluctantly part of an underground witch's council
- had a run in with corp  security after (probably falsely) using magic off license and had to flee on scooter. A terrible storm was happening at the time, she remembers loosing control over her scooter and skidding out into a slide. After that- she doesn't remember much but to her surprise woke facing a brighter sky than she had ever seen.
- discovered her "new home" the Worldhelm.

Name: Val "Maestri" Tamboia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and Raised in Terra
- Underground Rock and Heavy Metal Singer and Guitarrist
- Learned the guitar and singing techniques from his Father, Mr. Spanò
- Unnaware of the fact that music can be used as magic
- Used part of his earnings from shows to charity
- Learned of a locked guitar in a SWORD HQ and a scheme involving what genre of music the populace hears 
- Learned of such scheme by overhearing a convo between 2 affiliated workers during one of his shows, unclear as to what are the ends of this scheme
- Invaded the HQ, passed trhough many guards and got the Thunder's Riff, escaped by jumping out of a window from a high story into a realmstorm
- The song played during the invasion was Queensrÿche's "Operation Mindcrime"

Name: Valen Bell
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and raised in Ironholde
- At 18 was a full time guard and was aspiring to become a Brightshield Knight
- Valen's Father Tadem Bell, died covering one of Valen's guard shift
- In his grief, Valen joined the rising Atee religion
-  Valen left his town to go a pilgramage to find a way to redeem himself when seeing his father's death as his fault in his eyes.

Name: Valentin Bernstein
Backstory Bullet Points:
Valentin was raised in a laboratory, subjected to genetic experiments and cybernetic enhancements before escaping due to a series of strange coincidences.
He spent years surviving on the streets, developing a deep hatred for technology and constantly fighting to stay alive.
After a desperate chase, he stumbled upon a medieval-style estate, where the head butler, Archibald Bernstein, took him in and trained him in the ways of servitude and discipline.
Valentin thrived under Archibald’s guidance until a technologically advanced force attacked the estate, leading to Archibald’s death.
Not long after, Valentin was chosen as a Goldhearted, and is now joining the Worldhelm

Name: Valentine O'Loshio Torres
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in Merrane's propaganda in Rachet
- Went to Korala Acedemy for 2 years
- Had a job as a bartender, gambled hard, had fun
- Got in a fight with his friends, learned the truth
- Depressive episode solved by a gambling high..
- Decided to be productive and write papers to spread the truth
- Approached by authorities to stop or else
- Packed a bag to Rachet to tell his home of the truth but was beamed to the Worldhelm

Name: Valerie Knight
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in North Rock with an absentee mother, an abusive father, and a little sister named Riley. Learned to be protective of her little sister. Father died when she was 18,

- Learned to pick up the slack financially for her little sister, hoping to scrounge up enough money to get by and get her sister a proper education with how talented she was.

- Got mixed in with the wrong crowd, soon she was doing any job she could get. Hoping that she could retire once Riley made a lot of money

- Found a stray by the name of Ozzy, saved him from being sent to juvenile prison and took him in.

- Only got more unhappy as she watched her sister and brother idolize her, but stayed on this path until it eventually killed her.

- She was brought back as an insolvent, swearing to herself that she could make an honest living now with her death wiping her slate clean. Takes any odd job she can get her hands on as long as it isn't too shady.

- Was taken by a Realmstorm along with her two siblings

Name: Vania
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was a career solider with Merrane.
- Started to develop an unknown illness that caused internal bleeding when her body is strained or stressed.
- Retired from field work at a young age and became a military instructor.
- Was stationed in Suntower to work with troops there.
- Hearing rumors of Suntower seceding from Merrane resolved to stand with Suntower as its been her home for over a decade.
- Begins trying to resharpen combat skills picking up magi-crystals to make up for lack of physicality she once had.
- Begins working harder to keep soldiers in Suntower ready and prepared in the event of retaliation from Merrane due to the rumors or in the event Suntower fully secedes.

Name: Vanigad Ensed
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Before he was Vanigad, he was born with another name.
- His family worshipped Vanagandr, and fought to conquer Aldistir.
- When he came of age, he left his home, and was became a follower of Lilith.
- He served her for a while, leaving chaos and confusion in his wake.
- Eventually, he decided to see the edge of the world, but got caught in a blizzard.
- The blizzard lasted way too long, and where he sought shelter turned out to be a lonely shrine to the void.
- The shrine had enough for him to outlast the blizzard, and in gratitude, he decided that this old god should have a follower, even if he has a limit to the power he can draw.
- He gave up his name, reemerging from the blizzard a new man. With a new name. And new abilities.
Birth Realm: Forgotten Shrine to the Fallen God, Aldistir
Remort Changes:
Esper changed to Empath
Navigator changed to Empathetic Bond

Name: Vanille Kuylenberg
Backstory Bullet Points:
Although Vanille was an adventurer in her younger years, she retired at 19 due to a severe injury. She settled down in Dryholde, where she would eventually marry her husband Arthur and have a son, Donovan. Arthur made his living as a monster hunter, and Vanille found fulfillment in turning the spoils of his hunts into incredible home cooking. Life had its struggles, but the family found their way together.

That all changed a year ago, when a monster attack beset the village of Dryholde. In the chaos, Vanille was separated from Arthur and the then 13-year-old Donovan, and she was knocked unconscious. When she came to the following morning, she found no trace of her family. Since then, she's trained her body and her techniques to once again take up adventuring.

Now, Vanille has found her son - under the name Marcelo Brightshield, the young king, a pawn for the Merchant with no memory of his mother. She will do whatever it takes to see him safe, and get revenge on those who hurt him.

Name: Vant Russel
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Once a devout warrior of the Sündisznó, Vant survived countless cycles and wars, earning a fearsome reputation among the Ironbrood... before leaving it all behind.
- Decades of ritual slaughter hollowed his devotion. What was once glorified as "divine struggle" revealed itself as bloodshed without purpose.
- By 37, Vant abandoned the Thorn Dominion amidst a territorial conflict to flee to Veyrhold.
- At first he meant to disappear. But among humans, he found new purpose: to be useful without violence, and to live without proving his worth through blood.
- Seeking to control his lycanthropy, Vant became entangled with supernatural incidents across the city. 
- Reports spread of a man clad in silver jewelry and ritual markings protecting civilians and resolving threats. The SIA took notice. Soon apprehended, Vant chose to join them.
- Now a DSE field investigator, he tracks and contains supernatural threats before they escalate. During a mission, he ended up pulled into a Realmstorm.
Quirk:
Bloodline - Werewolf

"The Sacred Cycle isn't a gift. It's a curse. Every day we fight and bleed and kill and feed... for what? The Divine? Our *ego*? 

It all leads to nothing. Our glory's as useless as the flesh we bleed off. It just stains the world with filth. I'll never be that monster again."

---

Vant is a Werewolf of the Sundiszno Tribe, constantly fighting against the primal urges rooted deep within him in order to live a more peaceful life. Usually, he forcefully restrains and weakens his lycanthropy through enchantments and silver jewelry, but if the need arises for him to tap into that power for the greater good, he will reluctantly release his restraints and let himself loose.

Name: Ven & Vid
Age:
Not applicable - Biologically a corpse.
Physically appears in early thirties.
Backstory Bullet Points:
* The result of two great warriors - a demon named Cogitav, and an Empty Monk named Ergo Nonsum - clashing, with Ergo turning Cogitav's soul-rending against it.
* Both of their souls, and all of the collected souls within Cogitav, merged and mixed in a massive maelstrom, eventually congealing and concatenating into the forms of Ven and Vid.
* This new gestalt soul has only lingering memories of who - and what - it was before this incident. It also hardly has knowledge of what it is to even be *alive*.
* Held together by force of will and curiosity, this new pair of bodies wanders to find out what life is about, and what its own unlife is for.

Name: Venus Nightingale
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born in Vale to a family of Archaeologists. Youngest of three children who were being trained on the family's duty and work. While they sold most of what they found the family would give artifacts from Colossi to the Veritas Clan.

Unknown to Venus, she was a descendent of the Tshawe Clan from beyond the Wall. Within her blood was the power from a Dahaka colossi. 

During "Operation Mute" Venus fell into a coma during the attack on Vale. Taken to Korala by some scientists after realizing the power within her blood.

Over the next six years she was taken care of and researched by scientists who wanted the best for her. Merrani caught wind and tried to take over the project. 

Venus killed one of them after they hurt the scientist who were taking care of her. She ended being sent to Heaven's Gate for safe keeping. Has been there for three years now.

Name: Vera Thorne
Backstory Bullet Points:
*Born and raised in Mastrazs
*Has a mother and sister
*Joined the Mastrazs army when he was 17 (he lied about his age)
*Calamities happened, his years in the service were rough and full of tragedy
*Grew hatred towards upperclass and their inability to stop arguing with each other and really worry about the real issues
*Deserted the army at 24
*Vera decided to cross the runewall after he deserted. He had enough of Mastrazs politics and duty.
*He knew it would pose a great threat on his life. However, Vera had already put his life in the line since he was 17.
*This would be no more than another trial for him. And if he died in the process? So be it.

*His anger would guide him through

Name: Verge
Backstory Bullet Points:
Verge was created as part of an experiment by Dr. Howard Forrester of Parabellum in order to assist in subduing and capturing dangerous monsters. She developed a close relationship with her creator, however, for unknown reasons she was sold to Tubal and Cain, where she was abused and used for weapons testing. After a full year she escaped, slaughtering her way through the corporate lab until she was chosen by the Worldhelm. Verge seeks to find Dr. Forrester for answers on why she was betrayed, and if she so decides, revenge.

After a mission from the Worldhelm, Verge confronted Forrester and made peace with him before his death. She returned with two sisters: the Doctor's birth daughter and another living weapon created off his research. She also gained an understanding that she had friends among the Goldhearted and didn't have to be so alone.
Quirk:
Fugitive Experiment: When a rule or ability requires you to spend 100 or fewer Hit Points, Mind Points, or
Inventory Points, you may suffer 1d8 Instability Points to ignore that cost.
At the end of each session (approximately four hours of play), you lose 1d6 Instability
Points (to a minimum of zero).
If your Instability Points ever reach 10 or more, you are immediately reduced to 0 Hit
Points and must Surrender. The consequences of this Surrender should be closely tied
to you losing control of your abilities. Then, you lose all Instability Points.

Name: Vespa
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Vespa grew up on her own with only her hound Brody to call family.
• An Explorer of Ruins (volunteered for others expeditions until she could afford her own)
• Avoided being sold into slavery as an orphan, by being quick witted
• Helped in the Rebellion (Also when she became Goldenhearted)
• Yearns for discovery and knowledge to help any way she can.

Name: Victor Cassidy
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Victor and his parents ran a general store in Eckard's Rise
- When the business began to fail when workers from Netherhill stopped coming due to its collapse the Cassidy's General Store needed to close as it was simply no longer sustainable, left town as a result
- While looking for work in New Jamestown encountered a group of outlaws that taught him how to gamble 
- While trying to make some extra zenit this way Victor happened to notice that his opponent was cheating at cards and decided to confront him about it, then his friends got involved and all aimed their guns at Victor. In that most vulnerable moment Victor would have a chance encounter with Stinger, at least that's who he thinks it was.
- Filled with a burning desire to fight for the weak and vulnerable like Stinger may have for him, Victor set out to help people find justice for wrongs committed, it was in one of these confrontations that a strange storm rolled in and swept Victor up and to the Worldhelm

Name: Victoria Kaur
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born 18 years ago to Nefius Kaur before she took leadership of Wimcomb.
* Had a rather strict upbringing. Always wanted to make her mother Proud.
* Trained in swordsmanship, she was never allowed to fight with others or go out on outside maneuvers.
* Ran afoul of one of her mother's advisors when she argued mercy for captured folk. 
* Her mother decided to finally test her, sending her out to fight a group of wights with a small party.
* This is where she discovers that her mother's advisor cursed her, causing her to flee in Terror.
* Once this happened, when she returned home her mother was incensed. She declared Victoria a coward, disowned her, then banished her from Wimcomb.
* Victoria wanders for a while, before she hears of the Expedition through the Rune Wall. Desperate for anything to give her a chance to redeem herself, she joins that expedition...

Name: Vigo Mortenkaisen
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Vigo is from an Aristocratic family in Brightshield who are focused on the way of the blade.
- She left home as was customary for her family at 21, and took a new last name as she travelled.
- She was picked up by the Worldhelm when she was weathering a particularly rough storm.
