- She has since been quietly assisting in the background, trying to lookout for those who seem to get overshadowed by more pressing matters.

Name: Vik (Vicorous) Aracar
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Vik, son of a marksman, was raised to be a hunter but was bad at it. He learned to support people with symbols rather then use a bow. 
- Moved out and lived their life as a tattoo artist and helped in hunts every now and then. He is still very, very bad at hunting, and uses his symbols instead.
- Almost a decade later Vik went on a hunt with their old father and almost died to a Draugr.
- Seeing this, their stubborn father ventured and asked a mage to craft a crossbow for Vik. He ended up stealing the crossbow for himself before it was finished.
- Angry mage found father and murdered him after Vik received the bow.
- Vik found his father and spiraled quickly. He walked out of camp, got lost in the snow, and on deaths door he found the Worldhelm. 

(Vik assumes his father commissioned the magical crossbow, and was killed in a robbery)
Remort Changes: None, little changes were made to the Merchant Tinker and Symbolist classes

Name: Viliana Atent
Backstory Bullet Points:
- 3rd eldest child of one of the current Prime Chroniclers.
- Seen as both one who has potential to become a Chronicler and someone to has no drive to learn something practical at the same time. Thanks to this potential she underwent the trials and succeeded in being able to access the power in her bloodline.
- She will follow the strangest threads in pursuit knowledge for her own goal of trying to make the "perfect" world, following-up on the strangest threads of knowledge.
- The strange energy coming from the chamber of The Black Tear though? That seems to be the first serious thing she wanted to help look into. It would be during this a spark of energy would engulf and bring her to the Worldhelm.

Name: Viola Molie
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Viola is a younger vampire, but she is also one who was quick to fall into her role for the Molie family.
- She took to her role as a Steward very well, becoming another nameless face in the crowd for many.
- In playing her part, she met a man who aided in her goal of appearing as a simple young woman. A performance of a spur-of-the-moment young romance that was cut short. Something that was supposed to be a mundane moment.
- In the most recent years, she was given one task. Find a Forsaken who has caused too many problems with her family and others. So for reasons not given to her, she was tasked to work alongside the man from her previous years until the job is done of her family no longer saw it beneficial.

Name: Violet
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Carmelita Aneta, codenamed Violet, was adopted by elite assassins after her parents' death and raised by a brutal mentor named Yori.

- Trained to suppress her emotions and become a ruthless killer, Violet harbored resentment toward her mentor.

- She seized the opportunity to betray Yori when a - group of Vignettes was tasked with eliminating her, killing Yori with a single shot.

- Violet was taken in by another Vignette member, who taught her hacking skills in addition to her combat training.

- After connecting with 100G officers, she became a Vignette assassin, eventually rising to become the right-hand woman of a 100G higher-up.

Name: Vista Wynn
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Was sired as a result of a deal with the Star-Eyed Stranger - one of those "give you great power in exchange for your firstborn" kind of deals. Upon taking the deal, Vista's human parent went "okay, so when do we start?"
* Grew up as an adoptee of a mob/mafia kind of deal. Used for her innate tychokinesis - manipulation of luck. Got herself out when she was young.
* Went to Tradesfair to be a dealer at a shady gambling den, with the intent of scamming rich fucks out of their money. Not many of those types show up at the place she worked at - she found she was just taking from those who didn't have much money to begin with.
* Leapt at the opportunity to do something better with herself.

Name: Vital Courtemanche
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born the son of merchants, but quickly found himself unsuited for it.
- Became rebellious as a teenager, getting into fights among other misdeeds.
  - Met a girl one night who taught him to embrace all of life's joys. 
  - Vital did not fully understand what she meant by that and just became a debaucherous young bachelor.
- Years later, he encountered the girl again during a gala. She was not impressed. 
  - She explains again, carefully this time, that it was about finding the good in everything, and not just drowning in vices.
  - Now realizing what she meant, Vital gets himself disowned in a huge public display. 
- Vital dedicates his life to protecting the precious and beautiful things in this world. He becomes an adventurer, using his old moniker “The Bantam Phantom”
- One day, he thought he saw the mystery woman once more, chasing her into the forest. After a prolonged pursuit, he emerged the other side not in a clearing but instead on The Worldhelm.

Name: Vivian Ashblanc
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Vivian was born to the Ashblancs, a family allied to the Ashwynds in pursuit of fighting off the monsters of the night. 
- In a bid to unite their houses as their populations dwindled, Vivian was betrothed to Ronan as children. The two were very close, and it seemed like the marriage would be able to go off without a hitch until Ronan was discovered to be half-fey and exiled.
- Chasing after his trail, Vivian found Ronan nigh dead in the snow, with a Moonshard monster approaching. Taking its attention and fleeing, the scuffle heavily wounded her with ice magic.
- This encounter gave her budding magic, and her family sent her from their home in Dryholde to Hudal Academy.
- She focused on her archery more than magic, and was going to be expelled when the Red Moon happened.
- After the sacrifice of Tonis protected Hudal, she rushed home... but found it empty. She followed their trail, then stumbled into a fae crossing. She was saved from the fate of Fae Lost only by the Realmstorm.

Name: Void
Backstory Bullet Points:
- A human who was once taken as part of the a program within Termina City, led by Baylore, something meant to help all of humanity.
- During preparation of the operation they found another volunteer that later became Subject Xan-17.
- The operation led them to becoming Void, a human-moonfallen hybrid. 
- Due to the nature of moonfallen, he was only allowed to leave during experiment procedures, forming a kinship with the other experiments before being sealed into a suspended animation chamber.
- While the operation was a hesitant success, there was no time to implement Void in a meaningful capacity before the bombs were dropped onto Termina City.
- For the last 60 years, he has been suck in that suspended animation chamber, the only person he could mentally communicate with was Zyx-8 (Olea's Guy), the escape was provided via realmstorm.

Name: Void Thunderstar
Backstory Bullet Points:
-An orphan born in the Southern Colonies, learned to work, steal and survive by any means available, learning early in his life how to control and charge electricity into different objects.
-For that reason he ended up working for Nova Wardrobes at a special space suits, accessories and gear workshop in Silver rock  until he decides to try to make the Southern colonies a better place for the creatures.
-While living and surviving on the colonies, understanding each biome and necessity for the creatures, he suddenly discovers that NTTech also sells creatures no matter what purpose they're being bought for. 
-Void decides to try to sabotage or maybe even stop any attempt of selling creatures.
-5 years later, he's sucked into strange storm in one of his expeditions, and expands his motivations to protect any creature and lifeform from the Realmstorms.
Relevant Arcana: Beast of the stars, Gazer Nova

Name: Vyldur Ulfsson
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Warrior in the Black Wolf Warband, persuaded by Maign's charisma
- Fought fiercely, enhanced by Chimerist shaman ritual
- Ritual went awry, permanently altering him
- Later miscorrected, some changes remained and became his Mutant powers
- Enhanced senses from being part Wolf enabled him to see the cruelty that Maign's words had blinded him to.
- Freed slaves and left the Warband
- Later hunted down by Warband warriors and fought
- Fell off a cliff into a Realmstorm, later found by the Worldhelm.

Name: Waylen Karson
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Mother died before he could remember
- Father took care of him throughout his whole life
- After getting a job at a startup company, his father disappeared
- He searched for his father, to no avail
- However, that search made him realize that people were hurting, and turning to the gangs that only drag out their suffering
- He quit his job, stealing the prototype they had been working on
- He took up the mantle of Millenium to take on the gangs that make things worse, to help the people that need it, and eventually, to take on the corps that leave the gangs in charge
Remort Changes: Added the line about being able to swap frames on a level up in Pilot. Otherwise, just keeping in mind the issue of a module breaking if he hits Crisis or Surrenders.

Name: Web
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born in the Winter Court to a jeweller and a healer
Skilled with healing magic from an early age
Grew proud and arrogant with her skill
Promised to heal someone and failed
For a promise broken she was forsaken and cast out of the winter court
Survived alone in the fey wilds until picked up by The Worldhelm

Name: Wen Tian
Backstory Bullet Points:
- grew up in one of the few settlements on the edge of Xiaohai
- father was a rogue cultivator who didnt even bother staying around for his birth
- mother raised him for a time, before she disappeared one day in his teens. a common occurrence for commoners in wujing guo
- left to fend for himself, he made it through a couple years, doing odd jobs to get food into his belly
- by absolute chance, he stumbled upon a cave just outside of the habitable zone, the echo of a master cultivator from back during the war inside
- he studied the echo's technique, adopting the shade as his master, learning the basics of cultivation from it
- eventually, a realm storm occurred in his cave, sending him to the worldhelm. but not before he could commit all of the echo's movements to memory so that he could study them further...

Name: Wido Sandijana
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Arrived in Bastion to become a healer, but got arrested due to lack of medical license.
- Decided to enter the KPLA as an alternative to jail time and eventually gets promoted into a Warden (specifically a Shield and Medical Specialist).

Name: Wilhelm Bergmann
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Raised in Constance, Wilhelm had an unremarkable childhood.

- As soon as he was of working age, Wilhelm began his long career as a miner on the slopes of the Iron Mountains. 

- During his career, he narrowly avoided dying in a natural gas explosion in the mines, leaving his face and upper body burned. His quick response, however, saved the rest of his team and got him on the track to be promoted.

- Wilhelm soon became the foreman of a new mine east of Constance, a high-risk project due to its distance from the city walls.

- One day, Merrani saboteurs came to destroy the mine. While most of the mechs were soon engaged by the KPLA, one of them entered the mines.

- To protect his team, Wilhelm lured the mech to an isolated passage before triggering a cave-in, sealing them both in the earth.

- Refusing to die, Wilhelm salvaged the mech and a large mining rig to craft his mech, the Killborer.

- Burrowing to the surface, Wilhelm vowed to deliver retribution to the Empire of Merrane.

Name: Wyrt
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Wyrt was Raised from a seed in Nezmira by a gardener named Martha.
-Martha was killed for harboring any magic (Wyrt)
-Wyrt goes on fueled by anger and a longing to care for another like he cared for Martha.
-Wyrt joins the party and goes on adventures!
Quirk: Arboreal (Weakness to fire and chosen spell is Curse XL renamed "Rage Vine Bind")
Remort Changes: None Applicable

Name: Xavier Periwinkle Mentos
Backstory Bullet Points:
• First woke up inside of a cauldron of a fey-touched alchemist that recently went missing
• External appearance is a translucent, gelatinous exterior covering a skeletal frame
• Arcane script of strange origin etched into his bones
• Can change parts of his body into different shapes and densities
• Has some fragmented memories of his life before the cauldron, like growing up as a human in a Kor'Tarion village whose name escapes him, and celebrating his 23rd birthday with friends and family
• Friendly, unassuming, and naïve to a fault
• Gets along well with the townsfolk he met after being rescued from the cauldron in the alchemist's shack 
• Determined to search for the person who made him so he can know more about himself after a year of doing odd-jobs around town
• Spent 10 months training in combat by a helpful town guard who was sympathetic to his plight
• Swept up in a Realmstorm soon after taking his first journey outside of his Hyacinthus in pursuit of his overarching goal

Name: Xelsia
Backstory Bullet Points:
Xelsia is the username of a girl named Alexis, whos family were refugees hiding away in the ruins of Termina City. After being caught in the crossfire of a disaster there as a child, she had to be brought to a hospital, and placed into intensive care.

Due to the extent of her wounds, and the exacerbation of her preexisting conditions, the doctors introduced Xelsia to the world of immersive VR gaming, as a means to keep her mind and motor functions intact during what would turn into a years-long hospital stay.

In the world of the game, Xelsia grew up, made friends, learned how to fight, and even discovered her own affinity for magic. Her 24/7 exposure to the game world twisted her perception of reality, however, making her nearly incapable of discerning real life from a new and exciting game. 

Once she was discharged from the hospital, Xelsia worked towards getting a temp ID from SWORD, and took on many dangerous missions, until becoming a Goldhearted.

Name: Xi Jianghsi
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Mother Changli directed a heavenly cultivation sect in Shuanwu City. Taught Jianghsi everything she knew.
- Corrupt cultivator killed his mother because her sect was growing, becoming a threat to his.
- Jianghsi loses most of the influence his family name held, and is humbled by force.
- Learns about the precarious conditions in Shuanwu City and takes it upon himself to make things better.
- Discovers ancient technique left by his mother to summon the help of a celestial dragon spirit.
- Joins a small rebel group, but gets shunted into the Worldhelm by a Realmstorm one day.
Birth Realm: Shuanwu City, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Relevant Arcana: Youlong Hao 光龙昊 (Eternal Heavenly Dragon)
Sheet Link: [I will shape a better future with my own hands.](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PCmjOZCkVjlgheD3SE78S9XhpQrubUM6-QqtM4tYdMM/edit?usp=sharing)

Name: Xing Wei
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Knew about his aptitude for demonic qi from an early age
- His qi aptitude cause him and his family to be shunned
- From a small village near the Stained Forests
- Family killed by a yokai one night, while he could do nothing but hide
- First cultivated demonic qi from the aftermath of his parents' murder
- Learned by feel, fumbling his way through cultivation
- Stalked Teisei, following behind the yokai and corrupt cultivators, cultivating from the aftermath of their battles and killings
- If he could, he tried to help people in trouble, but more often than not, he would only end up getting hurt or coming too late.
Birth Realm: Stained Forests near Sakai, Teisei, Tian Yin
Remort Changes: Only things that changed about Xing Wei's sheet is that his axe does 1 more damage (500z quality; HR+11 now), and his savior weapon does 1 less damage in each form (1500z quality; HR+17 and HR+13 now, respectively)

Name: Xu Yuanmin
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Born in Secret Fern Village
• Chosen as a sacrifice to the Beast King
• Rescued from her fate by a traveling cultivator following the Dao of Cooking, bartering for her release with a meal made in the Heavenly Festival Wok, a relic said to have been used to make feasts for the Gods
• Begged her savior to take her along and teach her, and became his apprentice due to her affinity for Fire Qi, needed to safely use the Heavenly Festival Wok
• Traveled around Shouwang Senlin, although she was mostly in the back of his cart doing dishes and learning. She would hide in the cart for safety when spirit beasts would come seeking delicious meals cooked in the Wok, or corrupt cultivators would come to challenge for or steal it
• Mentor was ambushed during a realmstorm, she left the cart to try to help, and he threw the Wok at her to save her, knocking her unconscious, and she woke aboard the Worldhelm with the Wok
• Seeks to return the Wok, feed the hungry, and learn more of the Dao of Cooking
Birth Realm: Secret Fern Village, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin

Name: Xylia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Childhood Dreamer:
As a child, Xylia was enchanted by the idea of magic and longed to become a mage. However, in Terra, magic is highly controlled, permitted only to select individuals with specific jobs under strict surveillance.

- Shattered Dreams:
Growing up, Xylia realized her dream of becoming a mage was unattainable due to the oppressive system in Terra. This led her to become withdrawn and depressed during her teenage years, feeling trapped by her circumstances.

- A Defiant Choice:
Upon turning 18, Xylia decided she wouldn’t give up on her dream. Instead of attending university, she used her parents' money to purchase a dark magic tome from the black market, fully aware this act would make her a criminal.

- The Ritual and the Deal:
Through the tome, Xylia performed a forbidden ritual to acquire unbound magic, granting her the power she sought. In return, she made a pact with an eldritch being, exchanging something of great value to secure her abilities.

Name: Yarrow Cheung
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Former employee of 100G with blood on her hands as part of it; a loyal worker for over a decade as part of their private army until she nearly got killed in a confrontation.
- After nearly dying, and losing her job while she was bedridden, she had a crisis of morality where she wondered if she was truly doing any good as part of this job.
- She's motivated to become a better person as she recovers. Someone who can do good beyond just guarding the rich at whatever cost to others.

Name: Yin Yue
Backstory Bullet Points:
- **Born in Xuanwu City** and raised in the **Jade Bloom Pavilion**, a minor sect known for its **Heavenly Blossom Theatre**, where music and performance thrive.  

- **Daughter of Yin Mei**, a legendary songstress who practices the Dao of Music and passed this philosophy to Yin Yue.  

- Learned to **cultivate through song**, using her voice to shape the elements, fortify herself, and affect the battlefield.  

- As a **Bishi’e**, she had a natural affinity for cultivation, refining her abilities under her mother’s guidance.  

- Grew up sheltered but aware of the city's corrupt cultivation practices and the suffering of mortals in the blood mines.  

- Inspired by her mother’s teachings and driven by personal ambition, she chose to venture beyond her home, seeking both to restore harmony and to make a name for herself.
Birth Realm: Xuanwu City, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Quirk:
BOON OF AUSPICIOUS WISDOM
You are one of the Bishi’e, a qilin-like people blessed by one of the sealed gods. You gain access to arcanist rituals of the knowledge domain. You also learn one spell from the elementalist, entropist, or spiritist lists. (Spell Chosen: Heal)

>When you take the Study action, your check triggers a critical success if both dice show the same number (and the Check is not a fumble).

Curse of Heavenly Enmity

Name: Yorick Medraut
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Alone on the streets of Skuala, Yorick grew up as an urchin. His parents were taken from him by Nezzim as suspect mages, and he was left to the streets.
- He met a man who took him in, trained him how to fight, and eventually died protecting him. "Maelstrom" was what people called him.
- He took the Bandalore Dusk from Maelstrom. A magical childrens toy made from the shells of Kiir, which he used to fight.
- As he grew up, he took to the streets, mirroring Maelstrom's heroic actions and taking matters into his own hands. With time, he would come to be known as "The Pale Maelstrom", guided by his motivation to be a symbol.
- Since joining the Worldhelm, he'd learned more information about the origin of the Bandalore Dusk. It's volatility, and it's danger. He is unbothered, though, fighting on.

Name: Yoyoy
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Raised in the care of his cultivation teacher

- Trained in cultivation for decades until becoming a teacher himself in the mountains south of Tikba Rainforest, spending several more decades training disciples.

- His training hall is set ablaze by Defilers, causing Qi deviation in Yoyoy. Yoyoy's poisonous Qi begins to wreak havoc on his body as it is no longer kept under control.

- Yoyoy and his disciples are captures by the Defilers and dragged into the Land of the Defiled

- While being dragged through the desert, Yoyoy's disciples sacrifice themselves to allow Yoyoy to escape into the desert.

- Yoyoy wanders for days before collapsing from starvation and the poison running through him. It is here on the brink of death that Yoyoy was taken by the Worldhelm.

Name: Yue Liang Er Xian 月亮儿咸
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born Eldest of twins, eldest no cultivate, younger cultivate
Ignored by parents, had a large group of friends
Sought out a cursed item to become a cultivator
Brother burned out and left, took up responsibilities
Learned grappling, became successful tournament fighter
Brother returned, became chef, no consequences. 
Lost major fight, struggling to find direction.

Name: Yuel F. Welkheim
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in Cronis rather peacefully as a farming lad along with his friend Nasaya, whom he would share wonderous visual magic.
- Parents believed he was going to become a successor as he had connected to the Soul Stone along with the great magical affinity within him.
- Along with his childhood friend Nasaya, who actually became a successor, traveled to Erdelkeith to learn from Soul Witches of the Erdelward Coven and its practices.
- Showed to be highly adept with learning, handling and understanding magic, becoming treated high favored with Soul Witches.
- They are of a very curious sort, seeking answers to mysteries, magic and solutions to the problems that ruin and rot the green and life of the land he loves, he is open to understand all kinds of magical practice.
- They left with their long time friend to the Runewall to see if this mysterious and even lethal anomaly could provide answers about the nature of the calamity in their lands, along with great curiosity and wonder.

Name: Yui Kiddo
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Mother was falsely convicted of a crime by a Biotech Company's security detail and went to prison.

- Lashing out at corpos landed her in a position to become a Private Investigator/Hired Thug.

- She found out that she had a weird connection with  the city itself, able to draw upon the power of the city to fight.

- Was eventually called to the Worldhelm but still holds that anger toward Corpos and anyone who preys on the weak.

Name: Yukari (縁)
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a hidden Yokai village near the Burning Lake, raised by Kuzunoha priests to protect their shrine

- Irreverent and freedom-loving, she'd often skirt duty to explore the surrounding woods

- One day, came across an Ald lad, Jesper,  alone and wounded. She healed him and sent him on his way.

- They would meet again many times, slowly growing close. One day, she took him to her village in secret, to see the sights.

- The next day, there were raiders at the village's door, and Jesper was among them. There was pain in his expression.

- The raiders were defeated, at great cost. Jesper fled. And Yukari was banished for her treason.

- Two years of lonely wandering later, Yukari found herself at the Sunfire Citadel. At first, believing in their mission was a convenient lie. But when Ragnarok came, and she had the chance to flee... she didn't. 

- She didn't alter the battle's end. But something changed in her heart that day. And so, one day, she awakens in a strange place...
Quirk:
The Beast Who Spoke
- Natural Weapon
- Can equip Custom Weapons

Name: Yule the Ascetic
Backstory Bullet Points:
- An experienced traveler, rationmaster and survivalist. Has journeyed all over Eurys, working as a deliverer of goods.
- At a young age, tried to steal the power of the Crystal of Eternity and got branded as a result-- a curse that prevented him from ever bonding with the Gaia Crystals, or properly making use of any magic (save for Symbolism--something he doesn't yet know).
- Cursed with both an inability for magic and a lack of martial talent, he picked up on survival techniques and alchemy instead -- something he termed "mastering the world rather than its magic". Despite this, Yule would often struggle from his curse and even be treated as an outcast in many places.
- On a trip to the southern side of Eurys, the ship he was working on got waylaid by sea monsters. Unable to protect his crewmates, Yule watched as his ship would get battered by the monsters and then dragged into the Realmstorm known as the "Runewall", with him as the only survivor.

Name: Yumiko
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From Garatsumi caravan
- learned swordplay early
- magic is expressed through swordarts
- Is already infected with godblood, currently "inactive" recieved from a draugr he "killed".
- half kitsune, half ald
- grew up mostly sheltered for aldistir standarts.
Remort Changes: None, we ball

Name: Yuna Manami
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Yuna Manami was a starry eyed girl from South Rock when she first began her foraying into working as a temp. Born into a family of competent swordsmen, Yuna was directed onto the the temp worker path from a young age.

- During her time she met a man named Gabriel, who served as a specialist and handler for a ragtag group of temp workers.

-  It wasn't long until Gabriel and her grew close. And she made fast friends with the other members of their group. Her future was looking bright, until a operation gone wrong took the lives of three of their group.

- Pushed into a corner and desperate, her sword skills were not enough to save her friends. Despite the clear directions to not open the prototype box they had been tasked with collecting. Yuna did so, in the hopes that maybe whatever was in it would save her and allow her to avenge her fallen comrades.

- Before she knew it, she had bound herself to the experimental weapon. Shackling her and the surviving members with debt to ETA.

Name: Yunalesca  Francesca
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Divine Knight:
Yuna is a human girl who serves as a "knight" for the divine being Caladrius, dedicated to his will and purpose.

- Eternal Guardian of Paradise:
She spent an extensive amount of time as a knight in the sub-realm known as Paradise, a divine sanctuary under Caladrius’s domain.

- Master of Social Dynamics:
Surrounded by the same people for centuries, Yuna grew weary of the stagnant relationships within Paradise. This monotony, however, sharpened her skills in reading people and forging meaningful connections.

- A Longing for Adventure:
Boredom with her static life eventually pushed Yuna to seek something new, leading to her arrival in the Worldhelm and beyond.

Name: Yuzuki Kurayami
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Heavenly Mountains to Oni Warchief Gomako and a human father.
- Estranged from her father after he was recalled to Amagi to serve as a spy.
- As a child, she followed her cold, commanding mother like a shadow—earning the name Kurayami, not out of love, but ownership.
- Trained relentlessly to meet the insurmountable expectations of her mother; strength was valued, affection was not.
- Formed a quiet bond with Tsumugi, a half-oni dancer—soft, warm, and everything Kurayami was not.
- Tsumugi saw something in her no one else did; for the first time, Kurayami felt something stir, feelings.
- In the battle for Amagi, Kurayami earned respect, her command echoing her mother’s legacy.
- Afterward, she reunited with her father, who gave her his surname: Yuzuki. The gesture awakened something human in her.
- Seeking purpose, Yuzuki fled Amagi with Tsumugi.
- Days later, a Realmstorm struck, casting them onto the Worldhelm—where they may become more than what they were made to be.

Name: Yuzuru  Eiji
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Son of a "Japanese" Mom and Dad, has a younger sister.
- Dad became an Insolvent when medical bills couldn't be paid/mom got swindled by loan sharks and his dad passed away. 
- He's now working as a temp to become a legendary temp and effectively have his family never worry about expenses again.
- Got augments done to have his body and mind keep up with the work of being a temp for 100gs though is willing to work for all companies save for Tubal & Cain.
- Despite being a temp, he behaves like an honorable samurai and not just a lawless merc. 
- Has begun to study Cultivation and master his newfound "Dao of Cut". 
- Training to become a Master Swordsman.
Quirk: Fugitive Experiment (this may be dropped or change due to Terra lore explanation & Daoist things)
Relevant Arcana: N/A (Though will be taking Arcanist levels potentially later, specifically Nimue)

(Navigator becomes Spiritual Bridge & Psychic Gifts changed to Psychokinesis (Qi Infusion)

Name: Yvette Lavigne
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born magic, formative years spent preparing her for excellence in schooling.

- Was listless, coasted on her talent and used studies to get away from her problems. Became a student at Korala Academy.

- Went to a magic font near Korala and egained her enthusiasm for study as she worked to try and create a sentient machine.

- The project was abandoned by everyone as the funding dried up. Except for Yvette and a chassis she was given that she called Beau. Still determined to give it life. She failed, but discovers Root, who gives her mech life.

- Spends a few months on the island. Returning to the mainland, now fused with a plant, and with Beau. She was immediately apprehended but allowed Beau to get away. She now resides in Heaven's Gate

Name: Zahra Gantzmann
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Ashlands, grew up hearing stories of better places.
- Grows up.
- Takes an old notebook from her mother that details a demon binding ritual. Pulls it off, though it does cost her a chunk of her soul in the process... Worth it though, because now she has a little demon of hunger named Glöetts, and his being involved opens *so many doors.* Demonic doors.
- Hops the border to live out the "good life" in the New Empire.
- Get there. Shit sucks, but the merc pay is good, especially when she comes with a demon as a package deal. Fill my pockets, but I need something better. 
- Cut ties with the empire, join the Adventurer's Guild instead.
- Get eaten by a fucking tornado or some shit.

Name: Zaid al Thuaban'n
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Travels around the sand dunes of Nezmira with his family's caravan. They revere the god Falak-khan - 'aspirants'.
- As the scion of his family, Zaid inherits the heirloom 'The Skin of the Serpent who Flew'. One day this relic will help reignite faith in the god.
- Through worship and the trials of life on the dunes, Zaid was bequeathed powers to help serve and venerate the god. His mantras are capable of manipulating the world around him, and Zaid can even change his body to take on aspects of the Wingless Serpent.
- Part of his family lineage is trapped in servitude to the empire in The Blue City. This echoes the repression of Falak-khan's dream to fly by Sariyah.
- Zaid seeks an end to slavery in Nezmira, and to revive the religion of Falak-khan in the realm.

Name: Zaizen (財前)
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Sold to oni at birth, then traded to ninja clan
- Survived brutal training to become an assassin
- Affinity for metal cultivation
- Learned of a sister enslaved to Oni
- Desperate greed to raise money for her freedom

Name: Zaylee Malloy
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in Lastport, Kor'Tarion.
* Was trained by her Father.
* *Really* liked to get into fights in her teen years.
* Also met a new friend during those years.
* Friend helped her set up small bouts as they traveled when she was at 21.
* Bouts slowed down during big demon attacks and the storm, but still did them when they could. Even if it was just for a little bit and to stay warm.
* Realmstorm happens while she was passed out after doing some late night training and looking out at the night sky.

Name: Zenith Igonyama
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in Rocade
* Wanna kill abominations
* Elders say protecting the forest is more important than going on the offensive
* Migrate to Mastrazs rather than listening
* Seek out Fuck it's way less foresty here
* End up in Erdelkeith
* Refined her Rocadian Eidolan magic via magical education from the witches, not really into the religion but wholeheartedly believe in protecting humanity
* Bond with a sick ass witch creature
* Deployed to fight abominations
* Witch creature is starving from lack of magic
* Go to realmstorm to feed on its magic
* Whoops, yubel

Name: Zero
Backstory Bullet Points:
-An Ophidiya
-Descendant of the Dragonlord of Dusk Layl
-Survived in the sand dunes and was hunted by the  Nezzim
-Picked up by Goldhearted after watching mom die from the Kiir

Name: Zeul
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Zeul belongs to an order of priests that live at the Oracle's Temple that is still hidden from the outside world.
- He rose in the ranks to proper priest hood and was chosen to act as a representative of the Oracle
- He knows he is not to reveal the location of the temple to those who are not worthy.
- He has set out to try and find those capable of helping the grim fate that Nezmira is currently heading towards.

Name: Zinnia Vindex
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Originally a member of the Sabeltiger Gang, a group of hoodlums that took on some of the shadier jobs from ETA.
- Group's 'muscle'. Breaking and entering, assault and battery, destruction of property, you name it.
- Tattooed her skin as a symbol of loyalty to the gang, later infused with nanotech with proceeds from ETA to make her job as the muscle easier.
- Brought to the brink of death during a con gone wrong, betrayed and left for dead by her crew as the fall gal.
- Survived by the skin of her teeth and her implants from ETA, went dark for several weeks before returning to society changed.
- Attempting to become a better person divorced from working directly with big corpo, believing her near-death experience to be the result of karma. Caught in a Realmstorm on her way to an interview for a construction working position.
Quirk:
Heirloom

Nanomachine Tattoos | Accessory
Quality - Adrenaline. When you recover Hit Points, if you are in Crisis, you recover 5 extra Hit Points.

Complication: These tattoos may give rise to civil unrest due to the clear gang-association of their design or through proactive elements that recognize them. The user herself must be continuously active outside of moments of rest or suffer potential impediments caused by overdosages of regenerative properties.

Name: Zlata Lyakhovich
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Orphaned in The Lost City of Markin before the calamity came. Zlata was cursed at birth to see, and be able to communicate with spirits and the undead.
- No one in town would take her in, and in fact, most people wanted her removed from their city. She ended up being taken in by a "lackluster" Knight of the city named Ivor Lyakhovich. He would become her foster father.
- Zlata showed an early interest in magic, though she seemed to lack much talent. In order to be able to protect herself, Ivor took to training her with a bow. 
- Zlata used to be afraid of the spirits that would come to her, but as she got older, she began to speak with them more, and even help some of them with whatever problems they may have.
- When the calamity came to Markin, Zlata fought off the hordes of monsters alongside her master, who ended up being killed in the fighting.
- Zlata left home, hoping to find some place to belong. Her journey lead her to the Runewall, and whatever may happen beyond it...

Name: Zmeika Balefire
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Balefire Cult Origins:
Zmeika hails from the Draconic Balefire Cult as the First Draken Daughter of the Hoard Subsect. Despite her strained relationship with the sect, she maintains ties out of deep concern for her sister, Shuffle, who remains within the cult.

- A Wayward Spirit:
Known for her immense physical strength, Zmeika’s carefree and adventurous nature made her difficult to control. She often escaped into the forest to explore, play, and seek excitement, prioritizing her own desires over her responsibilities.

- A Disappointment to the Sect:
Zmeika’s refusal to embrace her role earned her the sect’s scorn. They viewed her as a failure, with many members growing resentful of her inability to meet expectations despite her innate potential.

- Becoming Goldhearted:
An assassination attempt by another Draken Daughter from another sect almost ended Zmeika’s life. Her fall was intercepted by the Worldhelm, saving her from death and giving her the opportunity to become Goldhearted.

Name: Zoe Michaels
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born to the Michaels Family, owners of ‘Michaels Strategic Tactical Solutions,’ an arm of SWORD.
Third child, first daughter. Doted on and *hates* it.
As she grew older, she was paraded around by her father and brothers at expensive networking events. She resented these, but played her part.
During testing on an experimental drug, she snuck into the family lab and took some drugs. These drugs seem to have given her certain minor magical abilities that she is learning to hone.
When she was informed that she was to be married to Edward Lowell Jr., she had a bit of a crash out. 
Gained a temp license with SWORD. Started Mercenary work. Is bad at it.
Her father, Alex Michaels, has cut her off until she has accepted “her destiny” (His words)
She is defiant still, and it is this defiance that caught the worldhelm’s attention…

Name: Zoi Katsaros
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in Grey Fox Castle, learning her best on how to navigate Dreadlan's perils, both physical and social
- Learned from a young age that people with leverage tend to get the upper hand socially
- Learned how to take someone's most valuable item from a subordinate of the King in Gold
- Eventually was given the push to attend Gnosis Academy by her Father, who deals with the political landscape within Akala's domain
- Became a Gnosis Student at 19, and undertook the Rite of Arms Ritual at 20, to show her commitment to the Academy's mission of killing the True Arcanum, but still has yet to find a Regent

Name: Zophiel
Backstory Bullet Points:
A fleeing survivor of the Night of the Red Sky in Dryholde. Her single father who raised her was killed by demons. Her mother is alive, though she is unknown to Zophiel. 

Zophiel was lost until reaching Brightshield, at which point she enlisted as a Crusader.

Became a Goldhearted, following the sense of purpose she felt, believing this was what her father's spirit wanted for her.

Her faith in the King was shattered by fellow Goldhearted who convinced her of his current "condition." Between this and some key experiences with a partcular demon, she has become critical of the crusade and her own role in it.

Now she trusts in the direction provided by the Worldhelm, even if she does not fully trust herself to make the right calls.
Quirk:
Heirloom. Formulaic Accessory (1000z)

Hand of Albertus, a fiery hand tied to her father that allows Zophiel to use alchemic powers. 

Flaw: The Heirloom is demonic in nature, and may become an external source of negative emotions when she is in danger.
Remort Changes:
3 points in Secret Formula was moved to potion rain (2) and Gadgets (magispheres), due to the changes in the Tinkerer playtest (Secret Formula no longer provides damage to Magitech Armament)

Gadgets (Magispheres) choices:
Reinforce
Elemental Shroud

Name: Zora
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Created by T&C as a killer 
- Experimented on until they escaped 
- Became a Vignette because it was the only job they thought they knew how to do
- Lived a few years by themselves killing others to thrive 
- Found an orphan and took them under their wing for two years
- T&C found Zora and killed her child Vivian
- Sword revenge on T&R and grew their mountains of money to help fund anti-T&C movements 
- Got beamed up when dreaming of their dead daughter

Name: Zuozhi Xitian
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Terra, Haven

- Her father was a part of the Goldnails Mafia, always trying to get her to be a part of it as well

- While never her style, she always found herself searching for excitement in Terra. So much violence, unneeded suffering. Why not just have some fun?

- She eventually started streaming to viewers live, what did she stream? her own personal heists of course! under the moniker Shadowflame

- Though as an upstart, she was never the most popular. Her increasingly more dangerous and risky heists gained her some popularity, enough to actually be seen by GaleForce

- While not officially contracted with GaleForce, she'll always have some platform to stream on. To the public and other companies, there's simply nothing Galeforce can do about it, surely?

- Her greatest heist however, was one where she leaked a secret project of Tubal & Cain regarding advanced espertech hinting towards a connection with The Olympians. Granting her T&C's ire
Quirk:
Cursed: Revealing that T&C and The Olympians are working together, attempting to create a near-unstoppable machine using advanced espertech to crush the opposing companies and crime organizations

Effect: Crafted Items often have an unnatural repulsion to Zuozhi, causing them to be pushed away from her.

Name: charlies
Backstory Bullet Points:
Fake eyes where real eyes would be; karmic sight.

They can only read in brail

Books are their hyperfocus

Through game consequences have had their origin/history moved to tian yin.

Can read people's futures/pasts

Will NEVER spoil anything.

cannot lie

goal is to write the greatest book of all time.

Name: the last Stroke of the Canvas
Backstory Bullet Points:
- originally from the Fae Realms, from a group that tended to the dreams of mortals which gathered like dew on a web filled meadow. Every one of the tenders were called  Dream/Nightmare, collecting dew relating to a certain concepts.

- Stroke's concept is 'the last Stroke on the canvas', so they were responsible for dreams of artistry, inspiration, finishing and completion 

- these tenders are focused, like a in trance; by accident, Stroke touched the Dream Dew and found themselves 'awakening' and realizing to wanting more than this suddenly dull life. They learned to use the power of their concept to paint their feelings and reality, disturbing the work in the meadow by waking some siblings from this trance-like work as well.

- Stroke was banished from the meadow by the Elders - to not disturb them further. Now they are in the mortal world (originally Kor'Tarion before becoming an adventurer) and try to feel and experience everything they can, the good and the bad.

Name: Ádhán
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the Singing pools and left when they could fly confidently.

- followed the Sparrows path of becoming a courier and flew around most of firwood

- By the luck his jobs over time kept getting closer and closer to the The Looking Tree

- Met Arzen and in combination slowly becoming friends  while the jobs available pulled him closer to stay around longer and longer

- lucky that a job became available to fully stay at/near the The Looking Tree / Hearthome.

- At some point the bird too full of themselves found a flock among the Lion tribe and wanted to stick together and stayed ever since 

- _Choosing_ not to fly to stay by their friends side since they cannot
Quirk: Planet Oracle - prestige token from charlies

Name: Çuaromo Thiago Estevez
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Tessalia to a family of merchants, lived a fairly normal life.
- At about 19, he would join his uncle on his very first delving expedition. Even at first glance of the ruins beneath the surface, he was in love.
- For some years, he would wander Aranova with his uncle and a pack of delvers, unearthing secrets and treasures.
- During that time he would fall in love, and have a child. These were the happiest years of his life.
- Then he delved too deep, and tragedy struck. His uncle was killed, as was his delving pack.
- Thiago would be the lone survivor, unscathed, but with a curse upon his heart.
- Following this, he would continue to delve, for deeper, for longer - staying beneath the ground for weeks, then months at a time.
- His wife would leave him, taking their daughter. He couldn't even argue the point. He just kept delving.
- He would join the Adventurer's guild, plying his knowledge and expertise to the cause of the common peoples.
- He still hungers to delve.
Other Names: Çuaromo Thiago Estevez De La Santonio

Name: Óscar Serrano
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From a family of conservationists working for NTT within the Southern Colonies.
- Enamored with stories of his great grandfather's time as part of the NTT Nomad Tigers.
- Was passed on his bat, which scored the last home run of the first Baylore World Series.
- Throughout his youth Oscar trained to one day enter the Prime Corp Major League, eventually becoming a batter on the Nomad Tigers like his grandfather.
- Was a popular rising star for a time, before crossing the wrong people by trying to reveal unethical practices in the PCML and being framed for doping during a BWS Qualifier match.
- Now having been kicked out of the league, Oscar is brought onto the Worldhelm as he looks to clear his reputation and become a batter his great grandfather could be proud of.
